Wild caper bushes cling desperately to the calcified mortar joints of a crumbling stone wall, their pale green leaves coated in white dust. You stop briefly in their thin shadow to catch your breath and feel the steady, reassuring weight of the cold ceramic key. The stillness of the desert presses hard against your ears.

The path splits near the remains of the old enclosure, offering choices for the journey ahead.

nodes.brief: The wind drops entirely, leaving the dry basin to hum with the thin, singing vibration of sun-baked window-shards.

exits.label: Advance toward the edge of the great white pan

nodes.title: Singing Glass
nodes.page:
The wind drops entirely, leaving the dry basin wrapped in an eerie hush that hums with the thin, metallic vibration of sun-baked window-shards. Every movement rings out across the flat crust like a plucked harp string. You keep the banked coal-lantern still and listen to the strange music of the dead city.

The open expanse stretches before you under a deepening violet sky.

nodes.brief: Near the broken water-gate, Calder advises you to douse your lantern before the glass-sentries on the ridge spot the glare.

exits.label: Open the draft-vent to let the coals glow ruby-red
Slide the heavy iron shutter closed to hide the light
Strike a sulphur match to wake the banked coals anew

nodes.title: The Broken Gate
nodes.page: Near the broken water-gate, Calder holds up a warning hand and advises you to douse your lantern before the glass-sentries on the ridge spot the revealing glare. The cold metal casing of the lamp ticks softly as the coals inside bank against the lack of draft. Every shadow among the ruined masonry looks like a toll-lord watcher.

nodes.brief: You crouch behind a low windbreak of stacked slate, debating whether the coming dusk requires the ember-lamp's warmth.

exits.label: Spin the draft-vent wide to warm the cold air
Strike a sulphur match against the rough stone
Press the iron damper shut and march into the starlight

nodes.title: The Slate Windbreak
nodes.page:
You crouch low behind a windbreak of stacked slate, debating whether the biting evening chill requires the warmth and glow of the ember-lamp. The wind whistles through the gaps in the stone, carrying the scent of parched earth and distant woodsmoke. Your fingers trace the cold contours of the Seedkey hidden inside your coat.

The time has come to leave the shelter of the ridge and choose your path into the dark.

nodes.brief: Solitary in the deepening gloom, you reach for your tinder-box while a cold evening draft stirs the alkaline dust.

exits.label: Open the draft vent wide
Slide the heavy shutter closed
Press on into the starlight

nodes.title: Striking the Flint
nodes.page:
Darkness pools in the hollows of the rim road while a sharp draft carries the alkaline sting of the dry basin. Cold fingers fumble with the tin tinder-box, scraping flint against iron to coax a stubborn spark from the charred cloth within. Each tiny flash illuminates the frosted salt crust underfoot and the heavy ceramic Seedkey pressing cold against your ribs.

Before the ember catches or dies in the wind, a decision must be made regarding the lantern's glow and the long miles ahead.

nodes.brief: Calder taps the iron casing of your lantern, reminding you that lit coals draw both well-thieves and mirror-sentries.

exits.label: Slide the iron shutter closed
March out with grey smoke

nodes.title: Calder's Sharp Warning
nodes.page:
Metal clinks against metal as Calder taps a gloved knuckle sharply against the iron casing of your lantern. The glass-diver leans in close, smelling faintly of brine and sun-bleached rope, muttering that every lit coal on the crust acts as a beacon for wandering well-thieves and mirror-sentries alike. The warning hangs heavy in the settling frost while the vast white expanse waits silently beyond the ridge.

You eye the glowing seam of the lantern and weigh the risk of visibility against the encroaching night.

nodes.brief: A flock of startled sand-grouse erupts from a dry gully as the first violet shadows stretch across the white salt.

exits.label: Strike a sulphur match
March out into the starlight

nodes.title: Wings Over Salt
nodes.page:
A flock of startled sand-grouse bursts from a dry gully, pale wings battering the evening air and shattering the stillness. Long violet shadows stretch quickly across the blinding white salt, swallowing the last bruised traces of sunset behind the western hills. After the sudden movement the stony track goes quiet, save for the crunch of your boots on the crust.

Standing amid the fading light, you must choose how to manage your flame before complete darkness falls.

nodes.brief: You stand at the crossroads where the cart-track dissolves into the trackless basin, checking your flint and steel.

exits.label: Slide the heavy shutter closed
Strike a sulphur match to wake the tin

nodes.title: The Crossroads Dust
nodes.page:
Loose gravel shifts beneath your soles where the worn cart-track finally dissolves into the trackless, glittering pan of the great basin. Your thumb tests the sharp edge of your flint and steel, ensuring the striker is ready for whatever the salt wastes might demand. A low whistling wind carries the distant scent of ancient dust across the flat horizon.

With the civilized road behind you, a choice of how to carry your light into the wilderness must be made.

nodes.brief: Calder points out a distant amber blink on the horizon, signaling that the Glasswrights are swapping night-watches on Prism.

exits.label: Wake the tin lantern with a match
Press the iron damper shut

nodes.title: Amber on the Rim
nodes.page:
Far across the pale curvature of the basin, a sharp amber blink stabs through the gathering dusk like a needle of fire. Calder points a weather-roughened finger toward the distant horizon, noting that the Glasswrights are swapping their high night-watches upon the spires of Prism. The signal flashes twice more before dissolving back into the purple haze of the upper ridges.

You adjust the leather strap of your pack and decide how to proceed with the journey.

nodes.brief: The track ends abruptly at the edge of the great white pan, where night rushes down from the hills without twilight.

exits.label: Bank the coals into a dark secret
March out with only thin smoke

nodes.title: The Edge of Night
nodes.page:
Earth and salt drop away into an absolute hush as the winding track terminates abruptly at the lip of the great white pan. Night does not creep here; it rushes down from the jagged hills in one stroke, leaving no room for twilight or hesitation. The air turns instantly crisp and biting, smelling of ancient mineral beds and frozen dew.

Facing the vast, dark emptiness ahead, you consider the best way to handle your lamp.

nodes.brief: At the Last Lamp-Stall, you spin the draft-vent wide open, letting the coal-pan glow ruby-red against the biting night chill.

exits.label: Press on across the salt

nodes.title: The Ruby Glow
nodes.page:
Iron screeches softly as you spin the draft-vent wide open against the biting chill of the plateau. A brilliant ruby-red glare spills from the coal-pan, casting long dancing shadows across the weathered timber walls of the Last Lamp-Stall and warming your numbed fingers. The sudden brightness feels defiant against the encroaching dark of the basin.

With your lantern blazing brightly, the path forward calls for immediate action.

nodes.brief: By the tethering-post of the Last Lamp-Stall, you slide the heavy iron shutter closed, banking the coals into a dark, smoky secret.

exits.label: Press on into the dark

nodes.title: The Smoldering Secret
nodes.page:
Heavy iron slides home with a dull metallic thud beside the weathered tethering-post of the Last Lamp-Stall. You bank the glowing coals into a dark, smoky secret, trapping the heat within thick plates so no wandering sentry on the ridges can spot your passing. The surrounding night closes in thick and black, demanding absolute reliance on memory and touch.

Enveloped in shadows with only a wisp of grey exhaust, you prepare to move out.

nodes.brief: Amid the smell of mutton-tallow and roasting barley at the Last Lamp-Stall, you strike a sulphur match to wake the tin lantern.

exits.label: Press on toward the basin

nodes.title: The Sulphur Match
nodes.page:
Thick aromas of roasting barley and mutton-tallow hang heavy in the air around the Last Lamp-Stall as you scratch a sulphur match against the rough wood. A sharp, chemical hiss flares into a bright yellow flame, which you promptly feed to the wick and tin burner of your traveling lamp. The metal vessel warms reassuringly in your palms as the yellow glow cuts through the yard-dust.

With the lantern fully awake, you ready yourself to leave the safety of the stalls.

nodes.brief: Under the creaking sign of the Last Lamp-Stall, you press the iron damper shut, marching out into the starlight with only a thin wisp of grey smoke.

exits.label: Press on into the starlight
Turn back toward the shelter

nodes.title: The Iron Damper
nodes.page:
Rough timber beams of the Last Lamp-Stall creak overhead as you press the heavy iron damper firmly shut with your thumb. Only a thin, escaping wisp of grey smoke betrays the banked heat within the metal casing as you step boldly out into the freezing starlight. The vast, salt-crystalled plain stretches endlessly before you, silent and waiting.

Leaving the warmth of the outpost behind, you weigh whether to continue forward or retrace your steps.

nodes.brief: By the oil-scummed horse-trough of the lower square, you strike a flint to catch the wick before the night-chill sets in.

exits.label: Step toward the sunken crevice along the rim road
Turn away toward the crumbling lime-kiln ruins
Follow the path beneath the skeletal salt-wain

nodes.title: By the Oil-Scummed Trough
nodes.page: Flint sparks catch the oily wick in the lower square just as the evening wind begins to carry the bitter tang of old brine. Shadows stretch long across the cracked flags, and the weight of your ceramic key feels cold against your ribs.

nodes.brief: You tuck the cast-iron lid tight over the glowing coals of your belt-lantern, feeling only the dull warmth against your thigh.

exits.label: Step down the eastern wagon ruts
Follow the narrow footpath past the cairn
Take the stony track toward the ridge

nodes.title: The Cast Iron Lid
nodes.page:
You tuck the cast-iron lid tight over the glowing coals of your belt-lantern, feeling only the dull warmth against your thigh. Out on the Rim Road, the white dust stretches like a bone-field under the cold stare of the stars, promising nothing but miles of dry gravel and the occasional whisper of wind through skeletal salt-bush. Every breath tastes of alkaline grit, reminding you that the low murmur of Candlemere's tallow-vats is fading behind your heels for the last time.

Three distinct tracks diverge where the old wagon-ruts bite deep into the crust, each one leading toward a different hazard of the arid basin rim.

nodes.brief: Beneath the creaking iron sign of the Salt-Weighers' Rest, a squinting drover warns you that the rim road has slipped into a sink-crevice.

exits.label: Tread carefully past the broken timber barricade
Cut across the rubble toward the fallen lime-kiln
Seek out the pedlar beneath the skeletal wagon ribs

nodes.title: The Salt-Weighers' Rest
nodes.page: Squinting under a creaking iron sign, a weathered drover warns you that a stretch of the upper rim road has given way into a deep sink-crevice. The yellow glare of your lamp flickers against the peeling boards of the weigh-house, casting long and jittery shapes across the gravel. You weigh whether to press forward or seek a safer detour.

nodes.brief: Past the tallow-vats, an old cousin thrusts a heel-crusted loaf into your pack and demands you trade it only for rain-warrant.

exits.label: Duck beneath the sagging wire fence
Climb the embankment toward the horse pond
Head straight for the mirror guild tower

nodes.title: The Heel Crusted Loaf
nodes.page:
Past the tallow-vats, an old cousin thrusts a heel-crusted loaf into your pack and demands you trade it only for rain-warrant. The heavy sourdough smells of woodsmoke and stale lard, a stubborn token from a town that has already forgotten how to bloom. You push the crust deep beside your cold ceramic key, feeling its sharp angles dig through the canvas. Every doorway along the lane is shuttered against the coming drought, and the grey dust swirls in listless eddies around your ankles.

Three shadowed paths open up ahead through the perimeter fence, each promising a different trial before the open salt reaches out to greet you.

nodes.brief: Under the orange glare of your raised chimney-wick, three toll-touts from the Salt Court step out from a lime-shed to measure your stride.

exits.label: Slip past the dark horse pond
Cut through the collapsed drying sheds
Scramble up the steep miller mound

nodes.title: The Lime Shed Watch
nodes.page:
Under the orange glare of your raised chimney-wick, three toll-touts from the Salt Court step out from a lime-shed to measure your stride. Their oiled leather coats gleam faintly in the amber wash, smelling sharply of vinegar and cheap brass buttons. One of them taps a heavy ledger against an open palm, eyeing the bulge of your belt-lantern with greedy calculation. The dusty ground beneath your boots feels brittle and treacherous, ready to give way if you make a sudden break for the open flats.

Ahead of you, the lane splits around a crumbling pile of masonry, offering three narrow avenues of escape.

nodes.brief: Behind the drying racks of bladder-wrack, a frightened apprentice drops a pouch of spare flint-stones into your palm and whispers of watchers.

exits.label: Follow the old parish boundary stones
Cross near the high tension fence wire
Seek shelter in the abandoned cistern

nodes.title: The Flint Stone Drop
nodes.page:
Behind the drying racks of bladder-wrack, a frightened apprentice drops a pouch of spare flint-stones into your palm and whispers of watchers. The rough canvas bag feels heavy and alive with sharp edges, a small mercy traded in the reeking gloom of the seaweed sheds. Outside, the wind howls thinly across the salt-crust, carrying the dry rattle of dead stalks from the abandoned kitchen gardens. Your lamp sways at your hip, casting frantic orange leaps against the weathered timbers.

Three uncertain routes beckon out into the gathering dusk beyond the racks.

nodes.brief: In the shadowed ditch where the town ditch-water runs black, you stumble over a discarded harness while keeping your dark lantern hidden.

exits.label: Dodge behind the stone sheep shelter
Pick your way along the basin haul
Climb the bed of the dry irrigation ditch

nodes.title: The Black Ditch
nodes.page:
In the shadowed ditch where the town ditch-water runs black, you stumble over a discarded harness while keeping your dark lantern hidden. The rusted iron buckle bites hard through your trousers into your shin, but you dare not cry out against the sudden pain. Thick vapours rise from the stagnant slime, smelling of rotting reeds and old copper coins lost by travellers long turned to dust. Above the lip of the trench, the grey expanse of the Rim Road waits like a blank page.

Three directions lie open before you in the gloom beyond the sunken bank.

nodes.brief: Beside the locked gate of the western granary, a shivering watchman warms his chilblains against your iron chimney before checking your seal.

exits.label: Make for the gnarled parish thorn tree
Head toward the widening lime stack ditch

nodes.title: The Granary Gate
nodes.page:
Beside the locked gate of the western granary, a shivering watchman warms his chilblains against your iron chimney before checking your seal. His breath fogs grey in the biting draft that sweeps off the barren flats, smelling faintly of turnip-tops and cheap gin. His calloused thumb tracks your stamped wax paper; he grunts without comment while lantern oil sloshes in a dull rhythm. The massive timber doors behind him are barred with iron straps thicker than your wrist.

Three paths fan out from the portal into the sprawling grey expanse.

nodes.brief: At the crossroads of the three-mile well, an old crone sells dried salt-pears while eyeing the yellow glow of your iron burner.

exits.label: Climb the marl ridge toward the dark
Skirt the relay stump by the starlight

nodes.title: The Three-Mile Well
nodes.page:
Dusty wrinkles crease the old crone's face as she hawks leathery salt-pears from a rush basket at the three-mile crossroads. Her rheumy gaze fastens instantly on the yellow glow leaking through the perforated iron chimney of your burner, weighing your chances against the long miles ahead. She offers a withered fruit for a copper, muttering warnings about the dry wash beyond the ridge.

The cold ceramic weight of the Seedkey taps reassuringly against your ribs while the desert wind begins to carry the bitter scent of baked alkali.

nodes.brief: Among the rubble of the fallen lime-kiln, a stray cur sniffs your boot-heel while your banked lantern stays silent and dark.

exits.label: Descend beneath the old aqueduct arch
Pick a path across the alkali flat

nodes.title: The Fallen Lime-Kiln
nodes.page:
Sharp shards of tumbled masonry crunch beneath your heavy boot-heels among the ruins of the old lime-kiln. A lean, mangy cur emerges from the lime-dust, sniffing eagerly at your cuff while your banked lantern remains tightly shuttered and dark against prying eyes. The night air tastes of stale lime and dry earth, thick with the silence of a dying frontier.

You grip the strap of your pack and listen closely for any sound of pursuit from the lamp-town behind you.

nodes.brief: Under the skeletal ribs of an old salt-wain, a nervous pedlar offers to trade a cracked spyglass for your spare oil-skin.

exits.label: Inspect the mirror by the relay post
Traverse the loose gravel of the quarry
Head back toward the dim town lamps

nodes.title: The Salt-Wain Ribs
nodes.page:
Rusted iron ribs of an abandoned salt-wain arch overhead like the skeleton of some prehistoric beast stranded in the dust. Crouched in their meager shadow, a nervous pedlar thrusts forward a scratched, brass-bound spyglass, begging to trade it for your spare oil-skin before the weather breaks. His fingers tremble as he watches the amber flicker of your belt-lamp throw long, jittery shadows across the parched earth.

The option to retrace your steps lingers in your mind as the wind groans through the metal frame.

nodes.brief: In the lee of the chalk-kiln wall, a debt-collector from the court sharpens a skinning knife by the sudden yellow flare of your wick.

exits.label: Slip past toward the relay stump
Push onward across the empty flat

nodes.title: The Chalk-Kiln Wall
nodes.page:
Harsh grinding sounds pierce the quiet as a debt-collector from the salt court hones a heavy skinning knife against the chalk-kiln wall. The sudden, brilliant yellow flare of your wick catches his eye, illuminating a cruel grin beneath his wide-brimmed hat. He pauses his work, testing the razor edge with a scarred thumb while sizing up your gear and your mission.

Every instinct urges you to move before he decides to claim a toll in blood instead of coin.

nodes.brief: By the brackish horse-pond, a knee-deep mire traps your left boot while your dark lantern clicks against a loose belt-ring.

exits.label: Head into the pitch-dark aqueduct
Make for the distant signal mirror
Pick your way toward the lower pit

nodes.title: The Brackish Horse-Pond
nodes.page:
Thick, foul-smelling mud claims your left boot up to the ankle by the margins of the stagnant horse-pond. As you wrench your foot free with a wet sucking sound, your dark lantern strikes a loose iron belt-ring with a sharp, echoing metallic ping. Mosquitoes drift lazy above the brackish scum, and the basin's distant grind seems to press in from all sides.

You balance your weight carefully on solid ground and search for a cleaner path.

nodes.brief: Beneath the leaning telegraph pole of the mirror-guild, a blinking green signal flashes from the ridge above your lifted flame.

exits.label: Walk out onto the wind-swept flat
Inspect the scrawled cattle-gate warning

nodes.title: The Leaning Pole
nodes.page:
High above your lifted flame, a green signal light blinks in rhythmic pulses from the mirror-guild's leaning telegraph pole on the ridge. The sharp scent of ozone and heated copper drifts down through the lattice of wires as the automated relay chatters to itself in coded flashes. You shield your coal-lamp with a gloved hand, wondering if the message overhead speaks of trouble on the salt crust or merely routine weather reports.

The dark track stretches onward into the looming shadows of the basin.

nodes.brief: In the narrow gap between two collapsed drying sheds, a stray donkey brays at the smell of your charred coal smoke.

exits.label: Follow the cliff overhang into the dark
Navigate the rusted sheep-dip wire

nodes.title: The Drying Sheds
nodes.page:
Sharp whiffs of charred coal smoke billow from your ventilation vents as you squeeze through the narrow passage between two collapsed drying sheds. A stray donkey tethered in the rubble lets out a raspy, discordant bray at the scent, startling a flock of dust-sparrows from the thatch. The cramped walls radiate the day's trapped heat, making the air stifling and close around your woolen travel coat.

You quicken your pace as the alley opens up toward the rugged wasteland.

nodes.brief: Across the gravel slope of the miller's mound, a shadow detaches itself from the mill-wheel while you keep your lamp hooded.

exits.label: Check the warning by the gate post
Step carefully around the wire tangle

nodes.title: The Miller's Mound
nodes.page:
Loose gravel shifts beneath your tread as you climb the slope of the miller's mound, keeping your lantern closely hooded against the skyline. A bulky shadow suddenly detaches itself from the rotting timber of the great mill-wheel, pausing to listen in the breathless desert hush. You freeze in your tracks, hand hovering near your belt as you wait to see if the figure is friend, foe, or mere illusion.

The path splits ahead, offering two distinct ways around the obstruction.

nodes.brief: Beside the stone marker bearing the parish boundary, a salt-crusted boot scrap marks where someone turned back in haste.

exits.label: Follow the silt-cliff overhang forward
Bypass the barbed wire near the dip
Brace against the gust on the wash lip

nodes.title: The Parish Boundary
nodes.page:
Weathered stone marks the ancient parish boundary where the cultivated loam finally gives way to the barren white salt crust. A deep boot scrape crusted with dry brine mars the dirt beside the marker, suggesting someone turned back in frantic haste just moments before. Your lantern flame dips and dances in a sudden eddy of cold air rolling down from the basin interior.

You weigh the silent warning left by whoever walked this way before you.

nodes.brief: Under the hum of the high-tension wire-fence, a discarded ledger page flutters against your leg in the dry desert draft.

exits.label: Read the charcoal warning on the timber
Step past the tangled sheep-dip wire
Search the paddock wall for more relics

nodes.title: The Wire-Fence
nodes.page:
High-tension wires hum an electric song overhead, vibrating faintly in the dry desert draft that whips across the abandoned tanner's paddock. A discarded ledger page, yellowed and brittle, snaps loose from a thorn bush and flutters sharply against your shin. Beyond the broken stone wall, an old brass button gleams dull and green in the downward pool of light cast by your lantern.

The open trail beckons past the rusted boundary fences.

nodes.brief: In the hollow of an abandoned cistern, a charcoal-burner shares his greasy mutton fat while your lantern warms his cold fingers.

exits.label: Step out onto the cracking alkali flats
Pick your way toward the silent wind-pump
Follow the coral marker near the old trail

nodes.title: The Cistern Hollow
nodes.page:
Settled within the limestone hollow of a dry cistern, you share a scrap of greasy mutton fat with a lone charcoal-burner whose soot-blackened fingers tremble slightly against the warmth of your iron lamp. He speaks in low, raspy whispers about the crust thickening across the lower basin while your coal-glow chases the damp chill from his palms.

The embers hiss softly as the midnight draft finds a gap in the masonry, reminding you that twenty days will turn this dust to mud. You knot your oilskin tighter and look out toward the branching tracks that lead deeper into the white expanse.

nodes.brief: Behind the low stone sheep-shelter, a frightened hare bolts from the beam of light cutting across the grey dust.

exits.label: Climb toward the windy lip of the dry wash
Cross the brittle crust of the alkali sump
Seek shelter by the dismantled metal pump

nodes.title: The Sheep Shelter
nodes.page:
Crouched behind the low rubble of a stone sheep-shelter, you freeze as a startled hare bolts from the amber beam cutting across the grey dust. Its frantic paws scratch against loose grit before it vanishes into the blackness of the scrub. Your banked lantern throws long shadows of dry thistle against the mortarless wall while the wind draws a low, hollow note through the stones.

Every nerve stays tight against the silence of the rim road, waiting to see if the movement drew any unwanted attention from the ridge above.

nodes.brief: By the rusted tracks of the old basin-haul, a discarded iron shackle snags your cloak while your dark lantern stays sealed.

exits.label: Inspect the rusted shadows of the iron pump
Pass the fossil coral milestone in the dark
Slip through the withered hedge by the fence

nodes.title: The Iron Shackle
nodes.page:
Dragging your boots past the rusted tracks of the old basin-haul, a discarded iron shackle suddenly snags the hem of your heavy wool cloak. You pause in the dark, keeping your lantern tightly shuttered so its glow remains a secret against the salt-bleached sleepers. Working the metal free requires slow, careful fingers that must not scrape against the iron and ring out across the flats.

The night air tastes of old grease and oxidized steel as you weigh your next step along the edge of the abandoned railway.

nodes.brief: Across the chalky bed of the dead irrigation ditch, an owl swoops low toward the amber glass of your swinging chimney.

exits.label: Check the dark base of the skeletal wind-pump
Head toward the fossil coral milestone ahead
Squeeze through the gap in the withered hedge

nodes.title: The Irrigation Ditch
nodes.page:
Walking across the chalky bed of the dead irrigation ditch, you watch a silent owl swoop low toward the amber glass of your swinging chimney, its wings brushing the dry air just inches from your shoulder. The bird veers away into the grey dark, startled by the steady pulse of bottled heat you carry against the cold. Your boots crunch softly over sun-baked clay that has not seen water since the great reservoirs shrank behind the western hills.

The path splits ahead where the shadows of the old perimeter merge with the open flats.

nodes.brief: Under the gnarled boughs of the parish thorn-tree, a clay flask of sour small-beer sits half-buried in grey silt.

exits.label: Traverse the grey silt of the duck-pond
Skirt the crumbling brick foundation of the customs house
Turn back toward the oil-scummed horse-trough

nodes.title: The Parish Thorn
nodes.page:
Pausing beneath the gnarled, twisting boughs of the parish thorn-tree, you notice a clay flask of sour small-beer half-buried in the grey silt near the exposed roots. The liquor has turned bitter with age, but someone left it here as a meager offering or a desperate marker before heading out into the grey expanse. Your lamp illuminates the dry fissures in the soil around the trunk while the distant wind rattles the high fences.

You can press onward into the dark or retrace your steps toward the safety of the lower square before the night deepens further.

nodes.brief: Near the lime-stack where the boundary ditch widens, a muffled cough betrays a watcher who expected you an hour ago.

exits.label: Slide through the gap in the dry hawthorn hedge
Approach the cold draught near the customs foundation

nodes.title: The Lime-Stack Watch
nodes.page:
Tucked against the towering flank of the lime-stack where the parish boundary ditch widens into a deep cut, a muffled cough betrays a watcher who clearly expected you an hour ago. You drop your hand instinctively toward the warmth of your coat as a silhouette shifts behind the white dust-motes kicked up by the wind. Whoever waits in the chalk-dust has business on the rim road, and their patience is wearing as thin as the boundary wire overhead.

You choose your footing carefully before addressing the shadow in the lime-smoke.

nodes.brief: On the shoulder of the low marl ridge, your lamp-beam startles a family of desert-rats scuttling into a drainage pipe.

exits.label: Push onward to the final broken shale switchback

nodes.title: The Marl Ridge
nodes.page:
As you climb the shoulder of the low marl ridge, your lamp beam startles a family of desert-rats scuttling headlong into an abandoned drainage pipe. The corrugated metal echoes with their frantic claws as they vanish into the subterranean dry. You adjust the heavy strap of your seedkey pouch across your chest, making sure the cold ceramic talisman rests securely against your ribs where no thief can easily reach it.

The path ahead winds upward into the teeth of the rising wind.

nodes.brief: Beneath the skeletal arch of the old suspension aqueduct, you walk in pitch-darkness while listening for the scrape of salt-shod boots.

exits.label: Step quietly into the deeper shadow

nodes.title: Beneath the Iron Ribs
nodes.page:
Shadows stretch long and jagged beneath the skeletal arch of the old suspension aqueduct, where you walk in pitch-darkness while listening for the scrape of salt-shod boots. Your ember-lamp casts a small, trembling circle of orange light against the rusted iron plates and encrusted stalactites of dried brine. Somewhere in the echoing dark ahead, a rhythmic crunch of gravel suggests you are not the only traveler treading this forgotten trade route.

You pause to adjust the heavy wool wrap around your throat, hand drifting instinctively toward the cold ceramic weight of the Seedkey in your pocket, wondering whether to press forward into the chill draft or seek a narrow side-canyon to wait out whatever approaches.

nodes.brief: By the concrete stump of the telegraph relay, a discarded brass signal-mirror catches the weak starlight above your hooded burner.

exits.label: Scale the final switchback toward the broken shale
Pick your way along the edge of the quarry-cut
Turn back to warm your chilblains by the granary gate

nodes.title: The Telegraph Stump
nodes.page:
Reaching the concrete stump of the telegraph relay, a discarded brass signal-mirror catches the weak, scattered starlight, flashing a dull sliver of silver just above your hooded burner. You shield the glass instantly, knowing how far a reflection can travel across the flat, mirror-like crust of the dried basin when the morning or night air is clear. The copper wires overhead hum a low, monotonous chord that vibrates directly through the soles of your boots.

You weigh your direction between the drop-off and the path back.

nodes.brief: Across the alkali flat where the scrub-oak died last season, the wind whistles through your gear with a dry, rattling hiss.

exits.label: Approach the black drop of the western quarry-cut
Follow the white cairn stones along the high ledge

nodes.title: The Alkali Flat
nodes.page:
Crossing the wide alkali flat where the scrub-oak grove died during the previous drought, the wind whistles through your gear with a dry, rattling hiss like dry bones shifting in a sack. The salt crust beneath your boots is hard enough to bear your weight, but it groans occasionally with a hollow, threatening timbre. Your ember-lamp casts a warm, flickering circle of yellow light that barely pushes back the immense, starlit emptiness of the dying sea.

Two distinct routes open before you across the white expanse.

nodes.brief: In the deep gravel pit of the lower quarry, a pile of damp pit-props threatens to slide under your searching footsteps.

exits.label: Climb toward the shale switchback
Skirt the pit-props toward the parish line

nodes.title: The Lower Quarry Pit
nodes.page:
Heavy timbers shift beneath your boots with a dry, groaning groan as you navigate the deep gravel pit of the lower quarry. A pile of damp pit-props threatens to slide down the slope, dislodging sharp shards of slate that clatter into the dark below. Your hooded burner casts a flickering amber glow against the damp earth walls while you search for firmer footing.

You can scramble up the loose shale toward the switchback trail, or edge carefully past the rust-stained props toward the parish boundary.

nodes.brief: Beside the iron post of the cattle-gate, a scrawled charcoal warning on the timber tells of poisoned well-heads ahead.

exits.label: Follow the low track past the gate
Climb the high ledge toward the white cairn
Seek shelter in the limestone bluff

nodes.title: The Cattle Gate Warning
nodes.page: Scrawled in greasy charcoal across the weathered timber of the cattle-gate, a blunt message warns of poisoned well-heads lying further down the track. The cold ceramic key inside your travel coat presses heavily against your ribs as you study the hasty warning marks. A sharp desert wind whistles through the iron post, carrying the faint, dry scent of alkali dust from the basin floor.

nodes.brief: Under the grey overhang of the silt-cliff, you pause to trim the charred wick while smelling the sharp tang of sulphur.

exits.label: Head toward the white stone cairn
Slip into the limestone cleft
Take the reckless way

nodes.title: The Silt-Cliff Overhang
nodes.page:
Sharp sulphur stings your nostrils as you pause under the grey overhang of the silt-cliff to trim the charred wick of your ember-lamp. The banked coals pulse with a dull red warmth, keeping the chill of the rising night wind at bay. Loose dust trickles down from the dry earth above, ticking against your woollen cloak like falling gravel.

You can press onward toward the white cairn on the ledge, slip away into the limestone cleft, or strike your lamp directly into the volatile air of the old lime-kiln.

nodes.brief: Near the dry bed of the sheep-dip, a tangled nest of rusted barbed wire catches the hem of your travel-trousers.

exits.label: Climb toward the western quarry-cut
Walk toward the white stone ledge

nodes.title: The Sheep-Dip Wire
nodes.page:
Tangled nests of rusted barbed wire catch sharply at the hem of your travel-trousers near the dry, cracked bed of the sheep-dip. You pause to unhook the heavy wool, your hooded lamp casting long, skeletal shadows across the sunken concrete troughs. The dry wind howls continuously through the broken wire fences, rattling loose bits of metal against the parched stone.

You can press upward toward the edge of the western quarry-cut or make your way toward the high ledge marked by white stones.

nodes.brief: On the windy lip of the dry wash, your lantern flame flickers dangerously close to going out in the sudden gust.

exits.label: Head toward the parish milestone
Pass along the limestone bluff
Turn back

nodes.title: The Windy Dry Wash
nodes.page:
A sudden, violent gust sweeps across the windy lip of the dry wash, threatening to blow out your precious lantern flame entirely. You cup your gloved hands around the iron chimney, feeling the intense heat of the banked coals flare against your palms. Below the bank, the cracked earth stretches away into grey twilight toward the distant salt basin.

You can push onward toward the parish milestone, skirt the limestone bluff's shadow, or retrace your steps toward the drying racks.

nodes.brief: Behind the broken stone wall of the tanner's paddock, an old brass button gleams dull and green in your downward glance.

exits.label: Walk toward the parish milestone
Climb toward the high ledge
Make for the limestone bluff

nodes.title: The Tanner's Paddock
nodes.page:
Dull and green against the grey dust, an old brass button gleams in the dirt as you glance down behind the broken stone wall of the tanner's paddock. The smell of old hides and lime still clings faintly to the crumbling mortar despite years of drought. Your hooded burner swings gently from your fingers, casting a rhythmic circle of orange light over the rubble.

You can continue toward the parish milestone, climb up toward the high stone ledge, or seek the shelter of the limestone bluff.

nodes.brief: Across the crust of the alkali sump, your boots leave deep, cracking prints that fill immediately with white dust.

exits.label: Traverse the steep scree slope
Head toward the rusted toll-gate

nodes.title: The Alkali Sump
nodes.page:
Deep, cracking footprints form instantly in the crust of the alkali sump beneath your boots, filling immediately with fine white dust that coats your ankles. The landscape here is bleached and silent, save for the crunch of salt crystals breaking under your tread. Your lamp casts a warm glow that turns the surrounding white expanse into fields of shattered ice.

You can struggle across the steep scree slope of the rim or follow the path toward the old toll-gate.

nodes.brief: In the shadow of the dismantled wind-pump, a damp bundle of rags smells strongly of stale tallow and rusted iron.

exits.label: Walk toward the white stone cairn
Cross the steep scree slope

nodes.title: The Wind-Pump Shadow
nodes.page:
Stale tallow and rusted iron rise heavily from a damp bundle of rags hidden in the deep shadow of the dismantled wind-pump. The skeletal wooden tower creaks softly above you in the dry draft, its shattered blades pointing silently toward the east. Your lamp flickers in the draft, throwing long, jittery beams across the parched earth.

You can make your way toward the white stone cairn on the ledge or cross the steep scree slope toward the basin.

nodes.brief: By the milestone carved from a lump of fossil coral, a chipped tin mug hangs from a bent iron nail.

exits.label: Continue toward the old toll-gate

nodes.title: The Fossil Milestone
nodes.page:
Chipped from a dense lump of fossil coral, an old milestone stands beside the track with a tin mug hanging from a bent iron nail on its side. The metal clinks softly against the stone whenever the evening wind shifts through the scrub. Your hooded lamp provides the only warmth in the rapidly chilling air of the rim road.

You can follow the trail onward toward the iron-studded post of the old toll-gate.

nodes.brief: Under the low wires of the magistrate's fence, you slip through a gap where the hawthorn hedge has withered to bone.

exits.label: Head toward the rusted toll-gate
Press toward the boundary gallows-frame

nodes.title: The Magistrate's Hedge
nodes.page:
Dry hawthorn branches snap beneath your weight as you slip through a withered gap in the magistrate's fence. The thorny hedge has turned entirely to bone under years of relentless sun, offering no shelter but plenty of snags for your woolen cloak. Your burner swings steadily at your side, its coals glowing a deep, banked red.

You can follow the path toward the rusted toll-gate or push ahead toward the gallows-frame of the boundary marker.

nodes.brief: Across the grey silt of the former duck-pond, a dry crust crackles like thin eggshells beneath your deliberate tread.

exits.label: Follow the narrow gap toward the basin

nodes.title: The Cracked Silt
nodes.page: Across the grey silt of the former duck-pond, a dry crust crackles like thin eggshells beneath your deliberate tread. Each step disturbs a pale film of alkaline dust that clings to your boots and dulls the brass of your lamp. The winter reeds stand like rusted iron wires, brittle and lifeless in the bitter wind blowing off the high crags. Farther ahead, the path dips toward a narrow gap in the stone wall where the basin air smells faintly of old lime and damp stone. You adjust the cold ceramic key in your inner pocket and weigh the value of pressing on into the dry expanse before the dusk settles.

nodes.brief: Near the crumbling brick foundation of the old customs house, a cold draught eddies around your ankles from the basin below.

exits.label: Step through the shattered doorway onto the lower track
Climb the broken stone steps toward the basin rim

nodes.title: The Customs House Draught
nodes.page: Near the crumbling brick foundation of the old customs house, a cold draught eddies around your ankles from the basin below. Weeds have split the mortar, and the timber roof caved in long before the wells failed, leaving only a skeletal hearth against the eastern wall. Your banked coal-lantern casts a warm, flickering glow across the charred floorboards, revealing scraps of old toll-manifests half-buried in grey sand. The wind whistles through the vacant window frames, carrying the scent of dry salt and distant copper-smoke from the lower terraces.

nodes.brief: At the final switchback where the rim road breaks down into broken shale, you adjust your shoulder-strap before the great descent.

exits.label: Descend onto the hard crust of the flats
Pause by the roadside to check your gear

nodes.title: The Final Switchback
nodes.page: At the final switchback where the rim road breaks down into broken shale, you adjust your shoulder-strap before the great descent. Below you, the vast white stretch of the Saltglass Basin stretches out like a sheet of hammered tin under the pale afternoon glare. The air grows noticeably thinner here, carrying the sharp, metallic tang of fused glass and old salt pans. Your ember-lamp bumps gently against your hip, a steady weight that reminds you of the failing hearths back in Candlemere and the urgency of the journey ahead.

nodes.brief: Above the black drop of the western quarry-cut, the wind howls through the wire fences while your lamp casts long, dancing shadows.

exits.label: Tread carefully along the cliff edge
Step into the shelter of the abandoned adit
Turn away from the drop and find another way

nodes.title: The Quarry Cut
nodes.page: Above the black drop of the western quarry-cut, the wind howls through the wire fences while your lamp casts long, dancing shadows. Jagged blocks of grey limestone hang suspended over the abyss where convict labor once carved out the town foundations. Down in the hollow, a rusted winch stands silent beside a blocked adit, its iron chain frozen solid in red rust. The path narrows sharply here, hugging the cliff face where every foothold feels precarious against the rushing draught.

nodes.brief: Beside the milestone that marks the end of the town parish, a discarded bundle of court writs flutters in the salt-rime.

exits.label: Leave the parish behind and push onward
Examine the fluttering papers for any useful news

nodes.title: The Parish Milestone
nodes.page: Beside the milestone that marks the end of the town parish, a discarded bundle of court writs flutters in the salt-rime. The faded ink on the parchment speaks of forgotten debts and seized water-rights, signed by magistrates who have long since abandoned their posts. The road ahead loses its paved crown, turning into a rough track of compacted gravel and wind-blown dust that leads straight into the glare of the lowlands. Your boots crunch softly on the edge of the parish boundary as you gaze into the empty distance.

nodes.brief: On the high ledge overlooking the grey expanse of the basin, a cairn of white stones marks where runners leave their final doubts.

exits.label: Continue down the ridge toward the salt
Add a small pebble to the weathered pile

nodes.title: The Cairn of Doubts
nodes.page: On the high ledge overlooking the grey expanse of the basin, a cairn of white stones marks where runners leave their final doubts. Small slips of dried reed-paper are wedged between the jagged rocks, bearing names, warnings, and quiet prayers for rain that never came. Your lamp flickers as a sudden gust catches the ridge, threatening the banked coals within the tin housing. You stand for a moment in the biting wind, feeling the immense scale of the dry sea stretching out beneath your boots.

nodes.brief: In the cleft of the limestone bluff, an old metal sign warns that all wells beyond this point belong to the Salt Court.

exits.label: Follow the line of iron stakes downward
Slip behind the limestone bluff to avoid the markers

nodes.title: The Salt Court Warning
nodes.page: In the cleft of the limestone bluff, an old metal sign warns that all wells beyond this point belong to the Salt Court. The brass letters have been scoured clean by wind-driven grit, gleaming coldly in the harsh light. A series of rusted iron stakes trace the boundary of their claimed jurisdiction, running down toward the grey flats like the ribs of an ancient leviathan. You check the seal of your pack to ensure the Seedkey is hidden securely out of sight from any passing toll-lord scouts.

nodes.brief: Across the steep scree slope of the rim's edge, a small landslide of loose shale clatters down into the dark abyss.

exits.label: Scramble quickly across the unstable stones
Pause to let the dust settle before moving

nodes.title: The Scree Slope
nodes.page: Across the steep scree slope of the rim's edge, a small landslide of loose shale clatters down into the dark abyss. The path here is little more than a goat-track of sliding grey stones that shift beneath your boots with every stride. Dust rises in small choking clouds, smelling of dry earth and sulfur. You keep your center of gravity low, using your free hand to steady yourself against the rock face while your lantern swings rhythmically at your side.

nodes.brief: By the iron-studded post of the old toll-gate, a rusted padlock hangs open from a staple that has rusted through completely.

exits.label: Walk past the broken barrier into the flats
Inspect the empty watch-box for dropped supplies

nodes.title: The Rusted Toll-Gate
nodes.page: By the iron-studded post of the old toll-gate, a rusted padlock hangs open from a staple that has rusted through completely. The heavy oak barrier has fallen away into the dirt, half-swallowed by grey salt-crust and creeping thorn bushes. No guards sit in the wooden watch-box today; only the dry wind rattles the empty lantern bracket overhead. You step over the splintered timber, leaving the guarded precincts of the upper rim behind you for good.

nodes.brief: Beneath the gallows-frame of the old boundary marker, the track narrows to a single sheep-path choked with greythorn scrub.

exits.label: Push through the thicket along the ridge
Descend toward the lower salt pans
Follow the sheep-path deeper into the scrub
Turn back toward the warmth of the town

nodes.title: The Narrow Sheep-Path
nodes.page: Beneath the gallows-frame of the old boundary marker, the track narrows to a single sheep-path choked with greythorn scrub. Thorny branches catch at your traveling cloak, and the ground beneath your feet grows increasingly chalky and dry. The distant murmur of Candlemere fades entirely, replaced by the hollow howling of the wind across the salt basins. You shield the glass of your lamp with one hand to keep the banked coals from being smothered by the blowing dust.

nodes.brief: At the threshold of the Bitterflats, the hard salt crust rings like iron under your boots as the vast white desert opens before you.

exits.label: Step out onto the blinding white crust

nodes.title: The Bitterflats Threshold
nodes.page:
Hard salt crust rings like iron under your boots as the vast white desert opens before you, stretching toward a pale horizon blurred by rising heat haze. The cold ceramic Seedkey rests heavy in your pocket, a reassuring weight against the dry wind that starts to scour the flat expanse. Behind you, the rim road fades into greythorn scrub, leaving only the endless glare of the ancient basin.

Adjusting the strap of your ember-lamp, you test the weight of your pack and prepare for the long crossing ahead.

nodes.brief: Where the rim road crumbles into the salt-marsh, your lantern beam catches the first glint of the shattered glass dunes of the basin floor.

exits.label: Follow the glittering trail into the flats

nodes.title: Glint of the Basin
nodes.page:
Shimmering salt-marsh gives way to the first true reaches of the basin floor, where your lantern beam catches the jagged glint of shattered glass dunes stretching far into the distance. Sharp fragments of ancient mirrors crunch beneath your soles, flashing brief points of reflected sunlight back at a pale sky. The air smells intensely of dry minerals and old dust, thick with the promise of the long drought.

You grip the handle of your banked lantern and weigh the long miles remaining before nightfall.

nodes.brief: By the bleached skull of a baggage-mule stuck in the crust, you take your last steady breath of damp town air before the dry wind strikes.

exits.label: Leave the marker behind and walk forward

nodes.title: The Mule Skull
nodes.page:
Bleached bone of a baggage-mule juts from the thick salt crust like a fencepost left behind by forgotten travellers, marking the final boundary of the cultivated slopes. You pause beside it to take your last steady breath of damp town air before the harsh, dry wind of the open basin strikes your face. The ember-lamp swings softly from your fingers, banked coals holding a hidden warmth against the deepening chill.

With a final glance back at the shadowed hills, you step past the skeletal remains.

nodes.brief: At the crumbling edge of the great descent, the lights of Candlemere wink out behind you, leaving only the salt-glare and the dark.

exits.label: Head down into the vast empty basin

nodes.title: Lights of Candlemere
nodes.page:
Crumbling earth gives way at the edge of the great descent, and the familiar lights of Candlemere wink out one by one behind a fold of grey hills. Only the blinding salt-glare ahead and the deepening dark remain to guide your boots over the uneven ground. Your fingers trace the cold ceramic outline of the Seedkey, reminding you of the desperate harvest waiting at the heart of the basin.

You adjust your pack and descend into the vast silence of the desert.

nodes.brief: Ignoring Calder's warning, you swing your blazing lamp high above your head to spite the toll-riders, drawing a volley of poisoned sling-stones from the dark and cracking your water-cask against a limestone boulder.
nodes.title: The High Swing
nodes.page: Ignoring Calder's warning, you swing your blazing lamp high above your head to spite the toll-riders, drawing a volley of poisoned sling-stones from the dark and cracking your water-cask against a limestone boulder. Cool, bitter brine immediately soaks into the thirsty dust around your boots, smelling of old salt-pans and finality. Your fingers grow slippery where the dampness spreads, and the frantic rattling of your belt-lantern sounds hollow against the vast night. There will be no drinking from this skin when the sun climbs high tomorrow, nor any reaching the distant glass spires of Prism. The darkness closes in swiftly, heavy with the taste of gypsum and the quiet certainty that your journey ends right here in the white grit.

nodes.brief: Striking your lamp in the volatile gas-pocket of the old lime-kiln, you trigger a blinding flash that shatters your gear and leaves you blind and stranded in the salt-dust.
nodes.title: Flash in the Lime-Kiln
nodes.page: Striking your lamp within the volatile gas-pocket of the old lime-kiln, you trigger a sudden, blinding flash that roars through the hollow stone chamber with terrifying speed. The concussive wave shatters your gear, sending shards of metal and glass clattering across the floor while thick white dust fills the air. Left completely blind and stranded in the stifling heat, you listen to the silence close in around you as your journey ends here.

nodes.brief: Arrival in The Bitterflats: white salt flats, mirages, the Dune Sisters' wells and their oath, the Salt Court's toll-hut, rumours of the vault. The reader enters with several ways forward.

exits.label: Follow the clear lamp-lit road ahead
Cut directly across the open common ground

exits.intent: Ask the way of a stranger
exits.label: Hail a nearby traveller to ask the way
Take the old drovers' track through the salt

nodes.title: Arrival in the Bitterflats
nodes.page:
White salt flats stretch in every direction under a heavy zinc sky, playing tricks on your eyes with shimmering mirages of nonexistent lakes and soaring towers. In the distance, the low stone huts of the Dune Sisters mark their guarded wells, while a solitary Salt Court toll-hut cuts a sharp silhouette against the blinding horizon. Rumours of the deep vault whisper on the hot wind, drawing you onward into the heart of the ancient basin.

Several distinct tracks branch out across the crusted salt before you.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Dune Sisters' Well: the Dune Sisters offer water in exchange for a binding oath (to answer one request later); the reader accepts or refuses

exits.intent: Swear the well-oath for water and shelter
exits.label: Swear the well-oath for water and shelter

exits.intent: Refuse the oath and pay dear for water
exits.label: Refuse the oath and pay dear for water

nodes.title: The Binding Oath
nodes.page:
Steam rises faintly from the stone well-mouth as the well-keepers gather close, waiting for your final word on the bargain. Accepting their water means pledging your future loyalty to an unknown demand, whereas refusing leaves you to carry your thirst back out into the blinding white expanse with your own dwindling supplies.

The choice hangs heavy in the dry air between you and the silent watchers.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Toll-Hut: a Salt Court toll-hut: take their loan (a debt, with a creditor who will collect) or pay out of the reader's purse

exits.intent: Take the Salt Court's loan of passage
exits.label: Take the Salt Court's loan of passage

exits.intent: Pay the toll from your own purse
exits.label: Pay the toll from your own purse

nodes.title: The Toll-Collector's Demand
nodes.page: A lean official blocks your way, tapping a ledger with an ink-stained finger and demanding settlement before you take another step across the Salt Court's territory. You can either sign your name to their cruel credit terms, pledging a future portion of your harvest for safe passage today, or you can open your personal purse and pay the heavy coin fee outright. The clerk waits with quill poised, watching the glow of your lamp with sharp, calculating eyes.

nodes.brief: Leaving The Bitterflats for The Shard Cities: close this part of the journey.

exits.label: Proceed into the ruined city

nodes.title: Leaving the Bitterflats
nodes.page: Behind you, the endless white expanse of the Bitterflats fades into a shimmering haze of salt and mirage, its cruel beauty swallowed by the gathering shadows of evening. Ahead lies the labyrinthine maze of the Shard Cities, where towering walls of fractured glass and ancient metal whisper secrets to the desert wind. You hitch the ember-lamp strap and check the glowing coals so they keep their heat for the chill of the ruined metropolis.

nodes.brief: Across the blinding salt crust of the Bitterflats, your boots kick up dry white dust while a distant shimmer masks the horizon, threatening false turns that could drain your flask.

exits.label: Pass the crumbling foundation of an old watch-tower

nodes.title: Salt Crust and Shimmer
nodes.page:
Blinding salt crust crumbles beneath your boots while distant mirages distort the horizon, painting false lakes of water that threaten to drain your flask if you chase them. The dry white dust kicked up by your stride coats your ankles, and the sun beats down relentlessly upon your shoulders. You must keep your eyes fixed firmly on the ground to avoid hidden sinkholes and jagged crystal ridges.

A choice of paths opens before you amid the glaring expanse.

nodes.brief: A skeletal copper signpost hammered crooked into the brine marks the frontier, its rusted arrow pointing toward the Dune Sisters' territory as the midday heat begins to bake your shoulders.

exits.label: Climb over the jagged ridge of alkali blocks
Approach the glass-diver scraping brine from his goggles
Cross the pink-tinted expanse of crystal shells

nodes.title: The Crooked Signpost
nodes.page:
Skeletal copper signpost hammered crooked into the brine marks the frontier, its rusted arrow pointing stubbornly toward the distant territory of the Dune Sisters. The midday heat begins to bake your shoulders through your wool tunic, making every breath taste of dry salt and old iron. Small swirls of white dust dance across the flat ground around the metal post, driven by erratic gusts of wind.

You survey the branching tracks stretching away from the marker.

nodes.brief: You skirt the edge of a jagged trench of fused glass where ancient mirror shards catch the glare, risking a deep slice into your shins if you lose your footing on the glassy slope.

exits.label: Inspect the humming metal boundary marker nearby
Examine the sun-split leather waterskin on the salt
Watch the white-feathered gulls wheeling overhead

nodes.title: The Fused Glass Trench
nodes.page:
Jagged trench of fused glass runs alongside your path, its ancient mirror shards catching the glaring sunlight and throwing blinding reflections in every direction. One false step on the glassy slope risks a deep slice into your shins, forcing you to tread with absolute care along the edge. The air here hums with a faint, residual heat trapped within the melted silica.

The trench narrows ahead, forcing a decision on your route.

nodes.brief: A wandering salt-peddler named Throm crouches behind a bleached camel skull, offering stale dried melon rinds for a pinch of coal from your lamp before hurrying back into the blinding haze.

exits.label: Trade a pinch of coal for dried melon rinds
Refuse the barter and keep your embers banked
Ignore his frantic whispers and stride past the skull

nodes.title: The Salt-Peddler's Bargain
nodes.page:
Crouching behind a bleached camel skull, a wandering salt-peddler named Throm offers stale dried melon rinds for a pinch of coal from your lamp. The blinding haze shimmers around his thin frame as he waits anxiously for your decision, clutching his leather pouch of grey crystals.

You must weigh the value of your precious fuel against the gnawing hunger in your stomach before he loses his nerve and scurries back into the white glare.

nodes.brief: Beneath a canopy of heat-warped air, you pass the crumbling foundation of an old watch-tower where a discarded iron bucket rattles in the empty wind, reminding you how thin the margin is between survival and bone-dry ruin.

exits.label: Follow the faint track toward the horizon
Skirt the massive mound of fused green slag

nodes.title: The Heat-Warped Foundation
nodes.page:
Beneath a canopy of heat-warped air, you pass the crumbling foundation of an old watch-tower where a discarded iron bucket rattles in the empty wind. This hollow clatter reminds you how thin the margin is between survival and bone-dry ruin out here on the open flats.

Several faint tracks diverge into the shimmering distance, offering different routes through the blinding expanse as the midday heat presses down like lead.

nodes.brief: Keeping your ember-lamp completely shuttered and cold, you slip silently past a sleeping patrol of Salt Court toll-guards huddled in the shade of a monolith, saving your coal and your anonymity in one lucky stride.

nodes.title: The Sleeping Patrol
nodes.page:
Keeping your ember-lamp completely shuttered and cold, you slip silently past a sleeping patrol of Salt Court toll-guards huddled in the deep shade of a basalt monolith. Moving with deliberate care saves both your coal and your anonymity in one lucky stride, leaving the snoring sentries behind in the dust.

The open basin stretches out before you, presenting multiple winding paths away from the dangerous shadow of the guards.

nodes.brief: A low ridge of crystallized alkali blocks the direct path, forcing you to scramble over jagged, crumbling mineral teeth that threaten to crush the ceramic Seedkey tucked securely inside your inner belt pouch.

nodes.title: The Alkali Ridge
nodes.page:
A low ridge of crystallized alkali blocks your direct path, forcing you to scramble over jagged, crumbling mineral teeth that threaten to crush the ceramic Seedkey tucked securely inside your inner belt pouch. Every handhold is sharp enough to slice leather, demanding absolute precision with every step.

Beyond the treacherous crest, the landscape opens into swirling dust and quiet expanses where new directions wait to be chosen.

nodes.brief: An old glass-diver named Corin sits upon a salt-caked crate scraping brine from his goggles, muttering warnings about sudden sinkholes opening beneath the crust just as the dry wind picks up an abrasive whistle.

exits.label: Walk toward the flat salt-pavement where Orla sits
Cross the rotting timbers of the collapsed brine-conduit
Veer away from the flapping Salt Court banner

nodes.title: The Glass-Diver's Warning
nodes.page: An old glass-diver named Corin sits upon a salt-caked crate scraping brine from his goggles, muttering dire warnings about sudden sinkholes opening beneath the crust. His dry cough matches the abrasive whistle of the rising wind as he points a weathered finger toward the treacherous ground ahead.

nodes.brief: You cross a flat expanse of pink-tinted salt where thousands of crystallized snail shells crunch beneath your soles like broken china, leaving a clear trail that any keen tracker could follow across the blinding flats.

exits.label: Step carefully across the collapsed underground conduit
Give the snapping Salt Court banner a wide berth

nodes.title: The Shimmering Snail Trail
nodes.page:
You cross a flat expanse of pink-tinted salt where thousands of crystallized snail shells crunch beneath your soles like broken china, leaving a clear trail that any keen tracker could follow across the blinding flats. The unnerving sound of crushing shells echoes loudly in the heavy air, drawing unwanted attention to your passage.

Several paths branch away from the crunching crust, leading toward different hazards in the distance.

nodes.brief: A solitary metal boundary marker hums softly in the dry heat, vibrating with some residual low-frequency current from the Old Lensfolk days that sets your teeth on edge as you hurry past the humming iron.

nodes.title: The Humming Boundary
nodes.page:
A solitary metal boundary marker vibrates in the dry heat with residual low-frequency current from the Old Lensfolk days that sets your teeth on edge as you hurry past the iron. The strange metallic resonance hangs heavy in the stagnant air, making the skin on your arms prickle.

Traveling completely alone and unencumbered by a guide allows you to notice subtle details that others might miss in the landscape.

nodes.brief: You pause to examine a discarded leather waterskin split wide open by the sun, its dark stain vanished into the crust long ago, warning you of the brutal thirst awaiting those who misjudge the distance between wells.

nodes.title: The Split Waterskin
nodes.page:
You pause to examine a discarded leather waterskin split wide open by the sun, its dark stain vanished into the crust long ago, warning you of the brutal thirst awaiting those who misjudge the distance between wells. The empty shell of leather curls like a dead leaf against the harsh white salt.

Various routes stretch out before you, each carrying its own silent warning about the scarcity of water.

nodes.brief: A flock of white-feathered alkali gulls wheels overhead against the pale zinc sky, their sharp cries echoing across the empty flats like mockery from creatures that know where every hidden moisture pocket lies.

exits.label: Climb the steep ridge of salt and pottery fragments

nodes.title: The Wheeling Gulls
nodes.page:
A flock of white-feathered alkali gulls wheels overhead against the pale zinc sky, their sharp cries echoing across the empty flats like mockery from creatures that know where every hidden moisture pocket lies. Their wings catch the glaring sunlight as they swoop low over the horizon and vanish into the haze.

A steep ridge of hard-packed salt looms ahead, offering a vantage point to survey the grueling trek.

nodes.brief: You wade through a shallow basin of crusted alkaline slush that sucks greedily at your boot-heels, threatening to pull you off balance and exhaust your leg muscles before you reach the firm ground beyond.

nodes.title: The Crusted Slush
nodes.page: You wade through a shallow basin of crusted alkaline slush that sucks greedily at your boot-heels, threatening to pull you off balance and exhaust your leg muscles before you reach the firm ground beyond. The thick paste clings stubbornly to your leather boots, making every single forward step a heavy battle against suction and weight.

nodes.brief: A weathered timber stake bearing a faded brand of the Salt Court leans drunkenly in the glare, marking a closed concession where illegal diggers once sought buried glass beads before the bailiffs drove them out.

nodes.title: The Brand of Authority
nodes.page: A weathered timber stake bearing a faded brand of the Salt Court leans drunkenly in the glare, marking a closed concession where illegal diggers once sought buried glass beads before the bailiffs drove them out. The surrounding ground is pitted with small, shallow craters like the pockmarks of a diseased skin, glinting with discarded shards that catch the cruel midday fire. You wipe the sweat from your forehead with the back of a calloused hand, your fingers brushing against the cold ceramic weight of the Seedkey hidden beneath your tunic. Behind you, the blinding flats stretch endlessly toward a shimmering horizon, while ahead the trail divides amidst the ruined diggings.

nodes.brief: Traveling entirely alone across the blinding crust without a guide's chatter to distract you, you spot a faint depression in the salt where a fresh moisture seep has recently softened the surface.

exits.label: Step carefully into the muddy depression

nodes.title: The Damp Hollow
nodes.page: Silence presses down upon the Bitterflats like a hot, flat iron, broken only by the dry crunch of your boots against the crystalline crust. Traveling entirely alone across this blinding expanse without a guide's chatter to distract you, you spot a faint depression in the salt where a fresh moisture seep has recently softened the surface. A rich, earthy smell rises from the damp grey clay, offering a rare chance to refill your canteen or perhaps unearth something left behind by earlier travelers. Ahead, the pale glare shimmers into dancing white lakes that obscure the horizon, leaving you to decide whether to investigate the muddy hollow or press onward before the midday heat peaks.

nodes.brief: You skirt a massive mound of fused green slag that hums with trapped solar heat, casting a long shadow where you stop briefly to wet your parched throat from your rapidly dwindling flask.

exits.label: Skirt wide around the vibrating mound
Duck into the jagged salt labyrinth

nodes.title: The Slag Mound
nodes.page: Shimmering heat rolls off a massive mound of fused green slag that still holds trapped solar warmth, casting a long shadow where you stop briefly to wet your parched throat from your rapidly dwindling flask. The strange glassy rock vibrates faintly beneath your palms, storing the fierce daylight of the Basin within its twisted, bubbles-pocked green belly. To the left, the open flats stretch away in a glare of absolute white, while to the right, a tighter maze of wind-carved pillars offers a cooler, more shadowed route that demands constant twisting and ducking.

nodes.brief: A weather-beaten wooden cart abandoned by desperate refugees stands tilted on a broken axle, its cargo of brittle salt-bricks spilling out like bleached loaves across the blinding white expanse.

exits.label: Navigate the jagged salt pillars
Approach the wary glass-diver

nodes.title: The Salt-Brick Cart
nodes.page: A weather-beaten wooden cart abandoned by desperate refugees stands tilted on a broken axle, its cargo of brittle salt-bricks spilling out like bleached loaves across the blinding white expanse. The sun has baked the timber until it splinters at a touch, and the wheel spokes are choked with fine alkaline dust. You pause in its meager shadow, running a hand over the rough-hewn frame before looking out at the featureless terrain stretching before you. A narrow passage opens between towering salt formations, while further off a solitary figure is visible near a dry cistern.

nodes.brief: You dodge a sudden whirl of stinging alkali dust sweeping across the basin, pulling your woollen scarf tight across your nose while navigating entirely by the angle of the blinding midday sun.

exits.label: Cross the treacherous brine-pan ice

nodes.title: The Alkali Whirl
nodes.page: You dodge a sudden whirl of stinging alkali dust sweeping across the basin, pulling your woollen scarf tight across your nose while navigating entirely by the angle of the blinding midday sun. The stinging grit abrades your cheeks and finds every seam in your travel-worn boots, turning each step into an exercise in stubborn endurance. Through the swirling white haze, the skeletal remains of old structures loom like ghost ships upon a frozen sea. You tighten your grip on your heavy canvas cloak to keep the dust from fouling your banked ember-lamp. Ahead lies a treacherous expanse of thin ice over a dormant brine-pan that demands your absolute concentration.

nodes.brief: An elderly scavenger named Orla sits cross-legged upon a flat salt-pavement, polishing a fragment of singing green lens that chimes musically whenever the hot desert draught sweeps across its razor-thin edge.

exits.label: Navigate the jagged salt pillars
Approach the wary glass-diver
Visit the abandoned rain-god shrine

nodes.title: The Singing Lens
nodes.page: An elderly scavenger named Orla sits cross-legged upon a flat salt-pavement, polishing a fragment of singing green lens that chimes musically whenever the hot desert draught sweeps across its razor-thin edge. She glances up with eyes crinkled against the glare, offering a toothless grin and a nod that acknowledges your weary posture without asking for pity. The haunting, bell-like tones echo softly against the surrounding flats, creating an eerie melody in the dead silence of the basin. You stand for a moment in the warm wind, listening to the glass sing of storms that haven't broken in decades. Three distinct routes beckon from her resting place.

nodes.brief: You cross the rotting timbers of an underground brine-conduit that has collapsed inward, revealing a dark subterranean shaft where drops of heavy, bitter water plink against unseen stone far below.

exits.label: Visit the abandoned rain-god shrine
Skirt the smoking sulfur vent
Follow the inquisitive desert fox

nodes.title: The Collapsed Conduit
nodes.page: You cross the rotting timbers of an underground brine-conduit that has collapsed inward, revealing a dark subterranean shaft where drops of heavy, bitter water plink against unseen stone far below. The air rising from the fissure is cool and damp, carrying an ancient scent of buried mud that contrasts sharply with the scorching salt crust above. You peer down into the shadowy void, gripping your canvas cloak so the banked coal-lamp does not swing loose against your ribs. The ground around the rim looks unstable, threatening to slough away if you linger too long. You can follow the fractured trench toward a ruined shrine, skirt a smoking sulfur vent, or track a desert fox toward a culvert.

nodes.brief: A tethered, wind-bleached canvas banner bearing the twin serpents of the Salt Court flutters aggressively from an iron pole, marking the outer perimeter of their toll-collection zone ahead.

nodes.title: The Toll Banner
nodes.page: A tethered, wind-bleached canvas banner bearing the twin serpents of the Salt Court flutters aggressively from an iron pole, marking the outer perimeter of their toll-collection zone ahead. The sharp clinking of brass coin-weights drifts faintly on the dry wind from a low stone hut crouched behind the fluttering marker. You clutch your canvas cloak tighter around your chest, acutely aware of the Seedkey hidden against your ribs and the heavy copper coins in your pocket that the toll-lords would gladly claim. You can approach the ruined rain-shrine to seek shelter and avoid the checkpoint entirely, or plunge your lamp into total darkness and try to creep past the guards unseen.

nodes.title: The Hidden Flagstone Path
nodes.page: Traveling completely alone and unencumbered by a guide, you notice a subtle color shift in the alkali crust that reveals an ancient, buried flagstone path bypassing the main toll-hut entirely. The pale slate stones are worn smooth by centuries of vanished feet, offering firm footing beneath the treacherous white dust. Because no companion is walking beside you to point out the obvious landmarks, your sharp eyes catch the faint geometric edges where the old road re-emerges from the flats. You slip quietly onto the hidden flagstones, leaving the patrols far behind. A low culvert lies ahead, framed by smooth glass lining.

nodes.brief: You wade cautiously through a dry drainage ditch choked with razor-sharp glass reeds that rustle like dry parchment, testing your patience and threatening to shred your trousers with every labored step.

exits.label: Follow the inquisitive desert fox
Cross the ancient basalt pavement

nodes.title: The Glass Reed Ditch
nodes.page: You wade cautiously through a dry drainage ditch choked with razor-sharp glass reeds that rustle like dry parchment, testing your patience and threatening to shred your trousers with every labored step. The translucent stalks clink against one another like wind chimes made of ice whenever your shins brush past them, creating a delicate music that betrays your passage. You keep your hands tucked safely inside your sleeves to avoid cutting your palms on the glittering vegetation. The ditch leads steadily downward into the heart of the flats, offering two distinct ways forward as the reeds thin out.

nodes.brief: A lone sentry from the glasswright signal towers stands atop a low mound flashing a small handheld mirror toward the horizon, sending silent coded warnings about dust storms gathering near the Basin center.

exits.label: Inspect the rusted crane structure ahead
Approach the weary traveler in the shade
Push through the brittle salt-fern thicket

nodes.title: The Signal Mirror
nodes.page: High upon a weathered rise of white gypsum, a lone sentry from the glasswright signal towers stands motionless. In one hand, a small polished disk catches the blinding noon glare, flicking swift, rhythmic warnings across the horizon about dust storms gathering near the Basin center. You pause in the lee of the mound to catch your breath, adjusting the heavy canvas strap of your banked coal-lamp as the mirrored flashes cease and the watcher turns a pair of goggles down toward your path.

nodes.brief: You climb a steep ridge of hard-packed salt and crushed pottery fragments, pausing at the summit to scan the shimmering expanse for the telltale green pennants of the Dune Sisters' well-stations.

exits.label: Cross the cracked hexagonal stone pavement
Examine the orange lichen on the glass block

nodes.title: Ridge of Broken Pottery
nodes.page: Sharp shards of ancient ceramic crunch beneath your boots as you crest a steep ridge of hard-packed salt and crushed red pottery fragments. From this dusty vantage point, you scan the shimmering, heat-warped expanse below for any sign of the telltale green pennants marking the Dune Sisters' well-stations. The air dances with mirages, making distant salt-pillars look like towering spires, while your throat feels as dry and cracked as the ground beneath you.

nodes.brief: A weathered milestone carved from grey basalt stands half-buried in the crust, bearing an ancient distance tally to Prism that reminds you how many grueling leagues still separate you from the Rain Vault.

exits.label: Head toward the rusted iron crane arm
Seek out the traveler resting under shade-cloth

nodes.title: The Basalt Milestone
nodes.page: Half-buried in the blinding crust of the alkali flat, a weathered milestone carved from grey basalt bears a deep, ancient distance tally pointing toward Prism. The worn glyphs remind you of the grueling leagues that still separate your tired legs from the Rain Vault, urging you to push onward despite the burning ache in your thighs. Around the stone, the white desert stretches away into an empty glare that seems to swallow the horizon whole.

nodes.brief: You pass a cluster of hollow ceramic jars left by ancient travelers as moisture traps, finding every single vessel bone-dry and filled only with fine white dust that billows out in a choking puff.

exits.label: Inspect the lichen-covered block of fused glass
Pick a path through the fossilized salt-ferns

nodes.title: The Hollow Ceramic Jars
nodes.page: Rows of hollow ceramic jars, left behind by forgotten generations of travelers as emergency moisture traps, line the edge of a dry basin. You pry the stopper from the nearest vessel, only to find it bone-dry and packed with fine white dust that billows out in a sudden, choking cloud. Coughing into your scarf, you kick the empty earthenware aside and wonder how many others before you reached into these jars and found only emptiness.

nodes.brief: Keeping your banked coal-lamp securely hidden beneath your heavy canvas cloak, you slip past an unattended Salt Court toll-post while the guards are napping inside their canvas awning.

exits.label: Step onto the smooth well-head apron
Follow the converging pilgrim footprints

nodes.title: Unattended Toll-Post
nodes.page: Keeping your banked coal-lamp securely hidden beneath the heavy folds of your canvas cloak, you slip past an unattended Salt Court toll-post while the guards doze heavily inside their striped canvas awning. The toll-rope lies slack across the white track, inviting you to cross without paying the exorbitant passage fees demanded by the toll-lords. Your heart thrums a rapid rhythm against your ribs as you leave the sleeping sentries behind and quicken your pace toward the open basin.

nodes.brief: You navigate a labyrinth of jagged salt pillars sculpted by centuries of abrasive winds, ducking through narrow white alleys that smell faintly of ancient brine and sun-baked stone.

exits.label: Step out onto the cool outer apron

nodes.title: Salt Pillar Labyrinth
nodes.page: Jagged white pillars of pure salt, sculpted by centuries of abrasive desert winds, tower above your head to form a blinding, confusing labyrinth. You duck through narrow white alleys that smell faintly of ancient brine and sun-baked stone, keeping your hand brushing against the cool crystalline walls to guide your way. Every turn looks identical to the last, demanding absolute concentration if you are to avoid wandering in circles until your water skin runs empty.
