nodes.brief: A wary glass-diver named Joran crouches inside a dry cistern, sharpening a brass scraping tool while watching your approach with sharp eyes that assess the value of your equipment.

exits.label: Step out onto the white apron of the well
Approach the low stone wall of the compound

nodes.title: The Glass-Diver's Cistern
nodes.page: Crouched within the cool shadow of a dry stone cistern, a wary glass-diver named Joran sharpens a notched brass scraping tool with deliberate care. He watches your approach with piercing eyes, instantly measuring the weight of your pack and the glint of your hidden lamp. A faint smell of silica dust and stale water hangs in the sunken recess, contrasting sharply with the blazing heat radiating from the open flats above.

nodes.brief: You cross a treacherous crust of thin white ice over a dormant brine-pan, listening to the ominous crackle beneath your boots while stepping as lightly as possible to avoid breaking through.

exits.label: Approach the low stone compound wall
Cross the smooth expanse of salt plaster

nodes.title: The Brine-Pan Crust
nodes.page: A treacherous sheet of thin white ice stretches across a dormant brine-pan, crackling ominously under the heavy tread of your boots. You spread your arms for balance and shorten your stride, stepping as lightly as possible to avoid fracturing the brittle crust and plunging knee-deep into corrosive liquor. Every breath sounds unnaturally loud in the silent expanse, amplifying the tension of each cautious step forward.

nodes.brief: A weather-worn wooden shrine dedicated to the ancient rain-gods stands abandoned amidst the salt, its offerings reduced to sun-bleached animal bones and cracked pottery bowls filled with drift-sand.

exits.label: Step out onto the smooth stone apron
Follow the converging pilgrim tracks onward
Turn back toward the earlier watch-tower ruins

nodes.title: The Abandoned Shrine
nodes.page: Weathered timbers and sun-bleached animal bones mark the remains of a forgotten shrine dedicated to ancient rain-gods, standing forlornly amidst the endless white. Cracked pottery bowls filled with drift-sand sit before a blank stone altar where countless desperate suppliants once prayed for a deluge. You pause for a brief moment in the shelter of its sagging roof, listening to the dry wind whistle through the empty gaps in the woodwork.

nodes.brief: You skirt the perimeter of a smoking sulfur vent that taints the dry air with the stench of rotten eggs, forcing you to pull your scarf higher and quicken your pace across the yellowed flat.

exits.label: Pass through the weathered cedar gate

nodes.title: The Sulfur Vent
nodes.page: A thin plume of acrid, yellowish smoke hisses from a fissure in the crust, filling the dry air with the sharp, unmistakable stench of rotten eggs. You yank your woven scarf higher across your nose and mouth, quickening your stride across the discolored flat to escape the irritating fumes before they catch in your chest. The ground beneath your boots grows noticeably warmer here, vibrating with the faint, deep rumble of the restless earth below.

nodes.brief: Marching with your ember-lamp safely extinguished and cold, you slip unnoticed past a patrolling toll-lord on a salt-skimmer, using the blinding midday mirage as perfect cover for your advance.

exits.label: Slip past the silent skimmer track
Follow the wide cedar gate ahead
Thread the empty water-barrel alley

priv.why: the reader walks with a banked, dark lamp and slips through unseen

nodes.title: The Toll-Lord's Wake
nodes.page: Your ember-lamp remains cold and dark at your hip, its unlit metal casing offering no telltale gleam against the glare. Out on the white crust, a salt-skimmer drifts across the shimmering horizon, its canvas sail catching the furnace wind while its toll-lord rider sweeps a spyglass across the flats. You hunker low behind a ridge of fossilized foam, letting the blinding midday mirage blur your silhouette into the trembling horizon. The skimmer glides past with a dry hiss of runners on mineral, leaving you entirely unseen in the blinding waste.

nodes.brief: An inquisitive desert fox with huge ears watches you from the mouth of a glass-lined culvert before darting away into the shimmering heat haze, leaving only tiny paw prints in the crust.

exits.label: Follow the fox's vanishing tracks
Turn toward the barrel-stacked square

nodes.title: The Long-Eared Watcher
nodes.page: An inquisitive desert fox with huge ears sits perched at the mouth of a glass-lined culvert, its dark eyes fixed upon you with wary intelligence. The heat haze ripples off the fused earthenware pipes behind it, turning the landscape into a wavering canvas of white and pale gold. As you take a cautious step forward to check your bearings, the creature darts away into the blinding glare in a flash of tawny fur, leaving only a delicate trail of tiny paw prints stamped into the salt crust.

nodes.brief: You cross a flat pavement of hexagonal basalt stones laid by the Old Lensfolk, now cracked and heaved upward by the expanding salt crystals that grow like white flowers through every joint.

exits.label: Step onto the converging pilgrim track
Approach the open cedar gate
Seek the sunlit barrel square

nodes.title: The Fractured Basalt
nodes.page: Hexagonal basalt stones laid by the Old Lensfolk in forgotten centuries form a cracked and heaved pavement under your travel-worn boots. Expanding salt crystals have forced their way upward through every tight joint, blooming into delicate white flower-like formations that crunch underfoot with every stride. The ancient road stretches ahead like a broken spine across the blinding expanse of the Bitterflats, offering a firm path through the treacherous salt-skree.

nodes.brief: A rusted iron crane arm left over from ancient dredging operations hangs suspended over a dry basin, creaking mournfully in the hot wind like a giant metal skeleton pointing toward the south.

exits.label: Head toward the wide cedar gate
Approach the pale linen guard

nodes.title: The Iron Skeleton
nodes.page: A rusted iron crane arm, left behind from some ancient dredging operation of the inland sea, hangs suspended over a completely dry basin. It creaks mournfully in the hot desert wind like a giant metal skeleton, its rusted jib pointing steadily toward the south where Prism's glass spires glimmer through the haze. Coarse salt cakes its joints and thick cables, turning a tool of heavy labor into a permanent monument to the drying of the world.

nodes.brief: You inspect a cluster of bright orange lichen clinging stubbornly to a block of fused glass, marvelling at how any living thing survives in this scorched wilderness of mineral and mirage.

exits.label: Skirt the circular stone reservoir
Step onto the packed red clay

nodes.title: The Orange Lichen
nodes.page: Bright orange lichen clings stubbornly to a block of fused green glass, forming a brilliant splash of color against the bleached wilderness of mineral and mirage. You pause for a moment to marvel at how any living thing survives this scorched domain, feeding only on the scant moisture wrung from dawn mists. The dry wind rattles the dry mineral crust around the base of the glass block as you adjust the heavy straps of your pack.

nodes.brief: A weary traveler named Miri sits hunched over a meager shade-cloth, offering to trade a handful of dried dates for a drop of water from your flask before you push onward.

exits.label: Speak with the solemn tally-guard
Skirt the damp pigeon reservoir

nodes.title: The Roadside Shade
nodes.page: A weary traveler named Miri sits hunched beneath a tattered patch of shade-cloth, shielding her eyes from the relentless glare of the midday sun. She glances up as you approach, offering to trade a handful of sweet dried dates in exchange for a single precious drop of water from your traveling flask. The surrounding salt flats stretch out in every direction like a frozen sea of white glass, making every meeting between travelers a fragile bargain for survival.

nodes.brief: You push through a dense thicket of fossilized salt-ferns that crackle and shatter like glass under your shins, leaving a trail of sparkling white dust across your dusty boots and trousers.

exits.label: Continue toward the tally-guard
Cross onto the packed red clay

nodes.title: The Salt-Fern Thicket
nodes.page: Dense thickets of fossilized salt-ferns rise around your knees, crackling and shattering like thin crystal under your shins as you push your way through. Each snapped stalk leaves a fine trail of sparkling white dust that settles over your travel-worn boots and trousers like fallen snow. The sharp, mineral scent of ancient brine fills the air, masking the heavier odors of the flats and muffling your footsteps against the hard ground.

nodes.brief: You step out onto the smooth white apron surrounding the outer well-head, where the air grows noticeably cooler and a faint smell of damp clay hints at the subterranean moisture below.

exits.label: Approach the severe well matriarch

nodes.title: The Outer Well-Head
nodes.page: You step out onto the smooth white apron surrounding the outer well-head, where the heavy air grows noticeably cooler against your sun-baked skin. A faint, earthy smell of damp clay rises from the stone masonry, hinting at the deep subterranean moisture banked far below the parched surface of the Basin. The blinding glare of the salt flats fades slightly behind the low stone walls of the well compound, offering a brief respite from the relentless white desert.

nodes.brief: A low stone wall built by the Dune Sisters marks the approach to their compound, its top decorated with rows of inverted blue glass bottles that catch and refract the blinding desert glare.

exits.label: Face the severe well matriarch
Turn back toward the dry ditch

nodes.title: The Blue Bottle Wall
nodes.page: A low stone wall built by the Dune Sisters marks the formal approach to their well compound, its top decorated with orderly rows of inverted blue glass bottles. These captured fragments of old vessels catch and refract the blinding desert glare into pools of cool sapphire light upon the white mortar. Beyond the barrier, the shaded courtyards of the water-keepers offer a sanctuary of discipline and measured resource.

nodes.brief: You cross a wide expanse of smooth salt plaster where the footprints of countless pilgrims converge into a single deep track leading straight toward the shaded pavilions of the well-keepers.

exits.label: Approach the central well-head
Enter the striped central pavilion
Seek the cloaked sister's trough

nodes.title: The Pilgrim Track
nodes.page: Countless pilgrim footprints converge here into a single deep track worn smooth across the wide expanse of white salt plaster. The path leads straight toward the shaded canvas pavilions of the Dune Sisters, where well-keepers manage the distribution of life-sustaining water under strict oaths. The air grows still and heavy as you follow the depression in the crust, leaving the open flats behind you.

nodes.brief: A weathered cedar gate hung between two carved stone pillars stands wide open, welcoming weary runners into the outer courtyard of the well-station where copper wind-chimes tinkle softly.

exits.label: Step through the open gate
Approach the central pavilion tent
Turn back toward the distant ridge

nodes.title: The Open Cedar Gate
nodes.page:
Weathered cedar panels swing wide between carved stone pillars, inviting weary travelers into the outer courtyard of the well-station. Copper wind-chimes suspended from the eaves tinkle softly in the dry breeze, offering a melodic contrast to the unrelenting glare of the salt flats.

Dust settles around your boots as you weigh the various paths stretching out before you under the blinding noon sky.

nodes.brief: You navigate a narrow passage between towering stacks of empty water-barrels, emerging into a sunlit square where the heavy timber lever of the deep well pump points skyward.

exits.label: Inspect the deep well machinery
Follow the path toward the inner courtyard

nodes.title: The Timber Lever Pump
nodes.page:
Narrow gaps between towering stacks of empty water-barrels open directly into a sunlit square dominated by a heavy timber lever pointing skyward. The air smells sharply of damp earth and rusted iron where previous travelers have drawn their daily share from the hidden aquifers below.

Dust motes dance in the harsh light as you stand considering which direction to take next.

nodes.brief: A solemn guard wearing a pale linen robe and carrying a notched wooden tally-staff nods silently from her post beside the arched stone entrance, signaling your arrival at the threshold.

exits.label: Proceed past the checkpoint
Divert toward the barrel storage yard

nodes.title: The Stone Entrance Post
nodes.page:
Pale linen rustles softly as a solemn guard nods from her post beside the arched stone entrance, her fingers resting lightly on a notched wooden tally-staff. She watches your approach with quiet vigilance, marking every traveler who crosses the threshold into the well-station compound.

The cool shadow of the stone archway offers a brief reprieve from the desert heat.

nodes.brief: You skirt a circular stone reservoir where a handful of desert pigeons flutter around a damp seepage puddle, drinking greedily before scattering into the bright sky as you draw near.

exits.label: Approach the stone rim to gather the seepage

nodes.title: The Seepage Puddle
nodes.page: Desert pigeons scatter into the dazzling sky as you draw near a circular stone reservoir, their wings beating a frantic rhythm against the dry heat. A handful of thirsty birds have been drinking greedily from a damp seepage puddle clinging to the masonry's mossy flank. Your canvas water-skin feels light and warm at your hip, and the cool smell of mud offers a sharp temptation in the glaring white expanse.

nodes.brief: The ground beneath your boots changes from crunching salt crust to packed red clay as you step onto the sacred plaza of the Dune Sisters' well-station, ending your long march across the flats.

exits.label: Walk toward the creaking pump
Approach the cistern house shade

nodes.title: The Red Clay Plaza
nodes.page:
Crushing white salt crust gives way beneath your boots to packed red clay as you step onto the sacred plaza of the well-station, bringing your grueling march across the flats to a close. Ornate mosaics set into the brickwork depict legendary rains of the past.

The atmosphere shifts perceptibly as you stand at the center of the spacious courtyard.

nodes.brief: You stand before the main well-head of the Dune Sisters, where a severe matriarch holding a bronze measuring cup demands your formal agreement to an unbreakable oath in exchange for fresh water.

exits.label: Press on and make your choice

nodes.title: The Bronze Measuring Cup
nodes.page:
Severe lines mark the face of the matriarch standing before the main well-head, holding out a heavy bronze measuring cup as a token of the station's liquid wealth. She demands your formal, unyielding agreement to an unbreakable oath before a single drop passes your parched lips.

The surrounding guards watch your hands for any sign of hesitation.

nodes.brief: Under the striped canvas awning of the central pavilion, the chief well-keeper extends a clay beaker of sweet water, warning you that drinking requires binding yourself to fulfill one future request without question.

exits.label: Press on and make your choice

nodes.title: The Striped Canvas Pavilion
nodes.page:
Colored canvas flutters above the central pavilion where the chief well-keeper extends a clay beaker filled with cool, sweet water. She warns you plainly that partaking of this vital resource requires binding yourself to fulfill one future request without question or hesitation.

Sunlight filters through the fabric overhead, casting striped shadows across the dusty ground.

nodes.brief: Beside the creaking wooden pump, a cloaked sister blocks your path to the water trough, laying out the sacred binding terms that every traveler must swear to before tasting the station's deep reserve.

exits.label: Swear the binding oath to drink deeply

nodes.title: The Guarded Trough
nodes.page: A cloaked sister steps out beside the creaking wooden pump, blocking your direct approach to the stone water trough with calm finality. She lays out the sacred binding terms required of every traveler, her voice dry as the salt crystals dusting her hem. To taste the station's deep reserve, you must swear an unbreakable oath to the well-keepers, tying your future steps to their hidden designs. You weigh the heavy thirst scratching at your throat against the dangerous price of a stranger's binding word.

nodes.brief: In the cool shade of the stone cistern house, the keeper of the well holds out a silver-rimmed bowl of water, asking if you will pledge your solemn word to answer a future summons in return for life-saving hydration.

exits.label: Accept the bowl and make the solemn pledge

nodes.title: The Silver Bowl
nodes.page: Cool shade pours from the open door of the stone cistern house, offering a brief reprieve from the blinding glare of the Bitterflats. The keeper of the well stands within, holding out a silver-rimmed bowl of water that glints with unbearable invitation. She asks if you are willing to pledge your solemn word to answer a future summons in return for this life-saving hydration. Your fingers tighten around the cold ceramic Seedkey in your pocket while you weigh the cost of indebted freedom.

nodes.brief: Beside the steaming well-mouth, you shoulder your lamp and skirt a dune of purple brine where discarded clay cups crunch beneath your boots.

exits.label: Climb the upper crust ridge

exits.privWhy: Calder the glass-diver is with the reader and knows this place
exits.label: Follow Calder toward the sunken track
Plunge directly into the blinding glare

nodes.title: The Brine Dune
nodes.page: Beside the steaming well-mouth, you shoulder your lamp and skirt a dune of purple brine where discarded clay cups crunch beneath your boots. The heavy air smells of boiled lime and old sediment, clinging to your damp wool collar like a wet hand. Overhead, the sky stretches like an unpolished tin plate, hammering down a flat and merciless glare that makes the distant horizon waver and warp.

nodes.brief: Leaving the sisterly oath behind, you strike across the blinding crust while your damp scarf stiffens into a brittle mask of salt.

exits.label: Tread softly past the limestone sink
Veer toward the shimmering heat-mirages
Press onward straight into the white haze

nodes.title: The Brittle Mask
nodes.page: Leaving the sisterly oath behind, you strike across the blinding crust while your damp scarf stiffens into a brittle mask of salt. Every step forward produces a sharp, glassine crack that echoes thinly across the empty pan. Your canteen swings heavy and lukewarm against your hip, a liquid reminder of how quickly wells turn sour in this parched expanse.

nodes.brief: Beneath a rib of bleached acacia wood, you dodge a drift of stinging powder that bites your eyes before your goggles seal.

exits.label: Skirt the edge of the timber shadow
Follow the wind into the open salt-pan
Search the hollow root for hidden water
Cut across the dry water-course below

nodes.title: The Acacia Rib
nodes.page: Beneath a rib of bleached acacia wood, you dodge a drift of stinging powder that bites your eyes before your goggles seal. The wind here carries a dry, metallic whistle through the hollow timber frame, sounding almost like human breath trapped in metal lungs. You check the leather straps of your lamp to ensure no stray grit has fouled the vents where the red coals breathe.

nodes.brief: Calder whistles softly, guiding your boots onto an ancient basalt track hidden beneath the shifting salt-crust where blisters will not form.

exits.label: Follow the dark stones forward

exits.privWhy: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over
exits.label: Step aside to listen to the singing earth
Chase the rolling sphere of dried glass-kelp

priv.why: Calder the glass-diver is with the reader and knows this place

nodes.title: The Basalt Track
nodes.page: Calder whistles softly, guiding your boots onto an ancient basalt track hidden beneath the shifting salt-crust where blisters will not form. Having a glass-diver at your shoulder turns this lethal maze into a manageable puzzle, especially when he points out the subtle violet discoloration that warns of soft mire below. The dark stones feel firm and trustworthy beneath your tired soles, a rare luxury in the Basin.

nodes.brief: A discarded mule-skeleton stripped to clean ivory points the way toward a cluster of heat-mirages dancing on the horizon.

exits.privWhy: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over
exits.label: Pause to listen to the salt crystals
Kick the rolling tumbleweed of kelp aside
Check the ceramic key in your pocket
Trace the numbers on the copper milestone

nodes.title: The Ivory Ribs
nodes.page: A discarded mule-skeleton stripped to clean ivory points the way toward a cluster of heat-mirages dancing on the horizon. The sun beats down with punishing weight, turning the salt flats into a glaring mirror that reflects the blinding white sky right back into your face. You grip your lamp handle tighter, and the banked embers warm your knuckles.

nodes.brief: You step carefully across a crust that rings like iron beneath your soles, fearing the hollow drum of a sunken brine-pit below.

exits.label: Wade through the pink drainage ditch
Watch the distant mirror flashes blink
Leap across the purple mineral fissure

nodes.title: The Iron Crust
nodes.page: You step carefully across a crust that rings like iron beneath your soles, fearing the hollow drum of a sunken brine-pit below. The landscape here is a monochromatic waste of stark white and pale silver, broken only by the occasional flash of distant mirrors. Your breathing sounds loud inside your scarf, a rhythmic rasp that marks each painful league toward the centre.

nodes.brief: A small earthenware flask rolls from your pack, shattering into red sherds that vanish instantly in the searing glare of noon.

exits.label: Inspect the abandoned merchant barrow
Wipe the stinging brine from your brow
Pass the old stone boundary cairn

nodes.title: The Red Sherds
nodes.page: A small earthenware flask rolls from your pack, shattering into red sherds that vanish instantly in the searing glare of noon. There is no time to mourn the lost water; the salt greedily drinks whatever moisture touches the ground before it can even form a puddle. You quicken your pace, keeping your eyes fixed on the hazy outline of the distant observatory spires.

nodes.brief: You pause to scrape thick salt-rime from your ember-lamp's iron grille, ensuring the banked coals retain their vital breath of warmth.

exits.label: Shake the sharp quartz from your gaiters
Listen to the deep strata humming below

nodes.title: The Iron Grille
nodes.page: You pause to scrape thick salt-rime from your ember-lamp's iron grille, ensuring the banked coals retain their vital breath of warmth. The tiny glow inside is your only true companion against the encroaching dark and the biting alkaline dust. Far off across the flats, a low hum begins to vibrate through the earth, singing a strange and ancient tune of cooling glass.

nodes.brief: Within the shadow of a basalt boulder, you find an abandoned surveyor's tripod encrusted with sparkling cubic crystals that mock your thirst.

exits.label: Duck behind the screen of iron slag
Examine the empty Candlemere crate

nodes.title: The Cubic Crystals
nodes.page: Within the shadow of a basalt boulder, you find an abandoned surveyor's tripod encrusted with sparkling cubic crystals that mock your thirst. The metal legs are fused solid into the salt floor, held fast by decades of mineral growth that no hammer could break. You rest your shoulder against the cool stone, letting the brief shade reset your breath.

nodes.brief: A solitary raven with white-rimmed eyes circles above your head, waiting for a runner who stumbles in the glaring alkali flats.

exits.label: Seek refuge behind the slag screen
Check the branded trading guild crate

nodes.title: The White-Eyed Raven
nodes.page: A solitary raven with white-rimmed eyes circles above your head, waiting for a runner who stumbles in the glaring alkali flats. Its harsh croak cuts through the ringing silence of the basin like a dry knife. You ignore the bird and keep your boots moving, knowing better than to invite the company of scavengers before your journey is half done.

nodes.brief: You skirt a bubbling spring of bitter yellow brine that smells of rotten kelp and ancient sulphur trapped beneath the floor.

exits.label: Follow the startled desert grouse toward the low reeds
Step carefully onto the green bottle-glass causeway
Inspect the rusted salt-scraper's spade in the tailings

nodes.title: The Sulphur Spring
nodes.page:
Yellow brine bubbles from a jagged vent in the floor, venting a heavy stench of rotten kelp and ancient sulphur that coats the back of your throat. You trim the wick of your banked lamp; its mild heat sits oddly against the cold mineral air rising from the fissure.

The crust beneath your boots shudders slightly under the pressure of hidden gases, urging you to choose your footing before the alkaline ground gives way entirely.

nodes.brief: Following the carved notches on a weathered boundary post, you slip past a dried water-course choked with grey tumble-reeds.

exits.label: Inspect the old timber crates nearby
Step onto the green glass causeway

nodes.title: The Boundary Post
nodes.page:
Weathered boundary posts jut from the alkali crust like broken teeth, their carved notches offering a reliable guide past a dried water-course choked with grey tumble-reeds. You adjust the shoulder strap of your coal-lantern as the midday heat radiates upward through your sandal soles.

Ahead, the trail splits where the dry gully meets a sun-bleached expanse of old ruins.

nodes.brief: Walking alone lets you hear the faint subterranean singing of salt-crystals expanding in the midday heat, warning you away from unstable ground.

exits.label: Check the rusted tailings spade
Navigate the jagged salt pillars

priv.why: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over

nodes.title: The Singing Salt
nodes.page:
Walking entirely alone through the blistering basin leaves you exposed to the vast emptiness, but it gives you something a companion would talk over: the faint, eerie subterranean singing of salt-crystals expanding in the midday heat. Each tiny ping and groan warns your feet away from hollow, unstable ground where the crust hangs perilously thin over subterranean voids.

You pick your steps with extreme care, listening to the ground beneath you before committing your weight.

nodes.brief: A stray gust of wind rolls a sphere of dried glass-kelp past your shins like a brittle tumbleweed bound for the southern sink.

exits.label: Venture into the pillar labyrinth
Inspect the tethered leather bag

nodes.title: The Glass-Kelp Sphere
nodes.page:
A stray gust of desert wind sweeps across the white crust, rolling a sphere of dried glass-kelp past your shins like a brittle tumbleweed bound for the southern sink. The fragile sphere chatters musically as it bounces over the salt ridges, reminding you of the brittle beauty hiding everywhere in this dead sea.

You watch it vanish into the dazzling glare before turning your attention back to the winding trail ahead.

nodes.brief: You check the heavy ceramic Seedkey in its padded pocket, feeling its reassuring chill against your sweating thigh through the wool.

exits.label: Investigate the abandoned tailings spade
Examine the hanging leather water-bag

nodes.title: The Cold Seedkey
nodes.page:
Your hand brushes against your pocket, and you pause to check the heavy ceramic Seedkey inside its padded lining, feeling its reassuring, unearthly chill against your sweating thigh through the thick wool. In a landscape where everything radiates punishing heat, that cold little key is your sole anchor to the damp vault waiting at the heart of Prism.

You secure the flap tightly and press onward through the glaring dust.

nodes.brief: An old copper milestone lies half-buried in the white drift, its engraved distance numbers rubbed smooth by decades of scouring dust-storms.

exits.privWhy: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over
exits.label: Track the hidden patrol footprints
Cross the tilting hexagonal tiles

nodes.title: The Copper Milestone
nodes.page: An old copper milestone lies half-buried in the white drift, its engraved distance numbers scoured smooth by decades of relentless dust-storms until it is nothing more than a dull green coin in the salt. You pause in its meager shadow to catch your breath, scanning the horizon for any sign of movement. Being entirely by yourself means you catch every subtle disturbance in the landscape that a guide's idle chatter might have masked.

nodes.brief: You wade through a shallow drainage ditch filled with pink salt-crust that crunches like autumn leaves under your tired sandals.

exits.label: Cross the cracked hexagonal tiles
Approach the Salt Court banner

nodes.title: The Pink Drainage Ditch
nodes.page:
You wade cautiously through a shallow drainage ditch filled with pink salt-crust that crunches like autumn leaves under your tired sandals, kicking up a fine, stinging dust with every stride. The mineral deposits here stain your shins a faint rose color in the harsh noon light.

The trench eventually opens up into a wider stretch of fractured flats stretching toward the southern horizon.

nodes.brief: A distant flash from a glasswright's mirror tower winks three times across the basin, signaling trouble on the high plateaus ahead.

exits.label: Approach the flapping canvas banner
Measure your remaining water sips
Take the reckless way

nodes.title: The Mirror Flash
nodes.page:
A sharp flash from a distant glasswright's mirror tower winks three times across the basin, signaling trouble and strict watchfulness on the high plateaus ahead. You shade your eyes against the glare, trying to decipher whether the code warns of shifting salt-storms or approaching toll-collectors.

The light fades into the shimmering haze, leaving you to decide your immediate path.

nodes.brief: You leap across a jagged fissure in the floor where purple mineral water gleams in the dark like liquid amethyst out of reach.

exits.label: Head toward the distant banner
Check your canteen water level
Listen to the chattering glass-reeds
Turn back

nodes.title: The Amethyst Fissure
nodes.page:
You leap gracefully across a jagged fissure in the floor where deep purple mineral water gleams in the dark like liquid amethyst completely out of reach. The damp scent of old sulfur rises from the crack, cool and sharp against the dry air of the flats.

On the far side, the path branches among various old markers and faint tracks.

nodes.brief: A discarded merchant's barrow with iron-spoked wheels sits abandoned in the glare, its canvas tilt shredded by the relentless alkali gales.

exits.label: Pass the chattering glass-reeds
Navigate the basalt paving slabs

nodes.title: The Rusted Barrow
nodes.page:
A discarded merchant's barrow with iron-spoked wheels sits completely abandoned in the glare, its canvas tilt shredded into ribbons by relentless alkali gales. Nothing remains inside save for a drift of fine white dust and the skeleton of an old wooden frame.

The narrow trail winds past the wreckage, leading deeper into the stark white expanse.

nodes.brief: You wipe a crust of salt from your forehead with the back of your glove, tasting bitter brine where the sweat has dried.

exits.label: Duck behind the crumbling slag wall
Pick your way past the basalt slabs

nodes.title: The Brine Crust
nodes.page:
You wipe a crust of salt from your forehead with the back of your glove, tasting bitter brine where the sweat has dried. The midday glare bounces off the flat basin floor like a sheet of white fire, making every distant salt-dome shimmer and waver in the heat. Your canvas pack feels heavier with every league, and the banked coals in your hip-lamp radiate a steady, familiar warmth against your thigh.

Ahead, the trail splits between a low wall of fused slag and a narrow defile choked with basalt blocks, forcing you to choose your footing carefully before the wind shifts.

nodes.brief: A low stone cairn built by earlier runners marks the boundary where the hard salt ends and the treacherous ash-crust begins.

exits.label: Take cover behind the slag rampart
Navigate around the blocked defile

nodes.title: The Ash Cairn
nodes.page:
A low stone cairn built by earlier runners marks the boundary where the hard salt ends and the treacherous ash-crust begins. You pause to test the stability of the grey, powdery earth with the toe of your boot, watching tiny puffs of dark dust settle back into the cracks. Somewhere out in the blinding distance, a mirror-signal flashes a brief, sharp greeting that vanishes almost as quickly as it appeared.

The wind carries the faint metallic tang of old iron and sulfur, urging you to decide whether to seek shelter from the rising gale or push deeper into the grey expanse.

nodes.brief: You pause to adjust your canvas gaiters, shaking out a handful of sharp quartz sand that threatens to skin your heels raw.

exits.label: Squeeze past the basalt-choked defile
Scrape the gypsum crust from your boots
Head toward the distant drift of wood-smoke

nodes.title: The Sharp Quartz
nodes.page:
You pause to adjust your canvas gaiters, shaking out a handful of sharp quartz sand that threatens to skin your heels raw. The arid wind whispers across the crystalline flats, carrying tiny grains that hiss against your leather coat like scattered seed. Your fingers brush the cold ceramic shape of the Seedkey in your pocket, reassuring you that your mission remains secure despite the punishing heat.

Three distinct paths beckon across the shimmering pan, each leading toward different hazards in the blinding expanse.

nodes.brief: A strange singing hum rises from the ground beneath your boots as the midday sun bakes the deeper strata of glass and salt.

exits.label: Bypass the heavy hand-cart in the gorge
Investigate the smell of distant wood-smoke

nodes.title: The Singing Ground
nodes.page:
Strange music rises from the ground beneath your boots as the midday sun bakes the deeper strata of glass and salt. Distant brass bells seem buried deep beneath the crust, and their chorus climbs through the soles of your feet in a low rhythmic knock. You check the glass lens of your belt-lamp to ensure the banked coals are secure against the vibrations.

Two routes lie open before you, one winding toward an obstacle of stone and the other toward the faint scent of smoke.

nodes.brief: Behind a screen of twisted iron slag, you catch your breath while watching a dust-devil spin across the flat like a grey dancer.

exits.label: Climb toward the northern timber palisade
Follow the groaning iron conduit pipe

nodes.title: The Gray Dancer
nodes.page:
Behind a screen of twisted iron slag, you catch your breath while watching a dust-devil spin across the flat like a grey dancer. The miniature tempest tears up flakes of dried mud and white salt, whirling them into a spinning pillar before dissolving into the empty air. Your throat feels dry as parchment, and you take a small, measured sip from your waterskin to clear the dust.

Two possible trails wind away from your makeshift shelter into the sun-bleached expanse.

nodes.brief: You examine a bleached wooden crate marked with the faded brand of the Candlemere trading guild, found empty in a salt-hollow.

exits.label: Head toward the distant palisade ridge

nodes.title: The Empty Guild Crate
nodes.page:
You examine a bleached wooden crate marked with the faded brand of the Candlemere trading guild, found empty in a salt-hollow. The dry air has split its pine staves wide open, leaving it completely useless for storing anything against the coming monsoon. Yet its presence reminds you that other runners from your home town have passed this way before, facing the same relentless glare and thirst.

A single path winds away from the hollow toward the northern ridges of the basin.

nodes.brief: A flight of pale desert grouse bursts from a sinkhole of dry reeds, startling your hand toward the heavy lamp on your hip.

exits.label: Follow the path beside the groaning conduit
Inspect the battered tariff warning sign
Take shelter beneath the deserted lean-to

nodes.title: The Desert Grouse
nodes.page:
A flight of pale desert grouse bursts from a sinkhole of dry reeds, startling your hand toward the heavy lamp on your hip. The birds beat their wings against the dry wind before vanishing into the shimmering haze above the salt-domes. You let out a quiet breath, easing your grip on the lantern as the sudden rustle fades into silence.

Several tracks diverge from the reed-choked hollow, offering different directions across the flats.

nodes.brief: You step onto a causeway paved with hexagonal blocks of green bottle-glass that gleam like emeralds under the punishing vertical sun.

exits.label: Descend toward the northern timber palisade
Continue along the groaning iron pipe
Turn back toward the acacia ribs

nodes.title: The Emerald Causeway
nodes.page:
You step onto a causeway paved with hexagonal blocks of green bottle-glass that gleam like emeralds under the punishing vertical sun. The ancient glass is cool to the touch despite the heat, fused together by forgotten arts that left the roadway smoother than any natural stone. Your boots click rhythmically against the green tiles as you scan the horizon for any sign of movement.

You can press onward along the luminous tiles, seek a different route, or retrace your steps.

nodes.brief: An old salt-scraper's spade stands upright in a mound of tailings, its rusted iron blade stained with orange streaks of oxidized iron.

exits.label: Tread carefully across the pink alkali drift

nodes.title: The Rusted Spade
nodes.page:
An old salt-scraper's spade stands upright in a mound of tailings, its rusted iron blade stained with orange streaks of oxidized iron. The wooden handle has bleached to a pale silver under decades of unfiltered desert sunlight, driven deep into the crust by someone who never returned to claim it. You touch the cold metal blade as you pass, feeling the absolute stillness of the empty basin pressing in from all sides.

A single trail leads away from the marker toward a shimmering field of pink dust.

nodes.brief: You navigate a labyrinth of jagged salt-pillars that cast razor-sharp blue shadows across the blinding white expanse of the basin.

exits.label: Follow the path of the groaning iron conduit
Step across the bright magenta alkali dust

nodes.title: The Salt Pillars
nodes.page:
You navigate a labyrinth of jagged salt-pillars that cast razor-sharp blue shadows across the blinding white expanse of the basin. Each pillar stands like a frozen wave of brine, sculpted by centuries of alkali winds into strange, jagged spires that tower overhead. The air trapped between the pillars is dead and hot, smelling faintly of sulfur and ancient sea-salt.

Two narrow gaps in the salt formation invite you to continue your journey.

nodes.brief: A tethered leather water-bag hangs from a dead telegraph pole, but when you lift it, you find only dry dust and disappointment.

exits.label: Follow the weathered boundary markers toward the tariff fence
Seek temporary shelter beneath the corrugated iron lean-to

nodes.title: The Empty Waterskin
nodes.page: A tethered leather water-bag hangs from a dead telegraph pole, swaying gently in the dry thermal drafts that sweep across the Bitterflats. When you lift the cracked pouch by its hempen cord, you find only dry dust and bitter disappointment sifting through the seams. Your ember-lamp knocks softly against your thigh as you look ahead along the white, baking expanse.

nodes.brief: Moving in silence without a guide's chatter lets you spot the faint boot-prints of a Salt Court patrol veering off toward the east.

exits.label: Take the path past the weathered copper tariff warnings

priv.why: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over

nodes.title: The Solitary Tracks
nodes.page: Walking completely alone leaves your thoughts entirely to yourself, undisturbed by any companion's chatter or the clink of hired gear. Moving in this unbroken silence lets you spot the faint boot-prints of a Salt Court patrol veering off toward the east, cutting a sharp line across the alkali crust. You adjust the heavy strap of your ember-lamp and weigh your solitary path against the shimmering horizon.

nodes.brief: You cross a flat expanse where the salt has cracked into giant hexagonal tiles that tilt crazily like stepping-stones over mud.

exits.label: Take shelter beneath the corrugated iron roof
Follow the track past the clattering camel skulls

nodes.title: The Tilting Tiles
nodes.page:
Giant hexagonal tiles of crusted salt heave upward from the grey mud like the carapaces of buried tortoises, tilting at sharp, treacherous angles across the blinding flat. Your boots slip on the damp, alkaline seams between the tilting plates, sending small cascades of salt-dust rattling into the black mire below. Your banked ember-lamp digs into your thigh, its mild warmth set against the freezing glare of the basin. Ahead, the path bifurcates around a rusted iron lean-to slumped against a heap of tailings, while off to the right, a dry wire hums in the rising thermal wind above a clattering row of sun-bleached skulls.

You pause on a tilted slab to test the slick mud beneath your left heel before deciding which direction to press through the white furnace.

nodes.brief: A tattered canvas banner bearing the scales of the Salt Court flutters feebly from a rusted iron stake planted in a mound.

exits.label: Cut toward the corrugated iron lean-to by the old track
Follow the wire strung with clacking camel skulls further north
Circle closer to the wooden rampart of the toll-hut

nodes.title: The Salt Court Banner
nodes.page: A tattered canvas banner bearing the scales of the Salt Court flutters feebly from a rusted iron stake planted deep in an alkali mound. The fabric is bleached bone-white by the relentless basin sun, its painted emblems flaking away into the dust. You pull your collar higher against the glare and grip your ember-lamp tightly as you survey the branching tracks ahead.

nodes.brief: You dip your fingers into your canteen, measuring your remaining sips against the long miles remaining before the toll-hut appears.

exits.label: Follow the wire hung with dried camel skulls along the track
Peer through the gap in the salt-mound toward the tax-station
Approach the wooden rampart where the lone guard paces

nodes.title: Measuring the Sips
nodes.page: You dip your fingers into your canteen, measuring your remaining sips against the long miles remaining before the toll-hut appears through the haze. The cool metal feels precious against your skin, reminding you just how few drops stand between you and the thirst of the basin. The road stretches onward through blinding white salt-pans under a pitiless sky.

nodes.brief: A cluster of dried glass-reeds chatters musically in the hot draft, sounding like wind chimes hung in an abandoned temple porch.

exits.label: Make your way toward the corrugated iron lean-to ahead
Take the track marked by the string of dried camel skulls

nodes.title: The Singing Glass-Reeds
nodes.page: A cluster of dried glass-reeds chatters musically in the hot draft, sounding like wind chimes hung in an abandoned temple porch. Their hollow, crystalline voices ring out with strange clarity across the otherwise silent expanse of the Bitterflats. You pause for a heartbeat to listen to the eerie music before checking the heavy cold ceramic shape of the Seedkey in your pocket.

nodes.brief: You duck behind a crumbling retaining wall of fused slag as a sudden gust of wind whips the white dust into a choking fog.

exits.label: Inspect the low palisade of the nearby tax-station
Advance cautiously toward the wooden rampart of the toll-hut

nodes.title: The Slag Wall
nodes.page: You duck behind a crumbling retaining wall of fused slag as a sudden gust of wind whips the white dust into a choking fog. The sharp grit stings your cheeks and coats your eyelashes, blotting out the glaring sun for a few tense moments. As the pale storm begins to settle, the familiar shapes of the basin edge loom closer through the haze.

nodes.brief: An abandoned hand-cart loaded with heavy basalt paving slabs blocks the narrow defile between two salt-domes you must traverse.

exits.label: Slip past the cart toward the corrugated iron shelter
Follow the track past the wire strung with camel skulls
Move forward to inspect the palisade of the tax-station

nodes.title: The Basalt Blockade
nodes.page: An abandoned hand-cart loaded with heavy basalt paving slabs blocks the narrow defile between two salt-domes you must traverse. The wooden wheels have long since warped and split in the dry heat, leaving the cargo stranded squarely across your path. You squeeze past the jagged stone edges, making sure your ember-lamp does not strike the rough basalt.

nodes.brief: You scrape a layer of crystalline gypsum off your leather boots to lighten your load before tackling the steeper incline ahead.

exits.label: Head toward the copper sign warning of basin tariffs
Take the winding track beneath the clacking camel skulls
Approach the wooden rampart of the nearby toll-hut

nodes.title: The Gypsum Crust
nodes.page: You scrape a layer of crystalline gypsum off your leather boots to lighten your load before tackling the steeper incline ahead. The hardened flakes fall away in small white scales, clinking softly against the salt floor as you work with your pocket-knife. With your footing restored, you hoist the strap of your ember-lamp and look up at the bright horizon.

nodes.brief: A faint smell of wood-smoke drifts across the salt-pans from an unseen hearth hidden somewhere in the shimmering heat haze.

exits.label: Examine the low palisade of the tax-station ahead
Approach the wooden rampart where the guard keeps watch

nodes.title: The Wood-Smoke Drift
nodes.page: A faint smell of wood-smoke drifts across the salt-pans from an unseen hearth hidden somewhere in the shimmering heat haze. It is an unexpected scent in this vast desert of salt and glass, carrying a faint tang of burning scrub-root. You test the air for a moment, wondering who else might be burning fuel in the Bitterflats before pressing on.

nodes.brief: You climb a low ridge of crusted silt and look down upon the low timber palisade of the Salt Court's northern toll-station.

exits.label: Descend the slope toward the timber gate

nodes.title: The Northern Palisade
nodes.page: Ridge crests offer a harsh vantage over the low timber palisade of the Salt Court's northern toll-station, where watch-fires smolder against the blinding white expanse. Below, armed wardens patrol the perimeter while wagons laden with blocks of coarse mineral wait in the baking heat for their papers to be stamped. Your ember-lamp feels heavy against your thigh, its banked coals radiating a dull, familiar warmth that matches the sweat stinging your brow. You grip the strap of your pack and consider whether to circle wider around the station or test your luck along the rutted track.

nodes.brief: A rusted iron conduit pipe emerges from the salt floor beside your path, groaning softly as it expands in the ferocious midday heat.

exits.label: Follow the groaning conduit toward the station

nodes.title: The Groaning Pipe
nodes.page: Iron pipes emerge from the fractured salt floor beside your path, groaning softly as midday heat makes the metal expand with a metallic click. Rust flakes off the ancient conduit in orange scales and stains the pristine white crystals under your boots. The air shimmers with mirages, bending the horizon into liquid pools that vanish whenever you blink. Adjusting your grip on your ember-lamp, you weigh the wisdom of following this old utility line or cutting across the open crust toward the looming toll-station.

nodes.brief: You step gingerly over a drift of pink alkali dust that leaves bright magenta stains across the toes of your heavy boots.

exits.label: Skirt the pink dust toward the smoke
Press straight ahead along the main track

nodes.title: Pink Alkali Dust
nodes.page: Magenta powder drifts across the salt flats in soft dunes, leaving bright, chemical stains across the leather toes of your heavy boots. This alkaline drift burns the nostrils with a sharp, vinegar tang whenever the dry wind shifts. Further ahead, the landscape fractures into deeper trenches of salt and glass, while a faint plume of wood-smoke rises near the perimeter of the Salt Court's station.

nodes.brief: A battered copper sign nailed to a fence-post warns unauthorized travelers of heavy basin tariffs and mandatory debt registration.

exits.label: Take the side track away from the notice
March boldly toward the main gate

nodes.title: The Battered Sign
nodes.page: Weathered copper plates nailed to a fence-post warn unauthorized travelers of heavy basin tariffs and mandatory debt registration enforced by the Salt Court. Green verdigris streaks the metal letters, making the stern warnings almost illegible under the harsh glare of the high sun. Beyond the post, the well-worn trail leads directly toward the fortified perimeter of the regional tax-station. You run a thumb over the cold ceramic key in your hidden pocket, wondering if you can slip past the notice unnoticed.

nodes.brief: You shelter briefly beneath the corrugated iron lean-to of a deserted toll-keeper's shelter while checking your map for hidden tracks.

exits.label: Step out and follow the hidden map-track
Head directly toward the guarded outpost ahead

nodes.title: The Corrugated Lean-To
nodes.page: Rusted iron sheets rattle in the hot wind above a deserted toll-keeper's shelter that offers a brief, welcome pocket of shade from the blazing sky. Unrolling a creased salt-stained map across a barrel top, you search for hidden tracks that bypass the watchful eyes of the Salt Court wardens. Outside the makeshift roof, the blinding white glare of the Bitterflats stretches toward a distant horizon of jagged glass spires. You fold the parchment away and prepare to make your next move.

nodes.brief: A string of dried camel skulls hangs from a wire above the track, clacking together in the hot wind like bone wind-chimes.

exits.label: Walk beneath the skulls toward the gate
Detour around the bone-strung boundary

nodes.title: Skulls on a Wire
nodes.page: Bleached camel skulls hang from a rusted wire stretched above the track, clacking together in the hot wind like bone wind-chimes played by a skeleton. Their hollow eye sockets gaze out over the endless expanse of salt and glass with permanent, unblinking indifference. The metallic clatter echoes loudly in the heavy air, warning any approaching traveler of the territory they are entering. You duck beneath the grim barrier and ready your pace for the approach to the outpost.

nodes.brief: You peer through a gap in the salt-mound and see the low palisade of the tax-station less than a hundred paces away.

exits.label: Skirt the mound toward the outer fence
Approach the station entrance head-on

nodes.title: Through the Salt Mound
nodes.page: Jagged mounds of crystallized mineral afford a narrow vantage through which you peer at the low timber palisade of the tax-station less than a hundred paces away. Sentries in boiled-leather jerkins pace the ramparts, swinging brass tally-keys that catch the fierce sunlight in blinding flashes. Your ember-lamp warms your hip with banked coal heat, and you think of the Candlemere hearths you left behind. You draw back into the shadow of the salt-drift to weigh your options before the guards look your way.

nodes.brief: A lone guard in a boiled-leather jerkin paces the wooden rampart of the nearby toll-hut, swinging a heavy brass tally-key.

exits.label: Wait for the guard to turn and approach

nodes.title: The Pacing Guard
nodes.page: Boots grind against the wooden rampart as a lone guard in a boiled-leather jerkin paces the toll-hut perimeter, swinging a brass tally-key by its leather thong. The rhythmic clink of metal against brass punctuates the oppressive silence of the salt basin. Below the platform, the main path narrows into a bottleneck flanked by sharp stakes and barbed wire. You slip into a shallow hollow in the salt crust, waiting for the sentry to turn his back so you can make your move.

nodes.brief: You approach the heavy timber gate of the toll-hut where a brass bell hangs from a gallows-frame above the dusty track.

exits.label: Ring the bell and press on inside

nodes.title: The Hanging Bell
nodes.page: Heavy timber gates bar the entrance to the compound where a brass bell hangs from a gallows-frame above the dusty, sun-baked track. A thick layer of white dust coats the wood, and the surrounding walls hum with the low murmur of ledger-clerks tallying up traveler debts within. Your fingers graze the cold ceramic surface of the Seedkey in your pocket, steadying your nerves against the coming confrontation. At the threshold you reach for the striker that hangs beside the gate.

nodes.brief: A ledger-clerk in spectacles sits behind a barred window in the toll-hut wall, tapping a quill against a greasy stack of debt-bonds.

exits.label: Speak with the clerk and press on

nodes.title: The Ledger-Clerk
nodes.page: Spectacles gleam behind a barred window set into the thick timber wall of the toll-hut as a ledger-clerk taps a quill against a greasy stack of debt-bonds. The scratch of pen on parchment fills the stifling air of the intake chamber, and flies circle the inkpot in a lazy cloud. Outside the iron bars, you clutch your pack tighter, knowing that every traveler entering this zone must either bargain with the scribes or find another way across. You clear your throat to announce your presence to the man behind the glass.

nodes.brief: You halt before the bolted wicket of the Salt Court outpost, where a copper placard announces that all travelers must pay or borrow.

exits.label: Press on past the guarded barrier

nodes.title: The Bolted Wicket
nodes.page: A copper placard bolted to the timber post proclaims that all travelers must satisfy the toll or bind themselves to the ledger before crossing the salt-crust. You halt before the small iron wicket, your hand resting lightly on the cold brass cylinder of the Seedkey in your pocket while your banked coal-lantern radiates a steady, comforting warmth against your hip. Behind thick spectacles the clerk taps a quill against a stack of parchment debt-bonds as the desert wind rattles the dry hinges.

nodes.brief: The heavy oak door of the toll-hut swings open on creaking iron hinges as a tax-collector steps out to bar your onward path.

exits.label: Press on along the dusty track

nodes.title: The Heavy Oak Door
nodes.page: On creaking iron hinges the oak door of the toll-hut swings wide to show a tax-collector in an oiled leather coat that smells of brine and dried ink. He steps directly into your path, blocking the narrow track across the shimmering white flats with an immovable posture and a hand held out for tribute. Behind him, the interior of the hut glows with the yellow light of tallow candles, casting long shadows across open ledgers and heavy iron lockboxes that hold the fortunes of the Basin's debtors.

nodes.brief: Beyond the iron toll-hut, you skirt a crater of singing glass where dry desert winds pluck strange chords from jagged shards.

exits.label: Follow the winding track past the crater

exits.privWhy: the reader's ember-lamp is burning and draws or reveals something
exits.label: Inspect the singing shards closer by your lamp
Take a wide berth around the ringing hollow

nodes.title: The Singing Glass
nodes.page: Beyond the iron toll-hut, you skirt a vast circular crater where jagged shards of green and amber glass protrude from the white earth like the teeth of a sleeping beast. Dry desert winds sweep across the jagged edges, plucking strange, haunting chords that vibrate through the soles of your boots and set your teeth on edge. The air here shimmers with dry heat, distorting the horizon into a dancing wall of silver mirages that makes it difficult to tell solid ground from alkaline mire.

nodes.brief: Past the toll-keepers, you follow a sunken drainage trench where bleached crusts of salt flake off beneath your boots.

exits.label: Climb out onto the open salt flats
Search the ruined culvert ahead
Follow the trench deeper into the maze

nodes.title: The Sunken Trench
nodes.page: Past the toll-keepers, you follow a sunken drainage trench where bleached crusts of salt flake off in dry white scales beneath your heavy boots. The trench walls shelter you from the scouring desert wind, though the air at the bottom smells stagnant and thick with old alkali dust. Overhead, the relentless midday sun beats down upon the rim of the cutting, turning the narrow path into a stifling kiln where every breath tastes of ancient ocean beds.

nodes.brief: Beside a rusted salt-pan, an old mender named Mallow trade tales of buried cisterns for a scrap of dried mutton.

exits.label: Step carefully across the white alkaline crust
Skirt the edge of the simmering pink pool
Heed the warning of the weary packer nearby
Squeeze through the narrow cleft of green panes

nodes.title: The Old Mender
nodes.page: Beside a rusted iron salt-pan, an old mender named Mallow sits cross-legged on a woven rush mat, patiently soldering cracked glass lenses with a tiny spirit-flame. He looks up as your boots crunch on the salt, offering to trade tales of buried cisterns and hidden water-vaults in exchange for a meager scrap of your dried mutton. The rich smell of toasted fat mingles with the sharp tang of flux as he gestures toward a shaded corner of the pan.

nodes.brief: Your burning ember-lamp catches the amber gleam of a half-buried ceramic marker, revealing a secret trench that shaves leagues off the route.

exits.label: Squeeze through the singing green window-panes
Slip past the abandoned watch-tower quietly
Walk across the field of shattered milk-glass

priv.why: the reader's ember-lamp is burning and draws or reveals something

nodes.title: The Hidden Trench
nodes.page: Your burning ember-lamp casts a warm, ruddy glow that catches the amber gleam of a half-buried ceramic marker protruding from the white salt crust. The familiar light reveals a narrow, hidden trench choked with dry desert tumbleweeds that shaves leagues off the tedious route around the alkaline flats. Stepping down into the sheltered cutting, you feel the wind drop away entirely, leaving you in a quiet, shadowy corridor of earth and old brick.

nodes.brief: Under the harsh glare of noon, you dodge a team of salt-scrapers hauling blocks on creaking wooden sledges.

exits.label: Slip past the old watch-tower ruins
Cross the field of shattered milk-glass
Wade through the dry drainage ditch
Follow the glass milestone northward

nodes.title: The Salt-Scrapers
nodes.page: Under the harsh, unsparing glare of noon, you dodge a team of weary salt-scrapers hauling massive white blocks on creaking wooden sledges across the blinding pan. The workers pull in unison against hemp harnesses, sunburned faces caked in a thick crust of salt until they resemble statues carved from sea-foam. Flat against a stack of dried reeds, you let the convoy rumble past without catching the overseer's eye.

nodes.brief: You cross a flat expanse of crazed glaze where your shadow stretches long and thin across the white alkali waste.

exits.privWhy: the reader walks with a banked, dark lamp and slips through unseen
exits.label: Slip past the sleeping sentry unseen
Cross the dry silt bed of hexagonal patterns
Pass the solitary glass-shingle roof

nodes.title: The Crazed Expanse
nodes.page: You cross a flat expanse of crazed glaze where the white earth has fused into a brilliant, porcelain-like sheet that stretches unbroken to the shimmering horizon. Your long, thin shadow races ahead of you across the white waste, distorted by the rising heat waves into a dancing, spectral silhouette. Every step produces a sharp, brittle crackle like walking on a frozen lake in the dead of winter, though the air burns your lungs with dry desert heat.

nodes.brief: Near a collapsed culvert, you find a discarded brass compass housing spinning wildly in the magnetic salt-haze.

exits.label: Climb the crumbling crystal ridge
Inspect the sealed well-head
Hide from the trotting wardens

nodes.title: The Spinning Housing
nodes.page: Near a collapsed culvert, you find a discarded brass compass housing spinning wildly in the magnetic salt-haze. The needle within has long since shattered, leaving only a frantic, copper-weighted stub that whips around against the glass like a trapped beetle. Your ember-lamp sputters, its banked wick shivering as a sudden thermal draft breathes up from the buried drainage pipes beneath your boots.

nodes.brief: You navigate a labyrinth of salt-heaps piled high by ancient dredges, keeping your lamp shielded from prying eyes.

exits.label: Hide from the trotting wardens
Watch the heat-mirage giants
Follow the vibrating telegraph wire

nodes.title: Among the Salt-Heaps
nodes.page: You navigate a labyrinth of salt-heaps piled high by ancient dredges, keeping your lamp shielded from prying eyes. Every footfall on the crystalline gravel sounds as loud as falling porcelain in the heavy, breathless air of the basin. Above the jagged crests of the mounds, the sun beats down with a flat, white glare that turns your own shadow into a pool of ink.

nodes.brief: A stray dust-devil dances across the alkaline crust ahead, kicking up spirals of blinding white powder.

exits.label: Share water beneath the broken dish
Skirt the hissing sulfur fumarole
Turn back toward the toll-hut

nodes.title: The Alkaline Dust-Devil
nodes.page:
A stray dust-devil dances across the alkaline crust ahead, kicking up spirals of blinding white powder that sting your eyes. Your hand instinctively brushes against the cold ceramic key at your belt, reassuring yourself it remains safe as you weigh your path through the shimmering haze.

To your left, a massive solar dish lies broken and half-submerged in the crust, offering a patch of shade where someone might rest. To your right, a jagged fissure vents a steady stream of superheated sulfur into the dry air. Behind you lies the familiar perimeter of the toll-hut and the strange musical crater.

nodes.brief: You skirt the edge of a simmering salt-pool where pink brine crusts into sharp, geometric needles.

exits.label: Rest near the solar dish
Pass the hissing sulfur vent

nodes.title: The Pink Brine Pool
nodes.page:
You skirt the edge of a simmering salt-pool where pink brine crusts into sharp, geometric needles that crunch under your soles with a delicate chime. The heat rising off the stagnant water creates shimmering ribbons of light that distort the distant horizon into shifting towers of glass and shadow.

Two paths open before you across the dazzling pan. You can press toward the shadow of a fallen metal collector dish where travellers often pause, or veer toward a narrow vent where sulfurous vapour curls from a fracture in the basin floor.

nodes.brief: A weary packer named Vane rests beside a milestone carved from green bottle-glass, warning of alkaline mires ahead.

exits.label: Rest beneath the solar dish
Trade with the wandering tinker

nodes.title: The Green Milestone
nodes.page: A weary packer named Vane rests beside a milestone carved from green bottle-glass, warning of alkaline mires ahead. He wipes a crust of salt from his eyebrows and gestures toward the shimmering white flats with a cracked thumb. Your lamp oil sloshes a slow rhythm against the tin housing as you pause to catch your breath in his shadow.

nodes.brief: You squeeze through a narrow cleft between two tilted slabs of fused green window-panes singing faintly in the draft.

exits.label: Walk past the steaming fissure
Approach the skeletal transport barge

nodes.title: The Fused Green Cleft
nodes.page:
You squeeze through a narrow cleft between two tilted slabs of fused green window-panes that sing faintly in the dry draft, crystalline edges shivering in the thin air. The passage opens into a wider corridor of the desolate basin where the glare hits with renewed intensity.

Ahead, a plume of sulfurous steam rises from a jagged crack in the floor, while further off, the massive skeletal ribcage of an ancient transport barge casts a long, dark shadow over the glass dunes.

nodes.brief: Keeping your head low, you slip past an abandoned Salt Court watch-tower where rusty shutter-hinges squeak in the thermal wind.

exits.label: Scramble down the steep alkaline bank
Navigate the sharp ammonia sump

nodes.title: The Rusted Watch-Tower
nodes.page:
Keeping your head low, you slip past an abandoned Salt Court watch-tower where rusty shutter-hinges squeak rhythmically in the thermal wind. The empty structure looms like a skeletal sentinel over the empty pan, its observation slits dark and silent against the glare.

You can scramble down a steep, unstable bank choked with loose flint and fine alkaline dust, or press onward toward a low basin where the heavy, sharp tang of ammonia hangs thick in the superheated air.

nodes.brief: Your boots crunch over a field of shattered milk-glass that scatters the blinding sunlight into dancing rainbow splinters.

exits.label: Inspect the half-melted ceramic jars
Avoid the evaporating industrial sump
Approach the solitary salt-crusted raven

nodes.title: The Milk-Glass Field
nodes.page:
Your boots crunch over a field of shattered milk-glass that scatters the blinding sunlight into dancing rainbow splinters across the white ground. The scattered shards chime like tiny bells with every step you take through this fragile, luminous waste.

Several features break the monotony of the glittering expanse. You spot a row of hollow ceramic jars half-fused into the crust, a reeking sump where the air tastes of ammonia, and a lone raven perched upon a bleached telegraph pole in the distance.

nodes.brief: You wade through a shallow drainage ditch choked with powdery salt and dried desert scrub roots.

exits.label: Follow the ditch past the ceramic jars
Climb toward the ammonia-scented depression

nodes.title: The Dry Drainage Ditch
nodes.page:
You wade through a shallow drainage ditch choked with powdery salt and the tangled, desiccated roots of ancient desert scrub that crackle beneath your boots. The trench offers a brief respite from the relentless wind, though the air at the bottom is stale and heavy with mineral dust.

The trench leads toward a line of half-melted ceramic vessels embedded in the surrounding crust, or opens out near a shimmering depression where the sharp, pungent scent of ammonia drifts on the thermal currents.

nodes.brief: An old milestone shaped like a tapering glass finger points toward the northern horizon with its tip sheared off.

exits.label: Head toward the skeletal barge
Examine the half-melted ceramic jars
Cross the warped iron girder bridge

nodes.title: The Sheared Glass Milestone
nodes.page:
An old milestone shaped like a tapering glass finger points toward the northern horizon with its tip sheared cleanly off by some forgotten blast. Its translucent surface catches the harsh light, casting fractured green and violet glows across the salt-crusted earth around your boots.

From this marker, you can trace your way toward the skeletal remains of an ancient transport barge resting on a glass dune, inspect a row of half-melted ceramic jars, or pick your path across a precarious bridge of warped iron girders spanning a gaping void.

nodes.brief: Moving with your ember-lamp banked entirely dark, you slip past a snoring toll-sentry slumped against a stack of salt-sacks.

exits.label: Follow the northern telegraph poles

exits.privWhy: the reader walks with a banked, dark lamp and slips through unseen
exits.label: Bypass the toll-station quietly

priv.why: the reader walks with a banked, dark lamp and slips through unseen

nodes.title: The Sleeping Sentry
nodes.page: Your ember-lamp remains banked and completely dark, its heat trapped beneath a tight lid as you pad softly across the crust. A towering stack of burlap salt-sacks forms a convenient screen against the wind and the toll-house light. Slumped directly against the cargo is a snoring sentry in a heavy wool coat, his brass tally-counter dangling idly from a leather thong. You move with absolute quiet, your boots brushing the white dust without making a sound until the guard's ragged breath fades behind you into the dry air.

nodes.brief: You cross a dry silt bed where the cracked earth forms intricate hexagonal patterns like a colossal tiled floor.

exits.label: Cross the warped iron girder bridge

exits.privWhy: the reader walks with a banked, dark lamp and slips through unseen
exits.label: Skirt past the distant guard patrol
Thread through the copper pipe forest

nodes.title: The Hexagonal Silt
nodes.page:
Cracked earth stretches in every direction like a colossal, sun-baked mosaic of interlocking hexagonal tiles, each one rimmed in white salt. The ground crunches faintly under your boots, shifting with a dry, papery rattle across the ancient lakebed. Heat ripples distort the horizon where the jagged silhouettes of the glass cities shimmer like floating islands. You pause for a breath, listening to the hollow echo of your own heartbeat in the vast emptiness.

Three distinct routes diverge across the cracked silt basin, each leading toward different hazards in the blinding glare.

nodes.brief: A solitary glass-shingle roof protrudes from the white pan like a tombstone marking a buried courtyard.

exits.privWhy: the reader walks with a banked, dark lamp and slips through unseen
exits.label: Slip past the resting tax-collectors
Pick your way through the copper pipes

nodes.title: The Buried Courtyard
nodes.page:
A solitary roof made of overlapping glass shingles juts out from the white pan like a jagged tombstone marking a buried courtyard below. The panes gleam with an eerie, sea-green luminescence despite the decades of scouring wind and abrasive dust. Peering down through a narrow gap between the warped framing, you see only deep shadow and the glint of ancient metal stairways leading down into the cool dark.

The glaring expanse continues around the sunken ruin, offering paths deeper into the white salt.

nodes.brief: You climb a low ridge of crushed crystal waste that crumbles treacherously beneath every hurried footstep.

exits.label: Head toward the broken signpost
Traverse the black obsidian terrace

nodes.title: The Crystal Ridge
nodes.page:
Crushed crystal waste forms a treacherous, loose-shingled ridge that slides and crumbles beneath every hurried footstep you take. Jagged shards of amber and green glass clink together musically with every shift in your weight, threatening to betray your passage to anyone listening across the flats. You lean forward into the slope, using your balanced weight to keep from slipping down the steep bank of glittering debris.

The crest of the ridge reveals two stark paths descending into the shimmering basin below.

nodes.brief: Beside a rusted winch frame, you inspect a dry well-head sealed with lead mortar and stamped with court insignia.

exits.label: Navigate through the copper pipe maze
Follow the path toward the broken signpost
Wipe your brow and press onward
Take the reckless way

nodes.title: The Sealed Well
nodes.page:
A rusted winch frame creaks rhythmically in the dry desert breeze above a stone well-head sealed tightly with thick lead mortar. Stamped heavily into the lead is the official seal of the Salt Court, marking the water as private property bought and paid for with heavy tolls. A faint smell of stagnant moisture rises from beneath the seal, reminding you sharply of the thirst burning in your throat.

Several options lie open before you under the relentless glare of the midday sun.

nodes.brief: You duck behind a towering stack of wooden crates as a patrol of mounted toll-wardens trots across the horizon.

exits.label: Cross the sun-baked obsidian terrace
Follow the wind-blown ledger page

nodes.title: The Obsidian Ridge
nodes.page:
A patrol of mounted toll-wardens trots across the distant horizon, their lances catching the harsh sunlight in brief, blinding flashes. You duck low behind a towering stack of wooden packing crates, holding your breath while the rhythmic thud of hooves reverberates through the salt crust. Once the riders vanish behind a swell of white dunes, you let out a slow, quiet breath and check the seal on your canvas pack.

The flat expanse stretches away from your hiding spot toward two distinct routes.

nodes.brief: A shimmering heat-mirage makes a distant line of telegraph poles look like towering glass giants wading through water.

exits.label: Walk across the black obsidian terrace
Chase the fluttering white ledger page
Duck beneath the swinging copper cable

nodes.title: The Shimmering Mirage
nodes.page:
Heat-mirages twist the landscape until a distant line of telegraph poles appears as towering glass giants wading waist-deep through an illusory sea. The air shimmers and dances just above the salt crust, making distances impossible to judge with any real certainty. Your eyes ache from the relentless glare bouncing off the endless white expanse around you.

Three tracks lead away from the shimmering heat distortion into the dry basin.

nodes.brief: You navigate by the low hum of a vibrating telegraph wire strung between two leaning iron pylons.

exits.label: Pass beneath the swinging copper cable

nodes.title: The Humming Wire
nodes.page:
A taut telegraph wire strung between two leaning iron pylons sings a thin metallic note across the white salt crust. Blind glare erases the horizon, so you steer by that acoustic vibration and the metallic sound alone. The wire shivers under a dry thermal updraft while you plant your boots on the crust.

The singing wire leads you straight toward a dangling obstacle swaying in the wind.

nodes.brief: Beneath a shattered solar-collector dish, you share a swallow of lukewarm water with a stranded caravan muleteer.

exits.label: Trace the edge of the dried silt basin
Squeeze through the crumbling brick wall
Turn back toward the old salt-pan

nodes.title: The Solar Basin
nodes.page:
Beneath a shattered solar-collector dish that curves toward the sky like a broken metal shell, you pause to share a precious swallow of lukewarm water with a stranded muleteer. The traveler's pack-mule stands patiently beside the wreckage, its ribs showing faintly beneath a dusty grey hide. You trade brief nods of solidarity against the harshness of the basin before checking your bearings for the journey ahead.

The basin splits into three distinct paths around the wreckage of the solar dish.

nodes.brief: You skirt a steaming fumarole where sulfurous gas hisses through a jagged crack in the crystalline basin floor.

exits.label: Follow the edge of the fissured silt plates
Turn back toward the old salt-pan

nodes.title: The Hissing Fumarole
nodes.page:
Sulfur-laden gas hisses sharply through a jagged fracture in the crystalline basin floor, puffing small clouds of yellow dust into the stifling air. You skirt wide around the steaming fumarole, keeping your nose wrapped in a dry cloth to filter out the stinging chemical stench. The ground beneath your boots feels warm and hollow here, as if a subterranean furnace were burning just inches below the salt crust.

The steaming vent leaves you with a choice of two directions across the white flats.

nodes.brief: A wandering tinker named Jape offers to trade a blunt drawing knife for a pinch of salt-cured tobacco.

exits.label: Trade your tobacco for the heavy blade
Ignore the tinker and press onward alone

nodes.title: The Tinker's Trade
nodes.page: Copper kettles and broken spectacles dangle from a canvas roll as a wandering tinker named Jape halts his hand-cart beside a jagged salt pillar. He squints through thick wire-rimmed lenses, offering to trade a heavy, blunt drawing knife for a single small pinch of salt-cured tobacco from your pouch. The heat beats down relentlessly against the white crust, making the horizon shimmer like molten silver while you weigh his proposition against the miles still left to travel before dusk.

nodes.brief: You slip through the skeletal ribcage of an ancient transport barge stranded high upon a glass dune.

exits.label: Climb across the splintered deck toward the northern track
Squeeze through the bulkhead gap toward the eastern ruins

nodes.title: Ribs of the Barge
nodes.page: Rusted iron beams arch overhead like the skeleton of some colossal desert beast stranded high upon a towering dune of pulverized glass. You slip through the cavernous ribcage of the ancient transport barge, feeling the cool shadow cast by its metallic hull against the scorching midday glare. Wind sighs through the twisted bulkheads, whistling past old storage lockers long since picked clean by passing scavengers.

nodes.brief: Your lamp-fuel sloshes softly as you scramble down a steep embankment of alkaline dust and loose flint.

exits.label: Descend the sliding slope toward the northern path
Veer sideways along the ridge toward the crumbling wall
Slide down the dusty bank straight into the sea of glass beads

nodes.title: The Alkaline Slope
nodes.page: Your lamp-fuel sloshes softly against its tin walls as you scramble down a steep, treacherous embankment composed entirely of fine alkaline dust and loose, sharp-edged flint. Dust puffs around your boots with every cautious step, stinging your throat and coating your traveling cloak in a fine white powder. Below this sliding ridge, the blinding white expanse of the basin stretches out toward shimmering horizons cut by distant shadows of glass architecture.

nodes.brief: You pass a row of hollow ceramic jars half-melted into the glass crust by some forgotten furnace blast.

exits.label: Follow the fused jars toward the dry drainage basin
Turn aside to inspect the crumbling brick boundary wall
Head toward the rose quartz fountain filled with alkali dust

nodes.title: Melted Jars of Old
nodes.page: Rows of hollow ceramic jars stand half-fused into the luminous glass crust, warped and blistered by some immense, long-forgotten furnace blast from the Old Lensfolk eras. You run a gloved finger along the smooth, vitrified lip of a vessel that once held oils or grain, marveling at how the intense ancient heat transformed the desert floor into a smooth mirror. The air smells faintly of baked clay and old minerals as you pause between the silent, melted pottery.

nodes.brief: A sudden gust of hot wind carries the sharp tang of ammonia from an evaporating industrial sump.

exits.label: Skirt the chemical sump toward the broken brick wall
Cross the ringing silica tiles toward the sea of glass beads
Head past the sump toward the rose quartz fountain

nodes.title: The Industrial Sump
