nodes.page: A sudden gust of hot desert wind carries the sharp, stinging tang of ammonia across the flats from a bubbling, evaporating industrial sump nearby. You pull your collar over your nose and quicken your pace past the chemical hollow, watching pale yellow crystals form along the receding edge of the stagnant brine. The ground beneath your boots grows harder here, paved with flat tiles of fused silica that ring like ceramic underfoot.

nodes.brief: You step carefully across a bridge of warped iron girders spanning a gaping subsidence crater.

exits.label: Cross the warped iron girders toward the glass beads
Descend the crater rim toward the rose quartz fountain

nodes.title: The Subsidence Crater
nodes.page: Twisted iron girders span a gaping subsidence crater like the ribs of a collapsed bridge, their rusted bolts groaning softly in the rising heat. You step with extreme care across the warped metal span, keeping your eyes fixed on the firm crust beyond while the dark, empty pit gapes directly beneath your boots. Every movement must be measured, for a single slip would send you tumbling into the shadowy depths of the old drainage tunnels below.

nodes.brief: A lone raven with salt-crusted feathers watches your approach from atop a bleached wooden telegraph pole.

exits.label: Pass beneath the telegraph pole toward the rose quartz fountain
Climb the jagged slag embankment to test the hollow ground

nodes.title: The Salt-Crested Raven
nodes.page: A lone raven with feathers stiffened by white salt crystals watches your approach from atop a bleached, leaning wooden telegraph pole. It tilts its head with ancient curiosity, letting out a dry, rattling croak that echoes thinly across the empty expanse of the flats. Beyond its lonely perch, the landscape ripples with blinding mirages that distort the distant silhouettes of the shattered shard towers.

nodes.brief: Walking with your ember-lamp safely banked and cold, you bypass a patrol of tax-collectors resting near a glowing beacon.

exits.label: Slip past the resting patrol toward the crumbling brick wall
Head toward the dried rose quartz fountain in the distance

priv.why: the reader walks with a banked, dark lamp and slips through unseen

nodes.title: The Shadow of the Beacon
nodes.page: Walking with your ember-lamp safely banked and cold, you blend into the long shadows cast by a crumbling foundation and slip past a patrol of tax-collectors resting near a glowing survey beacon. Their brass instruments catch the harsh sunlight, but their eyes are heavy with boredom and heat, missing your silent passage entirely in the blinding white glare. You keep your head down and your breathing steady until the bright flare of their signal lamp is safely behind a ridge of fused slag.

nodes.brief: You thread your way through a forest of twisted copper pipes protruding like dead roots from the salt crust.

exits.label: Thread through the copper pipes toward the flashing tower
Scramble up the jagged slag embankment where the ground rings hollow

nodes.title: The Copper Roots
nodes.page: Twisted copper pipes jut from the hard salt crust like dead oxidized roots, and hot gusts whistle thin notes through their hollow cores. You thread your way carefully through the metallic thicket, ducking beneath branching elbows of green-stained brass that gleam like jewelry in the harsh light. The ground here is uneven and scarred with ancient pipe-trenches, requiring constant attention to avoid a twisted ankle.

nodes.brief: A weather-beaten wooden signpost points toward the distant shard cities with all its directional arms snapped off.

exits.label: Leave the faceless post behind and head toward the flashing tower

nodes.title: The Faceless Signpost
nodes.page: A weather-beaten wooden signpost leans drunkenly into the wind, all of its directional arms snapped clean off by decades of howling salt-storms. You pause beside the bare post, running a hand over the splintered wood where travelers once read the mileage to Prism and the outer cisterns. The white flats stretch out endlessly beyond, unbroken save for the sharp silhouette of a distant mirror-tower catching the noon sun.

nodes.brief: You wipe a film of fine white salt from your brow as the afternoon heat beats down mercilessly.

exits.label: Climb the jagged embankment of fused slag
Follow the deep cart-rut along the glass road

nodes.title: The White Glare
nodes.page: You wipe a film of fine white salt from your brow as the afternoon heat beats down mercilessly across the cracked basin. The distant hum of the copper pipes fades behind you, replaced by an oppressive silence that stretches toward the shimmering horizon. Your water skin feels light against your hip, a reminder of the dry miles yet to cross before dusk settles over the salt flats.

nodes.brief: You traverse a broad terrace of black obsidian tiles that absorb the sun's glare and radiate intense dry heat.

exits.label: Pause beside the dried-up rose quartz fountain
Scramble up the jagged slag embankment

nodes.title: The Obsidian Terrace
nodes.page:
You traverse a broad terrace of black obsidian tiles that absorb the sun's glare and radiate intense dry heat right through the soles of your boots. The polished stone mirrors the blinding sky above, turning the ground beneath you into a vast sheet of dark glass that shimmers with phantom vapors. Every step requires concentration to avoid the sharp fractures where the old pavement has buckled under centuries of thermal stress.

The terrace narrows ahead where a cluster of ruined structures casts a long, welcome strip of shadow. You can push straight toward the crumbling courtyard or swing outward across the open crust.

nodes.brief: A discarded ledger page flutters past your ankles, its ink completely bleached white by decades of glaring sun.

exits.label: Watch the distant mirror-signal flash across the flats
Follow the deep cart-rut carved into the ancient glass road

nodes.title: The Bleached Ledger
nodes.page:
A discarded ledger page flutters past your ankles, its ink completely bleached white by decades of glaring sun and dry desert air. You watch it skitter across the crusted salt before getting snagged on a jagged shard of green bottle-glass. The stillness of the basin presses down on your shoulders, broken only by the faint, rhythmic ticking of your banked coal-lantern cooling in the wind.

Ahead, the trail splits among the skeletal foundations of a sunken storehouse. You can press forward toward the flashing signals in the distance or keep your head down along the old trade tracks.

nodes.brief: You duck beneath a dangling length of copper cable that swings rhythmically in the dry desert breeze.

exits.label: Follow the deep cart-rut toward the looming horizon

nodes.title: The Swinging Cable
nodes.page:
You duck beneath a dangling length of copper cable that swings rhythmically in the dry desert breeze, humming a low, mournful note with every arc. The oxidized metal leaves a faint greenish stain on your shoulder as you brush past it into the open glare of the flats. Salt dust clings to your eyelashes, stinging with every blink as you scan the horizon for any landmark that might confirm your course toward Prism.

The path ahead winds between low mounds of wind-blown silt and shattered masonry. You can press onward along the cart-rut or seek a different bearing across the crust.

nodes.brief: You trace the edge of a deep drainage basin where the silt has dried into deep, fissured polygonal plates.

exits.label: Head toward the rusted iron threshold of the outer gate
Approach the perimeter where the sentry lowers a barrier pole
Step onto the polished obsidian paving stones of the outer avenue

nodes.title: The Polygonal Silt
nodes.page:
You trace the edge of a deep drainage basin where the silt has dried into deep, fissured polygonal plates that crack sharply under your weight like thin ice. The air here smells of old minerals and baked clay, devoid of any moisture or living green. Your ember-lamp rests warm against your chest, banked coals ticking like a small reliable heart in the vast emptiness.

Three separate routes diverge near the lip of the dry basin, leading deeper into the labyrinth of the outer shard districts.

nodes.brief: A nervous caravan scout named Hale warns you that the northern shard gates are bolted against late travellers.

exits.label: Head toward the rusted iron threshold of the outer gate anyway
Step onto the polished obsidian paving stones of the outer avenue

nodes.title: The Scout's Warning
nodes.page:
A nervous caravan scout named Hale warns you that the northern shard gates are bolted against late travellers and those without proper salt-tithes to pay. He wipes sweat from his neck with a dirty rag, eyeing your heavy coal-lantern with undisguised suspicion before gesturing back toward the open flats. The wind carries a faint metallic tang from the manufacturing quarters deeper within the ruins.

You can heed the scout's cautious advice and seek a different entry point or press on toward the main gates regardless.

nodes.brief: You squeeze through a narrow breach in a crumbling brick boundary wall choked with wind-blown crystal sand.

exits.label: Approach the perimeter where the sentry lowers a barrier pole
Step onto the polished obsidian paving stones of the outer avenue

nodes.title: The Crumbling Wall
nodes.page:
You squeeze through a narrow breach in a crumbling brick boundary wall choked with wind-blown crystal sand and dried desert scrub. The abrasive grit rasps against your canvas coat as you force your way into the shadowed alley beyond, leaving the blinding expanse of the bitterflats at your back. A stale, trapped heat hangs between the leaning towers like a woolen blanket.

The alley splits ahead into a pair of narrow corridors winding through the abandoned masonry. You can approach the guarded perimeter or make for the polished avenues further in.

nodes.brief: Your boots crunch over millions of tiny glass beads that roll beneath your soles like frozen morning dew.

exits.label: Head toward the rusted iron threshold of the outer gate
Approach the perimeter where the sentry lowers a barrier pole

nodes.title: The Glass Beads
nodes.page:
Your boots crunch over millions of tiny glass beads that roll beneath your soles like frozen morning dew, scattering in every direction with a sound like breaking waves. The ground here glitters with an iridescent sheen that hurts the eyes even through squinted lids. In the distance, the skeletal silhouettes of the Shard Cities rise against the pale sky like jagged teeth.

Two distinct gates present themselves across the shimmering expanse of beads.

nodes.brief: You pause beside a dried-up fountain carved from rose quartz, now filled only with fine white alkali dust.

exits.label: Head toward the rusted iron threshold of the outer gate
Step onto the polished obsidian paving stones of the outer avenue

nodes.title: The Rose Fountain
nodes.page:
You pause beside a dried-up fountain carved from rose quartz, now filled only with fine white alkali dust and a scattering of dead copper leaves. The stone is cool to the touch despite the surrounding heat, offering a brief, illusory sense of comfort in an otherwise unforgiving landscape. Your hand rests on the cold ceramic Seedkey in your pocket, reassuring yourself of its weight before continuing.

The dry plaza opens into two distinct thoroughfares leading toward the heart of the ruined city. You can choose to seek the main gates or take the obsidian avenue.

nodes.brief: A distant flash of mirror-signal from a shard tower cuts across the white flats, spelling warnings in coded glints.

exits.label: Head toward the rusted iron threshold of the outer gate
Step onto the polished obsidian paving stones of the outer avenue

nodes.title: The Coded Glints
nodes.page:
A distant flash of mirror-signal from a shard tower cuts across the white flats, spelling warnings in coded glints that flicker and die before you can fully translate them. The Glasswrights clearly watch the approaches from their high perches, measuring every traveller who dares cross the basin before the monsoon arrives. You adjust the straps of your pack and quicken your pace across the crusted salt.

The signal leaves two possible directions open as you near the outskirts of the towering spires.

nodes.brief: You scramble up a jagged embankment of fused slag where the ground rings hollow beneath your heavy tread.

exits.label: Descend toward the smoking sulfur vent
Follow the path past the tower

nodes.title: The Slag Embankment
nodes.page: Jagged ribs of fused green slag tear at the dry air as you scramble upward, your heavy boots sending showers of sharp glass shards rattling down the slope. Every stride causes the hardened earth to ring with a deep, metallic hollow note that vibrates straight through the soles of your feet. Your ember-lamp swings from your belt, its banked coals radiating a steady, comforting heat against your thigh while the harsh white glare of the salt flats beats down from above.

nodes.brief: You follow a deep cart-rut carved into the ancient glass road, keeping your eyes fixed on the looming horizon.

exits.label: Follow the left groove toward the ridge
Keep straight along the central rut
Veer toward the eastern salt mounds

nodes.title: The Ancient Cart-Rut
nodes.page:
Deep channels carved into the ancient glass road guide your weary steps forward, demanding total focus as you keep your eyes fixed on the shimmering horizon. The surrounding expanse of white alkali shimmers under the relentless sun, playing cruel tricks on your vision until every distant heap of debris looks like a looming fortification or a vanished oasis. You adjust the cold ceramic Seedkey in your pocket, feeling its heavy, reassuring weight against your hip as the hot wind whistles past your ears.

Ahead, the ancient road splits into three separate directions, each leading deeper into the stark white expanse.

nodes.brief: You reach the rusted iron threshold of the outer shard gate as twilight paints the salt flats in bruised purple hues.

exits.label: Step through the rusting iron threshold

nodes.title: The Rusted Iron Threshold
nodes.page: Rusted iron gates frame the entrance to the outer shard boundary, their heavy hinges weeping orange corrosion as twilight paints the vast salt flats in bruised shades of purple and indigo. Cool shadows stretch across the ground, offering a brief respite from the burning daytime heat that has dogged your long journey across the bitterflats. You clutch your ember-lamp tighter, watching the tiny sparks swirl within the wire mesh as the first evening stars prick the darkening sky above the silent towers.

nodes.brief: A sentry in a mirrored visor lowers a spiked barrier pole as you approach the perimeter of the Shard Cities.

exits.label: Push past the lowered barrier pole

nodes.title: The Mirrored Sentry Post
nodes.page: A sentry wearing a polished mirror visor steps forward to lower a spiked barrier pole, blocking your approach to the perimeter of the Shard Cities with silent, rigid efficiency. Your reflection warps across the curved metal surface of the guard's mask, multiplying your weary face into a dozen tiny distortions under the fading light. The air here smells sharply of ozone and old dust, thick with the silent tension of a border that demands either heavy toll or iron resolve to cross.

nodes.brief: You step onto the polished obsidian paving stones of the outer avenue, leaving the blinding white bitterflats behind.

exits.label: Walk deeper down the dark avenue

nodes.title: The Obsidian Paving Stones
nodes.page: Polished obsidian paving stones rise beneath your boots as you leave the blinding white alkali fields behind, their dark surfaces cool and smooth against your aching feet. The harsh glare of the bitterflats softens into a quiet, shadowy gloom cast by towering walls of shattered crystal that pierce the evening sky like giant daggers. Your ember-lamp casts a warm, flickering amber glow across the dark stones, illuminating faint streaks of mineral dust left by countless travelers who walked this road before you.

nodes.brief: The massive glass gates of the metropolis loom before you, vibrating with the low, resonant hum of distant signal lenses.

exits.label: Approach the humming glass gates

nodes.title: The Humming Glass Gates
nodes.page: Massive gates constructed from fused green glass loom directly before you, shivering to the low note of distant signal lenses tuning themselves to the coming night. The sound fills your chest, and the cold ceramic Seedkey in your pocket seems to tick in time with the city's pulse. Wisps of salt-laden wind drift through the massive archways, carrying the faint, metallic tang of ancient industry and long-abandoned halls.

nodes.brief: Ignoring all warning signs of unstable salt-crust, you sprint recklessly across a hollow sink-basin and plunge straight down into a boiling pit of subterranean brine.
nodes.title: The Hollow Sinks
nodes.page: Ignoring all warning signs of unstable salt-crust and the faint hollow echo beneath your boots, you sprint recklessly across a fragile sink-basin in a desperate bid for speed. The white crust shatters instantly beneath your weight like thin window-glass, plunging you straight down into a boiling, suffocating pit of subterranean brine. The heavy air fills with choking sulfur and the sharp tang of hot salt as the white walls close in around you, swallowing your footsteps and your lamp-light forever.

nodes.brief: Ignoring all warnings, you attempt to cross the boiling sulfur flats at high noon without water, and collapse as your canteen runs bone dry.
nodes.title: The Boiling Flats
nodes.page: Scorching white heat rises in shimmering waves from the ground as you press onward across the boiling sulfur flats, ignoring every warning written in the alkali dust. Your canteen hangs empty and light against your hip, its leather sides bone-dry and useless after hours of merciless exposure under the high noon sun. A ringing dizziness takes your senses, and the dazzling landscape becomes a spinning blur of white and yellow before your legs buckle beneath you. You sink softly into the warm crust of the flats, leaving the unfinished journey to the drifting desert winds.

nodes.brief: Arrival in The Shard Cities: broken glass cities of the Old Lensfolk, Glasswright signal-towers, glass bridges, the toll-fort, scavengers. The reader enters with several ways forward.

exits.label: Follow the lamp-lit road
Cut across the common ground

exits.intent: Ask the way of a stranger
exits.label: Ask the way of a stranger
Take the old drovers track

nodes.title: Arrival in the Shard Cities
nodes.page: Jagged towers of fused crystal and shattered glass rise around you like the ribs of prehistoric beasts, forming a dense maze of silent alleys and towering archways in the heart of the Basin. High above, Glasswright signal-towers catch the last slanting rays of sunlight, casting sudden, blinding flashes of coded light across the labyrinth of narrow streets and narrow pedestrian bridges. Scavengers and stray travelers huddle in doorways wrapped in salt-stained cloaks, watching your progress with cautious eyes as the low whistle of the wind echoes through empty window frames.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Rumour Market: two rival rumours about the Rain Vault; the reader decides which to believe, and it will colour how they act

exits.intent: Believe the vault is still full
exits.label: Believe the vault is still full

exits.intent: Believe the vault was looted long ago
exits.label: Believe the vault was looted long ago

nodes.title: The Rumour Market
nodes.page: Heated arguments erupt near a fountain of dry, salt-crusted stone where merchants trade conflicting tales of the great subterranean vault. One faction of ragged scavengers swears the ancient cisterns remain untouched and brimming with fresh mountain meltwater, waiting only for the proper key to turn. Conversely, a group of frantic caravan guards insists the Salt Court breached the lower valves months ago and drained every drop for their private wells.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Glasswright Signal-Tower: a Glasswright offers to teach their mirror-signal speech in a night, at the cost of a day

exits.intent: Stay a night and learn the mirror-signals
exits.label: Spend twenty-four hours learning the mirror-signals
Leave the tower immediately without the lessons

nodes.title: The Signal-Tower Sanctum
nodes.page: Within the echoing heart of the signal-tower, a robed Glasswright pauses from adjusting a massive brass collimator and turns a pair of pale, lens-ground spectacles toward you. The artisan traces a complex pattern in the air with a polished silver rod, offering to teach you the intricate art of mirror-signal speech before the next watch changes. Such knowledge would unlock the silent language of the spires, but the process demands a full day of study that you can ill afford with the monsoon creeping closer across the basin.

nodes.brief: Leaving The Shard Cities for The Mirror Storm: close this part of the journey.

exits.label: Go on

nodes.title: The Mirror Storm
nodes.page:
The shattered labyrinth of the Shard Cities falls behind you as a roaring wall of glass-dust and rising gale swallows the horizon. Ahead lies the vast, untamed expanse of the dune-sea and the looming shadow of Prism, where the ancient Rain Vault waits beneath the dust. You adjust the strap of your ember-lamp, checking the cold weight of the Seedkey one last time before stepping boldly into the blinding squall.

You can continue your journey into the storm.

nodes.brief: You step onto the splintered green causeway of the First Shard, where jagged towers lean like broken teeth against the glare.

exits.label: Approach the scraper by the slag heap
Confront the guards at the brass gate
Cross the cantilevered glass bridge span

nodes.title: The Splintered Green Causeway
nodes.page:
Splintered green glass forms the solid foundation of the causeway beneath your boots, leaning at odd, dizzying angles like broken teeth against the harsh glare of the upper sky. Every step demands careful balance to avoid sliding down the slick, translucent slopes into the dark, ash-choked trenches that yawn between the towers. Your ember-lamp casts long, dancing shadows against the glittering walls, revealing strange, angular patterns fused into the very structure of the ancient masonry by forgotten fires.

At the far end of the span, the walkway widens into a ruined plaza where two distinct pathways invite further exploration.

nodes.brief: A low murmur rises from the glass-shingle dunes as a string of laden pack-mules picks its way past an ash-filled courtyard.

exits.label: Follow the footprints toward the lower bazaar
Dodge behind the laden mules into the narrow eastern lane
Climb the shattered steps toward the silent watchtower

nodes.title: The Mule Train Pass
nodes.page:
Low murmurs rise from the glass-shingle dunes as a string of laden pack-mules picks its way past an ash-filled courtyard. Hooves crunch rhythmically against shards of green and amber crystal, kicking up a fine white dust that coats your woollen cloak. The lead driver, swathed in indigo linen to ward off the glare, shouts a raspy warning to steer clear of the swinging crates.

You press your back against a cool pillar of vitrified brick, shielding your hooded ember-lamp as the beasts shuffle past. The alley splits three ways ahead through the jagged ruins, each path choked with drifting salt and sharp debris.

nodes.brief: You duck beneath an arch of fused obsidian while high above, a Glasswright mirror flashes a sharp warning across the basin.

exits.label: Slip through the narrow gap between the leaning walls
Step out onto the sunlit cobblestone passage
Duck into the shadowed cellarway beneath the arch

nodes.title: The Obsidian Arch
nodes.page:
Ducking beneath an arch of fused obsidian, you step into the sudden, cool shadow of a collapsed warehouse. High above your head, a Glasswright mirror flashes a sharp, rhythmic warning across the baking expanse of the basin, painting the stone walls with brilliant stabs of white light. The air here smells faintly of ozone and old, dry lime.

A narrow gap between two leaning tenements offers a way deeper into the shard maze, while a wider cobblestone passage leads toward the hum of distant traffic. Your fingers brush the cold ceramic key in your pocket for comfort as you weigh the silence.

nodes.brief: The salty wind whistles through hollow window frames of translucent crystal, chilling your fingers around the cold ceramic Seedkey in your pocket.

exits.privWhy: the reader owes nobody and can bargain freely
exits.label: Search for the hidden maintenance hatch in the floor
Head toward the guarded thoroughfare ahead

nodes.title: The Crystal Echoes
nodes.page: Salty wind whistles through the hollow window frames of translucent crystal, chilling your fingers around the cold ceramic Seedkey in your pocket. The ruins around you hum a faint, eerie note whenever a stray gust catches the razor-thin edges of the glass spires. Dust motes dance in the slanting beams of harsh midday light, turning the stagnant air into a shimmering haze of gold and grey.

nodes.brief: A barefoot scraper named Mallow crouches by a heap of ruby slag, offering to trade a scrap of dried melon for your coal-lantern.

exits.label: Climb the spiral stair of green vitrified brick
Approach the vendor roasting locusts near the bronze brazier
Squeeze through the narrow fissure between the amethyst tenements

nodes.title: The Ruby Slag Heap
nodes.page:
Barefoot scraper Mallow crouches by a heap of ruby slag, offering to trade a scrap of dried melon for your coal-lantern with a gap-toothed grin. The jagged glass fragments around his ankles click together like teeth as he shifts his weight, holding out a sticky, reddish rind on the flat of a calloused palm. The heat radiating off the slag heap makes the air ripple above his head.

You shake your head at the offer, keeping your grip firm on the iron handle of your lamp while the dust settles around your boots. Three distinct routes beckon away from the radiant mound.

nodes.brief: Salt Court sentries bar the narrow alley with a brass-bound gate, demanding a silver penny or three hours of your labor to pass.

exits.label: Squeeze through the narrow fissure in the nearby wall
Turn back toward the cart laden with scrap mirrors

nodes.title: The Salt Court Gate
nodes.page:
Salt Court sentries bar the narrow alley with a brass-bound gate, demanding a silver penny or three hours of your labor to pass through their toll-zone. They lean lazily against pikes tipped with dark iron, their canvas uniforms stiff with crusted brine. Past their barrier the street opens into a sun-bleached plaza lined with silent workshops.

You eye the heavy locks and the bored, sun-baked expressions of the guards, considering whether your coin-pouch or your time is worth the toll. Two alternative routes curve away from the blocked threshold.

nodes.brief: A cantilevered glass bridge shimmers above a dry trench, its transparent span humming whenever the midday heat makes the joints contract.

exits.label: Pick your way past the jammed handcart of mirrors
Cross into the courtyard paved with mosaic tiles
Investigate the dripping bronze pipe in the ruined facade

nodes.title: The Humming Bridge
nodes.page:
A cantilevered glass bridge shimmers above a dry trench, and its transparent span creaks whenever midday heat pulls the joints tight under your boots. Looking down, you can see the dizzying depth of a forgotten cellar far below, its floor carpeted in glittering white dust. The air over the span is dead still and intensely hot.

You draw one careful breath and test the firmness of the glassy rail with one glove before taking a step onto the vibrating surface. Beyond the far side, the path fractures into three distinct directions.

nodes.brief: Two scavengers argue over a heap of copper wire inside a gutted observatory, ignoring the blinding glare reflected off the dome above.

exits.label: Squeeze through the narrow fissure in the outer wall
Step out onto the cobalt mosaic courtyard
Follow the drip toward the leaking bronze pipe

nodes.title: The Gutted Observatory
nodes.page:
Two scavengers argue fiercely over a heap of copper wire inside a gutted observatory, completely ignoring the blinding glare reflected off the broken dome above. Their voices bounce off the curved metal walls in harsh, jagged echoes that set your teeth on edge. Piles of discarded brass cogs and shattered lenses litter the soot-stained floor around their boots.

You keep your footsteps light as you skirt the edge of the bickering pair, searching for an exit away from the rising tension in the dome. Three routes lead out of the ruined chamber into the quiet alleys.

nodes.brief: You crawl through a subterranean drainage pipe lined with green sea-glass, emerging into a choked courtyard smelling of stagnant sulfur.

exits.label: Watch the children playing with polished glass marbles
Navigate the perilous ledge of translucent roofing tiles

nodes.title: The Subterranean Pipe
nodes.page:
Crawling through a subterranean drainage pipe lined with green sea-glass, you emerge into a choked courtyard smelling sharply of stagnant sulfur. The damp stone walls are coated in a pale crust of salt crystals that flake off at the slightest touch. A harsh shaft of sunlight pierces the gloom from a collapsed ceiling high above.

You shake the gritty dust from your sleeves and stand up slowly, wiping your palms on your trousers. Two distinct ways lead onward from the foul-smelling courtyard into the labyrinth.

nodes.brief: A solitary Glasswright on a high stone balcony swings a brass heliograph mirror, flashing a silent code that makes your temples throb.

exits.label: Head toward the dripping bronze pipe in the wall
Watch the children playing marbles near the leaning wall
Step onto the perilous ledge of translucent roofing tiles

nodes.title: The Heliograph Flash
nodes.page:
A solitary Glasswright on a high stone balcony swings a brass heliograph mirror, flashing a silent code that makes your temples throb in rhythm with the glare. Every sweep of the polished metal sends a blinding bolt of reflected sunlight dancing across the crumbling facades around you. The air smells intensely of sun-baked stone and hot copper.

You shield your eyes with a raised forearm, ducking low against a pillar to avoid catching the full glare in your gaze. Three paths branch outward from the base of the balcony tower.

nodes.brief: A tethered goat belonging to a nomadic well-keeper chews on a strip of canvas near a dry stone basin where a trickle of brackish water gathers.

exits.label: Approach the toll-lord's clerk at the slate desk
Slip behind the hanging copper chains in the workshop

nodes.title: The Well-Keeper's Goat
nodes.page:
A tethered goat belonging to a nomadic well-keeper chews patiently on a strip of canvas near a dry stone basin where a thin trickle of brackish water gathers. The animal gives you a dull, golden-eyed stare as you approach, its horns scraping against a rusted iron ring in the pavement. The meager puddle in the basin barely reflects the pale sky above.

You give the beast a wide berth, keeping your hand steady on your ember-lamp while the heat beats down on your neck. Two quiet routes lead away from the lonely watering spot.

nodes.brief: Shard-dust grinds beneath your boots as you cross an open plaza where the skeletons of ancient trees are preserved entirely in milky quartz.

exits.label: Approach the slate desk of the toll-clerk
Trade tobacco with the pale hide-map scavenger

exits.privWhy: the reader is bound by the Dune Sisters' well-oath, and is known for it
exits.label: Present your well-seal to the cautious gate-guard
Climb the dangling rope to the shattered balcony

nodes.title: The Milky Quartz Plaza
nodes.page: Shard-dust grinds beneath your boots as you cross an open plaza where the skeletons of ancient trees are preserved entirely in milky quartz. The midday glare bounces off their translucent branches, casting distorted prisms across the cracked flagstones. You adjust the strap of your ember-lamp, feeling the dry heat radiate against your thigh as you weigh the various paths cutting through the silent ruins.

nodes.brief: Recognizing your unburdened hands and untied debts, an old lens-grinder points out a hidden maintenance hatch that bypasses the toll-fort completely.

exits.label: Slip behind the hanging copper workshop chains

nodes.title: The Unburdened Maintenance Hatch
nodes.page: Recognizing your unburdened hands and untied debts, an old lens-grinder points out a hidden maintenance hatch that bypasses the toll-fort completely. You carry no heavy loans or creditor's marks upon your skin, leaving your movements entirely your own in this brittle labyrinth. The rusty iron ring of the hatch sits flush with the paving stones, offering an unmonitored drop into the cool sub-levels.

nodes.brief: A heavy iron portcullis blocks the mouth of the sunken street, guarded by a bored Salt Court bailiff who polishes his brass knuckles with a rag.

exits.label: Offer tobacco for the hide map
Climb the dangling rope to the shattered balcony

nodes.title: The Iron Portcullis
nodes.page: A heavy iron portcullis blocks the mouth of the sunken street, guarded by a bored Salt Court bailiff who polishes his brass knuckles with a rag. The metal spikes are coated in a fine layer of white salt crystals that flake off with every passing breeze. You pause before the barrier, watching the bailiff eye your travel-stained pack with professional disinterest.

nodes.brief: You climb a spiral stair of green vitrified brick that winds inside a hollow spire, emerging onto a narrow walkway overlooking a sea of jagged glass.

exits.label: Descend toward the headless bronze magistrate

nodes.title: The Vitrified Spire Stair
nodes.page: You climb a spiral stair of green vitrified brick that winds inside a hollow spire, emerging onto a narrow walkway overlooking a sea of jagged glass. The wind howls softly through the hollow tubes of the surrounding towers, making the entire structure hum with a low, melancholy resonance. Far below, the glittering streets stretch out toward the horizon like shattered mirrors.

nodes.brief: A dust-caked vendor named Vane sells roasted locusts from a bronze brazier, muttering about the strange lights dancing nightly over the central observatory.

exits.privWhy: the reader's ember-lamp is burning and draws or reveals something
exits.label: Follow the gleam through the debris
Leap clear as the masonry gives way

nodes.title: The Cinder Vendor's Stall
nodes.page:
Thick clouds of fragrant grease rise from Vane's bronze brazier, where roasted locusts sizzle beside crusts of salt-bread. The dust-caked vendor pokes the coals with an iron skewer, muttering about the phantom fires that dance above the central observatory each midnight. He offers you a handful of charred insects for a copper farthing, gesturing with his chin toward the towering glass spires ahead.

Your lantern swings at your hip, its banked coals casting a warm, steady circle of light against the grey masonry while the desert wind rattles loose splinters of quartz along the alleyway.

nodes.brief: You squeeze through a narrow fissure between two leaning glass tenements, feeling the sharp edges of amethyst panes pluck at your travel-worn tunic.

exits.privWhy: the reader's ember-lamp is burning and draws or reveals something
exits.label: Let your lantern beam reveal the hidden bronze
Listen to the blind glass-blower's singing bowl

nodes.title: The Amethyst Tenement Fissure
nodes.page: You squeeze through a narrow fissure between two leaning glass tenements, feeling the sharp edges of amethyst panes pluck at your travel-worn tunic. The passage is dim and cool, shielded from the relentless glare of the desert sun by the sheer height of the leaning walls. Every movement must be deliberate to avoid snagging your pack or lantern on the razor-sharp quartz projections.

nodes.brief: A battered handcart laden with scrap mirrors blocks your route, its wooden wheels jammed tight with fused sand and sharp fragments of green bottle-glass.

exits.privWhy: the reader's ember-lamp is burning and draws or reveals something
exits.label: Use your lantern light to uncover the bronze
Duck beneath the collapsing upper balcony

nodes.title: The Scrap Mirror Handcart
nodes.page: A battered handcart laden with scrap mirrors blocks your route, its wooden wheels jammed tight with fused sand and sharp fragments of green bottle-glass. The tilted surfaces catch fragments of the blinding daylight, throwing fractured flashes of yellow and white across the walls of the nearby ruins. Clearing a path will require careful hands and steady patience.

nodes.brief: You cross a courtyard paved with mosaic tiles of blue cobalt glass that ring like tiny bells under the rhythmic crunch of your heavy boots.

exits.label: Seek the blind glass-blower by the brazier
Avoid the chained desert hound in the courtyard

nodes.title: The Cobalt Mosaic Court
nodes.page: You cross a courtyard paved with mosaic tiles of blue cobalt glass that ring like tiny bells under the rhythmic crunch of your heavy boots. The deep azure pattern depicts rolling waves from an era long before the sea dried into salt and fused shards. The open space offers little cover from the piercing sky, urging you toward the shadowed archways on the far side.

nodes.brief: A hollow bronze pipe extends from a ruined facade, leaking a steady drip of lukewarm, mineral-heavy water into a chipped stone basin below.

exits.label: Cross the polished obsidian threshold into the dome
Watch the Salt Court tax-collectors by the fountain

nodes.title: The Dripping Bronze Pipe
nodes.page: A hollow bronze pipe extends from a ruined facade, leaking lukewarm mineral water in slow drips into a chipped stone basin below. The rhythmic plop-plop echoes off the surrounding stone walls like a mockery of the coming monsoon. You cup your hand beneath the meager stream to test its temperature and taste before deciding your next direction.

nodes.brief: A group of children toss polished glass marbles against a leaning wall, pausing their game to stare at the faint orange glow of your hidden lantern.

exits.label: Pass the tax-collectors drinking by the fountain
Squeeze through the jagged weaver's loft window

nodes.title: The Glass-Marble Children
nodes.page: A group of children toss polished glass marbles against a leaning wall, pausing their game to stare at the faint orange glow of your hidden lantern. Their faces are smeared with white basin-dust, and their clothes are patched from coarse canvas and salvaged sacking. They whisper among themselves, curious about a traveler carrying fire through the daylight.

nodes.brief: You navigate a perilous ledge of translucent roofing tiles, watching the dry basin floor drop away into dizzying depths fifty feet below.

exits.label: Step through the window frame
Reach the groaning iron sign
Inspect the ash mound below

nodes.title: The Translucent Ledge
nodes.page:
Translucent roofing tiles shift dangerously beneath your boots as you pick your way along the narrow rib of a ruined villa. Fifty feet below, the dry basin floor glitters with a crust of salt and fused glass, offering no mercy should your footing fail. The desert wind hums through the jagged architectural bones around you, carrying the dry scent of ancient dust.

Ahead, the precarious pathway splits, leaving you to decide whether to brave the interior gloom or test another narrow span.

nodes.brief: A toll-lord's clerk sits behind a makeshift desk of slate and timber, demanding proof of water-tax payment before you cross the boundary stone.

exits.label: Slip past toward the loft
Turn toward the groaning sign

nodes.title: The Slate Desk
nodes.page: A makeshift desk of rough slate and salvaged timber blocks the narrow alley, presided over by a toll-lord's clerk wearing ink-stained cuffs. The official taps a ledger with an ivory stylus, demanding immediate proof of water-tax payment before allowing any traveler to pass the boundary stone. The air here smells of stale vinegar and dried parchment, thick with the bureaucratic weight of the Salt Court.

nodes.brief: You slip behind a curtain of hanging copper chains inside a deserted workshop, avoiding the sharp eyes of a passing Salt Court patrol squad.

exits.label: Climb toward the weaving loft
Cross the narrow cedar beam
Seek the giant solar mirror

nodes.title: The Copper Curtain
nodes.page:
Hanging chains of heavy copper jingle softly as you pull them closed behind you, concealing your form within the dim recesses of a deserted workshop. Through the linked metal, you watch a Salt Court patrol squad march past in formation, their brass breastplates catching the harsh glare of the basin sun. Dust motes dance in the amber light cast by your banked coal-lantern, forcing you to keep the shutter nearly closed.

Silence settles over the room once the footsteps fade, leaving several paths open for your continued escape.

nodes.brief: A pale scavenger named Thistle offers to trade a map drawn on salted hide for a single pinch of dried tobacco from your pouch.

exits.label: Trade tobacco for the map
Head toward the solar mirror

nodes.title: The Salted Hide Map
nodes.page:
A pale scavenger crouching by a charred hearth holds up a stiff piece of salted hide marked with faded ink lines. He introduces himself as Thistle and whispers that he will trade his crude map for a single pinch of dried tobacco from your pouch. The surrounding ruins are deathly quiet, save for the faint crackle of cooling glass settling in the heat.

You weigh the value of your remaining supplies against the usefulness of his cartography.

nodes.brief: Noting the Dune Sisters' sacred seal inked on your wrist, a cautious well-guard unlocks a private postern gate and waves you through without a toll.

exits.label: Approach the colossal solar mirror
Meet the waiting ragged urchin

priv.why: the reader is bound by the Dune Sisters' well-oath, and is known for it

nodes.title: The Sacred Seal
nodes.page:
The sacred water-oath inked upon your wrist catches the eye of the well-guard stationed at the postern gate, marking you as a friend of the Dune Sisters. Without a word of demand for tolls or taxes, the weary sentry turns a heavy iron crank and swings the reinforced postern wide. Cool air drifts briefly from the protected courtyard beyond, offering a welcome respite from the baking street.

You step through the threshold into the shaded passage beyond.

nodes.brief: You haul yourself up a frayed hemp rope dangling from a shattered second-story balcony to escape a sudden gust of stinging alkaline dust.

exits.label: Follow the urchin through crates

nodes.title: The Hemp Rope
nodes.page:
A sudden gust of stinging alkaline dust sweeps down the canyon-like street, stinging your eyes and coating your tongue in bitter salt. To escape the blinding squall, you leap toward a frayed hemp rope dangling from a shattered second-story balcony and haul yourself upward with straining muscles. The abrasive fibers bite into your palms as you hoist your weight over the stone sill into comparative shelter.

Catching your breath in the gloom, you look out over the hazy basin below.

nodes.brief: A headless bronze statue of an Old Lensfolk magistrate stands in a weed-choked plaza, its outstretched arm pointing toward a narrow tunnel of dark glass.

exits.label: Descend into the salt market
Approach the riveted iron gate

nodes.title: The Headless Magistrate
nodes.page:
A headless bronze statue of an Old Lensfolk magistrate stands rigidly in the center of a weed-choked plaza, its oxidized arm pointing with unyielding gravity toward a dark glass tunnel. Verdigris coats the folds of its heavy robe, and the surrounding cobblestones are fractured by ancient heat. The entrance it indicates leads away from the blinding glare and into subterranean gloom.

You stand before the silent monument, weighing the descent against other routes.

nodes.brief: The steady amber radiance of your coal-lantern catches the glint of a dropped brass gear, revealing a hidden crawlspace beneath the cobblestones.

exits.label: Crawl beneath the stone floor

priv.why: the reader's ember-lamp is burning and draws or reveals something

nodes.title: The Hidden Crawlspace
nodes.page:
Amber radiance from your coal-lantern spills across the uneven cobblestones, catching the unexpected glint of a dropped brass gear half-buried in sand. Following the metallic reflection reveals a low, dark crawlspace hidden beneath a displaced paving slab, untouched by the scavengers above. The warm glow of your lamp cuts deep into the subterranean recess, revealing a passage that ordinary daylight never touches.

You kneel before the dark opening, considering where it might lead.

nodes.brief: A blind glass-blower named Kestrel sits by a smoking brazier, tapping a small singing bowl that emits a pure, high note echoing down the empty street.

exits.label: Test the riveted iron gate
Duck behind the fish crates

nodes.title: The Singing Bowl
nodes.page:
A blind glass-blower named Kestrel sits cross-legged beside a smoking brazier, striking a small singing bowl with a padded mallet to produce a pure, resonant note that vibrates in your teeth. The sound rolls down the empty street, bouncing off glass facades with hypnotic clarity. She tilts her head toward the approach of your footsteps without breaking her rhythmic cadence.

The music hangs in the dry air as you weigh your next direction.

nodes.brief: You dodge a shower of glittering shards as a brittle upper balcony collapses under the relentless heat of the mid-afternoon sun.

exits.label: Hurry down the salt steps
Test the heavy iron gate

nodes.title: The Brittle Balcony
nodes.page:
A sharp crack splits the heavy afternoon air as a brittle upper balcony shears away from its moorings under the relentless heat. You throw yourself forward, dodging a dangerous shower of glittering glass shards that clatter onto the pavement right where you stood. Dust billows into the stifling street, coating your shoulders in a fine white powder.

Shaking off the debris, you scan the remaining routes through the ruined square.

nodes.brief: A tethered desert hound bares its teeth from a vine-wrapped courtyard, straining against a rusty chain anchored to a massive block of green slag.

exits.label: Slip past the snapping hound

nodes.title: The Hound's Yard
nodes.page: A tethered desert hound bares its sharp teeth from a vine-wrapped courtyard, straining against a rusty chain anchored to a massive block of green slag. Its tawny coat is matted with white alkali dust, and a low, rattling growl vibrates deep within its narrow chest whenever your boots crunch against the gravel. The high stone walls offer no alternate route around the beast, forcing you to choose between facing the snapping animal directly or retreating back into the twisting alleys of the glass district before it breaks its moorings entirely.

nodes.brief: You step across a threshold of polished obsidian into a cool, domed vestibule where the air smells faintly of old parchment and dried lavender.

exits.label: Follow the quiet arched corridor

nodes.title: The Obsidian Vestibule
nodes.page: You step across a threshold of polished obsidian into a cool, domed vestibule where the air smells faintly of old parchment and dried lavender. Sunlight filters through amber-tinted ceiling panes, casting long geometric shadows across mosaic floors inlaid with mother-of-pearl. The sudden quiet of the chamber is a sharp relief from the harsh glare and wind outside, yet the absolute stillness feels heavy with forgotten secrets. A narrow arched corridor leads deeper into the silent heart of the building.

nodes.brief: A trio of Salt Court tax-collectors lounge by a dry fountain, drinking tepid goat milk from earthenware jugs while watching the perimeter walls.

exits.label: Sidestep toward the pillared portico
Cross the dry canal bed quietly

nodes.title: The Salt Court's Rest
nodes.page: A trio of Salt Court tax-collectors lounge by a dry fountain, drinking tepid goat milk from earthenware jugs while watching the perimeter walls with bored vigilance. Brass breastplates catch a dull gleam under the glaring afternoon sky, and ledger books lie half-open on the stone rim beside a pair of weighted scales. They have not yet noticed your approach, but any sudden movement will draw their sharp eyes and uncomfortable questions about your permits and baggage.

nodes.brief: You squeeze through a jagged window frame into a weaver's loft strewn with tangled threads of spun glass that glitter like frozen cobwebs.

exits.label: Pick a path toward the pillared portico
Head down toward the dry canal bed

nodes.title: The Weaver's Loft
nodes.page: You squeeze through a jagged window frame into a weaver's loft strewn with tangled threads of spun glass that glitter like frozen cobwebs across the floorboards. Every footfall must be measured and light to avoid snapping the delicate filaments that ring out like tiny crystal chimes in the stale air. Sunlight catches the suspended threads, creating an intricate maze of rainbow refractions that obscure the farther corners of the room.

nodes.brief: A rusted iron signboard swings on a single hinge above a boarded doorway, groaning rhythmically in the dry wind blowing off the salt flats.

exits.label: Cross the dry canal bed
Squeeze past the sweating laborers

nodes.title: The Creaking Signboard
nodes.page: A rusted iron signboard swings on a single hinge above a boarded doorway, groaning rhythmically in the dry wind blowing off the salt flats. Below it, the wooden threshold is choked with drifts of fine white dust and dried tumble-weeds that rustle against your shins. The building appears long abandoned, yet a faint curl of grey smoke rises from a cracked chimney pipe further down the row, suggesting you are not entirely alone in this desolate lane.

nodes.brief: You balance on a narrow cedar beam bridging a deep gap between two leaning glass towers, keeping your eyes fixed firmly on the far wall.

exits.label: Head toward the bustling central plaza
Squeeze past the sweating laborers
Seek the brightly painted canvas awning

nodes.title: The Cedar Beam
nodes.page: You balance on a narrow cedar beam bridging a deep gap between two leaning glass towers, keeping your eyes fixed firmly on the far wall. Far below, the jagged floor of the basin glitters with shards of ancient green and amber bottle-glass, offering a terrifying drop if your footing should slip. The wind picks up suddenly, tugging at the straps of your pack and testing your equilibrium with every deliberate step you take across the void.

nodes.brief: A hooded scavenger pokes through a mound of ash with a long iron spit, unearthing a string of heavy ceramic beads that clink softly together.

exits.label: Squeeze past the sweating laborers

nodes.title: The Ash Mound
nodes.page: A hooded scavenger pokes through a mound of ash with a long iron spit, unearthing a string of heavy ceramic beads that clink softly together. The acrid scent of burnt bone and dry peat hangs thick in the stagnant air around the hearth-pit. The scavenger pauses, glancing sideways from beneath a frayed hood to measure your worth and see whether you carry anything worth trading for a handful of ash-glass beads.

nodes.brief: You pause within the shadow of a colossal solar mirror, feeling its immense curved surface radiate residual heat long after the sun has shifted.

exits.label: Head toward the bustling central plaza
Squeeze past the sweating laborers
Seek the brightly painted canvas awning

nodes.title: The Solar Mirror
nodes.page: You pause within the shadow of a colossal solar mirror, feeling its immense curved surface radiate residual heat long after the sun has shifted. The polished metal plates are bolted to a massive stone gantry that towers above the ruined rooftops like the ribcage of some metallic beast. This towering relic once focused the desert glare to power the old city's furnaces, and standing beneath its concave dish makes the back of your neck prickle with phantom warmth.

nodes.brief: A ragged urchin darts out from behind a stack of empty crates, thrusting a bruised yellow plum toward you before scurrying back into the gloom.

exits.label: Squeeze past the sweating laborers
Seek the brightly painted canvas awning

nodes.title: The Urchin's Offering
nodes.page: A ragged urchin darts out from behind a stack of empty crates, thrusting a bruised yellow plum toward you before scurrying back into the gloom. The fruit is dusty and small, yet its sweet, fermented aroma cuts sharply through the dry alkali stench of the alley. Before you can offer a coin or a word of thanks, the child vanishes into a narrow gap between two cracked masonry walls, leaving only the sound of pattering bare feet behind.

nodes.brief: You descend a steep flight of stone steps slick with white salt crust, entering a subterranean marketplace echoing with the low murmur of tradesmen.

exits.label: Dive into the noisy rumor market
Seek a quiet corner away from the crowd

nodes.title: The Salt Steps
nodes.page: You descend a steep flight of stone steps slick with white salt crust, entering a subterranean marketplace echoing with the low murmur of tradesmen. Oil lamps flicker from iron brackets along the damp walls, casting amber glints over stalls piled high with dried herbs, copper wire, and sealed jars of brackish water. The air down here is cooler than the burning streets above, heavy with the mingling scents of cardamom, sheep fat, and old earth.

nodes.brief: A towering gate of riveted iron plates bars the end of the corridor, guarded by two veterans wearing breastplates fashioned from recycled green bottle-glass.

exits.label: Approach the guards to test the heavy bolt
Turn back toward the ringing mosaic courtyard

nodes.title: The Iron Gate
nodes.page: Heavy iron plates riveted together with copper studs form a towering barrier at the corridor's end, blocking any further passage. Two veterans stand guard before the massive threshold, wearing gleaming breastplates beaten out of recycled green bottle-glass that catches the harsh desert glare. They lean against long pikes, eyeing your ember-lamp with cautious professional curiosity while the dry wind hums against the metal seams.

nodes.brief: You slip through a narrow gap behind a stack of salted fish crates, emerging into a bustling alleyway lit by flickering tallow dips.

exits.label: Follow the winding lane deeper into the market
Duck beneath a frayed canvas awning to seek quieter ground
Thread your way toward the crowded central square

nodes.title: Behind the Fish Crates
nodes.page: Tallow dips flicker along the walls of a bustling alleyway as you slip through a narrow gap behind stacked crates of salted fish. The scent of brine and old wood hangs thick in the close air, mingling with the distant shouting of merchants and the scrape of iron-shod wheels on stone. Shadows stretch long across the packed dirt floor while unseen voices argue over the price of dried provisions.

nodes.brief: A nervous archivist named Fenn sorts through stacks of damp ledgers inside a pillared portico, muttering about missing seals and fraudulent water deeds.

exits.label: Step closer to ask Fenn about the records
Leave the scholar to his disputes and head for the square

nodes.title: The Archivist's Portico
nodes.page: Damp ledgers are stacked high upon a marble table beneath a pillared portico where a nervous archivist named Fenn sorts through crumbling parchment. He mutters constantly about missing wax seals and fraudulent water deeds, his ink-stained fingers trembling as another page sticks together in the dry heat. A faint smell of vinegar and old glue drifts from his makeshift desk while the street noise murmurs beyond the columns.

nodes.brief: You cross a dry canal bed on a footbridge made of interlaced willow branches, listening to the dry reeds rattle in the hot afternoon draft.

exits.label: Continue forward toward the clamour of the market
Step off the path to seek a shaded nook among the reeds

nodes.title: The Willow Footbridge
nodes.page: Dry reeds rattle in the hot afternoon draft as you cross a dry canal bed on a narrow footbridge made of interlaced willow branches. The wooden structure creaks rhythmically beneath your boots, sagging slightly toward the baked silt below where cracked mud tiles bake under the glare. Farther along the opposite bank, low adobe walls shimmer through the rising heat haze.

nodes.brief: A broad plaza opens before you, its center dominated by a dry stone fountain where travelers gather to trade gossip and fill their waterskins.

exits.label: Join the circle around the basin to listen closer
Cross the open plaza toward the northern thoroughfare

nodes.title: The Dry Fountain Plaza
nodes.page: Travelers gather around a dry stone fountain at the center of a broad plaza, trading gossip and dipping tin cups into a meager basin. The sun beats down mercilessly on the dusty flagstones, turning the open space into a glaring white arena of sound and motion. Someone near the rim of the stone basin claims to have seen strange lights moving across the upper balconies of Prism just before dawn.

nodes.brief: You squeeze past a team of sweating laborers hauling a massive quartz lens on a wooden sledge through the narrowing commercial thoroughfare.

exits.label: Slip past the struggling team to reach the noisy bazaar
Duck into an alcove until the sledge clears the passage
Follow close behind the timber frame into the open square

nodes.title: The Lens Sledge
nodes.page: Sweating laborers strain against thick hemp ropes, hauling a massive quartz lens on a wooden sledge right down the narrowing commercial thoroughfare. You squeeze tightly past the rough-hewn timber frame as it grinds against the sun-baked plaster walls, scattering a fine grit of glass dust into the air. The heavy metal runners spark faintly whenever they strike hidden flints embedded in the paving stones.

nodes.brief: A brightly painted canvas awning flaps wildly above a crowded spice stall, casting shifting patterns of shadow across the sun-bleached flagstones.

exits.label: Push past the spice racks toward the central market

nodes.title: The Canvas Awning
nodes.page: A brightly painted canvas awning flaps wildly above a crowded spice stall, casting shifting patterns of indigo shadow across the sun-bleached flagstones. Pungent heaps of yellow turmeric and dried salt-lavender mound in shallow baskets, filling the warm breeze with sharp, medicinal aromas. Shoppers jostle past one another in the narrow lane, their voices rising above the dry snapping of the canvas overhead.

nodes.brief: You step into the chaotic clamour of the Rumour Market, where merchants hawk dubious tales and travelers crowd around competing information stalls.

exits.label: Press on into the heart of the frantic crowd

nodes.title: The Rumour Market
nodes.page: Merchants hawk dubious tales from wooden crates while desperate travelers crowd around competing information stalls in the chaotic clamour of the Rumour Market. Voices rise and fall in a frantic competition for attention, each vendor swearing their particular map or secret is the only one guaranteed to reach the Vault. Your hand instinctively brushes against the cold ceramic key hidden safely within your tunic.

nodes.brief: The air hums with urgent whispers as rival factions trade conflicting stories about the sealed gates and hidden water levels of the Rain Vault.

exits.label: Press on to hear what the merchants truly know

nodes.title: Whispers of the Vault
nodes.page: Urgent whispers hum through the sultry air as rival factions trade conflicting stories regarding the sealed gates and hidden water levels of the Rain Vault. Some claim the subterranean chambers are already half-flooded by ancient leaks, while others swear the doors remain locked tight against the approaching monsoon. The tension in the crowded thoroughfare feels as brittle and sharp as unannealed glass.

nodes.brief: You push through a throng of arguing traders and bickering scribes, seeking a quiet corner to weigh the conflicting reports before choosing your path.

exits.label: Press on to make your final choice among the gossips

nodes.title: Weighing the Reports
nodes.page: Arguing traders and bickering scribes shove past your shoulders as you seek out a quiet corner to weigh the conflicting reports before choosing your path. Every stranger seems to have a different warning about the toll-lords or the temperamental glass-divers who patrol the upper tiers. You steady your breathing, keeping your banked coal-lantern close against your ribs while the market roars around you.

nodes.brief: Standing at the heart of the bustling market square, you prepare to hear the twin rumors that will determine your next desperate move forward.

exits.label: Press on into the market crowd

nodes.title: Heart of the Market
nodes.page: Vendors shout over displays of spun crystal and clouded quartz while the scent of roasted thistle seed hangs thick in the hazy air. Your fingers brush the cold ceramic weight of the Seedkey hidden beneath your tunic, reminding you of the failing harvests back at Candlemere. Two competing whispers cut through the din regarding the true state of the deep underground waterworks. You step closer to the stalls to weigh these claims before choosing your path.

nodes.brief: In the humming blue corridors of the Shard Bazaar, a toothless merchant murmurs that the Rain Vault is empty and dry.

exits.label: Thread through the narrow stalls
Climb the shattered crystal stairwell
Follow the low hum of the conduit

nodes.title: Shard Bazaar Corridor
nodes.page: Cool blue shadows stretch across the packed salt floor as you weave through the humming corridors of the Shard Bazaar. A toothless merchant leans against a pillar of fused glass, murmuring that the Rain Vault is empty and dry, nothing more than a hollow shell of rusted pipes. The your hand tightens over the banked embers of your lantern, keeping its pale glow hidden from the curious eyes of passing toll-collectors. Every corner hides a new danger or a fresh diversion pulling you deeper into the city.

nodes.brief: Beneath a leaning arcade of green glass, a desperate smuggler insists the Rain Vault is already guarded by the Salt Court.

exits.privWhy: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over
exits.label: Slip into the hidden drainage pipe
Dart across the sunlit courtyard
Crawl beneath the fallen crystal arch

nodes.title: Leaning Green Arcade
nodes.page: Sunlight filters through a leaning arcade of greenish glass, casting a sickly emerald hue over the cracked pavement beneath your boots. A desperate smuggler crouches near a pillar, insisting in a frantic whisper that the Rain Vault is already heavily guarded by the Salt Court's elite pikemen. Your breath catches in your throat as you realize how closely watched the main avenues have become. Without a companion to draw unwanted attention away, you notice small details that others usually miss entirely.

nodes.brief: You slip past a collapsed obsidian balcony where scavengers bicker over copper wire, risking a fall into the singing pits.

exits.label: Pick your way past the bickering scavengers
Descend into the purple slag tunnel

exits.privWhy: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over
exits.label: Utilize the unsecured winch above the barrier

nodes.title: Collapsed Obsidian Balcony
nodes.page: Rough obsidian crunches beneath your boots as you slip past a collapsed balcony where rival scavengers bicker furiously over twisted copper wire. Below your footing, a deep chasm hums with the eerie, resonant vibrations of the singing pits, threatening to betray your passage with every shifting pebble. You keep your weight low and your eyes fixed on the narrow ledge ahead, mindful of the vast drop just inches from your heel.

nodes.brief: A blind scavenger named Oren barters for your spare flint while leaning against a pillar of fused teal crystal.

exits.label: Skirt the edge of the apprentice workshop
Balance along the twisted lead rib
Duck behind the dark basalt pillar

nodes.title: Teal Crystal Pillar
nodes.page: A blind scavenger leans against a towering column of fused teal crystal, softly bartering for your spare flint with uncanny precision. The air around you smells of old dust and baked minerals, thick with the silence of a city long abandoned by its original makers. You offer a small piece of metal in exchange for safe passage through his territory before moving onward into the maze of shards.

nodes.brief: Amidst the debris of a mirror-maker's workshop, a jagged shard reflects the scorching noon glare directly into your eyes.

exits.label: Traverse the narrow quartz chasm ridge
Pass the clattering salt wind chimes
Seek shelter under the velvet carpet canopy
Avoid the groaning amber glass doorway

nodes.title: Mirror-Maker Workshop
nodes.page: Jagged shards of antique glass scatter across the floor of a ruined mirror-maker's workshop, catching the scorching noon glare and throwing blinding reflections directly into your eyes. You shield your face with a calloused forearm, navigating the glittering hazard by instinct and the crunch of glass beneath your heavy soles. The heat radiating off the ruined frames is stifling, pressing down like a physical weight upon your shoulders.

nodes.brief: Walking unguided, you notice a fresh bootprint in the salt dust leading straight into a hidden drainage conduit.

exits.label: Enter the amber glass doorway
Navigate the whistling hollow pillars
Approach the sunlit Dune Sister well

priv.why: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over

nodes.title: Fresh Salt Dust Print
nodes.page: Unburdened by the chatter of a guide, your eyes scan the ground with total concentration and immediately spot a fresh bootprint pressed deep into the fine salt dust. It leads straight toward the mouth of a hidden drainage conduit that most travellers would walk right past without a second glance. You crouch low, testing the coolness of the subterranean air rising from the dark opening.

nodes.brief: A toll-lord's scout peers from a high window of smoked glass, forcing you to duck behind a crumbling arch.

exits.label: Follow the whistling hollow pillars
Scramble over the spectacle frame heap
Trade cloaks with the hooded scavenger
Slip through the old vinegar larder

nodes.title: Smoked Glass Window
nodes.page: A toll-lord's scout peers down through a high window of smoked glass, his sharp eyes sweeping across the empty plaza below. You drop instantly behind the shelter of a crumbling arch, holding your breath as the heavy thud of distant boots echoes off the stone. The danger of discovery hangs heavily in the dry air, making every second feel stretched to its breaking point.

nodes.brief: The air grows heavy with the smell of scorched resin as you cross a bridge made of woven copper wire.

exits.label: Meet with the hooded map trader
Dodge the swinging iron crane chain
Hide inside the amethyst glass alcove

nodes.title: Woven Copper Wire Bridge
nodes.page: The air grows thick and heavy with the sharp scent of scorched resin as your boots step onto a suspension bridge made of tightly woven copper wire. The span gives under your steps, and a metallic note climbs through the soles of your feet. Far below, the dry floor of the Basin glitters like crushed diamonds in the harsh glare of the afternoon sun.

nodes.brief: In a courtyard of shattered crystal bells, a lone beggar named Sola begs for water while clutching a broken sextant.

exits.label: Listen to the frantic courier
Watch the skeletal street-cleaner sweep
Hear the old woman's salt-crust warning

nodes.title: The Court of Bells
nodes.page: Shattered crystal bells carpet a sun-baked courtyard, chiming faintly with every step you take across the alkaline dust. A lone beggar named Sola sits amid the crystal fragments, clutching a broken brass sextant to her chest while holding out a cracked clay cup and pleading for a single drop of water. The dry glare bounces off the sharp glass shards around you, making the air shimmer with heat.

nodes.brief: You crawl through a low tunnel of purple slag where the floor hums with strange, subterranean vibrations.

exits.label: Squeeze through the jagged green bottles

nodes.title: The Slag Tunnel
nodes.page:
Low walls of purple slag close in around your shoulders, radiating a dull, baked warmth that smells of sulfur and old smoke. The floor beneath your boots shakes with subterranean vibrations, as if massive gears turn deep within the dead city's foundations. Every breath tastes of metallic dust, urging you to keep moving through the dark, cramped conduit before the heat becomes too heavy to bear.

Ahead, the passage splits into narrow, uninviting fractures in the fused rock.

nodes.brief: Moving without a companion allows you to spot an unsecured winch that lifts you cleanly over a toll barrier.

exits.label: Squeeze through the jagged green bottles
Watch the skeletal street-cleaner sweep

priv.why: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over

nodes.title: The Solitary Winch
nodes.page:
Travelling completely on your own leaves your senses unburdened by conversation, allowing you to notice the small, neglected details that a companion would surely talk right over. Tucked behind a rusted iron bracket hangs an unsecured winch, its hempen rope frayed but taut enough to bear a climber's weight. You pull the iron lever and swing cleanly past the perimeter of the toll barrier without triggering the alarm bells.

You dangle quietly above the alleyway, weighing your next movement.

nodes.brief: A team of Glasswright apprentices argue noisily over the refractive index of a massive lens-block suspended above you.

exits.label: Squeeze through the jagged green bottles
Cross the humming copper bridge
Hear the old woman's salt-crust warning

nodes.title: The Lenswrights' Dispute
nodes.page:
Shouts echo off the curved walls as a team of Glasswright apprentices argue noisily over the refractive index of a massive, multi-ton lens-block suspended overhead by heavy chains. Their heated gestures punctuate a fierce debate about how the upcoming monsoon might warp the glass. The massive lens sways slightly in the rising thermal draft, casting dizzying prisms of violet light across your boots.

You must skirt around the arguing apprentices to find a safer route.

nodes.brief: You balance precariously on a narrow rib of twisted lead high above a chasm of razor-sharp quartz needles.

exits.label: Watch the skeletal street-cleaner sweep
Cross the humming copper bridge
Hear the old woman's salt-crust warning

nodes.title: The Lead Rib
nodes.page:
A narrow rib of twisted lead provides the only path across a yawning chasm filled with thousands of razor-sharp quartz needles pointing skyward like teeth. Balancing precariously on the slick metal, you keep your arms outstretched against the hot desert wind whistling through the gap. One misstep would send you plunging into the glittering trap below.

You slow your breath and prepare to cross the perilous span.

nodes.brief: A sudden flash from a distant signal-tower blinds you momentarily, masking your scramble behind a basalt pillar.

exits.label: Hide inside the hollow cistern
Leap across the glittering crystal chasm

nodes.title: The Signal Flash
nodes.page:
A blinding white flare erupts from a distant Glasswright signal-tower, washing the ruined plaza in an intense, momentary glare. Reacting on instinct, you hurl yourself behind a thick pillar of black basalt just as the sharp crack of the light-pulse reverberates through the square. The patrol's footsteps scrape against the glass overhead, searching for intruders in the sudden gloom.

You wait in the cool shadow, deciding how to proceed.

nodes.brief: Salt-encrusted wind chimes clatter mournfully in a ruined conservatory where nothing green has grown for centuries.

exits.privWhy: the reader owes nobody and can bargain freely
exits.label: Negotiate swift passage with the cart-driver
Trade dried dates with the weary scholar
Take the reckless glass-chute drop

nodes.title: The Conservatory Chimes
nodes.page:
Salt-encrusted wind chimes clatter mournfully in the hollow skeleton of a ruined glass conservatory where nothing green has taken root for centuries. The dry breeze rattles the metallic leaves against brittle panes, creating a lonely soundtrack in the empty ruins. The path ahead divides around a tangle of fused frames and collapsed iron arches.

You eye the remaining routes out of the silent garden.

nodes.brief: You trade a mouthful of brackish water for shelter beneath the velvet canopy of an itinerant carpet-weaver.

exits.privWhy: the reader owes nobody and can bargain freely
exits.label: Negotiate swift passage with the cart-driver
Leap across the glittering crystal chasm

nodes.title: The Weaver's Canopy
nodes.page:
Velvet draperies flutter softly inside a shaded alcove where an itinerant carpet-weaver offers temporary refuge from the scorching glare. You trade a mouthful of brackish water from your leather flask for permission to sit beneath the woven canopy and catch your breath. The cool fabric smells faintly of dried indigo and desert dust, offering a brief respite from the harsh exterior.

Refreshed, you look out toward the open paths waiting beyond the shelter.

nodes.brief: A forgotten doorway of amber glass groans ominously as shifting thermal currents threaten to shatter it.

exits.privWhy: the reader owes nobody and can bargain freely
exits.label: Negotiate swift passage with the cart-driver
Leap across the glittering crystal chasm
Trade dried dates with the weary scholar

nodes.title: The Amber Doorway
nodes.page:
A forgotten doorway crafted from thick amber glass groans ominously as shifting midday thermal currents cause the material to flex and crack. The honey-colored light pouring through the frame distorts the alley beyond into a warped, dreamlike smear of gold and shadow. Every creak of the cooling glass suggests the structure is on the verge of shattering completely.

You step quickly away from the unstable portal to choose your next direction.

nodes.brief: You navigate a labyrinth of hollow pillars that whistle a low, haunting note every time the wind stirs.

exits.label: Follow the white-feathered gulls
Approach the engraved crystal archway
Share bitter tea with the glass-cutter

nodes.title: The Whistle Pillars
nodes.page:
Hollow pillars of pale ceramic rise on all sides, forming a dense maze that whistles a low, haunting note every time a stray gust of wind stirs through their drilled vents. The sound rolls across the deserted plaza like a chorus of low sighs, masking the crunch of your boots against the salt crust. The labyrinth opens up into three distinct avenues further ahead.

You choose an alley to escape the eerie whistling.

nodes.brief: A group of fierce Dune Sisters block a sunlit courtyard, demanding an oath before letting you pass their well.

exits.label: Swear the binding oath to pass
Slip away southward through the rubble
Circle wide around the blocked courtyard

nodes.title: The Sisters of the Well
nodes.page:
Fierce Dune Sisters stand shoulder-to-shoulder across the sun-baked stones of the courtyard, their dark robes stiff with crusts of alkaline salt. They bar the path to the bubbling stone cistern, demanding a binding oath of silence and service before they will let a single drop touch your cracked lips.

The midday glare bounces blindingly off their bronze armlets, and your canteen hangs at your belt like a dead weight.

nodes.brief: You scramble over a mountain of discarded spectacle frames that clatter like dry bones beneath your heavy boots.

exits.label: Scramble down the western slope of lenses
Press onward toward the distant crystal arch
Haul yourself up the salt-encrusted drainpipe

nodes.title: Mountain of Broken Spectacles
nodes.page:
Piles of discarded spectacle frames rise in jagged mounds across the alley, clattering like dry, hollow bones beneath the heavy tread of your boots. Each step sends a cascade of tiny, wire-rimmed lenses sliding down the slope with a soft, musical chime that echoes off the surrounding glass walls.

The climb leaves your lungs burning in the thin desert air while the distant silhouette of Prism shimmers through the heat haze above.

nodes.brief: A hooded scavenger named Kael offers to trade a counterfeit map of Prism for your sturdy wool cloak.

exits.label: Trade your heavy wool cloak for the parchment
Ignore the offer and hurry down the eastern lane
Climb the vertical drainage pipe to escape the alley

nodes.title: The Hooded Scavenger
nodes.page:
A hooded figure named Kael crouches in the shade of a leaning mirror-wall, unrolling a creased parchment that smells faintly of old lamp oil. He whispers promises of a secret shortcut through the heart of the shard cities, offering to trade his counterfeit map of Prism for the sturdy wool cloak wrapped around your shoulders.

The evening wind begins to whistle mournfully through the hollow streets, carrying the bite of approaching cold against your sweat-dampened shirt.

nodes.brief: You slip through an abandoned larder smelling faintly of dried lemons and centuries-old vinegar.

exits.label: Follow the dark passage into the deeper vaults
Climb upward toward the shaft of moonlight

nodes.title: The Abandoned Larder
nodes.page:
Cool shadows embrace you as you slip through an abandoned larder deep within the foundations of a shattered glass tower. The air here smells faintly of dried lemons and centuries-old vinegar, offering a welcome respite from the scorching glare and alkaline dust of the basin floor.

A narrow passage leads deeper into the subterranean gloom while another route climbs toward a glinting shaft of moonlight.

nodes.brief: A rusted iron crane swings dangerously overhead, its dangling chain scraping against the calcified pavement.

exits.label: Dart forward beneath the swinging iron chain
Duck away into the narrow side-alley to the left
Wait against the pillar for the crane to settle

nodes.title: The Swinging Crane
nodes.page:
A rusted iron crane hangs precariously from a fractured beam overhead, its dangling chain scraping a rhythmic, grating note against the calcified pavement. Every sway of the boom jars loose glass shards from the crumbling cornice far above your head.

You press your back against the cool surface of a turquoise pillar while watching the iron pendulum arc back and forth across the street.

nodes.brief: You duck into a sunken alcove of amethyst glass while a patrol of toll-lords marches past with heavy pikes.

exits.label: Step out and follow the patrol from a distance
Take the twisting passage deeper into the ruins

nodes.title: Shadows of Amethyst
nodes.page:
Iron-shod boots crunch on the crystal pavement as a patrol of toll-lords marches past, pikes catching the pale daylight. You duck quickly into a sunken alcove of deep amethyst glass, holding your breath while the rhythmic clanking of their iron-shod gear fades into the distance.
