The shelter of the alcove is cool and dim, but lingering here accomplishes nothing while the twenty-day monsoon draws closer by the hour.

nodes.brief: In a plaza of fractured sunstones, a frantic courier begs you to carry a warning about poisoned cisterns.

exits.label: Accept the warning token and rush forward

nodes.title: The Plaza of Sunstones
nodes.page:
Fractured sunstones pave the wide plaza, glowing with a dull, internal amber warmth that makes the surrounding air shimmer like water. A frantic courier stumbles toward you from the shadows of an archway, clutching his side and begging you to carry a vital warning about poisoned cisterns to the authorities in Prism.

The courier collapses against a milestone, leaving you holding a brass token stamped with the seal of the water-watchers.

nodes.brief: You squeeze through a narrow fissure in a wall of fused green bottles, tearing your sleeve on jagged glass.

exits.label: Push forward into the sunlit square ahead
Duck behind the fallen sun-disc into the stairwell

nodes.title: The Fissure of Green Bottles
nodes.page:
Jagged edges of fused green wine bottles scrape against your shoulders as you squeeze sideways through a narrow fissure in the ancient wall. A sharp slip tears a long rent in your sleeve and draws a thin line of bright blood down your forearm, mingling with the dry salt crust on your skin.

Beyond the breach lies a wider lane bathed in the harsh white glare of the midday sun.

nodes.brief: A skeletal street-cleaner named Miri sweeps sparkling glass dust into neat piles with a twig broom.

exits.label: Slip past her broom down the narrow lane
Dart quickly across the broad avenue ahead

nodes.title: The Glass Sweeper
nodes.page:
A skeletal street-cleaner named Miri sweeps sparkling glass dust into neat, shimmering piles with a tireless twig broom. She does not look up as you approach, singing a dry, crackling little tune to herself about the price of tin and the depth of the dry wells.

A narrow alley winds away past her elbow while a broader avenue stretches toward the shadow of a high signal tower.

nodes.brief: You cross a suspension bridge woven from copper wire that hums like a hornet's nest beneath your feet.

exits.label: Cross the humming copper bridge to the far side
Turn back from the span to search for another way

nodes.title: The Copper Wire Bridge
nodes.page:
A suspension bridge woven from thick copper wire hums like an angry hornet's nest beneath the cautious placement of your boots. The structure sways gently in the dry thermal drafts, spanning a yawning chasm of shattered glass that glitters far below like frozen ocean waves.

On the far side, the path splits among a maze of leaning mirror-towers and silent archways.

nodes.brief: An old woman selling roasted salt-crusts warns you that the signal-towers are sending coded warnings tonight.

exits.label: Dash beneath the falling stained glass
Slip past the brass telescope observer
Duck behind the massive sun-disc stairwell

nodes.title: The Coded Beacons
nodes.page: Coarse salt-crusts sizzle on a tin brazier while an old woman in a patched oilskin coat gestures toward the heights of the shattered city. The high signal-towers flash in rhythmic, unbroken sequences against the gathering dusk, translating the silent warnings of the Glasswright sentries. Your ember-lamp shifts against your hip, its banked coals radiating a steady, familiar warmth through the thick canvas of your pack as you weigh your next step through the labyrinth.

nodes.brief: You hide inside a hollow cistern of black basalt while heavy footsteps echo loudly on the glass overhead.

exits.label: Descend into the hidden subterranean stair
Scramble across the slippery blue slag incline
Turn back toward the obsidian balcony

nodes.title: The Basalt Cistern
nodes.page: Absolute silence fills the hollow belly of the black basalt cistern, broken only by the measured crunch of iron-shod boots pacing across the thick glass roof directly above your head. You press your shoulder against the cold, damp stone, holding your breath while the rhythmic footfalls slowly recede into the distance. The weight of the ceramic Seedkey rests securely against your collarbone, an icy contrast to the feverish heat of your skin.

nodes.brief: Unburdened by debts or allies, you negotiate a swift passage with a rogue cart-driver for a single copper coin.

exits.label: Take the hidden stair behind the sun-disc
Follow the wind down the hollow glass canyon
Approach the nervous talisman broker

priv.why: the reader owes nobody and can bargain freely

nodes.title: The Unencumbered Cart
nodes.page: Owing neither debt chains nor the binding oaths demanded by the Dune Sisters, you stand before a waiting transport with a solitary copper coin pressed between your fingers. A rogue cart-driver nods once at the glint of honest metal, tipping his wide brim without asking your loyalties or what you haul. The open road through the shard towers stretches out wide and inviting under the pale, salt-bleached sky.

nodes.brief: A jagged chasm splits the street, forcing you to leap across a void of glittering crystal shards.

exits.label: Leap across toward the stained glass canopy
Drop behind the fallen solar disc
Push onward down the howling glass canyon
Turn back toward the obsidian balcony

nodes.title: The Crystal Chasm
nodes.page: A sudden, jagged cleft rips straight through the middle of the glass thoroughfare, exposing a dizzying drop into the glittering, razor-sharp depths below. Shards of violet and amber crystal chime softly like broken bells as small pebbles dislodge from the rim and tumble endlessly into the gloom. You tighten the straps of your travel pack, steady your footing on the brittle lip, and prepare to cross the dangerous void.

nodes.brief: You trade a handful of dried dates with a weary scholar for directions around the central toll-fort.

exits.label: Find the hidden stair behind the sun-disc
Climb the steep blue slag incline

nodes.title: The Scholar's Map
nodes.page: Dried dates disappear one by one into the palm of a weary scholar whose fingers trace intricate routes across a parchment stained with salt and ink. In exchange for the meager sweet ration, you receive precise guidance on how to skirt the edges of the central toll-fort without drawing the greedy gaze of the Salt Court enforcers. The desert air tastes of old dust and distant rain as you memorize the secret turnings.

nodes.brief: A flock of white-feathered gulls nests strangely atop a scorched pillar of iridescent slag.

exits.label: Walk the windy canyon of hollow towers
Traverse the slippery blue slag incline
Visit the nervous talisman broker

nodes.title: The Iridescent Pillar
nodes.page: A swirling cloud of white-feathered gulls erupts from the summit of a scorched pillar, their sharp cries echoing off the towering walls of iridescent slag. The glassy column radiates a faint, residual heat from some ancient fire, bathing the surrounding ruins in a shimmering, pearlescent glow. Below the nesting birds, a narrow track winds its way deeper into the heart of the shattered basin.

nodes.brief: You wade through a shallow pool of salty brine that stings the open blisters on your travel-weary feet.

exits.label: Talk to the nervous talisman broker
Find the unguarded postern gate
Balance along the narrow salt knife-edge

nodes.title: The Brine Pool
nodes.page: Warm, saline water laps against your shins, stinging the open blisters on your travel-worn feet with every cautious step through the shallow basin. The stagnant pool reflects the fractured towers above like a mirror of broken silver, hiding the jagged edges of sunken masonry beneath its murky surface. You keep your lamp held high above the waterline to protect the precious coals from the damp spray.

nodes.brief: A towering archway of engraved crystal frames a breathtaking view of the distant, silent Prism.

exits.label: Scale the slippery blue slag incline
Consult the nervous talisman broker

nodes.title: The Crystal Archway
nodes.page: A towering archway carved from pure, transparent crystal frames a breathtaking, silent vista of Prism rising in the distance like a jagged crown of diamonds against the horizon. The great observatory-city seems impossibly close, yet the treacherous expanse of the Shard Cities still lies heavily between your tired feet and the Rain Vault. The air here carries a clean, mineral sharpness that hints at high altitudes and ancient secrets.

nodes.brief: You pull yourself up a vertical drainage pipe encrusted with stubborn barnacles of white salt.

exits.label: Speak with the nervous talisman broker
Slip through the old foundry postern gate
Turn back toward the woven copper bridge

nodes.title: The Salt-Encrusted Pipe
nodes.page: Rough barnacles of hardened salt tear against your palms as you haul your weight up the vertical length of an old copper drainage pipe. Every muscle in your arms trembles with exertion, but the climb lifts you safely above the cluttered alleys where scavengers and toll-collectors roam. At the top, a narrow ledge offers a momentary breath of clean air before the next trial.

nodes.brief: A cautious glass-cutter named Bram shares a cup of bitter tea while warning you of traps ahead.

exits.label: Ascend the blue slag incline
Enter the old foundry postern gate

nodes.title: The Glass-Cutter's Warning
nodes.page: Steam rises from a tin cup of bitter herbal tea pushed across a rough workbench by a cautious glass-cutter named Bram. He points a calloused finger toward the dark alleyways ahead, detailing the tripwires and hidden snares left behind by rival scavengers who guard their turf jealously. The embers in your lantern cast a steady, comforting glow over his scarred hands as you listen closely to his advice.

nodes.brief: You navigate a collapsing gallery where thousands of tiny prisms scatter the moonlight into blinding rainbows.

exits.label: Follow the northern passage through the amber haze
Creep down the descending stair toward the darker vaults
Turn back toward the obsidian balcony

nodes.title: Prisms in the Dust
nodes.page: Thousands of tiny prisms dangle from the fractured ribwork of the gallery ceiling, catching the pale desert moon and scattering it into blinding, violet arcs across the floor. Every step crunches against brittle shards that hum like tuning forks under your boots. The air tastes of ozone and dry alkali, thick enough to coat your tongue.

nodes.brief: A rusted iron gate blocks the alley, its lock rusted solid by decades of alkaline desert winds.

exits.label: Squeeze past the jammed iron barrier

nodes.title: The Rusted Barricade
nodes.page: A heavy iron gate blocks the mouth of the alley, its thick bars pitted and rusted solid by decades of alkaline desert winds blowing across the Basin. Coarse salt crystals crust the hinges, locking the metal in a stubborn grip that refuses to budge under a casual shove. Your shoulder tests the bars; dry metal stays cold and unyielding against the canvas coat.

nodes.brief: Beneath a canopy of shattered stained glass, you dodge a falling fragment that shatters into deadly dust.

exits.label: Climb the spiralling glass stairs
Press flat against the warm wall

nodes.title: Falling Shards
nodes.page: Jagged chunks of stained glass hang precariously overhead in a vaulted ceiling rendered fragile by thermal shock and endless salt-storms. A sudden crack echoes above, and you throw yourself sideways as a massive fragment plummets, bursting into a cloud of razor-sharp dust that settles over your boots. Breathing heavily in the alkaline air, you look up to find your route divided by the debris.

nodes.brief: A lone sentry named Vane peers through a brass telescope, ignoring your presence as you dart past.

exits.label: Dash toward the humming signal-tower

nodes.title: The Sentry at the Lens
nodes.page: A lone glass-diver named Vane stands beside a brass telescope mounted on a pedestal of fused green slag, ignoring your presence entirely as he tracks the horizon for signal flashes. His coat is stiff with dried salt and his fingers are bandaged with strips of oiled linen. You crouch low in the shadow of a basalt buttress, waiting for a chance to slip past his narrow field of vision.

nodes.brief: You squeeze behind a massive fallen sun-disc that blocks the mouth of a hidden subterranean stairwell.

exits.label: Descend into the bronze-scented stairwell
Slip sideways along the sun-warmed wall

nodes.title: The Sun-Disc Ascent
nodes.page: Massive fragments of a fallen solar mirror lean against the masonry like giant bronze coins dropped by some careless titan of the old world. You squeeze your frame through the narrow gap behind the heavy metal, discovering a set of subterranean stone stairs descending into darkness. The air rising from the depths smells of damp earth and old copper rather than dry salt.

nodes.brief: The salty wind howls through a canyon of hollow glass towers, nearly knocking you off your balance.

exits.label: Climb the spiralling glass stairs upward
Step through the ajar bronze door

nodes.title: The Howling Glass Towers
nodes.page: Gale-force winds scream through the narrow canyon formed by the towering, hollow monoliths of the Old Lensfolk, carrying razor-sharp salt spray that stings your cheeks. Each gust sets the glassy walls ringing, a deep mournful note that climbs through your boots into your teeth. You cling tightly to your ember-lamp, shielding its precious glow with your coat as you hunt for footing on the slick, crystalline pavement. Two paths present themselves amidst the roaring gale: a spiralling ascent carved into the side of an adjacent tower, and a heavy, slightly ajar bronze portal at the base of the nearest structure.

nodes.brief: You scramble across a slippery incline of fused blue slag while distant drums signal an approaching patrol.

exits.label: Flatten against the warm glass facade
Hurry toward the glowing sanctum threshold

nodes.title: Slag and Drums
nodes.page: Your boots slide across a steep incline of blue glass slag that shatters beneath your weight with the sound of breaking porcelain. Far off across the white flats, deep rhythmic drums beat against the stone, signalling an armed patrol of the Salt Court moving between the lower tiers. You drop to one knee, letting the silence swallow your breath as you choose where to run.

nodes.brief: A nervous broker named Jora tries to sell you an ineffective talisman against the coming monsoon floods.

exits.label: Ascend the spiralling stair toward the tower
Press flat against the sun-baked wall

nodes.title: The Talisman Broker
nodes.page: A nervous broker named Jora steps out from behind a shattered archway, waving a string of hollow glass beads and whispering frantic offers of protection against the coming monsoon floods. His eyes dart nervously toward the upper balconies while he thrusts the worthless trinket toward your chest. You brush past his outstretched hands, keeping your gaze fixed on the paths ahead.

nodes.brief: You slip through an unguarded postern gate built into the massive outer wall of the old lens-foundry.

exits.label: Approach the beacon at the base
Enter the glowing tower threshold
Retrace your steps past the basalt pillar

nodes.title: The Foundry Postern
nodes.page: A low postern gate stands half-open in the massive exterior wall of the old lens-foundry, its hinges greased with animal fat to keep them silent. You slip through the narrow opening into a courtyard strewn with discarded prisms and cooling vats. Faint light spills from an interior doorway, cutting a sharp beam across the grey flagstones.

nodes.brief: The path narrows to a knife-edge of white salt, with the dark abyss of the basin yawning on either side.

exits.label: Climb the winding glass stairs
Head toward the open bronze doorway
Step inside the glowing sanctum entrance

nodes.title: The Salt-Edge Path
nodes.page: The ground narrows until it becomes a razor-edge ridge of packed white salt, dropping away on both sides into the dark, silent abyss of the dry sea basin. Every step requires absolute concentration as the salt crust crumbles beneath your heels into powdery dust. You keep your arms outstretched for balance, your eyes fixed on the stable structures rising ahead.

nodes.brief: You climb a steep flight of spiralling glass stairs that lead directly toward the humming signal-tower.

exits.label: Ascend the remaining steps and enter the tower

nodes.title: The Spiralling Glass Stairs
nodes.page: Sharp facets of green and amber crystal bite into your palms as you hoist yourself up the steep flight of spiralling glass stairs. Each turn of the helix brings you closer to the humming signal-tower where the Glasswrights send their blinding messages across the dried basin. Your ember-lamp swings at your hip, casting a warm orange glow against the cold, transparent risers. Far below, the salt-flats stretch away like a frozen ocean under the glare of the desert sun.

nodes.brief: A weathered bronze door at the base of the tower stands ajar, letting out a sharp beam of white light.

exits.label: Step through the glowing threshold into the passage

nodes.title: The Bronze Door Ajar
nodes.page: Metal hinges creak as you slip past a weathered bronze door standing ajar at the base of the signal-tower. A sharp beam of white light cuts through the dim interior, illuminating floating motes of salt dust and the faint scent of ozone. Your fingers brush the cold ceramic weight of the Seedkey hidden safely in your coat. Outside, the dry winds of the basin rattle against the metal frame like loose teeth.

nodes.brief: You dodge a sweeping mirror-flash from the upper gallery, pressing flat against the warm glass wall.

exits.label: Push forward along the gallery while the blind spot holds

nodes.title: The Sweeping Mirror Flash
nodes.page: Sudden brilliance floods the gallery as a rotating mirror-flash sweeps across the high wall just inches above your head. You press your spine flat against the warm glass masonry, holding your breath while the rhythmic clatter of clockwork machinery echoes overhead. The heat of the concentrated light warms the shoulder of your coat. When the beam swings away toward the western rim, the narrow corridor ahead opens up in the sudden gloom.

nodes.brief: The tower steps ring sharply under your boots as you approach the glowing threshold of the Glasswright's sanctum.

exits.label: Step across the threshold to meet the sentry

nodes.title: The Ringing Threshold
nodes.page: The tower steps ring crisp and musical under your boots as you climb toward the glowing sanctum of the Glasswrights. The air here tastes of heated sand and old copper, humming with a vibration that makes your teeth ache in time with the distant signal-lamps. Every surface around you reflects your tired face a hundred times over in warped green glass. You adjust the strap of your banked lantern and prepare to face whoever waits within the light.

nodes.brief: Among the leaning spire-ribs, you balance across a singing glass girder while a salt-gale tests your footing and your haste.

exits.label: Follow the narrow rib toward the eastern terrace
Drop down into the shadowed alcove beneath the span
Swing across the chasm toward the industrial ruins

nodes.title: The Singing Girder
nodes.page: Slender ribs of old spires lean against one another like the bones of ancient leviathans, forming a precarious bridge high above the salt floor. You balance carefully across a singing glass girder that hums with a deep, musical resonance every time a gust of the salt-gale strikes its flank. Your boots slide slightly on the smooth surface, demanding every ounce of your concentration as you hurry across the dizzying gap.

nodes.brief: In a courtyard of cracked prisms, a scavenging tinker trades stale water for a sliver of your lantern-fuel before you can pass.

exits.privWhy: the reader owes nobody and can bargain freely
exits.label: Offer a trade since your debts are entirely clear
Turn aside to skirt the dry obsidian fountain
Pick your way through the chiming conservatory crystal

nodes.title: The Cracked Prism Courtyard
nodes.page: Shards of prismatic glass crunch under your feet as you step into a sun-bleached courtyard enclosed by leaning glass monoliths. A scavenger tinker with a patched canvas eyepatch steps out from behind a dry fountain, demanding a sliver of your lantern-fuel as a toll before letting you pass. You weigh the value of your precious banked coals against the cost of a confrontation in this sun-baked maze.

nodes.brief: Beneath a canopy of melted lenses, an old mirror-sentry named Vane warns you that the upper viaducts hum with dangerous resonance.

exits.label: Crawl past the cobalt tunnel of the glass-eaters
Navigate the broken mirror-post on the amber terrace
Squeeze through the hollow statue of the queen

nodes.title: The Melted Canopy
nodes.page: Layers of ancient lenses have melted together over the street into a thick, distorted canopy that filters the desert glare into a sickly violet twilight. An old mirror-sentry named Vane sits on an upturned salt-block, sharpening a glass scraper, and he warns you that the upper viaducts carry a dangerous, shattering pitch. The air here tastes dry and metallic, smelling faintly of ozone and old copper wire.

nodes.brief: Within a hollow crystal dome, you navigate a maze of razor-sharp shards while distant signal-flashes blink warnings you cannot parse.

exits.label: Cross the shimmering floor of white salt-crust
Use the discarded miner cart to bridge the trench

exits.privWhy: the reader's ember-lamp is burning and draws or reveals something
exits.label: Follow the warm glow of your steady ember-lamp

nodes.title: The Crystal Dome Maze
nodes.page: Vaulted ribs of clear crystal arch overhead to form a hollow dome that traps the heat of the midday sun like an oven. You navigate a winding maze of razor-sharp shards, your boots crunching softly on the crystalline dust while distant signal-flashes blink cryptic warnings from unseen towers. The shadows shift strangely around you, casting long, fractured reflections that seem to move independently of your own body.

nodes.brief: Across a chasm of fused green glass, a rusted pulley-crane offers a perilous swing toward the lower industrial terraces.

exits.label: Swing across the chasm on the rusted crane
Slip past the tilting gallery of concave panes
Scramble up through the hollow ribs of the dome

nodes.title: The Green Glass Chasm
nodes.page:
Jagged plates of fused green glass form a sheer drop above the lower industrial terraces. A rusted pulley-crane hangs out over the emptiness, its iron cable groaning in the dry wind. You test the swinging arm with a gloved hand, weighing whether its momentum can carry you across the gap before the rusted pivot snaps.

To your left, a tilting gallery of concave panes distorts your sight into dizzying waves, while a nervous scavenger on a quartz balcony fumbles with a heavy sack of grinding sand. Ahead, the hollow ribs of an ancient dome offer a narrow, razor-sharp scramble upward.

nodes.brief: Because your debts are clear, a hospitable lens-grinder gifts you an intact optic lens that reveals hidden footholds in the glowing dust.

exits.label: Climb upward using the gifted optic lens
Descend past the sun-trapping mirror-frame
Squeeze through the hollow pillar of stacked spectacles

priv.why: the reader owes nobody and can bargain freely

nodes.title: The Grinder's Gift
nodes.page:
Your pockets are entirely unburdened by debts or borrowed coin, leaving your name clean among the folk of the shard cities. A hospitable lens-grinder nods at your free standing and gifts you an intact optic lens from a velvet pouch. Looking through its polished curve reveals hidden footholds shimmering in the glowing desert dust, bypassing the usual dangers of the climb.

The path ahead branches toward a steep, sun-baked vault or a narrow drop beside a dry cascade of violet crystals.

nodes.brief: Beside a dry obsidian fountain, a salt-crusted trader tries to block your path with tales of a collapsing archway ahead.

exits.label: Take the detour past the violet mirror-frame
Cross carefully over the spun glass-wool bridge
Duck beneath the smoky quartz vaulted ceiling
Pick your way through the courtyard of hollow bells

nodes.title: The Obsidian Fountain
nodes.page:
A dry obsidian fountain marks the plaza, its stone basin caked with grey salt and drifting soot. A salt-crusted trader steps into your path, waving weathered hands and warning of a collapsing archway just ahead that could trap unwary runners forever. His eyes dart toward your banked ember-lamp as he tries to steer you toward alternative routes.

You can skirt the fountain toward a slender bridge of spun glass-wool, slip under a smoky quartz ceiling smelling of old kilns, or ring your way through a courtyard of hollow crystal bells.

nodes.brief: Inside a ruined conservatory of singing crystal, chiming wind-wires threaten to trip your steps and draw unwanted attention.

exits.label: Step lightly through the courtyard of hanging bells
Dodge the scorched salt near the magnifying monolith
Wade through the sunken cellar of heavy optic fluid

nodes.title: The Singing Conservatory
nodes.page:
Fine crystalline wind-wires stretch across the ruined conservatory, humming a low, resonant note whenever the desert breeze sweeps through the shattered panes. Every movement threatens to brush against the vibrating threads and broadcast your position across the silent terraces. You tuck your cloak tightly around your shoulders and watch the shifting shadows of the glass-wrought columns.

To the left, a tall monolith of magnifying glass focuses intense sunbeams onto the salt crust, while a sunken cellar filled with preserved optic fluid waits further down.

nodes.brief: Through a tunnel of cobalt glass, you crawl past the nested nests of glass-eaters whose glittering shells mimic the pavement.

exits.label: Head toward the crumbling sea-green parapet
Venture into the amphitheatre of whispering echoes

nodes.title: The Cobalt Tunnel
nodes.page:
Cool shadows wash over you inside a narrow tunnel of cobalt glass, far from the blinding glare of the basin. Your boots scrape softly against the pavement, disturbing the nested shells of glass-eaters whose crystalline husks mimic the shattered floor tiles. You hold your breath, stepping with extreme care to avoid crunching any hidden carapace underfoot.

The passage eventually splits, leading either toward a crumbling parapet of sea-green glass or deep into a grand amphitheatre of whispering echoes.

nodes.brief: On a suspended terrace of amber mosaic, a broken mirror-post flashes erratic signals that blind your progress.

exits.label: Press onward toward the sea-green parapet
Dodge into the amphitheatre of whispering echoes
Walk the rusted iron chains between glass spires

nodes.title: The Amber Terrace
nodes.page:
Golden light catches on a suspended terrace of amber mosaic, where a broken mirror-post flashes erratic, blinding signals across the plaza. The erratic beams bounce from wall to wall, making it difficult to gauge distances or spot potential obstacles in your path. You keep your head down against the glare, feeling the raw heat of the focused reflections bite into your cheek.

You can press onward toward a crumbling sea-green parapet, slip into an echo-filled amphitheatre, or test your balance on a network of rusted iron chains strung between distant glass spires.

nodes.brief: Within a hollowed statue of an Old Lensfolk queen, you squeeze through a narrow joint to bypass a toll-lord checkpoint.

exits.label: Cross the rusted iron chains between spires
Hide in the dark alley beneath hanging prisms

nodes.title: The Queen's Joint
nodes.page:
A colossal hollow statue of an Old Lensfolk queen dominates the square, her stone-and-glass robes frozen in an eternal cascade. Squeezing through a rusted joint in her metal corset allows you to bypass a toll-lord checkpoint stationed at the main archway. The interior smells of stagnant air and ancient dust, offering a safe, cramped tunnel out of sight.

Emerging on the far side puts you right above a network of hanging iron chains or near a dark alley where distant mirror-signals flare against the masonry.

nodes.brief: Across a shimmering floor of white salt-crust, your boots crunch loudly while unseen watchers whisper from the hollow towers.

exits.label: Enter the grand amphitheatre of whispering echoes
Slip away into the dark alley of hanging prisms

nodes.title: The Salt Floor
nodes.page:
White salt-crust spreads in a blinding sheet across the open avenue, crunching loudly beneath your boots with every stride. Unseen watchers murmur from the hollow towers flanking the square, their voices carrying ghost-like over the flat expanse. You clutch your seedkey tightly in your pocket and keep an unhurried pace despite the exposure.

The path ahead leads either into the echoing vaults of a grand amphitheatre or toward a dark alley shadowed by hanging glass prisms.

nodes.brief: Beneath a shattered solar arch, a discarded miner cart provides a rolling bridge over a treacherous trench of broken crystal.

exits.label: Step into the workshop of frozen mercury vats
Climb the exhausting slope of granular salt

nodes.title: The Shutter Cart
nodes.page:
A discarded miner cart sits beneath a shattered solar arch, its iron wheels rusted fast to the rails. Using its wooden bed as a makeshift bridge lets you span a treacherous trench of broken crystal that cuts across the thoroughfare. The jagged shards below glitter with a sharp, unkind light.

Across the gap, the route divides toward an indoor workshop heavy with metallic fumes or a steep slope covered in loose salt and tiny glass beads.

nodes.brief: Because your ember-lamp burns steady, its warm orange glow catches a hidden vein of soft lead solder framing a secret crawlway.

exits.label: Crawl through into the mercury workshop
Ascend the sliding slope of salt and beads

priv.why: the reader's ember-lamp is burning and draws or reveals something

nodes.title: The Solder Seam
nodes.page:
Your ember-lamp burns with a steady, comforting warmth, casting a rich orange glow against the grey masonry. The flickering light catches a faint, dull gleam within a narrow corner: a hidden vein of soft lead solder framing a secret crawlway long forgotten by the city's scavengers. You push against the pliable metal with your fingers, finding it gives way just enough to admit a determined runner.

The concealed passage leads toward either a workshop filled with metallic fumes or a steep, sliding slope of salt and glass beads.

nodes.brief: Inside a tilting gallery of concave panes, your distorted reflection misleads your sense of balance and direction.

exits.label: Step through the warped borosilicate frame
Retreat toward the fractured ruby obelisk

nodes.title: The Tilting Gallery
nodes.page:
Concave panes curve outward in a dizzying sequence, swallowing your silhouette and bending your limbs into impossible angles. Your inner ear protests against the deceptive geometry, making every step feel as though the floor beneath your boots is suddenly pitching sideways. You steady yourself against a cool vertical pane, keeping your grip firm on your ember-lamp while the distorted world spins around you.

A warped frame beckons toward a shadowy interior, or you can veer aside to inspect a glinting landmark near the hot exterior wall.

nodes.brief: Upon a balcony of fused quartz, a nervous scavenger drops a bag of grinding sand right into your path.

exits.label: Continue forward through the swirling quartz dust
Sidestep toward the dry obelisk path below

nodes.title: The Quartz Balcony
nodes.page:
Sudden movement shatters the silence of the high walkway as a startled scavenger loses his grip on a burlap sack. Grinding sand pours out across the fused quartz flags, hissing softly as it cascades toward your boots and threatens to compromise your footing on the steep ledge. You freeze instantly, holding your breath while the cloud of abrasive grit settles over the sun-bleached masonry.

The narrow path ahead clears enough for a cautious advance, or you can slip down a parallel ledge to bypass the grit altogether.

nodes.brief: Through the ribcage of an ancient glass-dome, you scramble upward while sharp shards threaten to slice your heavy travel pack.

exits.label: Climb toward the multi-tiered mirror balcony
Balance across the narrow girder spanning the trench

nodes.title: The Ribbed Dome
nodes.page:
Twisted ribs of ancient glass arch overhead like the skeleton of some colossal beast beached upon the salt flats. Scrambling upward requires a delicate touch, for every ridge is lined with razor-sharp splinters eager to snag your travel pack and test the weave of your heavy coat. Below you, the basin stretches away in blinding sheets of white, while your boots find precarious purchases upon the glassy skeleton.

Two distinct upward fractures offer passage through the shattered crown of the dome.

nodes.brief: Beside a dry cascade of violet crystals, an abandoned mirror-frame acts as a sun-trap that bakes the air into shimmering ripples.

exits.label: Circle wide past the empty water skin
Tread carefully across the trembling metal girder

nodes.title: The Sun Trap
nodes.page:
Violet crystals cast long, unmoving shadows across a dry cascade that once channeled cooling brine through the heart of the district. An abandoned mirror-frame catches the midday glare, focusing a concentrated beam of heat that bakes the surrounding air into visible, shimmering ripples. Sweat stings your eyes as you skirt the perimeter of the thermal trap, listening to the faint ping of glass expanding under the intense solar load.

You can skirt the sun-baked perimeter toward a familiar landmark or risk the narrow metal span across the chasm.

nodes.brief: Within a hollow pillar of stacked spectacles, a trapped desert gecko startles you as it skitters across your cold ceramic key.

exits.label: Venture toward the glittering mirror balconies
Crawl beneath the low ceiling of leaded panes

nodes.title: The Pillar of Spectacles
nodes.page:
Thousands of discarded lenses stack into a porous hollow column that faintly sings under the ruined ceiling above. A tiny desert gecko darts out from between two stacked monocles, startling you as its cold body brushes against the cold ceramic key tucked safely at your belt. The creature vanishes into the gloom, leaving only the sound of your own measured breathing echoing within the glassy shaft.

The pillar opens onto two distinct routes deeper into the skeletal ruins.

nodes.brief: Across a slender bridge of spun glass-wool, you tread lightly to avoid tearing the delicate ancient webbing.

exits.label: Cross the trembling metal girder over the trench
Follow the bridge toward the subsonic wind-harps

nodes.title: The Glass-Wool Span
nodes.page:
Fine threads of spun glass-wool weave a treacherous, fibrous carpet across a yawning chasm between two shattered towers. Every footstep sinks softly into the resilient white mesh, threatening to tear the delicate ancient web if you shift your weight too quickly. Below your boots, the deep drop-off breathes up a draft of cool, stagnant air trapped since the Old Lensfolk abandoned their high workshops.

The delicate web narrows ahead, forcing a choice between the deep trench crossing or the singing wind-plaza.

nodes.brief: Underneath a vaulted ceiling of smoky quartz, a smoky draft carries the sulfurous stench of old glass-kilns.

exits.label: Investigate the steam rising from the hot brine pool
Walk toward the gallery of stretched portrait-mirrors

nodes.title: The Smoky Vault
nodes.page:
Heavy leaded glass darkens the vaulted ceiling overhead, casting the corridor into a twilight gloom thick with the sulfurous stench of old glass-kilns. A warm, greasy draft sweeps through the passage, carrying the faint scent of ash and long-extinguished fires from the lower chambers. Your ember-lamp flickers in response to the pressure shift, its orange flame dancing against the soot-stained masonry of the walls.

Two distinct drafts pull at your coat, drawing your eye toward different corners of the vaulted hall.

nodes.brief: In a courtyard filled with hollow glass bells, every footstep rings out like a crystalline chime across the silent basin.

exits.label: Head toward the steaming brine pool below

exits.privWhy: Calder the glass-diver is with the reader and knows this place
exits.label: Follow Calder through the secure drainage tunnel
Ascend toward the mother-of-pearl ledge above

nodes.title: The Bell Courtyard
nodes.page:
Hollow glass bells hang from rusted iron armatures across the open square, chiming with a pure, crystalline resonance whenever your boots touch the flagged stones. The clear notes ripple outward across the silent basin, carrying far enough to rouse echoes from distant cliff-faces. You pause between strides, letting the resonant vibrations fade before daring your next movement across the ringing pavement.

Several exits lead away from the melodic square into the shadowed maze of the district.

nodes.brief: Beside a towering monolith of magnifying glass, focused sunbeams scorch the salt crust inches from your boots.

exits.label: Press onward through the distorted portrait gallery
Scramble upward toward the mother-of-pearl ledge

nodes.title: The Monolith Beam
nodes.page:
A colossal pillar of magnifying glass catches the high desert sun, focusing a blinding column of light that scorches the salt crust mere inches from your boots. Tiny puffs of acrid smoke rise where the concentrated beam licks at the mineral floor, scorching black scars into the white expanse. You duck low beneath the deadly focal point, keeping your travel pack tight against your back as you calculate your dash across the hazard zone.

The scorching glare forces a choice between two shadowy passages flanking the burning monolith.

nodes.brief: Through a sunken cellar of preserved optic fluid, you wade ankle-deep through heavy, viscous oil that smells of stale rosemary.

exits.label: wade toward the gallery of distorted mirrors
Climb out onto the iridescent mother-of-pearl ledge

nodes.title: The Optic Cellar
nodes.page: Preserved optic fluid fills the sunken cellar to ankle depth, forming a heavy, viscous pool that moves sluggishly around your boots. The dense oil smells intensely of stale rosemary and aged resin, clinging to your hems and leaving dark, glossy ripples in your wake. Every movement requires a deliberate effort against the suction of the floor as you wade through the amber-tinted gloom.

nodes.brief: On a crumbling parapet of sea-green glass, you dodge a falling icicle of fused quartz that shatters at your heels.

exits.label: Dash toward the looming window-wall
Climb the translucent slag ramp

nodes.title: Sea-Green Parapet
nodes.page: Jagged shards of fused quartz cascade from a sea-green parapet overhead, splintering against the salt-crusted stones right at your heels. You pull your canvas cloak tight, shielding your ember-lamp as the heat radiates off the crystalline masonry.

nodes.brief: Within a grand amphitheatre of whispering echoes, phantom voices mock your urgency and obscure the real path.

exits.label: Slip past the looming window-wall
Thread the alleyway of weaving shadows
Ascend the translucent slag ramp

nodes.title: Whispering Amphitheatre
nodes.page: Ghostly murmurs echo off the curved stone benches of the grand amphitheatre, twisting your own breath into mocking jeers that obscure the path ahead. Phantom voices mimic your urgency, whispering doubts about whether the Rain Vault will open in time. You grip your cold ceramic Seedkey and press forward through the swirling acoustic traps, searching for a way out of the singing bowl.

nodes.brief: Across a network of rusted iron chains strung between glass spires, you inch forward like a tightrope walker.

exits.label: Step toward the weaving shadow alleys
Make for the translucent slag ramp
Cross the ribbed crystal sky-bridge

nodes.title: Rusted Iron Spans
nodes.page: Rusted iron chains stretch taut across the terrifying drop between two hollow glass spires, humming with the dry desert wind. You inch forward one boot at a time like a tightrope walker, keeping your center of gravity low while the salt flats glare far below. Your banked lantern swings heavily from your belt, casting long, frantic arcs against the translucent walls.

nodes.brief: Beneath a canopy of hanging prisms, a sudden flare of distant mirror-signals forces you to duck into a dark alcove.

exits.label: Head for the sheer window-wall
Follow the weaving shadow alleys

nodes.title: Prism Canopy
nodes.page: Hanging prisms catch the blinding overhead glare, scattering sudden flashes of mirror-signal across the ruined avenue. You duck low beneath a canopy of dangling crystal drops, sliding into the cool shadow of a dark alcove to let the beacon sweep past. The air smells of ozone and baked dust, urging you to keep moving before the Glasswright sentries spot your passage.

nodes.brief: Inside a workshop filled with frozen mercury vats, metallic fumes make your head swim as you search for an exit.

exits.label: Escape toward the sheer window-wall
Climb the translucent slag ramp

nodes.title: Frozen Mercury Vats
nodes.page: Heavy metallic fumes rise from rows of frozen mercury vats, making your head spin and your throat burn with every shallow breath. You press your sleeve against your face, navigating the labyrinth of lead-rimmed vats where toxic reflections ripple like silver grease. Finding a way out of this noxious cellar becomes a matter of urgent survival before your senses fail entirely.

nodes.brief: Upon a slope of granular salt and tiny glass beads, your boots slip backward with every exhausting stride upward.

exits.label: Push toward the looming window-wall
Struggle upward to the slag ramp

nodes.title: Shifting Salt Slopes
nodes.page: Granular salt and tiny glass beads slide treacherously beneath your boots, dragging you backward with every exhausting stride up the steep incline. You dig your heels into the unstable crust, leaning your weight into the slope as the midday heat bakes the exposed basin. Your shoulders ache under the pack, but stopping here means sliding back into the glittering trap.

nodes.brief: Through a warped doorway of melted borosilicate, you enter a chamber where the walls pulse with trapped twilight.

exits.label: Cross the ribbed crystal sky-bridge
Duck under the sagging lead arch

nodes.title: Melted Borosilicate Doorway
nodes.page: Warped frames of melted borosilicate groan as you push through into a hidden chamber where the walls pulse with trapped twilight. Soft violet light bleeds from the ancient glass, casting long, distorted shadows across the floor. The strange illumination feels cool against your scorched skin, offering a moment of eerie respite before you choose your next direction.

nodes.brief: Beside a fractured obelisk of ruby glass, a discarded water skin lies empty and taunting in the dry heat.

exits.label: Traverse the ribbed crystal sky-bridge

nodes.title: Ruby Obelisk
nodes.page: Fractured pillars of ruby glass cast blood-red glints across the dry courtyard, where a discarded water skin lies empty and taunting in the heat. You stare at the shriveled leather, remembering the dry wells of Candlemere and the urgency of the twenty-day monsoon limit. Nothing moves in the quiet heat except the heat-haze shimmering off the broken obelisk.

nodes.brief: Within a multi-tiered balcony of shattered mirrors, you dodge dancing sun-hares that dazzle your tired eyes.

exits.label: Descend the green-tiled subterranean conduit
Duck under the sagging lead arch

nodes.title: Shattered Balcony
nodes.page: Multi-tiered balconies of shattered mirrors throw a thousand dancing sun-hares across your tired eyes, blinding you with sudden flashes of reflected light. You squint through the glare, dodging the shifting bright spots as you pick a careful route across the unstable, glittering stone floor. The wind whistles softly through the iron railings, carrying the distant scent of the salt basin.

nodes.brief: Across a deep trench filled with jagged glass teeth, a fallen girder offers a narrow, trembling lane of safety.

exits.label: Cross the ribbed crystal sky-bridge
Descend the green-tiled subterranean conduit
Take the reckless way

nodes.title: Trench of Glass Teeth
nodes.page: Jagged glass teeth line the bottom of a deep trench that cuts across the thoroughfare like an open wound. A fallen metal girder spans the chasm, offering a narrow, trembling lane of safety above the razor-sharp floor. You steady your breathing and prepare to cross the terrifying gap, keeping your eyes fixed firmly on the far ledge.

nodes.brief: Under a low ceiling of heavy leaded panes, you crawl on hands and knees while sharp edges scrape your wool coat.

exits.label: Follow the downward shadow
Crawl toward the grey light

nodes.title: The Leaded Crawl
nodes.page:
Heavy leaded panes press down from above, forcing you onto your hands and knees in the narrow corridor. Every inch requires a deliberate shift of weight as sharp, jagged edges scrape against the coarse wool of your coat. Your ember-lamp bangs softly against your knee, its banked coals radiating a dull, steady warmth into the cramped gloom. Ahead, the low ceiling splits into divergent paths through the glass rubble.

One route slopes downward into deeper shadow while the other angles toward a glint of grey light.

nodes.brief: In a plaza of singing wind-harps, vibrating strings create a low subsonic drone that rattles your teeth in your skull.

exits.label: Run straight across the trembling plaza
Slip down the narrow eastern alley
Duck into the low southern archway

nodes.title: Plaza of Singing Wires
nodes.page:
Vibrating strings of old wind-harps fill the square with a low, bone-shaking subsonic drone that rattles the teeth in your skull. Invisible currents sweep across the open white stone, setting the taut metallic wires humming with an eerie, resonant fury. You press a hand to your jaw to steady the vibration while your boots crunch over fine crystal dust scattered by the gale. The acoustic pressure weighs heavy in the chest, demanding a hasty retreat or a bold sprint across the terrace.

Three distinct pathways branch away from the singing towers into the maze.

nodes.brief: Beside a bubbling pool of superheated brine, steam hisses against the cold base of your ceramic seedkey.

exits.label: Pick your way along the narrow northern ledge

nodes.title: The Brine Pool
nodes.page: Superheated brine bubbles and spits within a sunken basin of fused green slag, venting plumes of acrid, scalding steam into the stagnant air. The white vapor swirls around your ankles, hissing angrily the moment it touches the cold metal base of your ceramic seedkey. Salt crusts the rim of the pool like thick frost, gleaming with an oily iridescent sheen under the dim amber glow of your lantern.

nodes.brief: Because Calder guides your steps, you bypass the unstable cantilevered streets and slip safely through an old drainage flue.

exits.label: Follow the green-tiled conduit downward
Step through the quartz pillar forest
Climb toward the bright surface plaza

priv.why: Calder the glass-diver is with the reader and knows this place

nodes.title: The Diver's Conduit
nodes.page:
Calder weaves ahead through the ruined masonry with an easy, fluid grace, knowing precisely which cantilevered streets will hold weight and which will snap under a footfall. Following his wry lead, you drop away from the dangerous upper tiers and slip safely into a cool, shadowed drainage flue lined with smooth tiles. The air here smells faintly of ancient rain and dry moss, offering a welcome respite from the baking glare of the basin.

Several dark conduits branch outward from this sheltered junction into the lower ruins.

nodes.brief: Through a gallery of distorted portrait-mirrors, grotesque reflections of your tired face stretch into towering spectres.

exits.label: Press onward past the shifting mirrors
Turn back toward the upper viaducts

nodes.title: Gallery of Distorted Glass
nodes.page:
Portrait-mirrors line the long corridor, their warped and melted surfaces stretching your tired face into towering, grotesque spectres that follow your every move. The reflections ripple like water behind thick green glass, making your own silhouette look like a stranger drowning in quicksilver. Your ember-lamp casts long, twitching shadows that multiply endlessly in the polished panes, turning the empty gallery into a hall of distorted phantoms.

The passage splits ahead between a forward exit and a way back.

nodes.brief: On a ledge of iridescent mother-of-pearl glass, a flock of copper-winged desert birds takes flight and startles your pace.

exits.label: Advance along the pearl-scaled shelf

nodes.title: Mother-of-Pearl Ledge
nodes.page:
Iridescent mother-of-pearl glass paves the high ledge, shimmering with pastel shades of pink and sea-green under the washed-out sky. A sudden flurry of wings erupts from a crevice in the wall as a flock of copper-winged desert birds takes flight, startling your pace and sending tiny glass shards clattering into the abyss. You catch your breath against the rock face, watching the metallic birds spiral upward into the hazy distance.

A single path leads forward from the edge of the iridescent shelf.

nodes.brief: Approaching the outer boundary of the shard maze, you face a sheer wall of fused window-panes stretching toward the hazy sky.

exits.label: Scale the jagged seam in the glass wall

nodes.title: The Fused Wall
nodes.page:
Sheer walls of fused window-panes rise like an impassable cliff at the outer boundary of the shard maze, stretching endlessly toward the pale, hazy sky. Multicolored glass blocks have melted together into a smooth, towering barrier that catches the harsh midday glare and throws blinding reflections across the ground. Your boots scuff against the packed salt at the base of the monumental obstruction, searching for any foothold or seam in the ancient construction.

A narrow fissure offers a way up through the towering panes.

nodes.brief: At a junction of three glass-walled alleys, a dying signal-lamp casts long, weaving shadows that hide the correct trail.

exits.label: Take the leftmost glass corridor

nodes.title: The Threefold Junction
nodes.page: Three glass-walled alleys converge at a dark, silent junction where a dying signal-lamp casts long, weaving shadows across the smooth mosaic floor. The amber light flickers and stutters within its iron cage, threatening to plunge the crossing into complete darkness at any second. Each path looks identical in the dim, shifting illumination, hiding the true trail beneath overlapping trails of salt and blown sand.

nodes.brief: Climbing a spiralling ramp of translucent slag, you watch the vast salt flats spread out endlessly below your feet.

exits.label: Ascend higher toward the summit terrace
Step onto the glass-crater rim path
Approach the final ridge precipice
Turn back toward the smoky kilns

nodes.title: Ramp of Translucent Slag
nodes.page:
Translucent slag coils upward in a spiraling ramp that clings to the skeleton of a hollow tower. Below your boots, the vast white salt flats spread out endlessly, gleaming like a frozen ocean under the glare of the distant sun. Every step lifts you higher above the labyrinth, bringing the vast scale of the dried basin into sharp, lonely perspective.

Several arches and openings branch off from the winding climb.

nodes.brief: Crossing a high sky-bridge of ribbed crystal, you feel the structure hum ominously beneath the rising wind of the approaching storm.

exits.label: Step toward the gleaming glass-crater
Vault across the salvage barricade

nodes.title: The Ribbed Sky-Bridge
nodes.page:
Ribbed crystal spans the dizzying drop between two shattered towers, humming ominously beneath the rising wind of the approaching storm. The transparent span vibrates with every gust, letting you see the sheer, dizzying depth of the empty air straight through the floor beneath your soles. You grip your lamp tightly as the structure flexes, testing your nerve against the rising gale.

The bridge terminates at two distinct archways on the far side.

nodes.brief: Navigating a subterranean conduit of green glass tiles, you follow the cool draft that whispers of the open basin edge.

exits.label: Follow the refreshing draft outward
Descend into the deeper lateral branch

nodes.title: The Green Conduit
nodes.page:
Emerald tiles slick with subterranean condensation frame your hurried steps as you trace the subterranean conduit of green glass. A steady, cooling draft carries the distinct mineral tang of the open basin edge, whispering through the narrow passage. Every footfall echoes dully against the vitrified walls, urging you forward while your banked coal-lantern casts long, restless shadows ahead.

You can follow the draft toward a brighter glimmer of natural light, or duck into a narrower service branch that slopes sharply downward into shadow.

nodes.brief: Ducking beneath a sagging arch of lead and glass, you dodge a cascade of loose crystal beads tumbling from above.

exits.label: Sprint past the falling crystal cascade
Seek shelter beneath the reinforced lintel

nodes.title: The Falling Crystals
nodes.page:
Sharp shards and heavy crystal beads clatter against your leather pack as you duck beneath a sagging arch of lead and fused glass. A sudden cascade from above shatters into brilliant dust at your boots, warning you of the unstable masonry overhead. You shield your face with a gloved arm, keeping a firm grip on your precious ember-lamp while the air grows thick with fine, abrasive grit.

You can sprint past the cascading hazard toward the open gap ahead, or seek temporary shelter beneath a firmer stone lintel to the side.

nodes.brief: Weaving through a forest of hollow quartz pillars, you ignore the haunting musical notes your passage draws from the tubes.

exits.label: Push straight through the echoing grove
Veer toward the dark lateral cleft

nodes.title: The Singing Pillars
nodes.page:
Eerie, melodic hums vibrate through the soles of your boots as you weave swiftly through a forest of hollow quartz pillars. Each slender tube responds to your passing warmth with haunting musical notes that echo strangely in the dead city air, though you deliberately ignore the phantom choir. The ambient light here refracts in pale lavender beams, fracturing the gloom into a dozen shifting pathways.

You can press onward straight through the echoing grove, or veer toward a darker cleft between two massive pillars.

nodes.brief: Emerging onto a grand plaza of white salt and broken lenses, you ready your lamp against the gathering shadows of the mirror storm.

exits.label: Cross the open salt-flats directly

nodes.title: The White Plaza
nodes.page:
Blinding white salt crunches beneath your stride as you finally emerge onto a grand plaza strewn with ancient, broken lenses. The gathering shadows of the approaching mirror storm stretch long and dark across the glittering expanse, turning the landscape into a checkerboard of silver and dusk. You raise your hooded ember-lamp higher so its glow meets the growing chill of the squall.

You can march directly across the open salt-flats toward the looming silhouette of the observatory.

nodes.brief: Pausing on the final terrace of the Shard Cities, you spot the looming mass of Prism rising beyond the shimmering salt horizon.

exits.label: Press on

nodes.title: The Final Terrace
nodes.page:
Jagged horizons of fused glass stretch endlessly below as you pause on the final, wind-scoured terrace of the Shard Cities. Rising majestically beyond the shimmering salt plain, the monolithic mass of Prism looms like a mountain carved from a single block of dark crystal. The air hums with the static precursor of the storm, rattling the brass frame of your lamp and biting sharply at your cheeks.

You can leave the terrace behind to make your final push toward the observatory.

nodes.brief: Skirting the edge of a great glass-crater, you catch your breath as the first electric flashes of the mirror storm lick the southern sky.

exits.label: Press on

nodes.title: The Glass-Crater
nodes.page:
Faint electric arcs flicker across the southern sky, painting the vast rim of a great glass-crater in sharp, purple strokes. You skirt the perilous edge, catching your breath as the rising gale carries the sharp scent of ozone and crushed silica from the storm front. Your grip tightens instinctively on your coat, guarding the small coal-lantern from the sudden, violent gusts.

You can forge ahead along the rim toward the waiting gates.

nodes.brief: Vaulting over a low barricade of salvage crates, you leave the labyrinth of broken towers behind for the final approach to the observatory.

exits.label: Press on

nodes.title: The Salvage Barricade
nodes.page:
Vaulting cleanly over a low, rusted barricade of old salvage crates, you leave the confusing labyrinth of broken towers far behind. The terrain opens abruptly into a wide, glass-paved causeway that leads straight to the monolithic base of the observatory. Your boots ring sharply against the fused ground, keeping pace with the steady, reassuring warmth of the lamp at your belt.

You can advance rapidly across the open causeway toward the observatory.

nodes.brief: Standing at the precipice of the last glass ridge, you plunge your hand into your coat to feel the cold, reassuring weight of the Seedkey as the mirror storm breaks.

exits.label: Press on

nodes.title: The Glass Ridge
nodes.page:
Whipping winds tear at your collar as you stand at the precipice of the last razor-sharp glass ridge, watching the mirror storm break across the basin. Instinctively, your hand dives deep into your coat pocket to curl around the cold, reassuring weight of the Seedkey. It feels solid and enduring against your palm, a solitary anchor amidst the howling wilderness of salt and light.

You can descend the ridge to make your final approach.

nodes.brief: You attempt to slide down a steep chute of fused glass without a brake, shattering your ember-lamp and plunging yourself into darkness just as the patrol closes in.
nodes.title: The Glass Chute
nodes.page: Desperate to outrun the approaching patrol, you throw yourself onto a steep, polished chute of fused glass that drops sharply into the dark heart of the ruined city. Without a brake to slow your descent, you gather terrifying speed as the slick walls blur into a single blinding streak of white and amber. Your ember-lamp strikes a razor-sharp protruding joint with a sharp crack, shattering the glass chimney and dowsing your coals in an instant. Total darkness swallows you as you slide helplessly into the freezing abyss.

nodes.brief: Ignoring all caution, you sprint across an unstable bridge of singing glass that shatters completely beneath your boots, plunging you into a bottomless trench of sharp shards.
nodes.title: The Shuddering Span
nodes.page:
Careless haste proves fatal as you sprint across a frail bridge of singing glass that fractures completely beneath your boots. The melodic note snaps into a deafening shriek as the span disintegrates into a cloud of razor-edged dust. You tumble downward through the empty air, swallowed entirely by a bottomless trench of glittering shards.

The journey ends here in the silent heart of the old city.

nodes.brief: Arrival in The Mirror Storm: a wall of glass-dust storm and the dune-sea beyond it; the lamp, the Seedkey and the body are all tested. The reader enters with several ways forward.

exits.label: Follow the lamp-lit road
Cut across the common ground

exits.intent: Ask the way of a stranger
exits.label: Ask the way of a stranger
Take the old drovers' track

nodes.title: The Mirror Storm Breaks
nodes.page: A wall of singing glass-dust rears against the horizon, turning the pale sky the color of a bruised plum. You pull your thick wool scarf higher across your face as the gale-force wind flings fine crystal grit against your leather coat, testing every seam. Your banked ember-lamp glows a stubborn, warm orange in your gloved grip, and the cold ceramic Seedkey hums lightly against your ribs. The salt-crust beneath your boots shudders under the rising atmospheric pressure as you weigh your next steps into the blinding expanse of the storm.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Glass-Dust Wall: the storm wall rises; the reader decides how to protect the Seedkey (wrapped and slow, or quick and risky)

exits.intent: Wrap the Seedkey in cloth against the dust
exits.label: Wrap the Seedkey in cloth against the dust

exits.intent: Trust the pouch and run for it
exits.label: Trust the pouch and run for it

nodes.title: The Glass-Dust Wall
nodes.page:
Towering banks of razor-fine quartz and grey powder churn before you, a wall of the Mirror Storm that promises to strip paint from metal and flesh from bone. Your fingers brush the cold ceramic Seedkey in your pocket; one wrong method here will ruin the mission before you ever reach the heart of the Basin. Spare cloth waits in your pack to wrap the ceramic tight, though wrapping costs minutes the dunes will not give back. The leather pouch already holds it as it is, thin against the grit.

Glass grit skates across the Seedkey's cold face.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Heart of the Storm: the storm threatens to smash the ember-lamp; the reader shields it (and is burned by glass) or lets it go dark

exits.intent: Shield the lamp with your own body
exits.label: Shield the lamp with your own body

exits.intent: Let the storm take the lamp
exits.label: Let the storm take the lamp

nodes.title: Heart of the Storm
nodes.page: The storm reaches its roaring apex, screaming across the glass flats with enough force to shatter wood and strip skin, directly threatening to crush your ember-lamp into total darkness. If the coals go out here, the cold will claim your fingers before you ever reach the Vault, leaving the seed-hall locked forever. You can throw your own body around the brass chimney to take the brunt of the flying glass and heat, or you can let the storm take the lantern and trust your frozen feet to find the way through the blind dark.

nodes.brief: Leaving The Mirror Storm for Prism: close this part of the journey.

exits.label: Press forward toward the grand gates

nodes.title: Beyond the Storm
nodes.page: The howling gale of the mirror storm finally subsides behind you, leaving a vast, silent expanse of white earth stretching toward the distant horizon. Prism looms ahead like a jagged crown of glass and dark stone, its towers catching the pale desert light. You steady your breathing, adjust the cold ceramic key in your pouch, and prepare to cross the threshold into the heart of the dry basin.

nodes.brief: Beneath a sulfurous sky, you step onto the razor-crust dunes where the howling wind carries the first singing sting of powdered mirror.

exits.label: Follow the winding track deeper into the blinding drift
Climb the crest of the nearest crystalline dune to look for landmarks
Hunker down behind a jagged slab of green glass until the gust passes

nodes.title: Dunes of Razors
nodes.page: Beneath a sulfurous sky, you step onto the razor-crust dunes where the howling wind carries the first singing sting of powdered mirror. The grit scours your exposed skin, while the heavy ember-lamp swings like a pendulum against your thigh, keeping the dark at bay. You press your palm against the pocket holding the cold ceramic Seedkey to ensure it remains safe. The storm thickens ahead, wrapping the shifting landscape in a veil of gray haze.

nodes.brief: You crouch behind a shattered silt-obelisk as a squall of diamond grit scourges the barren flats, threatening to scour the skin from your bones.

exits.label: Dash toward a darker hollow between two tilted pillars
Crawl along the base of the monument toward a narrow defile
Slide down an unexpected depression in the unstable earth

nodes.title: Silt Obelisk Shelter
nodes.page: You crouch behind a shattered silt-obelisk as a squall of diamond grit scourges the barren flats, threatening to scour the skin from your bones. The ancient stone groans under the abrasive force, shedding fine powdery layers that mix with the howling air. Your lantern flickers low, fed by the banked coals inside, casting dancing shadows against the pitted pillar. Every breath tastes of dry salt and old iron as you wait for a break in the tearing gale.

nodes.brief: The ember-lamp flickers wildly in your grip as an oily yellow haze rolls across the jagged salt-flats, narrowing your world to a few glowing feet.

exits.label: Follow the faint depression where the salt crust dips away
Head toward a metallic hum vibrating through the heavy air
Step cautiously across a brittle shelf that sounds hollow

nodes.title: Oily Yellow Haze
nodes.page: The ember-lamp flickers wildly in your grip as an oily yellow haze rolls across the jagged salt-flats, narrowing your world to a few glowing feet. The air tastes thick with sulphur and ancient dust, muffling the roar of the distant storm into a low, continuous rumble. You feel the cold ceramic weight of the Seedkey pressing steadily against your chest, anchoring you against the disorientation. Every contour of the salt-crust beneath your boots looks unfamiliar and strange in this jaundiced light.

nodes.brief: You press your palm against the cold ceramic Seedkey while a low, vibrating hum rises from the glass-dust plain, warning of an impending squall.

exits.privWhy: the reader is bound by the Dune Sisters' well-oath, and is known for it
exits.label: Take the hidden seepage-track known to those bound by the well-oath
Plunge into the stinging alkali dust cloud relying purely on the lamp

nodes.title: Vibrating Plain
nodes.page: You press your palm against the cold ceramic Seedkey while a low, vibrating hum rises from the glass-dust plain, warning of an impending squall. The air grows heavy with static electricity, making the hairs on your arms stand upright inside your sleeves. Your ember-lamp throws a circle of orange light against the swirling gray fog encroaching from the east.

nodes.brief: An abandoned Salt Court toll-hut offers a cramped lee against the rising gale, though its iron latch is already jammed with hard-packed silica.

exits.label: Inspect the metal pack-frames of a nearby wind-stripped carcass

exits.privWhy: the reader believes the vault was looted and looks for the looters' trail
exits.label: Search for sheltered silt pockets where recent boot-prints might linger

nodes.title: Salt Court Toll-Hut
nodes.page: An abandoned Salt Court toll-hut offers a cramped lee against the rising gale, though its iron latch is already jammed with hard-packed silica. The wooden beams groan and splinter under the ceaseless onslaught of wind-driven sand, smelling faintly of old brine and dried leather. Inside the small shadow cast by the roofless ruin, you catch your breath and check the fuel in your lantern. The storm outside screams louder, demanding that you either force the rusted door or press back into the open dunes.

nodes.brief: You stumble upon a mummified surveyor half-buried in drift-glass, his brass sighting-rod still pointing toward the impenetrable wall of the approaching storm.

exits.label: Search the surveyor for any surviving maps or dry rations
Follow the precise line where the brass sighting-rod points

nodes.title: The Surveyors Cairn
nodes.page: You stumble upon a mummified surveyor half-buried in drift-glass, his brass sighting-rod still pointing toward the impenetrable wall of the approaching storm. His stiff leather coat is bleached white by decades of sun and salt, yet his scientific instruments remain curiously untouched by rust. The ember-lamp casts a warm, flickering glow across the dead man's weathered knuckles. You pull your collar tighter against the bitter draft whistling through the skeletal remains.

nodes.brief: A rusted wind-sieve clatters against a boulder of fused quartz, offering a dubious shelter where you must mend your frayed canvas gaiters.

exits.label: Squeeze through a narrow fissure between two canted slabs
Scramble up a towering ridge of crushed crystal into the wind

nodes.title: Rusted Wind-Sieve
nodes.page: A rusted wind-sieve clatters against a boulder of fused quartz, offering a dubious shelter where you must mend your frayed canvas gaiters. The metal mesh hums a monotonous, high-pitched note in the howling gale while fine dust sifts down like flour onto your shoulders. Your fingers are stiff and cold, making it difficult to knot the waxed twine around your boots. Every few seconds, a heavier gust rattles the frame, threatening to tear your makeshift sanctuary away into the storm.

nodes.brief: You navigate a treacherous labyrinth of hollow salt-tubes that whistle like dying birds under the immense pressure of the dry gale.

exits.label: Squeeze through a narrow fissure leading toward the dead-silent basin
Examine a discarded shark-skin ledger caught in a stone cairn
Climb a steep drift of crushed crystal to survey the storm front

nodes.title: Salt-Tube Labyrinth
nodes.page: You navigate a treacherous labyrinth of hollow salt-tubes that whistle like dying birds under the immense pressure of the dry gale. Each tubular conduit stands like a pipe organ organ-cast from brine and minerals, vibrating under your gloved touch. The air inside the maze is remarkably still, though heavy with the scent of stagnant moisture deep below. You keep your lamp held high, watching for sudden fissures in the crystalline floor.

nodes.brief: A lone scavenger named Vane squats over a small grease-fire in a dry cistern, offering a cup of brackish tea in exchange for news of the western rim.

exits.label: Inspect the salt-skin ledger resting near the scavenger's boots
Watch a frantic salt-fox dart past toward the dark horizon

nodes.title: The Cistern Fire
nodes.page: A lone scavenger named Vane squats over a small grease-fire in a dry cistern, offering a cup of brackish tea in exchange for news of the western rim. The acrid smoke curls away into the howling void above, barely visible against the churning gray sky. Vane's eyes gleam with sharp amusement behind a crust of dried salt as he gestures toward a crate seat by the flames. The warmth of the fire is an intense, almost painful luxury against your frozen joints.

nodes.brief: You dodge a cascade of sliding glass shingles that tumble down a dune face, uncovering a hidden trench carved by ancient water-seekers.

exits.label: Climb upward to face the gale

nodes.title: Shingles on the Slope
nodes.page:
Shards of green and amber glass cascade down the steep dune face like a breaking wave, forcing you to leap sideways into a shallow depression. Your boots crunch against buried ceramic tiles as you land in a hidden trench, carved deep into the salt-crust by ancient water-seekers long before the Basin dried. The howling gale diminishes here to a dry, organ-like drone against the stone ribs. You pause to scrape accumulated glass-dust from your lamp-gasket, watching the tiny red glow of your coals bat.

The trench deepens ahead into darkness, while a crumbling stair of fused brick winds upward toward the blinding crest of the dune.

nodes.brief: A tethered signaling mirror hums loudly in the wind-shear overhead, casting erratic blinding flashes across the white-hot dunes around you.

exits.label: Follow the rusted iron signpost toward Prism
Slide down the steep incline of loose pearl-sand

nodes.title: Hum of the Signal
nodes.page: Overhead a tethered signaling mirror clatters in the wind-shear and throws erratic blinding flashes across the white-hot dunes around you. The metallic shriek of its straining guy-wires vibrates directly through your boots into the salt floor. You grip your ember-lamp tightly as a blinding arc of reflected sunlight sweeps across your chest, momentarily erasing the shadows of the wasteland. The air tastes of scorched copper and fine alkali dust, stinging your eyes and throat.

nodes.brief: You cross a brittle shelf of crust that gives way underfoot, dropping you into a shallow trench lined with razor-sharp shards of green bottle-glass.

exits.label: Crawl through the low stone conduit
Inspect the abandoned kelp-drying rack
Face the sudden thermal dust updraft

nodes.title: Shards of the Shelf
nodes.page: A brittle shelf of crust gives way beneath your boots, dropping you sharply into a narrow trench lined with razor-sharp shards of green bottle-glass. You catch your weight against the earthen walls, feeling the cold, heavy cylinder of the Seedkey press safe and solid against your ribs. The storm above shrieks like a trapped animal against the rim of the cutting. You must find a way onward before the loose debris shifts further and seals the trench completely.

nodes.brief: Bound by your well-oath to the Dune Sisters, you easily identify the safe subterranean seepage-tracks that bypass the howling surface gale entirely.

exits.label: Inspect the abandoned kelp-drying rack
Face the sudden thermal dust updraft

priv.why: the reader is bound by the Dune Sisters' well-oath, and is known for it

nodes.title: Veins of the Sisters
nodes.page: Bound by your well-oath to the Dune Sisters, your tongue recognizes the distinct mineral tang of sweet moisture leaking through the deep sub-strata. You easily identify the safe subterranean seepage-tracks that bypass the howling surface gale entirely, following the cool damp current in the dark. Salt-encrusted walls carry the slow pulse of ancient wells drilled by hands that knew the deep desert. You move with quiet confidence, your banked lamp casting a warm circle of orange light upon the damp floor.

nodes.brief: A cloud of stinging alkali dust blinds you momentarily, forcing you to rely entirely on the steady warmth of your banked coal-lantern to keep your footing.

exits.label: Push forward into the thermal updraft

nodes.title: Blinded by Alkali
nodes.page: A thick cloud of stinging alkali dust blinds you momentarily, forcing you to rely entirely on the steady warmth of your banked coal-lantern to keep your footing. You press a salt-dampened rag across your mouth while the abrasive gale scours your woolen cloak. Every breath feels like swallowing hot needles, yet the familiar pulse of heat from your lamp reminds you of the fires of Candlemere. You wait blindly for the white-out to thin, listening to the shifting roar of the dunes around you.

nodes.brief: You discover a fresh mule-carcass stripped clean by the scouring wind, its metal pack-frames offering sturdy stakes to anchor your storm-cloak.

exits.label: Seek shelter beneath the customs gate arch
Cross the cracking expanse of purple mud

nodes.title: Stakes in the Basin
nodes.page: You discover a fresh mule-carcass stripped clean by the scouring wind, its metal pack-frames offering sturdy stakes to anchor your storm-cloak against the rising gale. The sun beats down like a brass hammer upon the bleached ribs and the frozen salt beneath them. You drive your walking staff deep into the crust to secure your footing, pausing to catch your breath in the thin, dry air. The horizon shimmers with deceptive blue lakes that vanish the moment you blink.

nodes.title: Footprints in the Pocket
nodes.page: Believing the vault was looted, you spot fresh boot-prints in a pocket of sheltered silt that lead directly toward a hidden crevice in the dunes. The tracks are sharp-edged and purposeful, cutting across the wind-rippled sand with disturbing recentness. You check the cold ceramic weight of the Seedkey in your pocket, your thumb tracing its smooth, unyielding angles. Someone else is moving through this blinding white maze with a destination in mind.

nodes.brief: An elderly Glasswright scout named Jael rests inside a hollow basalt rib, signaling with frantic amber flashes to warn you of a sudden micro-burst ahead.
