nodes.title: Basalt Ribs and Amber
nodes.page: An elderly Glasswright scout named Jael rests inside a hollow basalt rib, signaling with frantic amber flashes to warn you of a sudden micro-burst ahead. The old scout's mirrors click with rhythmic precision, casting swift yellow codes across the dark stone. You drop low against the ground as a sudden wall of superheated air screams overhead, tearing at the loose salt crust. Jael gestures urgently toward a protected trench leading deeper into the Basin.

nodes.brief: You squeeze through a narrow fissure between two canted slabs of sea-wall, emerging into a dead-silent basin choked with glittering dust-drifts.

exits.label: Cross the cracking expanse of purple mud
Investigate the distant flashing green signal
Scale the wall of fused brickwork

nodes.title: Silent Basin Fissure
nodes.page: You squeeze through a narrow fissure between two canted slabs of sea-wall, emerging into a dead-silent basin choked with glittering dust-drifts. The sudden absence of the roaring wind is almost deafening, leaving only the crunch of your own boots on the frozen brine. Ghostly towers of fused glass rise out of the haze like frozen lightning, casting long violet shadows across the flat pan. You lift your lamp to pierce the gloom, watching the red coals pulse in the sudden quiet.

nodes.brief: A discarded ledger bound in salted shark-skin flutters against a cairn, detailing the exorbitant interest rates levied by the southern toll-lords.

exits.label: Scale the wall of fused brickwork
Squeeze past the porous basalt chimney

nodes.title: Shark-Skin Ledger
nodes.page: A discarded ledger bound in salted shark-skin flutters against a cairn, detailing the exorbitant interest rates levied by the southern toll-lords. Its salt-stiffened pages crack open in the breeze, revealing neat columns of figures mortgaging future water rights for handfuls of dry coin. You step past the marker, shaking your head at the desperate bargains men strike when the wells run low. The road ahead drops into a deeper depression where the air smells faintly of sulfur and old mud.

nodes.brief: You scramble up a towering ridge of crushed crystal, your breath catching as the full terrifying expanse of the Mirror Storm wall comes into view.

exits.label: Follow the green signal beam toward the north
Climb the stranded brickwork of the ancient quay
Inspect the dry clay jar in the hollow

nodes.title: Ridge of Crushed Crystal
nodes.page: Jagged fragments of translucent quartz groan under your boots as you scramble up the towering crystalline ridge, your breath catching in your dry throat. Below you, the full, terrifying expanse of the Mirror Storm wall rolls across the basin like an advancing avalanche of silver grit and roaring wind. Your banked coal-lantern rattles against your ribs, and the cold ceramic shape of the Seedkey presses firmly through your pocket, reminding you of the long miles still remaining before Prism.

nodes.brief: A frantic salt-fox darts past your boots, fleeing the approaching atmospheric front that turns the horizon into a boiling soup of silver.

exits.label: Head toward the old harbor wall
Skirt the steaming volcanic chimney
Follow the screaming glass-gulls into the murk

nodes.title: Flight of the Salt-Fox
nodes.page: A frantic, pale-furred salt-fox darts wildly past your boots, fleeing the atmospheric front that turns the distant horizon into a boiling soup of silver. The howling wind kicks up sharp clouds of silica that bite at your exposed skin, testing your endurance as the temperature drops abruptly. You pull your thick woolen scarf tighter over your nose and press onward, holding tight to your sputtering ember-lamp. Ahead of you, several faint paths diverge through the drifting dust-heaps, each offering a different way deeper into the storm-choked basin.

nodes.brief: You pause to scrape accumulated glass-dust from your lamp-gasket, watching the tiny red glow of your coals battle against the encroaching gloom.

exits.label: Push past the venting basalt chimney
Press onward beneath the wheeling gulls

nodes.title: Cleaning the Lamp Gasket
nodes.page: You pause behind a shattered pillar to scrape the accumulated glass-dust from your lamp gasket, watching the tiny red glow of your banked coals battle against the encroaching gloom. The wind shrieks through the skeletal ruins around you like a chorus of hollow voices, and the weight of the cold Seedkey in your tunic feels heavier with every passing hour. Every breath tastes of alkaline dust and old salt, reminding you that the monsoon's arrival draws closer by the day.

nodes.brief: A rusted iron signpost points toward the sunken observatory of Prism, its lettering bitten away by decades of abrasive wind-scour.

exits.label: Wade through the knee-deep silica drift
Investigate the skeletal surveyor tripod in the mist

nodes.title: The Sunken Observatory Pointer
nodes.page: A rusted iron signpost leans at a sharp angle, pointing toward the sunken observatory of Prism while its lettering has been bitten away by decades of abrasive wind-scour. Fine grains of white crystal whisper across the metal post, creating a constant, eerie hum in the dead air. You adjust the heavy strap of your lantern and check the seal on your water flask, knowing that every league brings you closer to the heart of the dried sea.

nodes.brief: You slide down a steep incline of loose pearl-sand, landing amidst the shattered ribs of an ancient cargo-skiff half-swallowed by the dunes.

exits.label: Follow the screaming gulls through the yellow murk
Head toward the skeletal surveyor tripod

nodes.title: Ribs of the Cargo-Skiff
nodes.page: You slide down a steep incline of loose pearl-sand, landing amidst the shattered wooden ribs of an ancient cargo-skiff half-swallowed by the dunes. The salt-bleached timbers offer a brief windbreak against the howling gale, allowing you to catch your breath and check the steady glow of your lamp. Tiny eddies of dust swirl around your ankles like quicksilver as you survey the murky expanse ahead.

nodes.brief: A low-slung stone conduit hums with trapped air, providing a cramped crawlspace where the howling gale is reduced to a dull, hungry roar.

Turn back toward the inner basin

nodes.title: The Stone Conduit Crawl
nodes.page: A low-slung stone conduit hums with trapped air, providing a cramped crawlspace where the howling gale is reduced to a dull, hungry roar. You crouch low on hands and knees, dragging your lamp carefully behind you as the gritty floor abrades your palms. The air inside smells of ancient lime and damp earth, offering a strange, sheltered respite from the storm outside.

nodes.brief: You encounter a drying rack hung with desiccated kelp ribbons, marking the abandoned campsite of a reckless glass-diver who vanished into the haze.

exits.label: Wade through the sparkling silica drift

nodes.title: Abandoned Diver Camp
nodes.page: You encounter a drying rack hung with desiccated kelp ribbons, marking the abandoned campsite of a reckless glass-diver who vanished into the haze. A few rusted tools and an empty salt-kettle lie half-buried in the shifting dust nearby, telling a silent tale of haste and desperation. You secure your lamp against a sudden gust of wind and weigh your next steps carefully in the gathering gloom.

nodes.brief: A sudden thermal updraft lifts a cloud of incandescent dust around your head, searing your throat and testing the resilience of your wool scarf.

exits.label: Shelter behind the green bottle-glass block
March toward the distant basalt milestone

nodes.title: Thermal Updraft and Dust
nodes.page: A sudden thermal updraft lifts a cloud of incandescent dust around your head, searing your throat and testing the resilience of your wool scarf. You shield your eyes with a gauntleted hand, keeping your body hunched low against the blistering heat and swirling grit. The sudden surge of warm air carries the distant, metallic tang of the central basin, urging you forward despite the burning fatigue in your legs.

nodes.brief: You find shelter beneath the leaning arch of an old customs gate, where the carved insignia of the Salt Court has been defaced with fresh tar.

exits.label: Push onward to the final shale rise
Turn back toward the broken shelf

nodes.title: Defaced Customs Gate
nodes.page: You find shelter beneath the leaning arch of an old customs gate, where the carved insignia of the Salt Court has been defaced with fresh black tar. Chunks of fused glass crunch under your boots as you shake the accumulated dust from your cloak and tend to the dying embers of your lantern. The atmosphere hangs heavy with tension, reminding you of the toll-lords' watchful eyes across the basin.

nodes.brief: A nomadic well-tender named Oris calls out from a canvas tent pegged down with millstones, offering a dry rag to wipe your encrusted goggles.

exits.label: Climb toward the final shale rise

nodes.title: The Nomad Well-Tender
nodes.page: A nomadic well-tender named Oris calls out from a canvas tent pegged down with millstones, offering a dry rag to wipe your encrusted goggles. The scent of roasted chicory drifts from a small tin pot resting near the tent flap, cutting sharply through the bitter taste of salt in the air. You pause for a brief moment of human warmth before facing the open expanses of the storm-swept basin once more.

nodes.brief: You cross a flat expanse of purple vitrified mud that cracks like thin ice under your boots, echoing sharply across the empty basin.

exits.label: Climb toward the shale rise
Leap across the jagged crevasse
Hide behind the warehouse walls

nodes.title: The Vitrified Pave
nodes.page:
Shards of purple vitrified mud splinter like thin ice beneath your boots, sending sharp, echoing cracks across the empty basin. You shield your flickering lamp against the drafting wind while navigating the brittle crust, keeping a firm grip on the cold Seedkey tucked inside your pack. The air smells intensely of sulfur and baked alkali, warning you that the deep weather is shifting toward the ridges.

A choice lies before you as the ground shudders underfoot: you can press directly toward the rising shale slopes, skirt a gaping fissure that cuts across your path, or dive into the shelter of a collapsed warehouse foundation to escape a sudden local vortex.

nodes.brief: A discarded signal-mirror catches the weak sun and shoots a blinding green beam across the fog, signaling that the upper ridge is impassable.

exits.label: Leap toward the storm line
Turn back along the salt tubes

nodes.title: The Green Signal Beam
nodes.page: A discarded signal-mirror catches the weak, jaundiced sun and shoots a blinding green beam across the rolling fog, signaling clearly that the upper ridge remains completely impassable. You pause beside a jagged pillar of salt and hitch the straps of your weather-cape as the beam pulses twice more in warning. The amber lamp in your hand throws a steady, warm circle against the creeping gloom.

nodes.brief: You scale a wall of fused brickwork that once formed the quay of a vanished harbor, now stranded miles inland amidst roaring dunes.

exits.label: Advance toward the shale rise
Duck behind the warehouse ruins
Turn back down the slope

nodes.title: The Fused Harbor Quay
nodes.page:
You scale a steep wall of fused brickwork that once formed the bustling quay of a vanished harbor, now stranded miles inland amidst roaring dunes. Below you, the vast dried sea stretches like an endless sheet of cracked white bone, while above, the storm sky deepens to a bruising violet. Your fingers ache from the climb, yet the banked coals of your lamp remain a comforting weight against your chest.

Ahead lies a choice between pressing forward toward the vibrating shale rise, ducking behind a ruined warehouse foundation, or retreating down the slope to safer ground.

nodes.brief: A small clay water-jar lies unbroken in a hollow, its precious contents turned to bitter brine by the creeping alkali dust.

exits.label: Take cover behind the warehouse foundation
Approach the stranded traveler on the outcrop

nodes.title: The Brine-Filled Jar
nodes.page:
A small clay water-jar lies completely unbroken in a shallow hollow, but when you lift it, its precious contents turn out to be bitter brine ruined by creeping alkali dust. You set the vessel back down into the salt-crust and check the seal on your own meager rations, ensuring the Seedkey stays dry against your ribs. The rising wind howls through the skeletal remains of old glass-foundries all around you.

You can crouch behind a ruined warehouse foundation to ride out a swirling gust of fine dust, or press forward to aid a distressed traveler calling out from a rocky outcrop.

nodes.brief: You squeeze past a natural chimney of porous basalt that belches hot, sulphur-scented air from the deep crust beneath the old sea-bed.

exits.label: Leap across the bottomless chasm
Reach out to the trembling diver
Secure your lamp in the crevice

nodes.title: The Basalt Chimney
nodes.page:
You squeeze past a natural chimney of porous basalt that belches hot, sulphur-scented air straight from the deep crust beneath the old sea-bed. The heat warms your numb fingers for a brief moment before the howling gale disperses the steam into the yellow haze. Your lamp flickers violently in the draft, threatening to go out unless you shield the glass globe with your sleeve.

Ahead, you must choose whether to face a perilous leap across a bottomless chasm, check on a trembling glass-diver clinging to a nearby rock, or secure your gear firmly in a rocky crevice.

nodes.brief: A frantic flock of glass-gulls wheels through the yellow murk above, screaming against the wind as the great storm wall advances.

exits.label: Wedge your lamp into the crevice
Face the towering wall of cloud

nodes.title: The Wheeling Glass-Gulls
nodes.page:
A frantic flock of glass-gulls wheels through the yellow murk above, screaming against the rising gale as the great storm wall advances inexorably across the basin. Their crystalline wings chime like tiny bells in the wind, creating a haunting counterpoint to the deep, grinding roar of the desert. You pull your goggles tighter over your eyes and grip the handle of your amber lamp.

You must quickly decide whether to wedge your lamp into a safe crevice to free your hands or press forward into the towering wall of violet cloud.

nodes.brief: You wade through a drift of sparkling silica that reaches your knees, your muscles burning as you fight for every yard toward the ridge.

exits.label: Crouch behind the warehouse foundation
Assist the distressed glass-diver
Secure your lamp in a rocky crevice

nodes.title: The Silica Drift
nodes.page:
You wade through a deep drift of sparkling silica that reaches your knees, your muscles burning fiercely as you fight for every yard toward the distant ridge. Sand scrapes your leather boots at every step, and the Seedkey sits like an anvil against your chest. Every breath draws in the sharp, dry taste of ancient salt and pulverized glass.

From here, you can crouch behind a ruined warehouse foundation to catch your breath, check on a distressed glass-diver clinging to a rock, or pause to secure your lamp in a sheltered crevice.

nodes.brief: A rusted surveyor's tripod stands like a skeletal gibbet in the mist, draped with the tattered remnants of an oilskin weather-cape.

exits.label: Push forward into the cloud wall
Press against the ancient quay wall
Make final preparations in the wind
Turn back to the toll-hut

nodes.title: The Surveyor's Gibbet
nodes.page:
A rusted surveyor's tripod stands like a skeletal gibbet in the mist, draped with the tattered remnants of an oilskin weather-cape that flaps frantically in the rising wind. You step past its rusted legs, keeping your shoulder turned against the stinging onslaught of wind-blown grit. The amber glow of your lantern casts long, distorted shadows across the salt-pavement.

You face a critical juncture: push ahead into the towering wall of violet cloud, press your spine against an ancient ice-cold quay wall, make final preparations against the fierce gusts, or retreat to the cramped shelter of an abandoned toll-hut.

nodes.brief: Recognized by a patrolling Salt Court enforcer due to your unpaid toll-debt, you slip down a smuggler's drainage pipe while he fires a warning flare.

exits.label: Press against the cold quay wall
Make final preparations in the gale

nodes.title: The Smuggler's Drainage Pipe
nodes.page:
Recognized instantly by a patrolling Salt Court enforcer due to your outstanding toll-debt, you dive headfirst into a narrow smuggler's drainage pipe while a warning flare hisses overhead. The rusted metal scrapes your shoulders as you scramble through the dark conduit, coughing from the accumulation of ancient dust. Outside, the muffled shouts of the enforcer fade beneath the growing roar of the approaching storm.

Emerging from the pipe's other end, you can press your spine against the ice-cold stone of an ancient quay wall or make your final preparations before the gale hits.

nodes.brief: You shelter behind a massive block of green bottle-glass while a whirl of wind-driven grit scours the painted markings from your leather satchel.

exits.label: Press against the ancient quay wall
Make final preparations in the wind

nodes.title: The Bottle-Glass Shelter
nodes.page:
You shelter behind a massive block of green bottle-glass while a furious whirl of wind-driven grit scours the painted markings entirely from your leather satchel. The thick glass hums under the pressure of the gale, vibrating with a deep, resonant tone that matches the beating of your own heart. You use the brief lull to check the Seedkey, confirming it remains safely tucked in its pouch.

As the whistling wind momentarily subsides, you can press your spine against the ice-cold stone of an ancient quay wall or brace yourself for the final preparations before the storm breaks.

nodes.brief: A solitary milestone carved from basalt reads twenty leagues to Prism, its surface pitted and worn smooth by centuries of abrasive sand-blasting.

exits.label: Press deeper into the salt wastes
Turn back toward the rusted wind-sieve

nodes.title: The Basalt Milestone
nodes.page:
Basalt carved from the ancient seabed stands pitted and worn smooth by centuries of abrasive sand-blasting, marking twenty leagues remaining to Prism. The freezing ceramic Seedkey rests heavy against your ribs while the banked coals of your lamp throw a dull, stubborn glow against the drifting grit. Every breath tastes of dry alkaline dust, and the low, grinding hum of the distant mirror storm vibrates through the soles of your boots.

To the north, the salt-track vanishes into a swirling yellow haze, leaving you to weigh whether your failing provisions can endure another push forward or if you must retrace your steps before the weather breaks entirely.

nodes.brief: You reach the base of the final shale rise, where the air tastes of sharp ozone and the ground vibrates with the approaching tempest.

exits.label: Scramble down toward the storm wall
Seek shelter before the gale strikes

nodes.title: The Final Shale Rise
nodes.page:
Sharp ozone stings your throat at the base of the final shale rise, where the ground itself vibrates with the ominous approach of the tempest. Shards of fused quartz rattle against your shins as the wind gathers force, howling through the hollow arches of nearby glass ruins. Your thumb checks the twine on your waterproof pouch, reassuring yourself that the cold ceramic key remains safe from the abrasive air.

Above you, the sky darkens to a bruised violet, and every instinct warns that staying exposed on this elevated ridge invites disaster.

nodes.brief: A jagged crevasse blocks your direct approach to the storm-line, forcing a perilous leap across a bottomless chasm of singing quartz.

exits.label: Leap across the singing quartz chasm

nodes.title: The Singing Quartz Chasm
nodes.page:
Jagged fissures block your direct approach to the storm-line, presenting a perilous leap across a bottomless chasm where the exposed quartz walls hum a continuous, high-pitched note in the rising wind. Fine dust stings your exposed cheeks like thrown needles, and the banked coals in your tin lantern flicker frantically against the draft. Hesitating means being buried in the shifting drift, yet the chasm demands a leap of blind faith.

You gather your muscles, eyeing the narrow ledge on the far side while the air grows colder by the second.

nodes.brief: You crouch behind a ruined warehouse foundation as a tornado of fine glass-dust spins wildly across the salt-pan fifty paces ahead.

exits.label: Dash past the swirling glass-dust vortex
Wait out the gale in the ruins

nodes.title: The Bottle-Glass Ruins
nodes.page:
Ruined warehouse foundations offer a brief, desperate lee as a spinning tornado of fine glass-dust whirls wildly across the salt-pan fifty paces ahead. You crouch low behind a block of green bottle-glass, listening to the shrill whistle of air shearing over jagged shards. The weight of the ceramic Seedkey in your pocket grounds your racing thoughts while the amber lantern at your belt sputters in the eddying draft.

The spinning vortex shifts sideways, threatening to cut off your only viable path through the ruins.

nodes.brief: A trembling glass-diver named Maren clings to a rock outcrop, gasping for breath and warning you that the storm wall is shear and merciless.

exits.label: Push forward into the blinding gale
Pause to reconsider your desperate route

nodes.title: The Glass-Diver's Warning
nodes.page:
Maren clings desperately to a weathered rock outcrop, gasping for breath while warning you that the approaching storm wall is sheer, merciless, and entirely blind. The trembling glass-diver points toward the howling wall of white grit, shouting over the rising roar of the basin. Your grip tightens on the tin handle of your coal-lantern as flying crystals pepper your leather coat with a steady, drum-like rattle.

Deciding whether to heed the warning or force your way onward against the diver's advice leaves no room for error.

nodes.brief: You wedge your lamp securely into a crevice to free both hands, checking the twine on your waterproof pouch containing the cold Seedkey.

exits.label: Brace for the impending tempest front
Plunge headfirst into the screaming gale

nodes.title: Securing the Ember-Lamp
nodes.page:
Crevice stone bites into your palms as you wedge your lamp securely into a narrow rock split, freeing both hands to check the frayed twine on your waterproof pouch. Inside rests the cold ceramic Seedkey, untouched by the biting dust that cakes your eyelashes and eyebrows. The surrounding air hums with a dangerous, electric tension as the great storm front narrows the distance between the horizon and your hiding spot.

Every second spent adjusting your gear steals precious time from your race against the monsoon.

nodes.brief: A towering wall of violet cloud and spinning crystal fragments obliterates the horizon, blotting out the midday sun with terrifying speed.

exits.label: Grip the key and run blindly
Hunker down against the flying crystals
Charge directly into the screaming gale

nodes.title: The Obsidian Horizon
nodes.page:
Violet cloud towers mingle with spinning crystal fragments to obliterate the horizon, blotting out the midday sun with terrifying, unnatural speed. The vast plain of the Salt Basin turns the color of bruised iron under the shadow of the oncoming front. You clutch your amber lamp tighter to your chest, feeling the glass chimney grow warm as the wind presses against your wool cloak with the weight of a physical wall.

The blinding glare of the storm's edge leaves you no sanctuary, only a stark choice of direction.

nodes.brief: You press your spine against the ice-cold stone of an ancient quay wall, listening to the million-toned roar of the approaching glass-dust front.

exits.label: Bravely face the biting micro-crystals
Leap into the screaming gale ahead

nodes.title: The Ancient Quay Wall
nodes.page:
Ice-cold stone presses against your spine as you flatten yourself against the remnants of an ancient quay wall, listening to the million-toned roar of the approaching glass-dust front. The ground trembles rhythmically under your boots, matching the frantic beat of your own heart. Fine particles hiss against your leather satchel, chewing away at the old travel marks while your banked lantern glows like a solitary red eye in the gloom.

The roaring wall draws closer with every breath, demanding an immediate movement before the air becomes unbreathable.

nodes.brief: A fierce gust nearly rips the amber lamp from your numb fingers as you make your final preparations before the storm breaks over you.

exits.label: Plunge forward into the screaming gale

nodes.title: The Final Preparations
nodes.page:
Numb fingers struggle to secure your coat against a fierce gust that nearly rips the amber lamp from your grasp as you make your final preparations. The air is thick with the metallic tang of crushed quartz and ancient salt, signaling that the barrier between the open basin and the storm is vanishing. You check the cold ceramic key one last time, feeling its smooth, dead weight reassure you against the chaos.

The final barrier of the tempest looms directly before you, waiting to test every ounce of your endurance.

nodes.brief: The tempestuous wall of the Mirror Storm towers above the dunes, casting a pale, blinding glare across your salt-caked face as you stand exposed.

exits.label: Press on into the roaring storm

nodes.title: The Mirror Storm Wall
nodes.page:
Towering high above the bleached dunes, the tempestuous wall of the Mirror Storm casts a pale, blinding glare across your salt-caked face as you stand entirely exposed. Swirling sheets of microscopic glass hiss through the air, creating a shimmering curtain that swallows the landscape whole. Your lamp struggles against the vacuum of the drafting winds, throwing long, jittery shadows against your boots.

There is no cover left to claim, nor any path back to the safety of the lamp-towns; only the wall remains.

nodes.brief: You grip the cold ceramic Seedkey in your pocket, weighing the desperate need for speed against the certainty of abrasion in the howling gale.

exits.label: Press onward through the biting gale

nodes.title: The Weight of Speed
nodes.page:
Gales tear across the white wastes and drive abrasive needles of glass-dust into your exposed cheeks while you grip the cold ceramic Seedkey in your pocket. Every second spent standing in this open drift tests the seams of your coat and the endurance of your burning lungs. Landmarks fade as the white fills in; the open dunes keep their speed and their grit.

You hitch the Seedkey deeper into the pouch and lean into the next gust.

nodes.brief: The air grows thick with biting micro-crystals as the great storm front descends, forcing your immediate decision on how to shield your precious burden.

exits.label: Press on into the screaming tempest

nodes.title: Descending Micro-Crystals
nodes.page:
Sharp micro-crystals fill the freezing air, hissing against your woolen layers as the great storm front descends with sudden, suffocating fury. Your fingers grow numb around the handle of your amber lamp, fighting to keep the precious flame banked against the howling void. The blinding squall leaves no room for hesitation, demanding an immediate choice on how best to shield your vital burden from the scouring drift.

Every gust threatens to extinguish your only warmth and scour the skin from your face.

nodes.brief: With the screaming gale at your back and the wall of glass-dust looming inches away, you steel your nerves for the final blinding plunge.

exits.label: Press on through the wall of dust

nodes.title: The Blinding Plunge
nodes.page:
Screaming winds tear at your collar while the towering wall of glass-dust looms inches away, casting an eerie, pale luminescence across the frosted dunes. You steel your frayed nerves for the final blinding plunge into the roaring white, keeping one hand clamped firmly over the pocket where your cold ceramic key rests. The salt-crust beneath your boots shudders under the immense atmospheric pressure of the approaching storm front.

There is no turning back now as the tempest swallows the horizon whole.

nodes.brief: Among towering dunes of razor-fine quartz, you crawl through a buried culvert while biting shards pelt your woolen cloak, risking the loss of the Seedkey.

exits.label: Crawl deeper toward the open trench
Slide sideways into a rusted vent
Rise cautiously onto the upper ridge

nodes.title: The Buried Culvert
nodes.page:
Razor-fine quartz dunes tower overhead, their crests hissing as high winds drive a relentless stream of glass-dust across the barren wastes. You drop low, crawling on hands and knees through a buried iron culvert while sharp shards pelt your woolen cloak with the force of thrown gravel. The confined space offers temporary relief from the worst of the gale, but the shifting grit threatens to wedge against your pockets and dislodge the Seedkey into the dark silt.

Every inch forward requires deliberate effort against the choking drift.

nodes.brief: In a bowl of singing crystal debris, you crouch behind a shattered pillar while the abrasive white gale howls, risking the flame within your ember-lamp.

exits.privWhy: the reader believes the vault was looted and looks for the looters' trail
exits.label: Inspect the fresh tracks leading toward the flute
Dash across the ribbed flat of blistered alkali
Check your oil flask within the sunken barge

nodes.title: The Singing Crystal Bowl
nodes.page:
Jagged fragments of singing crystal surround you in a natural bowl, vibrating with a high, mournful note whenever the abrasive white gale sweeps across their razor-sharp edges. You crouch low behind a shattered porphyry pillar, shielding your flickering ember-lamp with your body as the wind tries to tear the iron door from its latch. The dancing flame casts long, wavering shadows against the glittering debris, threatening to sputter out entirely if the scouring draft finds a gap in your guard.

The surrounding debris hums a chaotic dirge to the storm.

nodes.brief: Beneath a crescent ridge of fused sand, an old salt-miner named Barnaby offers shelter for a pinch of tobacco, but his cough heralds lung-rot.

exits.label: Step inside the hollowed optic dome
Venture onto the violet glass shingles
Take refuge within the collapsed kelp-cake warehouse

nodes.title: The Salt-Miner's Arch
nodes.page:
Crescent ridges of fused sand tower above a hollow archway where an old salt-miner named Barnaby coughs into a stained rag, offering shelter from the gale for a pinch of tobacco. His breath rattles in his chest with the ominous wet wheeze of lung-rot, a common curse among those who breathe the Basin's glass-laden air too long. Outside, the storm shatters small dunes into flying dust, making any departure into the open expanse a hazardous gamble for your eyes and lungs.

The old man gestures toward a dim alcove out of the biting draft.

nodes.brief: Within a hollow archway of milk-glass, you wipe the stinging grit from your smarting eyes while the gale tests the ceramic Seedkey in your pocket.

exits.label: Step toward the leaning sun-tower
Circle the crater of fused green sand
Descend into the sunken mirror-slate corridor

nodes.title: The Milk-Glass Archway
nodes.page:
Hollow ribs of ancient milk-glass form a natural shelter where you pause to wipe the stinging grit from your smarting eyes with a salt-stiffened sleeve. The howling gale tests the integrity of your clothing and hammers rhythmically against the ceramic Seedkey resting in your pocket, reminding you that the storm is a physical weight. Outside this fragile sanctuary, the white waste shifts continuously, erasing old tracks and carving new dunes out of the wreckage of the Old Lensfolk cities.

Your breath fogs the smooth glass surface inches from your face.

nodes.brief: Beside a frozen cascade of green slag, a stranded cart from the Salt Court blocks the trench, threatening to delay your march against the mounting tempest.

exits.label: Seek shelter beneath the yellow salt-crust shelf
Cross the bridge of warped copper rails
Retreat into the hollow bronze valve-housing

nodes.title: The Salt Court Cart
nodes.page:
Frozen cascades of green slag flank a stranded wooden cart the Salt Court left behind, its iron-rimmed wheels jammed in a choked drainage trench. The obstacle blocks your direct path against the mounting tempest, forcing you to choose a scrambling detour across unstable debris while the wind howls like a trapped beast. Every surface is coated in a fine layer of abrasive powder that makes footing treacherous and handholds uncertain.

The creaking timbers of the abandoned wagon groan under the force of the gale.

nodes.brief: Behind a tumbled solar-reflector, you notice a fresh boot-print left by the alleged vault-looters pointing straight toward a hidden drainage flute.

exits.label: Slip inside the hollow bronze valve-housing
Follow the cairn of cracked spectacles
Descend toward the vaulted cistern of green mud

nodes.title: The Hidden Drainage Flute
nodes.page:
Tumbled solar-reflectors cast skewed shadows across the howling waste, and behind one massive mirror you spot a distinct, fresh boot-print left by the alleged vault-looters. The impression points straight toward the gaping mouth of a hidden drainage flute plunging down into the gloom of the lower ruins. Knowing that others have passed this way ahead of you adds a grim urgency to your steps, even as the storm shrieks its warning from the open dunes above.

The dark metal tube echoes with the steady whistle of draft air.

nodes.brief: Across a ribbed flat of blistered alkali, a singing telegraph pole vibrates with a high shriek, threatening to shatter your equilibrium in the blowing dust.

exits.label: Inspect the fluttering leather ledger near the spectacles

exits.privWhy: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over

Pick a careful path across the shifting pearl-grit slope

nodes.title: The Singing Telegraph
nodes.page: Wind scours the alkali crust until the earth itself seems to hum with a tooth-aching frequency. A tall iron telegraph pole, wrapped in singing copper wires, vibrates furiously against the gray blindness of the mirror storm. Your fingers tighten around the iron handle of your banked coal-lantern, shielding the faint orange glow from the biting grit. Every breath rasps dry against your throat as the metallic shriek builds in volume, threatening to unseat your balance on the blistered flats.

nodes.brief: Within the lee of a sunken glass barge, you check your oil flask against the rising dark, knowing the dwindling fuel will barely outlast the gale.

exits.label: Step out onto the treacherous pearl-grit slope
Venture into the green crystal dust of the old dispensary
Climb past the spinning iron winch by the basalt cogwheel

nodes.title: The Sunken Barge
nodes.page:
Darkness pools inside the rusted iron hull of the glass barge, offering a brief, trembling sanctuary from the gale outside. You pull your oil flask from your pouch, tilting it against the dying light to measure the precious fluid sloshing within. The meager reserve will barely survive the howling duration of the storm, leaving you to wonder if your embers will go cold before you reach Prism. Outside, the dunes shift and groan under the weight of the driving dust.

The oil levels drop with every anxious heartbeat, demanding an immediate decision.

nodes.brief: Inside a hollowed optic dome, a blind dromedary tethered to an iron ring stamps nervously, threatening to bolt into the blinding white fury outside.

exits.label: Crawl into the subterranean salt-glazed drainage pipe
Duck behind the bulwark of discarded mirror frames
Step out onto the frozen wave of amber slag

nodes.title: The Optic Dome
nodes.page:
Dust whips through the broken roof of the hollowed optic dome, stinging your eyes and coating your woolen collar in white alkali. A blind dromedary, tethered securely to a rusted iron ring in the floor, stamps its hooves in frantic terror against the howling white fury outside. You press your back against the cool, curved wall of the dome, keeping your lamp lifted high to watch the animal's frantic movements.

The beast threatens to snap its tether and bolt into the blinding storm, forcing your next move.

nodes.brief: Upon a ridge of violet glass shingles, you dodge tumbling panes that whistle like daggers, risking a deep slice across your unprotected knuckles.

exits.label: Duck behind the bulwark of discarded mirror frames
Step out onto the frozen wave of amber slag
Descend into the hollow basalt cistern to escape the wind

nodes.title: The Glass Ridge
nodes.page:
Jagged violet glass shingles slide down the steep slope with a sharp, whistling hiss that mimics the sound of flying daggers. You press your body flat against the ridge, shielding your face as a razor-sharp pane shears the air inches above your knuckles. The Seedkey rests cold against your chest beneath your tunic, a steady anchor amid the chaotic fury of the mirror storm. Every movement demands absolute precision to avoid a deep and disabling cut.

The flying shards give you mere seconds to choose your descent.

nodes.brief: Within a collapsed warehouse of dried kelp-cake, a scuttling dune-crab clicks its claws at your lantern-light, threatening to knock your precious embers into the dust.

exits.label: Crawl into the subterranean salt-glazed drainage pipe
Step out onto the frozen wave of amber slag

nodes.title: The Kelp Warehouse
nodes.page:
Dry kelp-cake crumbles into dust beneath your boots inside the collapsed framework of the old storage shed. A large, grey dune-crab scrambles out from the shadows, clicking its menacing claws directly at the warm glow of your lantern. You lift the coal-lantern higher, watching the crustacean threaten to lunge and scatter your precious embers into the suffocating gloom. The wind howls through the skeletal rafters overhead, carrying the sharp scent of old salt and rain-ghosts.

The aggressive creature blocks your path, requiring an instant reaction.

nodes.brief: Under a leaning sun-tower, an abandoned water-skin flutters like a white tongue, tempting you to taste its bitter contents while the salt dries your throat.

exits.label: Duck behind the bulwark of discarded mirror frames
Step out onto the frozen wave of amber slag
Descend into the hollow basalt cistern to escape the wind

nodes.title: The Leaning Tower
nodes.page:
Salt cakes your lips as you lean against the base of the tilting sun-tower, listening to the dry rattle of metal vanes high above. An abandoned water-skin hangs from a rusted bracket, flapping like a white, desiccated tongue in the gale. The temptation to reach out and taste its contents burns hot in your dry throat, even though you know well that aged basin water brings only sickness. Outside the tower's meager shadow, the white storm blinds the entire horizon.

The dry heat of your breath urges you onward into the howling waste.

nodes.brief: Beside a crater of fused green sand, a rusted surveying tripod hums in the gale, masking the stealthy crunch of something heavy moving in the drift.

exits.label: Descend into the hollow basalt cistern to escape the wind
Seek shelter beneath the canopy of twisted zinc conduits

nodes.title: The Green Crater
nodes.page:
Fused green sand circles a vast depression where an ancient solar furnace melted the basin floor into smooth, radioactive glass. A rusted surveying tripod stands at the crater's rim, humming a low, discordant note in the gale that masks any approaching footfalls. Something heavy drags itself through the drifting white dust just beyond your vision, crunching against the brittle salt-crust with deliberate weight. Your grip tightens instinctively around the iron handle of your lamp.

The hidden movement in the drift leaves no time for hesitation.

nodes.brief: Within a sunken corridor of mirror-slate, your boots crunch on millions of tiny prisms, threatening to reveal your footsteps to any watchers in the storm.

exits.label: Navigate toward the mountain of crushed quartz gravel
Cross the roofless courtyard of black basalt

nodes.title: The Mirror Corridor
nodes.page:
Millions of tiny, shattered prisms pave the sunken trench, crunching with a high, crystalline whisper beneath your every step. You tread as lightly as possible, knowing that any sharp sound might carry through the swirling air and alert watchers hidden in the storm. The walls of mirror-slate reflect thousands of fractured, ghost-like versions of your lamp-glow, turning the narrow corridor into a dizzying hall of light.

The fragile footing threatens to betray your presence at any moment.

nodes.brief: Under a shelf of yellow salt-crust, a shivering desert-fox watches your lamp with wide amber eyes, reminding you that life endures even in this grinding waste.

exits.label: Cross the roofless courtyard of black basalt
Step across the ribbed causeway of translucent slate

nodes.title: The Desert Fox
nodes.page:
Yellow salt-crust forms a low, protective shelf overhead, sheltering you from the worst of the flying glass-dust. A small desert-fox crouches in the dust beneath the overhang, wide amber eyes catching the warm glow of your lamp with startling intelligence. It does not bolt, but watches you with quiet resilience, reminding you that life endures even in this grinding, unforgiving wasteland. The storm continues to roar across the open basin beyond your shallow refuge.

The silent creature watches you weigh your next direction.

nodes.brief: Across a bridge of warped copper rails, the screaming wind threatens to lift you bodily into the air and hurl you against the jagged basin floor.

exits.label: Step across the ribbed causeway of translucent slate
Cling to the frozen iron stanchion beneath the balcony

nodes.title: The Copper Rails
nodes.page:
Warped copper rails twist upward into the howling murk like the ribs of some ancient, buried leviathan. The screaming wind catches your coat, threatening to lift you bodily off the iron track and hurl you down onto the jagged basin floor below. You drop low to the ties, clinging to the oxidized metal with both hands while your lamp swings wildly from your wrist, casting frantic arcs of orange light.

The fierce gale demands an immediate and desperate grip on your route.

nodes.brief: Inside a hollow bronze valve-housing, you shelter from a sudden vortex of glass-dust that scours the paint from your lantern and tests your endurance.

exits.label: Cross the translucent slate causeway
Listen at the whistling speaking tube

nodes.title: The Bronze Valve
nodes.page: Coiled copper shavings and gritty salt pack the seams of the massive bronze housing, offering a narrow, dim cavity away from the screaming gale. Your banked coal-lantern rattles against your knee, its tiny eye of red heat fighting a losing battle against the fine glass-dust that drifts through the air valves. Every breath tastes of old grease and baked brass as the storm pressure swells against the metal plates, testing the stubborn endurance in your limbs.

nodes.brief: Beside a cairn of cracked spectacles, an inked leather ledger flutters loose in the gust, threatening to scatter vital cartography across the blinding dunes.

exits.label: Follow the whistling brass speaking-tube
Cling to the quartz balcony stanchion

nodes.title: The Fluttering Ledger
nodes.page: Shards of discarded spectacles click and slide against one another like teeth in an iron jaw as the rising gust tears at the pages of an old, water-swollen ledger pinned beneath a heavy cairn. Inked cartography from a forgotten survey season ripples in the murk, threatening to scatter vital paths across the shifting, blinding dunes before you can commit them to memory. Your fingers grow stiff as you try to anchor the flailing calfskin against the driving squall.

nodes.brief: Within a vaulted cistern of green vitrified mud, a puddle of thick brine reflects your soot-stained face, warning you of the dehydration creeping into your veins.

exits.privWhy: the reader believes the vault was looted and looks for the looters' trail
exits.label: Track the faint tallow scent through the cleft
Strike the buried metal ring in the salt

nodes.title: The Vitrified Cistern
nodes.page: Green vitrified mud forms a slick, cup-shaped vault around a stagnant pool of thick, amber brine that mirrors your soot-stained, travel-worn face with cruel clarity. The dry heat of the basin has baked your tongue, and every swallow of your dwindling canteen water reminds you of the quiet dehydration creeping steadily into your veins. Shadows twist across the wet floor as the storm beats a frantic rhythm on the masonry above.

nodes.brief: Wandering off the track to escape the wind-shriek, your bootheel clicks against a concealed bronze latch marking the lost secondary cache of Prism.

exits.label: Pry at the concealed bronze latch
Traverse the blistered white alkali expanse

priv.why: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over

nodes.title: The Concealed Latch
nodes.page: Wandering deliberately wide of the main track to escape the relentless wind-shriek, your travel-worn bootheel clicks sharply against a concealed bronze latch half-swallowed by ancient crust. Because you travel entirely alone, with no guide to chatter or pull your sleeve toward safer ruts, you catch the slight metallic hollow beneath the salt that others stride right past. The discovery hints at a lost secondary cache belonging to old Prism, waiting just beneath the crust.

nodes.brief: Under a sagging framework of corrugated tin, a broken mirror flashes erratic violet signals into the murk, threatening to draw unwanted attention from signal-sentries.

exits.label: Step out onto the white alkali flat
Squeeze into the hollow copper cylinder
Secure the Seedkey inside your tunic

nodes.title: The Corrugated Shelter
nodes.page: Corrugated tin rattles overhead like a drum beaten by invisible hands, sheltering you briefly while a shattered mirror fragment catches the dim storm-light and throws erratic violet flashes into the swirling murk. Those wild beams cut through the haze, threatening to draw unwanted attention from watchful signal-sentries stationed on the higher ruins. You crouch low in the gray gloom, holding your flickering coal-lantern close to your chest.

nodes.brief: Across a slope of shifting pearl-grit, your ankles sink into treacherous quick-salt that pulls against your every step while the gale presses hard your back.

exits.label: Strike the buried metal ring in the salt
Seek refuge within the hollow copper cylinder

nodes.title: The Shifting Quick-Salt
nodes.page: Fine pearl-grit rolls beneath your soles like dry beads, offering no purchase as your ankles sink deeper into the treacherous quick-salt with every desperate stride. The gale shoves hard at your back toward the unstable crust, and the Seedkey shifts against your ribs. Every muscle in your legs burns as you fight to pull your boots free from the greedy, shifting basin floor.

nodes.brief: Inside a ruined dispensary of the old Lensfolk, green crystal dust coats your tongue with copper bitterness, threatening to choke your breath in the dark.

exits.label: Head out across the blistered alkali expanse
Lash the Seedkey securely inside your tunic

nodes.title: The Ruined Dispensary
nodes.page: Green crystal dust coats the dry roof-timbers of an old Lensfolk dispensary, filling the stagnant air with a sharp, coppery bitterness that burns your throat with every shallow gasp. The fine particles cling to your sweat-damp skin, threatening to choke your breath in the suffocating darkness of the ruined medical hall. Your hand drifts automatically to the warm iron of your coal-lantern to ensure the flame still holds against the draft.

nodes.brief: Beside a monumental basalt cogwheel, an iron winch spins uselessly in the howling draft, warning you that the mechanical pathways ahead are jammed with debris.

exits.label: Enter the hollow solar-lens cylinder
Secure the Seedkey beneath your tunic
Approach the sulfurous fissure in the slag

nodes.title: The Basalt Cogwheel
nodes.page: A monumental basalt cogwheel towers beside you, its iron winch spinning uselessly in the howling draft with a high, mournful screech of rusted teeth. The jammed machinery warns that the ancient mechanical pathways ahead are choked with impenetrable slag and wind-blown debris, blocking the direct route. Your lantern light flickers against the dark stone as you search for an alternative passage through the ruins.

nodes.brief: Within a subterranean drainage pipe of salt-glazed clay, you crawl through choking darkness while the Seedkey bangs against your ribs like a cold fist.

exits.label: Crawl toward the screaming drainage flute

nodes.title: The Clay Drainage Pipe
nodes.page:
Salt-glazed clay arches low overhead, forcing you into a cramped, choking crawl through subterranean darkness while the cold ceramic Seedkey bangs rhythmically against your ribs like an impatient fist. The air smells of damp earth and ancient lime, far removed from the screaming fury of the mirror storm above. Every movement forward scrapes your pack against the rough ceramic ribs of the long-abandoned conduit.

You must push deeper into the subterranean dark toward the outlet.

nodes.brief: Behind a bulwark of discarded mirror frames, a whistling gust tries to rip your woolen scarf away, exposing your neck to the scouring glass-dust.

exits.label: Advance into the screaming drainage flute

nodes.title: The Mirror Bulwark
nodes.page: Shards of discarded mirror frames form a jagged bulwark against the storm, but a persistent whistling gust curls around the edge to try and rip your woolen scarf away. The sudden loss of your neck-wrap would expose your skin directly to the scouring, glass-laden wind that strips paint from metal and flesh from bone. You brace your shoulder against the wooden frames, holding your coat tight.

nodes.brief: Across a frozen wave of amber slag, you steady your trembling grip on the hot iron handle of the lamp as the wick flickers dangerously low.

exits.label: Crawl through the low drainage flute
Shelter behind the green glass screen

nodes.title: The Amber Wave
nodes.page:
Across a frozen wave of amber slag, you steady your trembling grip on the hot iron handle of the lamp as the wick flickers dangerously low. Every gust from the salt-choked gale threatens to plunge you into absolute darkness, forcing you to lean your entire weight against the treacherous slope while the cold ceramic Seedkey rattles heavily against your belt.

Ahead, the path splits between a narrow subterranean duct and a jagged glass overlook exposed to the full fury of the storm.

nodes.brief: Inside a hollow basalt cistern, a solitary water-drop echoes with maddening slowness, testing your frayed nerves against the relentless roar of the mirror storm.

exits.label: Face the storm behind green glass
Cross the buckled iron framework

nodes.title: The Basalt Cistern
nodes.page: Inside a hollow basalt cistern, a solitary water-drop echoes with maddening slowness, testing your frayed nerves against the relentless roar of the mirror storm. The damp air tastes of ancient lime and stale dust, offering a brief, claustrophobic sanctuary from the howling gale outside while your lamp casts dancing, distorted shadows against the curved stone walls.

nodes.brief: Beneath a canopy of twisted zinc conduits, an old wind-chime made of sea-glass plays a frantic, discordant tune that threatens to drown out your thoughts.

exits.label: Step onto the buckled iron bridge

nodes.title: The Sea-Glass Chime
nodes.page:
Beneath a canopy of twisted zinc conduits, an old wind-chime made of sea-glass plays a frantic, discordant tune that threatens to drown out your thoughts. The sharp metallic clatter mingles with the howling wind, creating an unsettling rhythm that urges you to move faster before the unstable overhead structure gives way completely.

Your lamp light catches the vibrating shards above as you weigh your next step across the gale-swept divide.

nodes.brief: Beside a mountain of crushed quartz gravel, your right boot-sole peels away from the leather uppers, threatening to leave your heel bare to the abrasive ground.

exits.label: Seek cover behind the glass screen
Cross the buckled iron bridge ahead

nodes.title: The Worn Boot-Sole
nodes.page: Beside a mountain of crushed quartz gravel, your right boot-sole peels away from the leather uppers, threatening to leave your heel bare to the abrasive ground. The biting wind whips razor-sharp dust around your ankles, turning every movement into a painful struggle against the shifting terrain and the biting cold.

nodes.brief: Within a roofless courtyard of black basalt, a swirling vortex of white sand traps you against a dead wall while your lungs burn for clean air.

exits.label: Escape into the damp aqueduct junction
Seek refuge beneath the milk-glass spire

nodes.title: The Black Courtyard
nodes.page:
Within a roofless courtyard of black basalt, a swirling vortex of white sand traps you against a dead wall while your lungs burn for clean air. The heavy dust coats your throat like dry ash, making every breath a desperate effort while the amber light of your lantern struggles to pierce the gritty haze.

Two potential routes beckon through the swirling gloom, each promising an escape from the suffocating trap.

nodes.brief: Across a ribbed causeway of translucent slate, the storm pressure drops suddenly with a loud pop, popping your eardrums and confusing your sense of direction.

exits.label: Take shelter behind the green glass screen
Push toward the damp masonry junction
Wade through the heavy pulverized drifts

nodes.title: The Translucent Causeway
nodes.page:
Across a ribbed causeway of translucent slate, the storm pressure drops suddenly with a loud pop, popping your eardrums and confusing your sense of direction. The pale ground glows faintly underfoot like frozen milk, making it difficult to distinguish solid path from sheer drop as the gale shrieks across the open expanse.

You have a choice of paths leading deeper into the labyrinth of shattered glass and stone.

nodes.brief: Inside a sunken observation post, a rusty brass speaking-tube whistles with the voice of the gale, threatening to disorient you with its unearthly howling.

exits.label: Head toward the leaning milk-glass spire
Rest in the fossilized mud alcove

nodes.title: The Speaking-Tube
nodes.page:
Inside a sunken observation post, a rusty brass speaking-tube whistles with the voice of the gale, threatening to disorient you with its unearthly howling. The metallic pipe seems to channel the very breath of the basin, turning the wind's fury into a haunting, hollow drone that vibrates straight through your boots.

You can press forward toward the leaning milk-glass spire or seek the deeper quiet of the fossilized mud alcove.

nodes.brief: Beneath a cantilevered balcony of fused green quartz, you cling to a frozen iron stanchion while a slab of loose glass crashes into the ravine below.

exits.label: Retreat to the damp aqueduct junction
Climb toward the leaning milk-glass spire
Navigate the shifting pulverized quartz

nodes.title: The Cantilevered Balcony
nodes.page:
Beneath a cantilevered balcony of fused green quartz, you cling to a frozen iron stanchion while a slab of loose glass crashes into the ravine below. The structural groans of the old ruin remind you how fragile this dried sea truly is, leaving your muscles aching from tension as the freezing wind tests your grip.

Several routes offer a way away from the crumbling ledge into safer territory.

nodes.brief: Following the faint smell of burnt tallow left by the looters, you slip through a narrow cleft in the storm wall that bypasses the worst of the grit.

exits.label: Follow the path to the damp aqueduct
Advance through the shifting quartz dunes

nodes.title: The Loiterers' Cleft
nodes.page:
Following the faint smell of burnt tallow left by the looters, you slip through a narrow cleft in the storm wall that bypasses the worst of the grit. The sheltered crevice offers a welcome respite from the screaming winds, though the soot-stained walls suggest others passed this way not long before you.

You can follow the sheltered stone paths deeper into the complex while avoiding the worst of the surface gale.

nodes.brief: Within a sunken cistern choked with gray salt-drift, your foot strikes a buried metal ring that tolls like a muffled bell against the rushing wind.

exits.label: Push through the heavy pulverized dunes
Cross the iridescent salt-crust pan

nodes.title: The Sunken Ring
nodes.page:
Within a sunken cistern choked with gray salt-drift, your foot strikes a buried metal ring that tolls like a muffled bell against the rushing wind. The strange, resonant clang hangs in the heavy air for a long moment, cutting through the roar of the storm and hinting at forgotten machinery hidden beneath the crust.

The storm continues to press hard against your back, leaving two distinct directions for your escape.

nodes.brief: Across an open expanse of blistered white alkali, the gale hits with the force of a slammed door, driving millions of glass needles into your leather coat.

exits.label: Push forward into the blinding drift
Veer toward the low ridges of fused slag
Seek refuge within the dark mud alcove

nodes.title: The White Alkali
nodes.page: Across an open expanse of blistered white alkali, the gale hits with the force of a slammed door, driving millions of glass needles into your leather coat. Your banked coal-lantern rattles against your hip, sending weak orange flickers across the crusted ground as you struggle to keep your footing against the horizontal shriek of the storm.

nodes.brief: Inside a hollowed copper cylinder that once held a solar lens, you press your back to the curved wall while the tempest shrieks through the open ends.

exits.label: Step out into the churning grit
Follow the rumbling pipe deeper inward
Cross the ribbed pan of purple salt

nodes.title: The Copper Cylinder
nodes.page: Inside a hollowed copper cylinder that once held a solar lens, you press your back to the curved wall while the tempest shrieks through the open ends. The metal hums with a deep, vibrating resonance that matches the frantic beating of your heart, offering a brief, echoing pocket away from the direct fury of the gale.

nodes.brief: Beneath a massive flange of rusted iron pipe, you pause to lash the Seedkey securely inside your tunic with a length of braided hemp cord.

exits.label: Crawl along the shelter of the conduit
Head toward the bruised purple salt-pan
Take the reckless way

nodes.title: The Rusted Iron Flange
nodes.page: Beneath a massive flange of rusted iron pipe, you pause to lash the Seedkey securely inside your tunic with a length of braided hemp cord. The cold ceramic piece warms slightly against your ribs, reminding you of the green vaults waiting at the basin's heart while the metal overhead groans under the weight of the wind.

nodes.brief: Beside a cliff of yellow crystal slag, an eddy of warm, sulfurous air rises from a deep fissure, threatening to suffocate you with the breath of the dead basin.

exits.label: Breast the dune of pulverized quartz
Turn toward the darkening salt expanse

nodes.title: The Sulfur Fissure
nodes.page: Beside a cliff of yellow crystal slag, an eddy of warm, sulfurous air rises from a deep fissure, threatening to suffocate you with the breath of the dead basin. You pull your collar high across your nose and mouth, tasting the alkaline dust and ancient minerals as you weigh the foul heat against the freezing bite of the open storm.

nodes.brief: Within the throat of a colossal drainage flute, the howling wind compresses into a screaming pipe that tests your courage and threatens your balance.

exits.label: Crawl through the iron hatch ahead
Retreat to the mirror-station door

nodes.title: The Screaming Pipe
nodes.page: Shrieking air funnels through the rusted throat of the giant drainage flute, turning every breath into a struggle against the pressure. The howling wind rattles your ribs and scours the salt from your boots while you crouch low to keep your balance. Clinging tightly to the cold iron rim of the pipe, you must decide whether to crawl forward into the roaring interior or scramble back toward the shelter of the masonry.

nodes.brief: Behind a jagged screen of sea-green plate glass, you watch the full fury of the storm scour the basin floor while your lantern oil begins to smoke.

exits.label: Press onward to the deep siphon tube
Seek the battered mirror-station shelter

nodes.title: The Glass Screen
nodes.page: Behind a jagged screen of sea-green plate glass, you watch the full fury of the storm scour the basin floor while your lantern oil begins to smoke. The thick emerald barrier muffles the gale's roar to a dull knock from below, and you catch your breath while fixing your grip on the precious metal handle.

nodes.brief: Across a narrow bridge of buckled iron framework, the gale buffets your shoulders with physical blows, threatening to pitch you into the dark trench below.

exits.label: Rush across the iron framework now
Step back onto the windward lip

nodes.title: The Buckled Span
nodes.page: Slender ribs of buckled iron groan under the relentless weight of the gale, forming a narrow bridge across a yawning trench of darkness. Each gust strikes your shoulders like a physical blow, threatening to pitch you sideways into the empty air. With the heavy lamp swinging wildly at your side and the Seedkey cold against your palm, you weigh the dangerous crossing against the safety of the path behind.

nodes.brief: Inside a vaulted junction of salt-encrusted aqueducts, you catch your breath against the damp masonry while the storm above rattles the concrete ceiling.

exits.label: Follow the tunnel toward the central depression
Slip out beside the copper intake valve

nodes.title: The Salt Vault
nodes.page: Damp masonry cradles your tired shoulders inside the vaulted junction of the old aqueducts, offering a brief respite from the fury outside. Above your head the concrete ceiling vibrates with the storm's thunder while fine white salt sifts through the mortar joints. In the damp stillness you catch your breath and glance at the low tunnel down and the maintenance exit nearby.

nodes.brief: Beneath a leaning spire of milk-glass, your fingers grow numb and clumsy against the cold brass of the lamp handle as the temperature drops sharply.

exits.label: Push forward toward the windward ridge
Force open the battered mirror-station door

nodes.title: The Milk-Glass Spire
nodes.page: Freezing air spills down the face of the leaning milk-glass spire, turning your fingers numb and clumsy against the brass handle of your coal-lantern. The pale glow of the ember-lamp flickers weakly against the gathering gloom as frost begins to rim the glass plates underfoot. Shivering in the bitter draft, you ponder whether to press onward into the storm's teeth or seek refuge behind the warped hinges of the nearby station door.

nodes.brief: Beside a mountain of pulverized quartz, a sudden shift in the dune buries your shins in heavy grit, anchoring you fast against the rushing wind-wall.

exits.label: Struggle toward the Grand Siphon tube
Climb the windward depression edge
Lean against the battered mirror door

nodes.title: The Quartz Mountain
nodes.page: Beside a mountain of pulverized quartz, a sudden shift in the dune buries your shins in heavy grit, anchoring you fast against the rushing wind-wall. You wrench your right boot free with a sucking sound, shielding your glowing coal-lantern with your body to prevent the fine white powder from snuffing out the last ember of Candlemere.

nodes.title: The Mud Alcove
nodes.page: Deep within an alcove carved from ancient, fossilized mud, you press the ceramic Seedkey tight against your chest for a thin measure of warmth while glass-dust hisses and scratches furiously against the stone outside. The wind howls a hollow note through the crannies, threatening to tear the very breath from your lungs if you dare step another inch into the blinding white fury. You hold your smoking coal-lantern low, watching the tiny red glow of the coals fight against the creeping dampness seeping through your wool coat.

nodes.brief: Across a ribbed pan of iridescent salt-crust, the storm light turns from blinding white to a bruised purple, signaling the climax of the mirror gale.

nodes.title: The Purple Crust
nodes.page: Across a ribbed pan of iridescent salt-crust, the blinding white light of the gale twists into a bruised, bruised-plum purple that signals the fierce climax of the mirror storm. Jagged shards of flying mica cut the low air, their high-pitched whine drowning your own racing pulse. You crouch low over your copper-rimmed lamp, shielding the brass door with your stiffened sleeve while the ground beneath your boots vibrates from the relentless pressure of the air-wall.

nodes.brief: At the mouth of the Grand Siphon tube, the howling vortex funnels into a narrow iron hatch, testing your ability to reach the latch against the draft.

nodes.title: The Grand Siphon
nodes.page: At the yawning mouth of the Grand Siphon tube, a howling vortex funnels down into a narrow iron hatch, testing your raw strength to reach the heavy latch against the screaming draft. Every muscle in your arms trembles as you lean into the violent slipstream, fighting the suction that tries to yank your coat clean off your shoulders. Your cold-lantern rattles against your knee like a loose tooth while the metal rim of the hatch shivers under your gloved fingers.

nodes.brief: On the windward lip of the central depression, the storm strips the leather cover from your lamp, exposing the hot coals directly to the flying glass.

nodes.title: The Stripped Cover
nodes.page: On the high, windward lip of the central depression, a sudden and violent gust strips the heavy leather cover clean from your lamp, exposing the red-hot coals directly to the blizzard of flying glass. Sparks fly in a frantic flurry as the abrasive dust pelts the exposed metal, threatening to scatter your precious warmth into the freezing void of the Basin. You slam your body over the lantern cage, trying to starve the hungry wind of its target with your own flesh and bone.

nodes.brief: Inside the shelter of a battered mirror-station door, you brace your weight against the warped hinges while the gale hammers furiously on the exterior plates.

nodes.title: The Battered Station
nodes.page: Inside the splintered shelter of a battered mirror-station door, you brace your entire weight against the warped iron hinges while the gale hammers furiously on the exterior plates like a fist of solid stone. The wooden frame groans and spits tiny splinters into your hair, threatening to give way under the relentless battering of the dune-storm. Within the dim enclosure, the smell of old grease and stagnant air mixes with the sharp tang of ozone from the grinding glass outside.

The cold metal arches above you like the ribs of a buried leviathan, dripping with beads of condensation that freeze the moment they catch the draft. Your fingers go numb and cold as you brace the warm brass handle of your coal-lantern against the trembling ground.

Wind-scoured hands hang stiff and numb, yet the key stays solid and unyielding under your palms.

nodes.title: The Fused Crescent

The rising gale screeches against the hardened dunes, threatening to tear the tools from your stiff fingers. Every breath tastes of fine alkaline dust, but you keep your shoulder pressed against the shelter's curve, nursing the pale coal-glow within your lantern until the sputtering flame straightens into a steady yellow core.

The wind howls louder outside the barricade, yet the cold ceramic Seedkey remains heavy and dry against your collarbone, urging you deeper into the blinding expanse before the shifting sands bury your only path.

nodes.title: The Glass Skull
nodes.page:
Within a hollow glass skull, you wait out a blinding micro-burst, clutching your soot-blackened lantern against the rising chill. The curved obsidian walls hum like a plucked string as abrasive crystals hammer the exterior, sealing you in a temporary twilight of grey shadow and amber light. You adjust the wick with trembling care, ensuring the precious heat does not die in the gloom while the storm tears furiously at the dunes outside.

The air grows thin and stale within the domed enclosure, forcing you to consider your next movement before the drifting debris completely blocks the low, jagged opening.

nodes.title: The Amber Drain
nodes.page:
Walking entirely alone through the howling waste, you spot a dry drainage pipe choked with amber beads that shields your fragile flame from the screaming drift. No companion speaks to distract your thoughts or share the burden of the navigation, leaving only the crunch of salt beneath your boots and the frantic rattling of the glass beads in the pipe. You tuck your chin into your collar, guarding the amber lantern with your free hand as the wind tries to rip the very coat from your shoulders.

The quiet isolation presses hard against your temples, reminding you that every choice across this shifting desert rests entirely upon your own weary judgment.

nodes.title: The Blue Slag Arch
nodes.page:

The sharp scent of ozone and crushed salt fills the air as the tempest beats relentlessly against your makeshift cover. You draw the cold ceramic Seedkey closer to your ribs, feeling its dead chill contrast sharply against the feverish throb of your injured hand.

The howling outside dips into a lower, more threatening moan, signaling that the lull is temporary and the open expanse awaits your crossing.

nodes.title: The Bell-Jar Lee
nodes.page:
In the lee of a massive bell-jar fragment, you feed precious scrap-coal to your sputtering wick as the night turns abrasive and cold. The curved glass barrier blocks the worst of the howling gale, casting distorted reflections of your tired face into the surrounding gloom. You carefully break a dark lump of fuel between your palms, dropping it into the metal basket to revive the dying yellow eye of your lamp before the darkness swallows the trench entirely.

The temperature continues to drop sharply as the storm clouds gather weight overhead, demanding that you move before your boots freeze to the glass floor.

nodes.title: The Salt-Pimple Flats
nodes.page:
Across a ribbed crust of salt-pimple flats, you run low and hard, praying your singed wick holds its yellow spark against the ferocious downdraft. Every step crunches through the brittle white blisters of the ancient seabed, sending up tiny puffs of stinging dust that cling to your sweat-drenched neck. Your lungs burn with every inhalation, yet you dare not slacken your pace while the open mirrors stretch endlessly on every side.

The wind shifts abruptly from the west, bringing a sharper tang of sulfur and forcing you to lean heavily into the gale just to maintain your footing.

nodes.title: The Telegraph Wire
nodes.page:
Through a corridor of singing telegraph-wire, you dodge whipping glass reeds while your lamp casts long, stuttering shadows across the white floor. The thin metallic filaments hum with a sharp, musical vibration that sets your teeth on edge, echoing the distant fury of the mirror storm. You duck beneath a low-hanging loop of fused copper, keeping your eyes fixed on the dim horizon where Prism's spires should rise through the scouring grit.

The whistling wires pull tighter in the rising gale, creating a chaotic web of sound and motion that forces you to choose your footing with absolute precision.

nodes.title: The Hidden Spring
nodes.page:
Bound tightly by the sisters' well-oath, you recognize a hidden alkali spring beneath the drift that cools your scorched palm and feeds your resolve. The sacred promise still sits in your blood, and your eyes catch faint moisture breathing through the salt past the deceptive surface crust. You kneel in the stinging dust to press your damp fingers to your brow, letting the cold water renew your strength before the storm resumes its assault.

The surrounding dunes shift and settle with a dry hiss, reminding you that your sworn duty leaves no time for lingering in the shelter.

nodes.title: The Slag Ledge
nodes.page:
Under a ledge of milk-white slag, a shivering nomad named Nola trades a handful of coarse salt for a drop of water from your skin. Her fingers are wrapped in stained leather rags, and her eyes reflect the pale, frantic yellow of your guarded lantern as the wind tears at the edges of your coat. You exchange low whispers about the rising storm and the treacherous condition of the basin floor before she points a scarred thumb toward the southern transit.

The slag ledge groans under the pressure of the howling wind, urging you to leave the shelter and resume your lonely march across the Basin.

nodes.title: The Jagged Prisms
nodes.page:
Past a reef of jagged prisms, you scramble over shifting dunes, your breath rattling in a throat parched by microscopic grit. The blinding sun catches the razor edges of the crystal formations, splintering the grey daylight into shards of violet and gold. You keep your head bowed against the stinging spray of glass-dust, clutching the cold Seedkey tightly inside your tunic to ensure it remains free of abrasive silt.

The dunes slide away beneath your boots with every stride, threatening to trap you in a deep trough unless you find a firmer path.

You huddle low against the cold floor, holding your heavy wool cloak tight over your chest to shield the banked coal-lantern from the abrasive sleet. Every breath draws in the taste of powdered quartz and ancient smoke. Above the roar, the wind rattles against the rocks like iron filings in a tin box.

nodes.title: The Half-Buried Hoop
nodes.page: Half-submerged in the crusted salt, an iron water-hoop serves as your meager windbreak against the screaming gale. Your cold fingers trace the length of the ceramic Seedkey, feeling for any hairline fractures or structural flaws wrought by the violent, scouring tempest. The amber-lamp at your hip flickers wildly, its banked coals glowing like a stubborn eye against the encroaching dark. Fine mica dust clings to your sweat-slicked forehead, stinging whenever you blink.

nodes.title: The Glass Pipes
nodes.page: Hollow glass pipes groan and whistle in a complex, reedy chorus all around you, turning the howling tempest into an eerie underground tune. You lean against a smooth silicate conduit and let the ground's rhythmic knock steer your blistered feet forward. Prism's distant towers remain hidden behind a curtain of churning grey dust, but the acoustic resonance offers a reliable path through the blinding whiteout. You weigh your options on how to navigate the singing network ahead.

nodes.title: The Salt-Weaver's Warning
nodes.page: Jagged flakes of glittering scree cascade down a nearby slope as an old salt-weaver named Voss clutches a tattered rag to his mouth and shouts over the storm. He points a gnarled finger toward the shifting haze, warning of bottomless sinkholes that lurk invisibly beneath the dancing dust-whirls. Your lungs burn with every inhalation, and the weight of your ember-lamp feels heavier with each passing stride.

nodes.brief: Across a shimmering crust of sulphate, you sprint through a squall of diamond needles, keeping your shoulder turned to the biting wind.

nodes.title: The Diamond Squall
nodes.page:
Jagged plates of sulphate crack under your boots as a squall of microscopic diamond needles sweeps across the dried bed, stinging every inch of exposed skin. You turn your shoulder against the howling gale, clutching the warm metal of your ember-lamp close to your chest while the Seedkey hums with a faint, bone-cold chill in your pocket. The white dust obscures the horizon completely, leaving only the choice to seek shelter beneath a ruined dome or plunge headlong into a subterranean trench.

The howling wind shifts, carrying the sharp scent of ozone and crushed stone from the north.

Your fingers ache from the cold, yet you keep a firm grip on your lantern frame to ensure the coals stay banked.

nodes.title: The Howling Barrier
nodes.page: Blinding clouds of powdered crystal obscure the horizon, reducing the ancient basin to a churning abyss of grey and white. Every muscle in your body screams under the ceaseless battering of the tempest, and your ember-lamp requires both hands to keep its precious spark from scattering into the wind. The ceramic key against your breastbone pulses with an icy dampness, reminding you of the distant Rain Vault waiting at the center of the ruins. You press forward into the roaring blindness, seeking any route that will carry you closer to safety.

nodes.title: The Singing Spire

Trembling hands cup your battered lamp and coax the dying coals back into a crimson glow. The cold ceramic key rests heavily against your ribs, vibrating in rhythm with the low drone of the storm-swept basin. Ahead, the tumult eases slightly into a heavier, rolling roar that shakes the very ground beneath your travel-worn boots.

nodes.title: The Charred Trail

The scouring wind tears at your cloak, testing your stamina and threatening to tear the precious lantern from your numb fingers. Under your damp tunic the Seedkey stays so cold it numbs your skin. The trail dips lower into a shadowed trough where the screaming gale loses some of its immediate fury.

nodes.title: The Crystal Hollow
nodes.page: Fine crystal meal fills every fold of your travel-worn garments while you pause to scrape encrusted salt from your burning eyelids. Your muscles ache down to the bone, yet the ember-lamp still holds its vital coal against the swirling dark. The ceramic key feels like a block of river-ice against your chest, anchoring you to your mission as the storm shrieks overhead. Several uncertain paths branch out into the roaring haze, each offering a different gamble against the elements.

A lone scout named Garrow stands near the base, his face etched with salt-burns as he gestures toward a smoother trench cutting through the waste. Your tired body wants the shelter of the deeper passage, and your lamp burns low in your aching grip. The cold ceramic key presses against your ribs like a silent promise of water and life.

nodes.title: The Mica Veil
nodes.page: Choking clouds of mica flakes blind your eyes and coat your tongue in dry dust as you stumble through the blinding squall. The Seedkey sends a damp, reviving chill through your burning breastbone, easing the fierce ache in your tired muscles. You shield your flickering coal-lantern with your body, determined to keep the tiny flame alive against the mounting gale. Several faint openings appear through the swirling grey, promising temporary relief from the punishing storm.

The storm beats relentlessly against the broken arches above, filling the hollow space with a deep, vibrating roar. Your body feels hollow with exhaustion, yet the cold Seedkey against your chest reassures you that the journey is not yet lost. Two potential routes lead out into the scouring white waste, each demanding a firm decision.
