Weary limbs take a brief rest from the wind, though your heart still hammers a frantic rhythm against your ribs. The ember-lamp paints a weak glow on the damp earthen walls, and the Seedkey stays cold against your ribs beneath the tunic. Ahead, the trench splits into different directions through the blinding murk.

You sit cramped in the gloom, checking your meager fuel supply and coaxing the dwindling coals of your lamp back to life. Your tired muscles tremble with fatigue, but the icy touch of the Seedkey keeps your mind sharp and clear. Outside the pipe's narrow mouth, the whirling dust storm continues its relentless assault on the salt basin.

The wind howls outside this fragile shelter, scattering salt against the glass panes like handfuls of gravel, but here the air is still and smells of old dust and baked clay. You share a brief, silent nod with her before checking the hemp cord around your coat. The storm continues to batter the outer ruins, leaving you to decide whether to brave the open flagstones or seek out the underground drainage machinery.

You keep your head lowered, letting the bulk of your coat shield the precious ember-lamp tucked against your ribs while your fingers brush the cold ceramic edge of the Seedkey.

nodes.title: The Narrow Drainage Culvert
nodes.page: Traveling entirely alone without a guide to clutter your thoughts, you notice a narrow drainage culvert free of drift-piles that lets you bypass the worst of the howling gale. The stone sides are slick with old moisture, offering a hidden trench where the wind can barely reach your face or threaten your flickering coal-lantern. Moving in this quiet solitude gives you a clear sense of purpose as you weigh your next step toward the observatory.

nodes.brief: Across a plateau of grey basalt tiles, you fight for every stride against a wall of air thick with pulverized mirror-dust.

exits.label: Approach the low dark lintel where the lone glasswright stands.
Leave the screaming mirror storm behind for the quiet salt-pans.

nodes.title: The Grey Basalt Tiles
nodes.page: Across a plateau of grey basalt tiles, you fight for every stride against a wall of air thick with pulverized mirror-dust. The ground beneath your boots is slick and treacherous, forcing you to lean heavily into the tempest while your lantern swings wildly from your bruised hand. Every breath tastes of salt and ancient iron, testing the limits of your endurance as you push toward the heart of the dead city.

nodes.brief: Inside a hollowed bowl of slag-iron, you tend your flickering flame while the tempest rattles the metal plates overhead.

exits.label: Seek out the lone glasswright beneath the dark basalt lintel.
Step out across the ribbed terrace of old salt-pans.

nodes.title: The Hollow Slag-Iron Bowl
nodes.page: Inside a hollowed bowl of slag-iron, you tend your flickering flame while the tempest rattles the metal plates overhead. The tiny pocket of relative calm allows you to warm your stiff fingers against the lantern chimney and catch your breath before the next leg of your journey across the glass-strewn flats. Outside, the world is a white blur of scouring dust and howling air.

nodes.brief: Beneath a drooping wire-mesh awning, a weathered courier named Hale nods once before disappearing into the blinding white dust-sea.

exits.label: Step across the ribbed salt-terraces away from the storm.
Steady your limbs within the shadow of the massive cyclopean masonry.

nodes.title: The Drooping Wire-Mesh Awning
nodes.page: Beneath a drooping wire-mesh awning, a weathered courier named Hale nods once before disappearing into the blinding white dust-sea. The metal framework groans as the wind leans on it, showering fine grit onto your shoulders while you hitch the strap of your pack. You clutch your lantern closer to your chest, guarding the dying heat of the coals against the biting chill.

nodes.brief: Through a maze of upright glass stakes, you pick your path with agonizing care to protect your sole remaining box of matches.

exits.label: Step across the ribbed salt-terraces into the quiet air.
Prepare to face the formidable walls within the cyclopean shadow.

nodes.title: The Maze of Glass Stakes
nodes.page: Through a maze of upright glass stakes, you pick your path with agonizing care to protect your sole remaining box of matches. Each transparent shard rises from the salt-crust like a jagged tooth, catching the pale, filtered light of the storm and refracting it into blinding needles of white glare. You move with delicate precision, knowing that a single slip could shatter your supplies and leave you in the dark.

nodes.brief: Over a swelling dune of fine salt-crust, you surge toward the dark silhouette of Prism's outer wall looming through the murk.

exits.label: Steady your weary limbs within the shadow of the cyclopean masonry.

nodes.title: The Swelling Salt-Dune
nodes.page: Over a swelling dune of fine salt-crust, you surge toward the dark silhouette of Prism's outer wall looming through the murk. The ground shifts treacherously beneath your boots, threatening to slide backward with every upward stride, but the sheer gravity of your mission pulls you forward. You grip the Seedkey tightly in your pocket, feeling its reassuring chill against your knuckles as the great stone barrier draws closer.

nodes.brief: Beside a colossal brass gear half-swallowed by sand, you catch your breath as the mirror storm begins its slow, ragged dying.

exits.label: Hold up your steady ember-lamp before the great bronze wicket.
Watch the last swirls of mirror-dust settle between the pillars.

nodes.title: The Colossal Brass Gear
nodes.page: Beside a colossal brass gear half-swallowed by sand, you catch your breath as the mirror storm begins its slow, ragged dying. The heavy roar of the wind drops to a low, mournful sigh, leaving the air thick with suspended diamond-dust that sparkles in the returning light. You wipe the grime from your eyes and look up toward the towering architecture of the central observatory now visible through the haze.

nodes.brief: Under a towering arch of green bottle-glass, you check your ember-lamp one last time before stepping onto the dry approach.

exits.label: Present your steady ember-lamp before the great bronze wicket.
Watch the settling mirror-dust between the observatory pillars.

nodes.title: The Green Bottle-Glass Arch
nodes.page: Under a towering arch of green bottle-glass, you check your ember-lamp one last time before stepping onto the dry approach. The air is suddenly still, carrying only the faint scent of baked earth and ancient copper as the great storm finally exhausts its fury across the salt-flats. You adjust your coat and take a deep, steadying breath, knowing the hardest part of the journey lies just ahead.

nodes.brief: Across a wide apron of smooth white flagstones, you stride away from the scouring gale toward the quiet shadow of the observatory.

exits.label: Climb the broad flight of limestone steps
Follow the curving shadow of the retaining wall

nodes.title: The White Flagstones
nodes.page: Sunlight breaks through the fading yellow haze, striking a wide apron of smooth white flagstones that stretch toward the silent observatory. You stride away from the scouring gale, your boots clicking sharply against the sun-baked mineral crust. The air feels suddenly still here, smelling faintly of old stone and baked lime. At your hip the ember-lamp swings, its glow fading against the brightening noon.

nodes.brief: Within a ditch of fused slag-blocks, you shake the last stubborn grains of crystal dust from the folds of your tattered traveling cloak.

exits.label: Scramble up the crumbling embankment toward the upper terrace
Follow the narrow drainage conduit deeper into the shadows
Turn back toward the shelter of the outer dunes

nodes.title: The Fused Slag Ditch
nodes.page: Fine crystal dust clings to the wool of your tattered traveling cloak, and you pause within a shallow ditch of fused slag-blocks to shake out the stubborn grit. The storm's roar dwindles to a distant, hollow whistling among the glass ruins. Your shoulders ache from the long miles across the Basin, but the ceramic Seedkey rests cool and reassuring against your ribs. Two paths lie open before you through the rubble-strewn hollow.

nodes.brief: Beside a rusted sluice-gate wheel, you press your hand against the cold Seedkey and feel the vibration of distant subterranean machinery.

exits.label: Follow the iron conduit toward the upper galleries
Descend the steep maintenance ladder into the dark pits

nodes.title: The Rusted Sluice Wheel
nodes.page: Cold iron bites into your palm as you press your hand against a rusted sluice-gate wheel half-buried in salt-encrusted silt. Beneath your boots a deep vibration runs through the bedrock, the ancient pulse of subterranean machinery. The Seedkey warms slightly against your palm, responding to the hidden pulse of the vault far below. You can trace the iron conduit toward the upper galleries or descend into the dark machinery pits.

nodes.brief: Under a low lintel of dark basalt, a lone glasswright named Thistle signals with a brief flash of a mirror-shard that the path is clear.

exits.label: Step through the shadowed archway toward the inner portico
Ascend the winding maintenance stairs toward the archive tier
Turn back toward the safety of the outer cistern

nodes.title: The Basalt Lintel
nodes.page: Deep in the shadow of a low lintel of dark basalt, a lone glasswright named Thistle stands motionless with a small silvered mirror. A quick, blinding flash of reflected sunlight dances across the stone, signaling that the inner path is clear of patrol guards and drifting glass-dust. You nod in silent thanks, adjusting the strap of your ember-lamp as you step past the threshold. You can move deeper into the lower portico or climb the winding maintenance stairs.

nodes.brief: Across a ribbed terrace of old salt-pans, you leave the screaming mirror storm behind and step into the silent precinct of Prism's base.

exits.label: Walk around the western edge of the sunken basin
Cross the narrow stone bridge spanning the green water
Pick your way down the stepped ramp toward the lower vault doors

nodes.title: The Ribbed Salt-Terraces
nodes.page: Smooth ribbons of ancient salt-pans crunch softly underfoot as you leave the screaming mirror storm behind and cross into the silent precinct of Prism's base. Towering glass spires rise overhead like frozen lightning, catching the pale desert light and refracting it into shifting pools of violet and gold. Your breath comes easier now that the abrasive wind has died. Ahead, the terrace splits around a great sunken basin of stagnant green water.

nodes.brief: Within the shadow of Prism's massive cyclopean masonry, you steady your weary limbs and prepare to face the final gate of the vault.

exits.label: Approach the heavy bronze panels of the vault entrance

nodes.title: The Cyclopean Masonry
nodes.page: Massive blocks of cyclopean masonry loom overhead, casting long and cool shadows that offer immediate relief from the glaring salt-waste. You steady your weary limbs against the rough-hewn stone, feeling the immense weight of the observatory pressing down from the desert sky above. The final gate of the vault waits just around the corner, its heavy bronze panels scarred by centuries of wind and sand.

nodes.brief: Before the great bronze wicket of the Rain Vault, you hold up your steady ember-lamp to prove the flame survived the scouring Basin.

exits.label: Press on through the heavy bronze wicket

nodes.title: The Great Bronze Wicket
nodes.page: Heavy bronze rivets catch the amber glow as you stand before the great wicket of the Rain Vault, holding your lantern high to prove the flame survived the scouring Basin. The metal surface is cool and damp, weeping faint beads of condensation from the deep stone recesses. Within the massive frame, a deep mechanical click echoes through the dry air, acknowledging the presence of the Candlemere runner and the warmth of the living coal.

nodes.brief: Against the frost-etched panels of the inner door, you raise the heavy Seedkey as the air grows cool and damp with subterranean promise.

exits.label: Press on through the frost-etched panels

nodes.title: The Frost-Etched Panels
nodes.page: Frost-etched patterns swirl across the thick glass panels of the inner door, blooming under the influence of the cold air rising from the depths. You raise the heavy Seedkey toward the central depression, watching the pale ceramic material drink in the ambient chill. A low, musical hum vibrates through the frame as the ancient locks begin to shift and turn within their frozen housing.

nodes.brief: Between the towering pillars of the observatory, you watch the last swirls of mirror-dust settle into the cracks of the ancient flagstones.

exits.label: Press on between the towering basalt pillars

nodes.title: The Towering Pillars
nodes.page: Slender pillars of black basalt tower above you like ancient sentinels, framing the vaulted ceiling where the last swirls of mirror-dust slowly settle into the cracks of the flagstones. The air smells of damp earth and old iron, entirely cleansed of the stinging salt-grit that plagued your long march. You pause for a single heartbeat to catch your breath before the final descent into the mountain's heart.

nodes.brief: Upon the threshold of the deep seed-halls, you draw a long, clean breath of damp earth as your journey through the salt-waste ends.

exits.label: Press on into the vaulted seed-halls
Turn back toward the echoing pipe of the outer drainage

nodes.title: The Deep Seed-Halls
nodes.page: Cool, damp earth fills your lungs as you draw a long, clean breath upon the threshold of the deep seed-halls, knowing your grueling journey through the salt-waste has finally ended. Row upon row of sealed ceramic jars stretch away into the lantern-lit dark, holding the dormant harvests of a hundred vanished summers. Your fingers tighten around the Seedkey as the silence of the vault closes gently behind you.

nodes.brief: Racing recklessly through the heart of the mirror storm without shielding your face or lamp, you stumble into a sheer drop of broken glass and smash both your bones and your ember into useless dust.
nodes.title: The Glass Drop
nodes.page: Racing recklessly through the roaring heart of the mirror storm without shielding your face or your precious lamp, you stumble blindly into a sheer drop of broken glass and jagged shale. The air leaves your lungs in a sharp gasp as you fall, smashing both your brittle bones and your fragile ember into useless, silent dust upon the cruel floor below.

nodes.brief: Attempting to outrun the howling mirror storm without shielding your lamp, you stumble into a pit of razor-sharp cullet that drains your lifeblood in the dark.
nodes.title: The Glass Pit
nodes.page: Rushing blindly through the blinding tempest without cupping your precious lamp, your boot slips on the greasy rim of an ancient trench. You tumble heavily into a hidden nest of razor-sharp cullet, the jagged crystal shards biting deep into your limbs. The darkness closes in swiftly as your lifeblood warms the cold salt, and the wind howls a lonely dirge over your final resting place.

nodes.brief: Arrival in Prism: the observatory-city at the basin's heart: lens-halls, sentries of the Glasswrights, rivals arriving for the vault, the approach to the Rain Vault. The reader enters with several ways forward.

exits.label: Follow the lamp-lit road
Cut across the common ground

exits.intent: Ask the way of a stranger
exits.label: Ask the way of a stranger
Take the old drovers' track

nodes.title: The Heart of Prism
nodes.page: Rising from the flat expanse of the dried sea, Prism stands as an imposing maze of tilted lenses, basalt galleries, and quiet courtyards. Glasswright sentries flash warning codes from the upper parapets while rival claimants and weary wanderers crowd the lower approaches. Your journey has brought you to the doorstep of the legendary Rain Vault, and several distinct routes now open before you through the city's labyrinthine avenues.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Lens-Hall Door: the lens-hall maze; those with Calder have a guide who knows the Glasswright maintenance ways, those without must improvise

exits.intent: Calder knows the way through the lens-hall
exits.label: Calder knows the way through the lens-hall

exits.intent: Find your own way through the lens-hall
exits.label: Find your own way through the lens-hall

nodes.title: The Maze of Lenses
nodes.page: Mandatory scene at the Lens-Hall Door: the lens-hall maze; those with Calder have a guide who knows the Glasswright maintenance ways, those without must improvise. Shifting arrays of magnifying glass and silvered plates stretch out ahead like a labyrinth of mirrors, reflecting your single ember-lamp into a thousand anxious duplicates. Every path splits into confusing angles of refraction where a single misstep could send you stumbling into a drop or tripping an acoustic wire.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Sentry Terrace: Glasswright sentries on a terrace; those who learned the signals can talk their way past, the rest must sneak or bluff

exits.label: Answer the sentries in mirror-signal
Slip past the sentries unseen

nodes.title: The Sentry Terrace
nodes.page:
The wind whips across the vast expanse of the Sentry Terrace, carrying the metallic tang of heated brass and old glass. Ahead, the observation gates block the path toward the heart of Prism, manned by vigilant Glasswrights whose mirrors click like beetles in the dry air. You stand before the watchers' shimmering net, ready to talk your way through if your preparations hold, or to slip past on stealth alone if they do not.

The air is heavy with tension as you weigh your options against the relentless glare of the midday sun.

nodes.brief: Leaving Prism for The Rain Vault: close this part of the journey.

exits.label: Go on into the vaults

nodes.title: Leaving the Observatory
nodes.page:
Leaving Prism for the Rain Vault, you close this part of your long journey and look ahead to the dark chambers waiting beneath the ruined city. The heavy doors swing inward with a low, groaning scrape of ancient bronze upon stone, welcoming the draft of cool, damp air that pours upward from the deep seed halls. Every footstep echoes hollowly against the ribbed vaults as you leave the dry, sun-baked surface world behind you for good.

Below your boots, the hidden maze of the old reservoir stretches out in absolute silence, holding the forgotten wealth of a hundred dead towns in its stone bins. Your lantern beam cuts a narrow yellow lane through the clinging mist, guiding your hand toward the final doors that hold the survival of Candlemere.

nodes.brief: Beneath the cracked dome of the Outer Gallery, you dodge falling splinters of solar glass while Salt Court assessors bicker over land claims.

exits.label: Dodge beneath the crumbling archway
Slip past the bickering taxmen
Climb the shadowed stairs ahead

nodes.title: The Outer Gallery
nodes.page: Splinters of solar glass rain down from the cracked dome of the Outer Gallery, shattering into bright dust upon the ancient flagstones. Below the falling debris, sleek Salt Court assessors cluster in heated debate over old property deeds and basin boundaries. You keep your head low, hugging your hooded coat tight against the grit while searching for a clear path away from their grasping arguments.

nodes.brief: Among the frozen sun-dials of the North Vestibule, a Glasswright sentinel flashes mirror codes that warn of rising basin tides and closed gates.

exits.privWhy: the reader carries the glass-burn scar that marks them as one who crossed the Storm
exits.label: Show your glass-burn mark to the sentinel
Cross the courtyard of mirrors
Enter the scriptorium choked with drift-sand

nodes.title: The North Vestibule
nodes.page: Frost-rimed sun-dials cast long, unmoving shadows across the white stone of the North Vestibule, untouched by any warmth for years. High above on the iron balconies, a Glasswright sentinel flashes sharp mirror codes that warn of rising basin tides and heavily bolted gates. The air smells of old copper and ozone, urging you to choose your next direction before the signals shift and seal the approaches.

nodes.brief: Within the dusty cistern ring, you share stale water with Calder while heavy basalt drums signal the arrival of rival salt-tolls at the gatehouse.

exits.label: Search the sand-choked scriptorium
Cross the swaying rope bridge
Seek the wounded sentry near the spire

nodes.title: The Cistern Ring
nodes.page: Stale water from your skin tastes of copper and dust as you share a quiet moment with Calder within the echoing stone cistern ring. Heavy basalt drums begin to thump from the outer gatehouse, signaling the arrival of impatient rival salt-tolls eager to stake their claims. Calder flashes a dry, knowing grin and checks the strap of his digging pack, waiting to see which way you will turn.

nodes.brief: Beside a colossal fractured objective lens, a Dune Sister trades shelter for your pledge while distant mirrors catch the glare of approaching scavengers.

exits.label: Seek the wounded sentry near the spire
Join Calder beneath the meridian porch
Head toward the western basalt bulwark

nodes.title: The Fractured Lens
nodes.page: Colossal shards of a fractured objective lens lean against one another like fallen monoliths, casting distorted reflections across the dry ground. A Dune Sister waits quietly in their blue shade, offering safe shelter if you will only swear a binding oath to her well-keepers. In the distance, the greedy glare of approaching scavenger lanterns flickers across the salt-crust, leaving little time for hesitation.

nodes.brief: Under the low lintel of the Sundered Portico, you squeeze past rusted winch gears while salt-inspectors demand immediate tax on your ceramic key.

exits.label: Peer through the copper wall slit

exits.privWhy: the reader believes the vault is still full and acts on it
exits.label: Stride boldly past the nervous checkpoint

nodes.title: The Sundered Portico
nodes.page: Rusted winch gears groan overhead as you squeeze yourself through the low, sagging lintel of the Sundered Portico. Salt-inspectors immediately step forward from the shadows, demanding an exorbitant immediate tax on the cold ceramic key hidden in your pack. Their greedy fingers hover near their brass scales, ready the moment a coin shows.

nodes.brief: In the whistling acoustic corridor of the Whispering Arch, shifting wind drafts threaten to blow out your banked ember-lamp before you find shelter.

exits.label: Enter the great hall of the star-clock
Head toward the frozen light-well cascade
Seek shelter beneath the colonnade ribs

nodes.title: The Whispering Arch
nodes.page: Shifting wind drafts shriek through the narrow limestone flutes of the Whispering Arch, threatening to snuff out your banked ember-lamp with a single violent gust. You cup your hand desperately around the dying coals, shielding the weak red glow while you search for a pocket of calm air. The ancient stonework vibrates around you like a tuning fork struck by a heavy mallet.

nodes.brief: Amidst heaps of discarded optical glass in the Shard Pit, an old lens-grinder offers a forged pass in exchange for a pinch of precious salt.

exits.label: Enter the great hall of the star-clock
Head toward the frozen light-well cascade

nodes.title: The Shard Pit
nodes.page: Piles of discarded optical glass crunch and shift underfoot within the deep hollow of the Shard Pit, glittering balefully in the dim light. An old lens-grinder crouches amidst the jagged heaps, holding up a crudely forged pass and whispering an offer to trade it for a pinch of your precious salt. The air smells of fine silica dust and dry alkali.

nodes.brief: Your salt-blistered arm catches a beam from the high beacons, prompting an awed sentry to unlock a hidden service hatch for you.

exits.label: Descend into the frozen light well
Seek the colonnade where the singing pillar hums
Check the ceramic key in the keeper vestibule

priv.why: the reader carries the glass-burn scar that marks them as one who crossed the Storm

nodes.title: The Glass-Burn Hatch
nodes.page:
Your salt-blistered arm catches a beam from the high beacons, exposing the iridescent web of glass-burn scars left by your old crossing of the Storm. The sentry standing watch near the limestone pilasters draws in a sharp, startled breath, recognizing the mark of the wasteland survivors upon your skin. Without a word, he throws his weight against a concealed bronze lever, sliding open a hidden service hatch that drops away into the cool gloom beneath Prism.

You grip your banked ember-lamp tightly against your chest, stepping past the iron-bound frame before the heavy latch can swing shut again.

nodes.brief: Beside a dry bronze fountain in the Courtyard of Mirrors, rival toll-agents trade loud insults while guarding the main avenue to the observatory.

exits.label: Slip past the keeper vestibule while they argue
Crawl beneath the terrace of singing mirrors

nodes.title: The Courtyard of Mirrors
nodes.page:
Beside a dry bronze fountain in the sun-baked Courtyard of Mirrors, rival toll-agents trade loud, venomous insults while guarding the main avenue that leads up to the observatory. They wear heavy brass badges of the Salt Court, their tempers fraying under the relentless noon glare and the bitter knowledge that every runner in the Basin is hunting for the Rain Vault. You pull your cloak tighter around your shoulders, keeping your banked ember-lamp hidden from their greedy eyes as you weigh your next move.

The stone beneath your boots radiates trapped heat, shimmering with mirages of cool water that vanish the moment you blink.

nodes.brief: Inside a ruined scriptorium choked with drift-sand, you decipher ancient glass-charts detailing the underground service conduits beneath the high lens-halls.

exits.label: Crawl across the blinding terrace of singing mirrors
Meet Calder near the collapsed solar furnace
Enter the chilly crypt of the lens-founders

nodes.title: The Scriptorium of Charts
nodes.page:
Inside a ruined scriptorium choked with shifting drift-sand, you decipher ancient glass-charts detailing the underground service conduits that spider-web beneath the high lens-halls. The parchment crumbles to grey dust under your calloused fingertips, but the scratched lines of the master draftsman remain clear enough to trace by the orange glow of your banked ember-lamp. You trace a narrow tunnel route with your thumb, knowing it could bypass every major checkpoint if the masonry hasn't collapsed.

Somewhere above your head, heavy boots crunch against loose shards of optical glass, reminding you that you are not alone in these hollow halls.

nodes.brief: Across the swaying rope bridge of the Great Void, a nervous Salt Court clerk drops his ledgers into the salt-crust far below.

exits.label: Dodge the iron chains in the salt-encrusted vault
Descend into the chilly crypt of the lens-founders

nodes.title: The Swaying Bridge
nodes.page:
Across the swaying rope bridge of the Great Void, a nervous Salt Court clerk drops his heavy ledgers into the yawning salt-crust far below, watching them spiral down like wounded birds. The hemp cables groan under your weight as a sudden gust of wind from the Basin sweeps through the gorge, threatening to tear your banked ember-lamp from your aching fingers. You steady your balance against the fraying guide-rope, breathing in the scent of hot iron and old dust.

On the far side of the abyss, carved basalt archways lead deeper into the stone heart of Prism.

nodes.brief: Beneath the towering prismatic spire, a wounded Glasswright sentinel presses a singing prism into your palm before sliding into unconsciousness.

exits.label: Advance into the salt-encrusted ceiling vault
Search near the broken sluice-gates of the Lower Basin

nodes.title: The Sentinel's Gift
nodes.page:
Beneath the towering prismatic spire, a wounded Glasswright sentinel presses a singing prism into your palm before sliding into quiet unconsciousness against the cool stone skirting. The small crystal vibrates faintly against your calloused skin, humming with a pure, sorrowful note that seems to chase away the ringing in your ears. Your banked ember-lamp casts long, dancing shadows across his grease-stained tunic as you check for a pulse.

The corridor stretches onward into deep darkness, framed by shattered panels of stained window-glass.

nodes.brief: Within the cool shade of the Meridian Porch, you trade flat remarks with Calder about the strange silence echoing from the inner vaults.

exits.label: Enter the cedar-lined alcove of the archive
Cross the open floor of the great refractor

nodes.title: The Meridian Porch
nodes.page:
Within the cool shade of the Meridian Porch, you trade flat remarks with Calder about the strange silence echoing from the inner vaults where the water-halls ought to be roaring. He flicks a pebble off the stone balustrade, watching it bounce across the glaring white flats far below with a dry, humorless smirk. Your banked ember-lamp smokes gently in the draft, smelling of old peat and sulfur.

A narrow doorway opens behind the stone pillars, leading toward the heart of the observatory.

nodes.brief: Near the western basalt bulwark, a group of tired well-keepers light a small signal fire to guide their straggling companions through the blinding glare.

exits.label: Cross the open floor toward the great refractor

nodes.title: The Western Bulwark
nodes.page:
Near the western basalt bulwark, a group of tired well-keepers light a small signal fire to guide their straggling companions through the blinding glare of the afternoon salt flats. The acrid smell of burning camel-dung mingles with the sharp tang of the dry basin wind, stinging your watering eyes. You keep your head down, clutching your banked ember-lamp close to your ribs so its amber glow won't attract unwanted questions from the guardians of the well-network.

The shadow of the massive basalt wall offers a brief respite from the murderous sun.

nodes.brief: Through a narrow maintenance slit in the copper wall, you peer into a chamber where salt-lords argue over forged keys and hollow promises.

exits.label: Climb down the steep stairs of the ocular tower
Turn back toward the fractured lens and the dune sister

nodes.title: The Maintenance Slit
nodes.page:
Through a narrow maintenance slit in the copper wall, you peer into a tense chamber where salt-lords argue over forged keys and hollow promises of rain-taxes. Their embroidered robes are stiff with dried sweat and encrusted alkali, their voices sharp and desperate as they bicker over who holds the true claim to the vault. You press your shoulder against the cold metal plating, holding your breath so your banked ember-lamp doesn't give away your hiding spot in the shadows.

The corridor behind you stretches back toward the dusty stairwells of the lower rings.

nodes.brief: Believing the vault holds untouched rains, you stride boldly past a nervous checkpoint while guards mistake your absolute certainty for royal authority.

exits.label: Ascend the steep spiral stairs of the ocular tower
Enter the vaulted hall of tides and singing pipes

priv.why: the reader believes the vault is still full and acts on it

nodes.title: The Vault of Certainty
nodes.page:
Believing with absolute, unshakable conviction that the Rain Vault still holds deep, untouched water for Candlemere, you stride boldly past a nervous checkpoint without breaking your stride. The guards mistake your absolute certainty and upright posture for royal authority, stepping back and lowering their pikes as if you belong to the long-dead priesthood of the Lensfolk. Your banked ember-lamp swings at your side, warm light washing the grey stone walls.

Ahead of you, a heavy bronze portal stands slightly ajar, welcoming your approach.

nodes.brief: Within the echoing vault of the Star-Clock, brass cogs the size of cartwheels grind to a sudden halt under a drift of dry salt.

exits.label: Climb the steep stairs of the ocular tower
Walk toward the hall of tides and singing pipes
Cross the threshold of the warm amber gallery

nodes.title: The Star-Clock
nodes.page:
Within the echoing vault of the Star-Clock, massive brass cogs the size of cartwheels grind to a sudden, permanent halt under a heavy drift of dry white salt. The silence that follows is absolute, broken only by the faint ticking of your own pulse and the steady heat radiating from your banked ember-lamp. You trace the rim of a frozen gear, feeling the grit of centuries grinding beneath your thumb.

Three distinct archways lead away from the silent machinery into the dim bowels of the observatory.

nodes.brief: Beside the frozen cascade of the Light-Well, a desperate rival drops his water-skin and begs you for a share of your canteen.

exits.privWhy: the reader carries the glass-burn scar that marks them as one who crossed the Storm
exits.label: Inspect the hidden spring-latch beneath your scarred forearm
Step past the pleading traveler toward the astronomer crypt

nodes.title: The Light-Well Cascade
nodes.page: Frost-white crust flakes away from the frozen cascade of the Light-Well, where a rival traveler drops a cracked water-skin onto the flags and begs hoarsely for a single draught from your canvas canteen. Heat radiates upward from the fused glass floor, making the distant columns shiver in the glare. You clutch your banked coal-lantern closer against your hip while weighing the dry plea against your own dwindling reserves for the road ahead.

nodes.brief: Under the arched ribs of the Great Colonnade, a blind Glasswright tunes a singing pillar whose clear note masks the rumble of distant tremors.

exits.label: Step into the shadowed crypt
Inspect the abandoned clockwork ledger
Watch the distant dust storms

nodes.title: The Singing Pillar
nodes.page:
Under the arched ribs of the Great Colonnade, a blind Glasswright tunes a singing pillar whose clear note masks the rumble of distant tremors. The stone floor vibrates beneath your boots as the pitch climbs higher, grinding the salt encrustations on the capitals into a fine, shimmering powder. The air tastes of ozone and old dust, thick with the tension of the ancient observatory settling into its final age.

With the ground beginning to pulse more sharply beneath your feet, you weigh your options among the shadowed archways.

nodes.brief: In the cramped vestibule of the Prism-Keeper, old ledgers flutter in the draft while you check your ceramic key for hairline fractures.

exits.label: Seek the quiet shadows of the astronomer crypt
Inspect the abandoned ledger beside the clockwork gears
Watch the gathering storms through the high clerestory windows

nodes.title: The Prism-Keeper Vestibule
nodes.page: Yellowed ledgers flutter wildly in a sudden draft inside the cramped vestibule of the Prism-Keeper, smelling sharply of old paper and dried ink. You pull the cold ceramic key from your tunic pouch, turning it over in your palm to inspect the fine hairline fractures threatening its length. Outside this narrow shelter, the vast glare of the salt flats presses hard against the leaded windowpanes.

nodes.brief: Across the terrace of singing mirrors, sudden blinding sun-flashes from the sentry towers force you to crawl blindly along the scorching flagstones.

exits.label: Seek refuge within the shadowed astronomer crypt
Watch the distant storms from the high clerestory
Descend into the narrow conduit beneath the refracting floor

nodes.title: The Terrace of Mirrors
nodes.page: Blinding sun-flashes lance across the open terrace of singing mirrors from the high sentry towers, forcing you to drop and crawl awkwardly along the scorching flagstones. The heat radiating off the polished glass plates threatens to blister your knuckles through your leather gloves. Every movement must be timed between the rhythmic sweeps of light sweeping across the blinding white expanse.

nodes.brief: Within the shadow of a collapsed solar furnace, Calder cleans grit from his glass-diver goggles while warning you of traps in the floor.

exits.label: Inspect the silent bronze gears
Slip into the narrow conduit
Enter the frescoed hall of rains

nodes.title: The Solar Furnace
nodes.page:
Within the shadow of a collapsed solar furnace, Calder cleans grit from his glass-diver goggles while warning you of traps in the floor. His copper-rimmed tool clicks softly against the stone as he gestures toward hairline fractures spreading across the tiled pavement ahead. Scorched brass and dry earth scent the ruin, broken only by drips of unseen condensation from the higher tiers.

You grip your banked coal-lantern tighter as you consider the safest way forward through the hazard.

nodes.brief: Beneath a vaulted ceiling encrusted with salt crystals, you dodge heavy iron chains dropped by rival agents from the upper catwalks.

exits.label: Crawl through the dripping conduit
Cross the courtyard of the broken sundial
Turn back toward the fractured lens

nodes.title: The Falling Chains
nodes.page:
Beneath a vaulted ceiling encrusted with salt crystals, you dodge heavy iron chains dropped by rival agents from the upper catwalks. The thick links strike the glass-paved floor with deafening smashes, sending sharp shards spraying into the dim air like freezing stars. Your ember-lamp casts long, frantic shadows against the fluted pillars as you duck behind a thick basalt buttress for shelter.

The metallic echoes fade slightly, leaving you with three distinct paths through the chaotic chamber.

nodes.brief: Inside the chilly crypt of the Lens-Founders, your ember-lamp flickers over stone effigies holding empty bronze bowls that once caught dew.

exits.label: Proceed toward the frescoed hall
Pry open the jammed service hatch

nodes.title: The Crypt of Founders
nodes.page:
Inside the chilly crypt of the Lens-Founders, your ember-lamp flickers over stone effigies holding empty bronze bowls that once caught dew. The dead faces of the ancient opticians gaze blankly upward into the gloom, untouched by the growing heat of the approaching monsoon. A thin crust of white mineral coats their heavy robes, making the statues look like they are carved from solid salt rather than basalt.

You pause among the silent figures, weighing the passages that branch away from the cold vault.

nodes.brief: Near the broken sluice-gates of the Lower Basin, frantic diggers shovel white crust in a vain search for hidden emergency drainage pipes.

exits.label: Force open the jammed service hatch
Approach the smoldering threshold

nodes.title: The Broken Sluices
nodes.page:
Near the broken sluice-gates of the Lower Basin, frantic diggers shovel white crust in a vain search for hidden emergency drainage pipes. Their shovels scrape harshly against the fused glass floor, kicking up choking clouds of dry alkaline dust that catch in your throat. Around them, the ancient ironwork groans under the immense pressure of the dry earth above, threatening to give way at any moment.

With the laborers too frantic to notice your passing, you look for a clear route away from the excavation.

nodes.brief: Within the fragrant cedar-lined alcove of the Archive, a nervous clerk tries to bribe you with dried fruit to hand over your seedkey.

exits.label: Walk down the empty Meridian Gallery
Approach the smoking inner threshold
Turn back toward the outer dome

nodes.title: The Cedar Alcove
nodes.page:
Within the fragrant cedar-lined alcove of the Archive, a nervous clerk tries to bribe you with dried fruit to hand over your seedkey. His fingers twitch continuously against the folds of his salt-stained tunic as he glances anxiously toward the vaulted ceiling, terrified of the rival factions roaming the halls. The sweet, shriveled figs smell strongly of sugar and dust, offering a tempting contrast to the bitter journey ahead.

You step back from the outstretched palm, keeping your hand firmly on the cold ceramic key in your pouch.

nodes.brief: Across the open floor of the Great Refractor, converging flash-signals from hidden sentry nests force you to seek immediate stone cover.

exits.label: Slip toward the heavy bronze valves
Dash for the smoking basalt threshold

nodes.title: The Great Refractor
nodes.page:
Across the open floor of the Great Refractor, converging flash-signals from hidden sentry nests force you to seek immediate stone cover. Brilliant beams of reflected sunlight sweep the polished glass tiles like searching fingers, turning the dust motes into burning sparks. You flatten yourself against a low marble plinth while the signals stutter in their frantic, complex code above your head.

With the blinding light washing over the open floor, you need to choose your next movement carefully.

nodes.brief: Down the steep spiral stairs of the Ocular Tower, iron handrails burn hot from the relentless noon glare striking the upper domes.

exits.label: Approach the towering double iron gates
Enter the lamp-keepers vaulted vestibule
Turn back across the rope bridge

nodes.title: The Ocular Stair
nodes.page: Down the steep spiral stairs of the Ocular Tower, iron handrails burn hot from the relentless noon glare striking the upper domes. Every footstep echoes hollowly against the curved basalt masonry, carrying the faint scent of baked dust and ancient mortar. Below you, the staircase plunges deeper into shadow, while above, blinding shafts of sunlight pierce through narrow arrow-slits. You clutch your banked coal-lantern tighter, feeling the weight of the cold ceramic seedkey pressing against your ribs as you weigh your next descent.

nodes.brief: Inside the vaulted Hall of Tides, a chorus of singing glass pipes swells into a deafening tone that rattles your teeth.

exits.label: Push toward the obsidian sanctuary gates
Sprint along the sweeping upper gallery

nodes.title: The Singing Pipes
nodes.page: Inside the vaulted Hall of Tides, a chorus of singing glass pipes swells into a deafening tone that rattles your teeth. Long tubes of tuned quartz, hung from the vaulted ceiling by copper wire, vibrate with the thermal updrafts rising from the dry basin floor. You press your palms against your ears, navigating the quivering stone pavement while the high-pitched harmonic wail threatens to overwhelm your thoughts. Two distinct routes present themselves through the ringing din, offering a way onward.

nodes.brief: Across the threshold of the Amber Gallery, thick curtains of woven hemp trap the dry heat while salt-lords negotiate behind closed cedar doors.

exits.label: Seek shelter in the lens-keepers vestibule
Hurry past the upper gallery approach

nodes.title: The Amber Gallery
nodes.page: Across the threshold of the Amber Gallery, thick curtains of woven hemp trap the dry heat while salt-lords negotiate behind closed cedar doors. Muffled voices murmur in low, transactional tones, haggling over future water rights and vault shares as if the monsoon were already a commodity to be bought and sold. You slip quietly past the velvet drapes, keeping your shadow pressed against the wood-paneled walls. Ahead, the corridor splits, leading deeper into the heart of the observatory complex.

nodes.brief: The jagged glass-burn scar on your forearm catches the low-angle prism light, illuminating a hidden spring-latch on the heavy brass door.

exits.label: Step through toward the obsidian gates
Descend into the flickering lamp-keepers hall

priv.why: the reader carries the glass-burn scar that marks them as one who crossed the Storm

nodes.title: The Scars Legacy
nodes.page: The jagged glass-burn scar on your forearm catches the low-angle prism light, illuminating a hidden spring-latch on the heavy brass door. You remember the howling tempests of the crossing, the shrieking shards that bit deep into your skin when you traversed the outer wastes alone. The panel clicks open under your thumb, revealing a concealed service chamber smelling of ozone and old tallow. Two pathways lie beyond the hidden threshold, waiting in the stillness.

nodes.brief: Within the shadowed crypt of the First Astronomer, dust motes dance in the amber beam of your banked coal-lantern.

exits.label: Proceed toward the obsidian sanctuary doors
Follow the agents along the upper curve
Turn back toward the western bulwark

nodes.title: The First Astronomer
nodes.page: Within the shadowed crypt of the First Astronomer, dust motes dance in the amber beam of your banked coal-lantern. Stone effigies with polished quartz eyes stare mutely into the vaulted gloom, their carved hands resting on cracked celestial globes. The air here is dead and cold, untouched by the desert winds howling outside the thick observatory walls. You can retrace your steps to safety, or press forward into the complex.

nodes.brief: Beside the silent bronze gears of the great clockwork, a discarded Salt Court ledger lies open to pages smeared with dried brine.

exits.label: Head for the towering obsidian gates
Take the upper gallery toward the center
Squeeze into the low maintenance tunnel

nodes.title: The Clockwork Ledger
nodes.page: Beside the silent bronze gears of the great clockwork, a discarded Salt Court ledger lies open to pages smeared with dried brine. Columns of neat figures detail the mounting debts of desperate lamp-towns, trading entire seasonal harvests for a single trickle of well-water. The colossal brass cogs around you loom like sleeping teeth, locked fast by decades of desert dust and neglect. You step past the iron machinery toward the paths that narrow ahead.

nodes.brief: Through the high clerestory windows of the North Scriptorium, you watch distant dust storms sweep across the pale bed of the dead sea.

exits.label: Crawl through the low maintenance conduit
Enter the cooling chambers of the furnace

nodes.title: The North Scriptorium
nodes.page: Through the high clerestory windows of the North Scriptorium, you watch distant dust storms sweep across the pale bed of the dead sea. Desolate white flats stretch toward the hazy horizon, swallowing the landmarks of the old world beneath shifting drifts of alkali. Down on the writing desks, scattered sheets of vellum curl upward in the dry heat, abandoned by clerks who fled before the rising heat. Two egresses lead away from the high desk-halls into the darker stonework.

nodes.brief: In the narrow conduit beneath the refracting floor, dripping condensation feeds tiny clusters of pale salt-ferns clinging to damp stone.

exits.label: Climb toward the sweeping upper gallery
Drop into the solar furnace chambers
Watch the mirror-flashes on the tiered balconies

nodes.title: The Salt Ferns
nodes.page: In the narrow conduit beneath the refracting floor, dripping condensation feeds tiny clusters of pale salt-ferns clinging to damp stone. The air tastes of wet lime and iron rust, a rare coolness in a city built entirely of sun-baked glass and stone. Your boots splash softly in the shallow runoff puddle as you duck beneath low overhead cables. Ahead, the conduit branches into three distinct directions, each marked by the faint hum of distant machinery.

nodes.brief: Across the courtyard of the broken sundial, an old scavenger shouts warnings about unstable glass bridges spanning the inner chasm.

exits.label: Seek refuge in the solar furnace cooling rooms
Join Calder by the deep dry observatory well

nodes.title: The Broken Sundial
nodes.page: Across the courtyard of the broken sundial, an old scavenger shouts warnings about unstable glass bridges spanning the inner chasm. Shards of multicolored pavement crunch beneath your boots as you navigate the cracked stone dial, its bronze gnomon pointing at an empty sky. The yawning drop of the chasm splits the observatory grounds, spanned only by precarious ribbons of fused silica and rusted iron.

nodes.brief: Within the frescoed hall of the Seven Rains, flaking plaster reveals faded murals of green valleys that have not seen water for centuries.

exits.label: Climb down beside Calder at the dry well

nodes.title: The Seven Rains
nodes.page: Within the frescoed hall of the Seven Rains, flaking plaster reveals faded murals of green valleys that have not seen water for centuries. Painted rivers wind through cobalt hills while crimson-robed figures offer clay pitchers to an azure sky that will never open again. The dry air is heavy with the scent of ancient plaster dust settling on your shoulders. At the far end of the muraled hall, a single iron ladder descends into the lower workings.

nodes.brief: Near the heavy bronze valves of the lower conduits, Calder uses a copper wedge to pry open a jammed service hatch.

exits.label: Crawl through the salt-choked drainage pipe
Follow the soot-blackened catwalk toward the light
Squeeze into the cramped junction box of the brass conduits

nodes.title: The Copper Wedge
nodes.page:
Heavy bronze valves of the lower conduits sweat with ancient damp, casting a metallic tang into the stagnant air. Beside a rusted hatch, Calder drives a copper wedge into the jammed seam with steady, practiced strikes of a mallet. Metal groans against metal, spraying a fine rust across his scarred knuckles as the seal finally gives way with a sharp hiss.

Beyond the widening gap, two distinct routes beckon into the dim interior: one dips sharply downward into a narrow drainage pipe choked with white salt crusts, while the other leads along a soot-blackened catwalk toward a flickering lantern.

nodes.brief: Under the vaulted roof of the Meridian Gallery, your footsteps echo hollowly among rows of empty stone plinths that once held celestial spheres.

exits.label: Climb the steep spiral staircase into the drafts
Descend into the low-slung tunnel of darkness

nodes.title: The Meridian Gallery
nodes.page:
Vaulted stone ribs of the Meridian Gallery cage the silence, where your footsteps ring hollowly against empty marble floors. Long rows of vacant stone plinths stretch into the gloom like broken teeth, once holding celestial spheres that mapped a wetter sky. Dust motes dance lazily in stray beams of pale light slicing through high, grease-filmed clerestory windows.

Two narrow arches pierce the far wall, offering a choice between a steep spiral stair climbing upward into the drafts or a low-slung tunnel descending into darkness.

nodes.brief: Beside the great basalt threshold of the inner vault, a dropped lantern smolders in a puddle of spilled oil, fouling the dry air.

exits.label: Scramble up the narrow stone ledge to the left
Squeeze past the smoking wreckage into the gloom

nodes.title: The Basalt Threshold
nodes.page:
Basalt blocks of the inner threshold loom cold and massive, framing a scene of careless ruin. A dropped merchant lantern sputters in a shallow puddle of spilled lamp-oil, sending greasy black smoke curling up toward the blackened lintel and fouling the dry, breathless air. The glass fragments crunch underfoot like crushed eggshells as you step closer to the heavy iron barrier.

You can either skirt the burning oil by climbing a narrow ledge to the left or squeeze past the smoking wreckage straight ahead into the gloom.

nodes.brief: Through the narrow gap of the double iron gates, you glimpse the towering obsidian face of the ultimate sanctuary door.

exits.label: Push open the heavy double iron gates

nodes.title: The Obsidian Face
nodes.page:
Narrow bars of the double iron gates frame a terrifying vista of absolute shadow and looming stone. Towering above the threshold, the sheer obsidian face of the ultimate sanctuary door absorbs the meager light of your lamp without a single reflection. Faint scratching sounds echo from somewhere deep within the black stone, as though unseen claws test the ancient latches.

The barrier blocks further progress, and only one narrow way remains open through the gates.

nodes.brief: Inside the vaulted vestibule of the Lens-Keepers, flickering oil lamps cast long dancing shadows across rows of silent observation desks.

exits.label: Open the heavy oak portal bound in iron straps
Crawl through the low service hatch behind the cabinet

nodes.title: The Lens-Keepers' Vestibule
nodes.page:
Vaulted plaster walls of the Lens-Keepers' vestibule harbor a restless, flickering warmth from unattended oil lamps left burning on high desks. Long, dancing shadows stretch across rows of silent observation chairs, their leather seats cracked and gray with decades of accumulated desert dust. Parchment maps curl up at the edges on every table, their ink faded to the color of dried tea.

Two doors lead deeper into the silent complex: one heavy oak portal bound in iron straps, and a low service hatch half-concealed behind a stacked cabinet.

nodes.brief: Across the sweeping curve of the Upper Gallery, rival agents rush toward the central approach while their heavy boots crunch on salt.

exits.label: Confront the rushing rival agents head-on
Dive sideways into a shadowed stone alcove

nodes.title: The Upper Gallery Curve
nodes.page: Sweeping curves of the Upper Gallery vibrate with the frantic scuffle of heavy boots grinding salt crystals into powder. Rival agents emerge from the side corridors, their breath ragged and their eyes fixed entirely on the monumental goal ahead. Every footfall echoes off the high vaulted ceiling, announcing their desperate rush toward the central approach.

nodes.brief: Beneath the massive hanging counterweights of the great lens, you scramble through a low maintenance tunnel to avoid patrolling sentries.

exits.label: Follow the narrow southern crawlspace toward the vault
Slide down the steep metal chute into the lower machinery
Pry open the overhead ventilation grate with your fingers

nodes.title: The Counterweight's Shadow
nodes.page:
Massive iron counterweights of the great lens swing overhead with a slow, rhythmic groan that shakes the dust from the ceiling rafters. Ducking low beneath the dangling chains, you scramble through a cramped maintenance tunnel designed to keep runners hidden from patrolling sentries. The air tastes of hot machine grease and old stone.

The crawlspace branches ahead into distinct channels leading toward different sectors of the inner sanctum.

nodes.brief: Within the cooling chambers of the solar furnace, thick stone walls muffle the howling wind that sweeps across the dead basin floor.

exits.label: Step through the archway leading to the open courtyard
Descend the iron ladder into the subterranean machinery room

nodes.title: The Solar Furnace
nodes.page:
Thick stone walls of the solar furnace muffle the relentless howl of the desert wind sweeping across the dead basin floor. Residual heat still radiates from the massive copper parabolic mirrors, baking the air until your skin prickles with dry sweat. Cinders of long-burned charcoal crunch softly beneath your boots in the center of the vast chamber.

Two exit arches puncture the thick masonry, one leading toward the open courtyards and the other plunging into the subterranean machinery rooms.

nodes.brief: Beside the deep dry well of the observatory core, Calder tests the tension of a frayed winch rope with a skeptical frown.

exits.label: Walk the narrow stone ledge circling the abyss
Climb down the steep metal ladder into the dark
Hurry away along the wide corridor toward the outer halls

nodes.title: The Deep Dry Well
nodes.page:
Deep stone walls of the observatory core drop away into absolute darkness, smelling of ancient lime and damp earth. Beside the gaping rim of the dry well, Calder tests the tension of a frayed winch rope with a skeptical frown, his thumb pressing hard against the hemp fibers until they fray further. A single pebble dropped into the depths bounces silently against the dry stone walls.

Three paths branch out from the wellhead: a narrow stone ledge circling the abyss, a steep metal ladder descending into the dark, and a wide corridor leading toward the outer halls.

nodes.brief: Across the tiered stone balconies of the inner cylinder, sharp flashes of mirror signaling warn unauthorized climbers to halt immediately.

exits.label: Press flat against the inner wall to avoid the light
Dash swiftly across the exposed gap toward the doorway

nodes.title: The Tiered Balconies
nodes.page:
Tiered stone balconies of the inner cylinder vibrate underfoot as sharp, blinding flashes of mirror signaling slice across the open air. High above, Glasswright sentries wield polished brass heliographs, warning unauthorized climbers to halt immediately or face the consequences. The brilliant beams sweep back and forth across the white stone like accusing fingers.

You can either press yourself flat against the inner wall to avoid the blinding light or dash across the exposed gap toward the doorway opposite.

nodes.brief: Within the cramped junction box of the brass conduits, your cold ceramic key hums faintly as it comes close to the sealed vault mechanism.

exits.label: Force the rusted tumblers with a heavy iron wedge
Carefully slide the ceramic key into the central groove

nodes.title: The Brass Conduits
nodes.page: Inside the cramped junction box of the brass conduits, your cold ceramic key shivers faintly when it nears the sealed vault mechanism. The metal beneath your fingertips feels preternaturally cold, vibrating with a low, sub-audible thrum that echoes the approaching monsoon's distant drums. Around you, the dark machinery of Prism ticks and groans like a living creature waking from a century-long sleep.

nodes.brief: Before the towering bronze panels of the Lens-Hall Door, a intricate maze of interlocking optical gears blocks every straightforward approach.

exits.label: Press on by deciphering the geometric alignment marks

nodes.title: The Lens-Hall Door
nodes.page: Before the towering bronze panels of the Lens-Hall Door, an intricate maze of interlocking optical gears blocks every straightforward approach. Sunlight caught by distant rooftop mirrors strikes the polished metal face, casting blinding geometric patterns across the flagstones. Every cog and ratchet is fitted with mathematical precision, designed to lock out anyone who lacks the patience to decode its shifting equations.

nodes.brief: Facing the locked portals of the inner sanctum, Calder traces a forgotten Glasswright maintenance tunnel hidden behind a rusted brass grille.

exits.label: Press on through the hidden maintenance tunnel with Calder

nodes.title: The Hidden Grille
nodes.page: Facing the locked portals of the inner sanctum, Calder traces a forgotten Glasswright maintenance tunnel hidden behind a rusted brass grille. The air spilling from the dark aperture smells of ozone and ancient dry dust, promising a way around the impenetrable bronze barrier ahead. Your companion's fingers move with practiced ease, unlatching the corroded bolts without making a single sound.

nodes.brief: At the threshold of the massive lens-hall doors, you fumble with improvised tools while rival footsteps echo louder down the corridor behind you.

exits.label: Press on by forcing the stubborn latch despite the noise

nodes.title: The Fading Window
nodes.page: At the threshold of the massive lens-hall doors, you fumble with improvised tools while rival footsteps echo louder down the corridor behind you. The iron scraper in your hand slips against the grease-slicked brass, sending a sharp metallic ping ringing through the vaulted chamber. Time is running out as heavy boots draw nearer from the shadows of the lower stairwell.

nodes.brief: Standing before the heavy adamantine latch of the vault entrance, you raise your cold ceramic key as the great clockwork mechanism begins to groan.

exits.label: Press on into the cool mist of the vault interior

nodes.title: The Adamantine Latch
nodes.page: At the adamantine latch of the vault entrance you raise your cold ceramic key while the great clockwork mechanism begins to groan. Dark metal rings shift inside the wall and settle into a run of deep clicks that vibrate straight through your boots. The door eases outward and releases a gust of refrigerated air that smells faintly of rain and long-buried earth.

nodes.brief: In the humming blue gallery, Calder pries open a maintenance hatch while shifting lens-segments groan overhead.

exits.label: Follow Calder down the iron rungs
Leap across the open machinery pit
Squeeze past the jammed prism shutter

nodes.title: The Humming Blue Gallery
nodes.page: Massive lens-segments groan overhead like waking leviathans as Calder wedges a cold iron chisel into the maintenance hatch. Blue light filters through the vibrating glass floor, casting long, fractured shadows across your boots. Your ember-lamp rocks against your hip, its banked coals radiating a steady, familiar warmth against the chill of the observatory. With a sharp crack of rusted metal, the hatch gives way, venting a draft of dry, lime-scented air from the depths below.

nodes.brief: Beneath the fractured dome, you dodge a swinging focusing plate while groping for a hidden maintenance ladder.

exits.label: Crawl beneath the hanging green shards

exits.privWhy: the reader owes nobody and can bargain freely
exits.label: Slip through the forgotten side duct
Climb toward the abandoned observation ward

nodes.title: Beneath the Fractured Dome
nodes.page: Shards of green glass rain down in a silent cascade as a massive focusing plate swings overhead on rusted iron chains. You duck low, groping blindly along the damp stone wall until your fingers find the rusted rungs of a hidden maintenance ladder. The air smells of ozone and ancient dust, thick enough to coat your tongue. Above you, the fractured dome frames a sliver of blinding desert sky while the metal structure groans under the relentless desert heat.

nodes.brief: Calder leads you through a cool conduit where singing glass reverberates against your ribs with warning tones.

exits.label: Open the narrow service flue
Climb the sun-warmed spiral ramp
Force the warped bulkhead open

nodes.title: The Singing Glass Conduit
nodes.page: Resonant hums vibrate against your ribs, carrying warnings through the cool ceramic walls of the conduit. Calder moves ahead with silent surety, his boots skimming the smooth floor where ancient drafts carry the salt-scent of the Basin. Every surface carries an odd musical frequency, and your teeth ache slightly. The darkness ahead deepens, broken only by the faint, rhythmic pulse of your swinging ember-lamp.

nodes.brief: In a tilted mirror-vault, your guide spots a greasy grease-slick left by previous rivals scrambling upward.

exits.label: Pry open the deep cooling grate
Scramble across the green slag ridge
Slide through the narrow utility shaft

nodes.title: The Greasy Mirror-Vault
nodes.page: Tilting plates of polished glass reflect your distorted face a dozen times over in the dim light. Calder stops abruptly, pointing down at a smear of fresh oil left across the stone floor by earlier rivals scrambling upward. The air here is dead and heavy, smelling faintly of rendered fat and old salt. Your fingers tighten around your lamp handle as you weigh the treacherous footing against the need for haste.

nodes.brief: You squeeze past a jammed prism-shutter whose sharp edges threaten to sever your precious ember-lamp strap.

exits.label: Follow Calder along the scratched floor seam
Pry open the jammed louver to the glare
Crawl straight through the grease-stained iron gears

nodes.title: The Prism Shutter
nodes.page: Jagged teeth of fused quartz grip your ember-lamp's shoulder strap as you wedge your ribs through the narrow aperture. The metal frame groans under decades of desert expansion, threatening to slice the leather clean through and drop your only warmth into the dark. Beyond the obstruction, the corridor stretches into amber gloom, lit only by the faint, rhythmic pulse of distant signal-flashes dancing across the ceiling. Every breath tastes of old lime and dry heat.

nodes.brief: A collapsed ceiling of bottle-green cullet forces you to crawl beneath jagged pendants that swing like pendulums.

exits.label: Navigate through the rusted iron gear cluster
Toss a pebble to test the lower vault echo
Squeeze through the buckled copper frame
Push past the wind-blown salt dust on the ledge

nodes.title: The Green Cullet Ceiling
nodes.page: Bottle-green shards hang overhead like frozen icicles of glass, swinging with a faint, musical chime every time a draft sweeps through the cavity. You drop low onto your hands and knees, dragging your banked coal-lantern carefully behind you to avoid clipping the razor-sharp pendants. The floor beneath your palms is a mosaic of tiny, fused beads that roll and shift unpredictably, turning every inch of forward movement into a delicate exercise in balance.

nodes.brief: Unencumbered by debts or escorts, you spot a forgotten maintenance duct that bypasses the noisy main gear-room.

exits.label: Navigate the salt-dusted precipice ahead
Wedge a tool into the refractory brick wall
Scramble across the sliding glass shard floor

priv.why: the reader owes nobody and can bargain freely

nodes.title: The Unencumbered Vent
nodes.page: Carrying no heavy debts to the Salt Court and bound by no oaths to the Dune Sisters, you walk with a lighter, unburdened stride than any hired traveler. A clean, narrow maintenance duct opens directly beside your shoulder, entirely ignored by the heavily guarded main routes and free from the clanking noise of the central gear-rooms. The cool air drifting from the opening carries the faint, damp scent of deep stone and long-sealed cisterns.

nodes.brief: You stumble into an abandoned observatory ward where rusted brass rings obscure the upward escape route completely.

exits.label: Pry open the hidden telescope-cleaner passage
Cross the shifting floor of loose glass

exits.privWhy: the Seedkey is cracked and sings or fails near glass
exits.label: Follow the cold hum of the vibrating Seedkey
Duck beneath the swinging iron counterweight

nodes.title: The Brass Ring Ward
nodes.page: Heavy rings of tarnished brass interlock across the ceiling of the abandoned ward, forming a tangled web that completely blocks the upward climb. Your banked coal-lantern casts long, weaving shadows against the curved stone walls, where old charts of forgotten constellations peel away in dry curls. The air here is dead and thick with copper dust, making every inhalation burn the back of your throat.

nodes.brief: Calder taps a hollow ceramic flue, unlocking a narrow service chute that bypasses three patrols of nervous sentries.

exits.label: Slip past the dormant glass-eyed automaton
Descend into the dripping cistern-room

nodes.title: The Hollow Ceramic Flue
nodes.page: Sharp knuckle-taps echo softly against the baked clay as Calder locates the secret seam in the flue wall. With a sharp wrench, the ceramic panel slips inward, revealing a cramped vertical drop that completely bypasses three different sentry posts of the nervous Glasswrights. The darkness inside smells of cool soot and baked earth, offering a silent corridor away from watchful eyes.

nodes.brief: You climb a spiral ramp of fused sand while distant signal-flashes bounce blindingly off polished brass walls.

exits.label: Sneak past the silent guard automaton
Enter the damp and dripping cistern

nodes.title: The Fused Sand Ramp
nodes.page: Grit grinds beneath your boots as you push up the steep incline of fused sand, your muscles burning from the continuous upward slope. High above, polished brass walls catch the wandering signal-flashes from the observatory towers, throwing blinding arcs of golden light across your path. Every surface radiates the trapped heat of the midday sun, turning the enclosed ramp into a silent, shimmering oven.

nodes.brief: A rusted bulkhead blocks the ventilation conduit, demanding all your strength to force its warped hinges open.

exits.label: Push through the shifting glass pane

nodes.title: The Warped Bulkhead
nodes.page: Rust flakes drift down like red snow as you plant both feet against the bulkhead and throw your weight against the warped hinges. The metal screams in protest, resisting every fraction of an inch until the latch finally gives way with a sharp crack, admitting a rush of stale air from the hidden conduit beyond.

nodes.brief: Calder coaxes open a stubborn floor-grate, revealing a steep drop into the cooling flues of the great lens.

exits.label: Descend the steep flues into the darkness

exits.privWhy: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over
exits.label: Slip away to investigate the masonry draught alone

nodes.title: The Flue Drop
nodes.page: Rust flakes drift from the iron hinge as Calder drives the heel of his palm against the warped iron grille, coaxing the stubborn floor-grate upward with a dry shriek of metal. Beneath the gap lies a steep plunge into the dark, smelling sharply of baked soot and ancient lime where the cooling flues of the great lens funnel down toward the foundations. Your ember-lamp casts a weak, reddish glow over the soot-blackened brickwork, while the distant, hollow dripping of water echoes from somewhere far below. Calder wipes his grease-stained brow with a sleeve and gestures silently down into the shaft.

nodes.brief: You scramble over a ridge of fused green slag while distant foghorns moan across the empty salt basin.

exits.label: Tread lightly past the cascading glass beads
Pick your way through the maze of convex mirrors

nodes.title: The Slag Ridge
nodes.page: Jagged ribs of fused green slag tear at your boots as you scramble over the ridge, the glassy stone cooling into queer, twisted shapes beneath a pale, bleached sky. Across the empty salt basin, distant foghorns moan a low, mournful warning that vibrates in the hollows of your chest. The wind is picking up grit from the flats, hissing against your woollen coat and threatening to blow out your amber-lamp if you do not shield the iron door with your hand. You crouch behind a shattered parapet of old lens-glass to catch your breath and survey the jagged descent toward the observatory's lower tiers.

nodes.brief: In a narrow utility shaft, your shoulder bumps a hanging brass chime that reverberates like an alarm bell.

exits.privWhy: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over
exits.label: Slip away through the whispering wall fracture
Duck into the labyrinth of convex mirrors
Cross the crunching salt archive floor in haste

nodes.title: The Chime Shaft
nodes.page: Brass catches the point of your shoulder in the tight utility shaft and a sudden brazen chime rings off the curved brickwork with the persistence of an alarm bell. The metallic note hangs heavy in the confined air, vibrating against your ribs and dying away into a nervous silence that feels far too loud. You stand frozen in the gloom, clutching your banking coal-lantern tighter as dust motes swirl in the reddish light. The narrow passage splits ahead into several grim directions, each smelling of stale salt and old iron.

nodes.brief: Calder points out a faint scratch on the glass floor, marking the safe seam in a minefield of trapdoors.

exits.label: Slide along the outer wall
Step boldly across the etched seam

nodes.title: The Faint Scratch
nodes.page:
Fine crystalline dust cakes your collar as Calder crouches low, pointing a grimy finger toward a hair-thin arc etched into the gleaming floor. This faint scratch is the only visible boundary marking a treacherous minefield of rusted trapdoors designed to swallow the unwary. Beyond this narrow line, the floor appears smooth, yet every square span hides a hinged drop into the lightless substructure.

You balance your weight carefully on the ball of your foot, weighing whether to risk a silent slide along the wall or take a bolder stride over the deceptive expanse.

nodes.brief: You pry open a jammed louver, letting a rush of hot desert air and blinding glare into the dim shaft.

exits.label: Crawl into the soot-lined vent
Cross the fragile glass bridge

nodes.title: The Jammed Louver
nodes.page:
Metal screams against rusted iron as you force your shoulder against the stuck louver, tearing it free from its frame with a sudden, metallic groan. A violent rush of desert heat and blinding, unfiltered glare floods the cramped shaft, making your eyes water in the sudden brightness. Dust motes dance wildly in the beam of harsh sunlight while the wind whistles through the newly opened gap like a distant flute.

You crouch in the suffocating warmth, deciding whether to squeeze into the dark ventilation tunnel below or risk balancing across the chasm ahead.

nodes.brief: A nest of rusted iron gears blocks your passage, forcing you to crawl through their grease-stained center.

exits.label: Follow the soot-blackened air-vent
Leap past the swinging brass counterweight
Step onto the trembling glass bridge
Turn back toward the humming blue gallery

nodes.title: The Iron Maze
nodes.page:
Rusted iron gears tangle into veins that choke the corridor, a jagged barrier of spiked teeth and oversized cogs. There is no way around the mechanical blockage except to squeeze your frame directly through the greasy, narrow heart of the machine. The metal smells of ancient machine oil and dry desert age, cold against your skin as you wriggle into the tight iron gap.

You emerge on the far side among swinging pendulums, counterweights, and hidden drop-shafts, each next precarious step demanding care.

nodes.brief: Calder tosses a pebble into a dizzying vertical drop to test the acoustic echo of the lower vaults.

exits.label: Duck into the low soot-choked vent
Time your run past the swinging counterweight
Venture out onto the fragile glass span

nodes.title: The Echoing Drop
nodes.page:
Calder drops a small grey pebble into the sheer vertical shaft at your feet, waiting in the dry stillness for any sign of a bottom. Seconds pass before a faint, hollow clatter echoes back up through the darkness, revealing an immense drop that swallows sound whole. The stale air rising from the abyss carries a mineral tang of old salt and deep, forgotten stone.

You clutch your ember-lamp tighter against your ribs, wondering whether to seek a narrow crawlspace or trust your footing above the yawning void.

nodes.brief: You squeeze through a buckled copper frame where the walls of the observatory are slowly crushing inward.

exits.label: Trace the path of blue electrical sparks
Pry open the stubborn ventilation grille
Turn back beneath the fractured dome

nodes.title: The Buckled Frame
nodes.page:
Heavy stone walls groan and shift around you, pressing inward with the agonizing weight of centuries until the copper doorframe has buckled into a jagged diamond. You must twist your torso sideways and exhale every scrap of air just to force your ribs through the narrowing metal slit. Outside this crushing pinch, the observatory interior stretches away in a maze of flickering blue shadows and frayed wiring.

You catch your breath in the dim chamber, deciding whether to follow the scent of ozone or retrace your steps before the masonry settles further.

nodes.brief: A flurry of wind-blown salt dust blinds you momentarily as you navigate a ledge above a sheer drop.

exits.label: Step carefully onto the trembling glass bridge
Follow the scent of ozone and sparks
Press flat against the fluted pillar
Heed the warm vibration against your chest

nodes.title: The Salt Flurry
nodes.page:
A vicious gust of wind whips across the open ledge, driving a blinding flurry of crystalline salt directly into your face and stinging your eyes raw. You clamp one hand over your goggles and press your spine flat against the fluted stone pillar to keep from being swept into the empty air. Somewhere nearby, heavy boots crunch against grit, warning that the passage is not entirely deserted.

The grit settles slightly in the pale light, leaving you to choose between plunging into the gloom or slipping past unseen sentries.

nodes.brief: Calder wedges a crowbar into a refractory brick wall, prizing open a forgotten passage used by telescope-cleaners.

exits.label: Chase the scent of buzzing ozone
Force the stubborn ventilation latch

nodes.title: The Cleaner's Passage
nodes.page:
Iron scrapes screechingly against dry mortar as Calder drives a crowbar deep into the refractory brick wall, leveraging a forgotten wedge loose from the masonry. A dark, narrow crawlspace opens behind the loosened blocks - a low utility chute once used by the old telescope-cleaners to haul rags and polishing powders. A smell of dry lime and stagnant centuries drafts out from the hidden opening.

You peer into the black void of the chute, deciding whether to squeeze inside or test the ventilation grilles further along the corridor.

nodes.brief: You scramble across a floor of loose glass shards that slide dangerously beneath the weight of your pack.

exits.label: Strike the stubborn ventilation latch
Climb the greasy vertical cable-run

nodes.title: The Shard Floor
nodes.page:
Every step is a hazard on the floor of loose glass shards, which slide and whisper beneath your heavy boots like frozen scree. The weight of your pack threatens to throw you off balance with every shifting tile, risking a noisy cascade that would echo through the silent halls. You keep your knees slightly bent and brace with your arms as the glittering floor slopes away into deeper shadows.

You reach the far edge of the dangerous slope, needing to choose between a stubborn metal latch or a vertical climb.

nodes.brief: The cracked Seedkey hums violently against your coat, pointing directly through a solid wall of tinted crystal.

exits.label: Scramble up the slippery cable-run
Follow the resonant quartz vibrations
Extinguish your lamp and crawl blind

priv.why: the Seedkey is cracked and sings or fails near glass

nodes.title: The Crystal Wall
nodes.page:
The cracked Seedkey pulses violently against your breastbone, shivering in your coat like a live thing as it encounters the sheer wall of tinted crystal ahead. The cold ceramic grows almost hot to the touch, its fractures singing a high, reedy note that harmonizes with the invisible quartz veins running through the glass barrier. Here, where the lens-matter is thickest, the key recognizes its own reflection within the observatory's core.

You press your palm against the vibrating crystal, choosing whether to scale the cable, follow the resonant hum, or plunge into absolute darkness.

nodes.brief: You duck beneath a swinging iron counterweight that sweeps back and forth across the low service tunnel.

exits.label: Squeeze through the narrow dark aperture

nodes.title: The Iron Pendulum
nodes.page:
An iron counterweight sweeps the low service tunnel and throws a long shadow on the curved brickwork with every pass. You match each breath to the thud of swinging metal and crouch in the dust as it clears your cap by barely a handspan. The air smells of hot iron and old grease, thick in the close confines of the serviceway.

You wait until the mass swings clear, then set yourself to squeeze through the narrow aperture beyond its arc.

nodes.brief: You slip past a dormant automaton whose glass eyes catch the faint, sputtering glow of your coal-lantern.

exits.label: Step out onto the windy upper ledge
Climb the rusted iron framework toward the light
Freeze in the alcove while the light sweeps past

nodes.title: The Dormant Automaton
nodes.page:
