Silent and towering in the gloom, a dormant brass automaton blocks the corridor, its faceted glass eyes catching the faint, sputtering glow of your coal-lantern. You ease past its frozen limbs, listening to the hollow echo of your own breathing against the chill masonry.

The path splits ahead, offering a choice between a howling draught from the heights, an exposed iron climb, or a tight squeeze where a sentinel's mirror sweeps.

nodes.brief: In a dim cistern-room, dripping condensation threatens to drown your sole remaining source of heat and light.

exits.label: Step out onto the windy upper ledge
Freeze in the alcove while the light sweeps past

nodes.title: The Dripping Cistern
nodes.page:
Heavy drops of black condensation fall with rhythmic malice from the vaulted brickwork of the dim cistern-room, threatening to drown the sole remaining source of heat and light you carry from Candlemere. You cup your hand over the lantern's trembling coal, sheltering the orange glow as the moisture pools around your boots.

The damp air presses close, forcing you to choose your next direction before the cold extinguishes your only defense.

nodes.brief: You wedge your shoulder against a shifting glass pane to clear a path through a blocked maintenance tunnel.

exits.label: Climb the rusted iron framework toward the light
Freeze in the alcove while the light sweeps past

nodes.title: The Blocked Maintenance Tunnel
nodes.page: Bracing your shoulder against a stubborn, shifting pane of green-tinted glass, you heave until the jammed frame gives way with a dry groan, clearing a narrow path through the choked maintenance tunnel. Dust motes dance in the amber radius of your coal-lantern as you peer into the darkness beyond.

nodes.brief: Traveling entirely alone, you notice a subtle draft whispering through a hairline fracture in the masonry wall.

exits.label: Step out onto the windy upper ledge
Climb the rusted iron framework toward the light
Freeze in the alcove while the light sweeps past

priv.why: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over

nodes.title: The Hairline Fracture
nodes.page:
Traveling entirely alone through the hollow heart of Prism, without any companion's voice to cover your steps, you notice a subtle draft whispering through a hairline fracture in the masonry wall. This thin stream of outside air carries the sharp tang of salt and distant thunder, hinting at a hidden route.

The silence of the empty hall leaves your next move entirely in your own hands.

nodes.brief: A cascade of loose glass beads rattles down the sloping floor, threatening to betray your silent ascent.

exits.label: Freeze in the alcove while the light sweeps past
Push upward into the thin, scorching air

nodes.title: The Cascading Beads
nodes.page:
A stray boot-heel dislodges a pocket of ancient optical beads, sending a sudden cascade of loose glass rattling down the sloping floor with a sound like falling rain. You freeze instantly, holding your breath as the noisy clatter echoes through the chamber, threatening to betray your silent ascent to anyone listening in the dark.

The clatter fades, leaving you with a choice of where to hide or how to press forward.

nodes.brief: You navigate a labyrinth of convex mirrors that distort your reflection into a dozen terrifying, phantom pursuers.

exits.label: Freeze in the alcove while the light sweeps past
Claw your way up the choked drainage flue
Push upward into the thin, scorching air

nodes.title: The Hall of Mirrors
nodes.page:
Row upon row of curved and faceted mirrors surround you, multiplying your single frame into a dozen terrifying, phantom pursuers that mimic your every twitching movement in the gloom. The dizzying reflections warp the space around your coal-lantern until you can no longer tell which way is true.

You need to escape the disorienting maze before your nerve breaks.

nodes.brief: Thick salt crust crunches beneath your boots in a forgotten archive, leaving a damning trail for any trackers.

exits.label: Freeze in the alcove while the light sweeps past
Claw your way up the choked drainage flue
Push upward into the thin, scorching air

nodes.title: The Forgotten Archive
nodes.page: Thick salt crust crunches audibly beneath your boots as you cross the floor of a forgotten archive, leaving a stark, white trail across the dark floorboards that would invite any tracker straight to your heels. You sweep a hand behind you to scuff the crystals, but the dry crunch remains uncomfortably loud in the quiet vault.

nodes.brief: You crawl through an air-vent lined with velvet soot that blackens your face and chokes your breathing.

exits.label: Claw your way up the choked drainage flue
Push upward into the thin, scorching air

nodes.title: The Sooty Air-Vent
nodes.page:
Black velvet soot cakes the interior of the narrow air-vent, smearing across your face and clinging to your clothes with every wriggling inch, threatening to choke your breathing in the confined space. You drag yourself forward on elbows and knees, guided only by the faint warmth of your lantern trailing behind you.

The vent opens up ahead into choices of ascent or exposure.

nodes.brief: A dangling brass counterweight swings across your narrow ledge, timing your frantic leap with lethal precision.

exits.label: Push upward into the thin, scorching air
Slip behind the stacks while voices rise outside

nodes.title: The Swinging Counterweight
nodes.page:
A brass counterweight on a long iron arm sweeps your narrow ledge, slicing the dim air with a rhythmic whine that forces you to time your frantic leap with lethal precision. Muscles coiled, you wait for the mass to clear before springing across the void.

The metal pendulum clears, leaving you an instant to move forward.

nodes.brief: You cross a fragile glass bridge suspended over a yawning shaft where ancient machinery groans in darkness.

exits.label: Push upward into the thin, scorching air
Slip behind the stacks while voices rise outside
Leap for safety as the balustrade crumbles

nodes.title: The Fragile Bridge
nodes.page:
Suspended high over a yawning shaft where ancient machinery groans in darkness, a fragile bridge of ribbed glass groans under your weight, every step sending tiny shivers through the transparent spans. You keep your eyes fixed straight ahead, ignoring the dizzying drop inches below your boots.

The opposite side offers multiple branching paths into the observatory's interior.

nodes.brief: Pungent ozone fills a chamber where broken copper wires spit faint blue sparks into the dry air.

exits.label: Crawl through the sparking gap
Climb toward the scorching upper terrace
Slip behind the stack of spare lenses

nodes.title: The Ozone Chamber
nodes.page: Pungent ozone fills a chamber where broken copper wires spit faint blue sparks into the dry air. Every snap of electricity illuminates the flaking lead paint on the low ceiling, casting jagged shadows across your boots. You shield your face with a forearm as a particularly bright arc leaps toward a rusted conduit, leaving a metallic taste at the back of your throat.

nodes.brief: You flatten yourself against a fluted pillar as a patrol of mirror-bearers marches past with rhythmic clinking.

exits.label: Hide near the arguing glass-diver
Reach for the crumbling stone balustrade
Step out onto the Sentry Terrace

nodes.title: The Marching Patrol
nodes.page: You flatten yourself against a fluted pillar as a patrol of mirror-bearers marches past with rhythmic clinking. Polished brass plates hang at their hips, catching the stray shafts of sunlight that pierce the ruined vault above. Their boots strike the fused glass floor in unison, a drumbeat that climbs through your soles until they turn a corner and the echoes die in the tower's silence.

nodes.brief: A stubborn latch on a ventilation grille requires you to risk a noisy strike with your heavy tool.

exits.label: Head toward the blazing solar terrace
Duck behind the stack of spare lenses
Grasp the crumbling outer balustrade

nodes.title: The Stubborn Latch
nodes.page: A stubborn latch on a ventilation grille requires you to risk a noisy strike with your heavy tool. You tap the rusted hinge once, twice, holding your breath as the metal protests with a sharp, ringing ping that seems to carry for miles through the hollow shaft. A draft of stale air greets your face, smelling of old dust and distant rain, urging you to pull the stubborn grating open before anyone investigates the sound.

nodes.brief: You scramble up a vertical cable-run while greasy soot makes every handhold a slippery, terrifying gamble.

exits.label: Approach the scorching collector terrace
Test the weight of the stone balustrade
Take the reckless way

nodes.title: The Greasy Cable-Run
nodes.page: You scramble up a vertical cable-run while greasy soot makes every handhold a slippery, terrifying gamble. Your fingers find purchase along the braided steel strands, but ancient lubricants smear your palms, threatening to peel your grip away with every upward pull. Below you, the shaft drops into absolute darkness, while above, a pale smudge of daylight marks the edge of the terrace you need to reach.

nodes.brief: The Seedkey vibrates warmly against your chest, reacting to a hidden network of resonant quartz veins nearby.

exits.label: Duck behind the stack of spare lenses
Step out onto the Sentry Terrace

nodes.title: The Resonant Quartz
nodes.page: The Seedkey vibrates warmly against your chest, reacting to a hidden network of resonant quartz veins nearby. The ceramic surface ticks in a faint rhythm matched to ancient machinery buried deep within the observatory walls. This subtle tug draws your gaze toward a narrow aperture where the blue-tinted light shifts as though filtered through deep water.

nodes.brief: You squeeze through an aperture so narrow you must extinguish your ember-lamp and crawl blind in pitch black.

exits.label: Emerge onto the sunlit Sentry Terrace

nodes.title: The Blind Aperture
nodes.page: You squeeze through an aperture so narrow you must extinguish your ember-lamp and crawl blind in pitch black. The cold stone sides press tightly against your shoulders and back, leaving no room to turn or even lift an arm. Every inch forward requires a deliberate heave, relying entirely on the scrape of your knees against the grit and the faint smell of sun-baked dust guiding you onward.

nodes.brief: High above the Basin floor, a whistling gale through the broken roof tests your footing on slick glass.

exits.label: Crouch behind the low sun-shield
Edge along the outer parapet

nodes.title: The Whistling Gale
nodes.page: High above the Basin floor, a whistling gale through the broken roof tests your footing on slick glass. The wind tears at your cloak, howling through the twisted iron ribs of the dome as though trying to peel you away from the heights and cast you down into the immense dry emptiness below. You lean your weight hard into the blast, planting each boot with desperate care.

nodes.brief: You climb a leaning framework of iron girders toward the blinding white glare of the upper terraces.

exits.label: Take cover behind the sun-shield
Turn back down the shaft

nodes.title: The Iron Framework
nodes.page: You climb a leaning framework of iron girders toward the blinding white glare of the upper terraces. Rust flakes off beneath your grip, raining down into the dizzying void as you haul yourself upward hand over hand. The air grows noticeably thinner here, smelling intensely of baked metal and the ozone tang of high-altitude mirrors catching the noon sun.

nodes.brief: A sentinel's mirror-flash sweeps across your hiding alcove, forcing you to freeze amid dangling copper wires.

exits.label: Face the veteran sentry's demand

nodes.title: The Sweeping Mirror
nodes.page: A sentinel's mirror-flash sweeps across your hiding alcove, forcing you to freeze amid dangling copper wires. The brilliant beam of reflected sunlight paints the walls in harsh white light before sliding past, leaving black spots dancing before your eyes. You wait in the sudden gloom, listening intently for the crunch of boots on glass that might signal you have been spotted.

nodes.brief: You claw your way up a choked drainage flue that smells faintly of ancient oil and dried desert lime.

exits.label: Face the veteran sentry's demand
Mirror the sentry's complex code

nodes.title: The Choked Flue
nodes.page: You claw your way up a choked drainage flue that smells faintly of ancient oil and dried desert lime. Sharp fragments of old mortar bite into your knuckles as you scramble over a mound of wind-blown silt, dragging your heavy pack through the narrow constriction. Above you, a square of harsh daylight opens like an eye, promising an exit from the stifling dark.

nodes.brief: The air grows thin and scorching as you approach the grand solar-collector terrace where sentries keep watch.

exits.label: Dash across the open solar terrace
Creep along the narrow maintenance ledge

nodes.title: The Solar Collector Terrace
nodes.page: Heat radiates upward from the polished bronze tiles of the grand solar-collector terrace, distorting the horizon into shimmering pools of light. You crouch low as the air grows thin and scorching, smelling of roasted copper and baked stone. Above you, the gleaming mirror arrays of the Glasswright sentries pivot with a slow, mechanical groan, casting blinding flashes across the open expanse. Every step risks drawing an immediate challenge from the watchers stationed near the upper domes.

nodes.brief: You slip behind a stack of spare lenses while a glass-diver argues heatedly with a nervous sentry outside.

exits.label: Dart toward the upper service arch
Follow the arguing diver downward
Duck behind the western observation rig
Turn back across the sliding glass floor

nodes.title: Shadows Behind the Glass
nodes.page:
Stacks of spare, curved lenses lean precariously against the fluted pillars, casting distorted reflections of your tense posture. Just beyond your hiding spot, a weathered glass-diver argues heatedly with a nervous sentry, their sharp voices echoing off the vaulted ceiling. The diver gestures wildly toward the lower basins, demanding access, while the guard's polished breastplate catches the glaring desert sun.

The argument threatens to draw more attention to this sector at any second, leaving you a narrow window to slip away unnoticed or retrace your steps before you are discovered.

nodes.brief: A crumbling stone balustrade gives way beneath your hand, sending a clatter of debris echoing down the shaft.

exits.label: Scramble down the exposed service ladder
Pull yourself onto the upper stone platform

nodes.title: The Crumbling Balustrade
nodes.page:
A weathered stone balustrade suddenly gives way beneath your gripping fingers, sending a sharp clatter of crumbling masonry echoing down the deep shaft. Dust billows upward into the dry air, stinging your eyes and throat as you cling desperately to the remaining edge. Below, the sheer drop opens into darkness, while above, the telltale click of a sentry's turning mirror suggests the noise has already found an audience.

You must pull yourself up onto the safer platform ahead or scramble down an exposed service ladder before the guards investigate the disturbance.

nodes.brief: You emerge onto the threshold of the Sentry Terrace, where sharp mirror-signals slice through the blinding light.

exits.label: Advance past the active signal posts
Turn back into the shadowed corridor

nodes.title: Threshold of the Sentry Terrace
nodes.page:
Harsh daylight floods your vision as you emerge onto the windswept threshold of the Sentry Terrace. Sharp, rhythmic mirror-signals slice through the blinding glare, communicating coded warnings across the sprawling observatory heights. You pull your coat tight against the scouring wind and press your back against a sun-warmed pillar, watching the bright flashes leap from tower to tower.

Ahead lies the main transit route guarded by vigilant watchers, or you can retreat back into the dim corridors from which you just arrived.

nodes.brief: You crouch behind a low sun-shield while Glasswright sentries semaphore swift warnings across the dizzying drop.

exits.label: Press on toward the inner gates

nodes.title: Beneath the Sun Shield
nodes.page:
Corrugated sheets of dark sun-shield metal provide scant cover from the searing heat radiating across the upper tiers. You crouch low against the ribbed plates, watching Glasswright sentries semaphore swift, urgent warnings across the dizzying drop of the outer basin. Each flash of reflected light cuts through the dust-hazed air like a blade, warning of intruders below.

Your breath comes shallow and hot as you eye the narrow passage leading deeper into the complex.

nodes.brief: A veteran sentry turns his polished brass plate toward you, demanding your credentials in abrupt flashes of light.

exits.label: Press on past the demanding guard

nodes.title: The Veteran's Challenge
nodes.page:
A veteran sentry pivots abruptly on his heel, turning a polished brass plate straight toward your hiding place. Sharp, rhythmic bursts of light flash from his instrument, demanding your credentials in the silent, intimidating tongue of the tower guards. The metal hums softly with every flick of his wrist, waiting for a proper response that proves you belong among the spires.

You need to commit to your next move before the sentry lowers his shield and sounds a general alarm across the terrace.

nodes.brief: You edge along the outer parapet of the terrace, praying the whistling wind masks your frantic footsteps.

exits.label: Press on along the windy ledge

nodes.title: The Outer Parapet
nodes.page:
Your boots slide carefully along the narrow outer parapet, every muscle tensing against the sheer drop to the salt-crusted floor far below. The whistling desert wind howls around the stone curves, masking the frantic scuff of your footsteps against the ancient masonry. Below, the vast skeleton of the old observatory stretches out in a maze of glass and rusted iron.

Keeping your gaze fixed straight ahead, you look for a safe way to rejoin the main walkways.

nodes.brief: You raise your hand to mirror the sentry's complex code, gambling your entire journey on a single imitated flash.

exits.label: Press on through the signal gate

nodes.title: Imitating the Flash
nodes.page:
You lift your trembling hand and angle a shard of polished metal to catch the fierce midday glare. Trusting your instincts, you mirror the sentry's complex code of short and long flashes, gambling your entire journey on a single imitated signal. The answering pause from the watchtower feels agonizingly long as the light glints off their brass plates.

You must move immediately while the guards process your deceptive reply, pushing forward before the illusion shatters.

nodes.brief: Beside the whispering brass vanes of the meridian hall, you dodge a blind sentry whose mirrors click like beetles, risking detection by the looming Salt Court bailiffs.

exits.label: Dash across the open mosaic floor
Slip into the narrow clockwork gap
Crawl beneath the low stone benches

nodes.title: The Meridian Hall
nodes.page: Brass vanes chatter overhead as you slip between two polished columns, your shoulder brushing the cold flank of a meridian ring. Just feet away, a blind sentry turns in a slow, mechanical circle, its chest-mounted mirrors clicking like desert beetles while it listens for intruders. Beyond its patrol path, Salt Court bailiffs in velvet coats sweep across the flagstones, arguing in low voices over water tariffs and vault rights. Your lantern pulls at your trembling hand, banked coals radiating a stifling heat against your ribs.

nodes.brief: In the shadow of a slanted heliostat, you crawl past a team of Glasswright apprentices flashing warning codes across the salt-flats, while your heavy lantern gutters in the draft.

exits.privWhy: the reader believes the vault was looted and looks for the looters' trail
exits.label: Follow the looters down the broken stair
Dodge past the apprentices toward the eastern arch
Duck behind a stack of spare copper reflectors

nodes.title: The Slanted Heliostat
nodes.page: Heavy shadows stretch long and bruised across the terrace as you crouch beneath the rusted iron rib of a tilted heliostat, desperately shielding your sputtering lamp from the rising draught. A few paces away, a knot of young Glasswright apprentices mutters low urgency, their hands flashing polished signal-shards to warn distant sentries across the glowing salt-flats. You know from the broken padlocks and trampled dust nearby that thieves have already breached this upper level, leaving a trail of discarded tools and shattered lenses pointing down into the dark core of the observatory. With the wind clawing at your cloak, you have to choose your next move carefully before the apprentices finish their transmissions and turn their sharp eyes your way.

nodes.brief: Beneath a vaulted ceiling of purple slag, an old lens-cleaner named Mallow mistakes your ember-glow for a signal, offering false directions toward the wrong vault wing.

exits.label: Follow the cleaner down the wrong wing
Slip past him into the deeper shadows
Step forward and correct the old man

nodes.title: The Purple Slag Vault
nodes.page: Purple slag vaults curve overhead like the ribs of some ancient, fossilised beast, casting an eerie violet gloom over the stone floor where an old lens-cleaner named Mallow kneels with a greasy rag. Mistaking the warm glow of your hooded ember-lamp for a signal from the upper watch, he gestures frantically toward a crumbling staircase that leads away into the dry dark. You know from your maps that his directions point straight toward the abandoned storage wings rather than the true descent, yet remaining here risks drawing the attention of the roving patrols echoing through the corridors. You can accept his misguided help and head down the wrong wing, slip past him into the deeper shadows on the left, or step out to correct his mistake.

nodes.brief: Within a gallery of cracked prisms, a Salt Court debt-collector blocks the narrow passage, demanding your ceramic key under threat of a dry-desert flogging.

exits.label: Retreat quickly back into the dim corridor
Dart across the prism floor past him
Offer a heavy bribe of dried meat

nodes.title: The Cracked Prisms
nodes.page: Shards of fractured crystal crunch softly under your boots as you enter a narrow gallery where the walls are lined with weeping prisms that catch the dying daylight and scatter it in blind, dazzling slivers. A burly Salt Court debt-collector blocks the far exit, one hand on a brass truncheon, sharp eyes scanning the gloom for runners carrying the seedkeys of Candlemere. He flashes an ugly, salt-cracked grin as he spots your lantern, demanding the ceramic key under immediate threat of a brutal flogging out on the scorching flats. You can try to slip back the way you came, dart across the prism-strewn floor while he lunges, or offer a heavy bribe of dried meat to buy your passage.

nodes.brief: Amidst ticking solar clocks that measure the waning hours before the monsoon, a nervous sentry drops a magnifying plate, showering the flagstones with lethal glass shards.

exits.label: Leap over the sparkling glass debris
Duck into the empty astrolabe alcove
Flatten yourself against the vibrating wall

nodes.title: The Tick-Tock Gallery
nodes.page: Solar clocks tick away the waning hours before the monsoon with a relentless, metallic rhythm that fills the high-ceilinged hall, echoing off walls covered in faded astronomical charts. A nervous sentry fumbles with a heavy magnifying plate near the window, dropping the thick glass with a sharp crack that showers the flagstones right beside your boots with lethal, glittering shards. The sudden noise reverberates down the stone passage, drawing immediate shouts from the guard-post around the corner and forcing you to act before the corridor floods with armed pursuers. You can leap over the sparkling debris toward the northern exit, duck into an empty alcove behind a brass astrolabe, or flatten yourself against the vibrating wall.

nodes.brief: Spotting an unrecorded maintenance chute left open by looters, you slip past the upper galleries entirely, gaining an unexpected hour of quiet progress toward the foundations.

exits.label: Slide down into the dark metal chute
Search the wall for a ladder descent
Pause at the lip to listen closely

priv.why: the reader believes the vault was looted and looks for the looters' trail

nodes.title: The Maintenance Chute
nodes.page: Slipping away from the main terraces because you suspect the vault has already been plundered, you stumble upon an unrecorded maintenance chute tucked behind a rotting wooden screen. The steep metal slide smells of old grease and dry dust, descending sharply into the cool, silent bowels of the foundation levels far below the reach of the guards. It is an unexpected stroke of luck that bypasses the upper checkpoints entirely, giving you a quiet hour of uninterrupted progress toward the sealed heart of the Rain Vault. You can trust the dark slide and let gravity take you down, search the nearby wall for a safer ladder descent, or pause at the lip to listen for any sounds rising from below.

nodes.brief: Beside a dry ornamental fountain shaped like a bronze heron, a wounded Glasswright courier whispers a warning about patrolling bailiffs before his voice fails.

exits.label: Slip into the dim lead-bound library
Leap toward the salt-choked skylight above
Plunge down the green alabaster stairwell

exits.privWhy: Calder the glass-diver is with the reader and knows this place
exits.label: Follow Calder through the hidden drainage conduit

nodes.title: The Heron Fountain
nodes.page:
Beneath the shadow of a bronze heron with a throat choked in alkaline crust, a wounded Glasswright courier slumps against the dry basin. His crimson sash is stiff with old salt, and as you drop to your knees beside him, his fingers twitch toward the bronze hilt at his hip. He catches your sleeve with a grip surprisingly fierce, his breath smelling of bitter alum and scorched tin. Watch the upper arcades, he rasps, his voice rattling like dry gravel before his head drops sideways into the dust. The Salt Court bailiffs have traded their brass badges for grey cloaks, and they are sweeping every terrace between here and the lower seal. You touch the cold ceramic weight of the Seedkey in your tunic, weighing the open marble plazas against the shadowed alleys of the inner ring.

A sudden clatter of metal echoes from the colonnade behind you, forcing an immediate decision on your route through the city.

nodes.brief: Under the glare of a focusing dish that tracks the sinking sun, you squeeze behind a stack of spare reflectors, watching heavy boots patrol the terrace above.

exits.privWhy: Calder the glass-diver is with the reader and knows this place
exits.label: Wait patiently for the patrol to pass
Risk a quick crawl to the service hatch
Tap a soft rhythm on the copper dish

nodes.title: The Focusing Dish
nodes.page: The afternoon sun beats down mercilessly against a massive copper focusing dish that tracks the sky with slow, whining gears, filling the air with the smell of scorched metal and heated air. You squeeze your frame tightly behind a stack of spare concave reflectors, holding your breath as heavy, measured boots pace back and forth across the stone terrace directly above your head. Every shift of your weight threatens to rattle the loose metal plates and betray your hiding place to the patrolling bailiffs. You can wait patiently for the patrol to complete its circuit, risk a quick crawl toward the nearby service hatch, or tap a soft rhythm on the copper dish to create a diversion.

nodes.brief: In the rotunda of whispering echoes, an anxious apprentice named Joram drops his signalling mirror, threatening to draw every Glasswright guard to your hidden alcove.

exits.label: Lunge forward to help gather the glass
Dart past him toward the spiral stair

nodes.title: The Whispering Rotunda
nodes.page: Echoes bounce endlessly around the curved stone walls of the rotunda, magnifying every breath you take until it sounds like a rushing gale. An anxious young apprentice named Joram stumbles backward as you step into the light, dropping his heavy signalling mirror with a loud clatter that threatens to summon every Glasswright guard in the complex to your hidden alcove. His eyes widen in sheer panic as he scrambles on the floor among the glittering fragments, trying to silence the ringing echoes. You can lunge forward to help him gather the broken glass, dart past him toward the descending spiral stair, or press your back against the curved wall and stay perfectly still.

nodes.brief: Within a damp alcove smelling of old copper, a Salt Court hireling named Morvath sharpens a bone-handled blade while waiting for you to stumble into his trap.

exits.label: Draw your travel knife to face him
Extinguish your lamp to slip past

nodes.title: The Copper Alcove
nodes.page: The air in the damp alcove is thick with the verdigris smell of old copper and stagnant dampness, clinging to the back of your throat like fine salt. In the dim light, a Salt Court hireling named Morvath sits sharpening a wide bone-handled blade against a whetstone, humming a dry desert tune while he waits for you to stumble directly into his trap. His eyes glint with cruel amusement in the flickering amber glow of your lantern, knowing you have nowhere else to run on this sealed level. You can draw your own heavy travel knife and face him head-on, extinguish your lamp and try to slip past him in total darkness, or throw a handful of salt into his face and bolt.

nodes.brief: Beside a massive quartz lens that magnifies the distant horizon, a weary sentry doats over a tin of dried figs, ignoring your silent scramble across the sill.

exits.label: Slip past the humming lens toward the shadow.
Drop down behind the heavy brass astrolabe wheel.

nodes.title: The Quartz Lens
nodes.page: Sunlight hums through a massive quartz lens that skews the desert horizon into a violet smear. Beside the heavy frame, a weary sentry doats over a square tin of dried figs, utterly ignoring your silent scramble across the cool stone sill. The scent of roasted barley and dry dust hangs thick in the draft.

nodes.brief: Underneath a dangling chandelier of singing crystal, you dodge a sudden beam of focused sunlight that sweeps the floor like a burning searcher.

exits.label: Scramble toward the humming pillar in the corner.
Duck behind the painted archway where the water-seller waits.

nodes.title: The Singing Crystal
nodes.page:
A heavy bronze chandelier of singing crystal dangles overhead, chiming faintly with every tremor of the high masonry. A sudden beam of focused sunlight sweeps the floor like a burning searcher, forcing you to huddle low against the wainscot. The air tastes of ozone and hot glass.

You must find cover before the searing arc swings back across your boots.

nodes.brief: In a gallery lined with dusty astrolabes, an old woman named Thora mutters ancient weather proverbs, blocking the egress toward the descending stone stairs.

exits.label: Creep behind the stacked lead weights to avoid notice.

nodes.title: The Weather Proverb
nodes.page: Dust-caked astrolabes line the gallery walls like skeletons of strange metal birds. An old woman named Thora mutters ancient weather proverbs to herself, blocking the sole egress toward the descending stone stairs with her heavy wool skirts. Her rheumy eyes fix on the horizon, missing your approach entirely.

nodes.brief: Beside a frozen water-clock that smells of stagnant silt, you slide behind a carved basalt pillar just as heavy iron boots echo from the gallery entrance.

exits.label: Dart through the narrow archway into the whispering rotunda.
Crawl behind the heavy lead weights near the wall.
Squeeze through the narrow slot-window overlooking the dead basin.

nodes.title: The Frozen Clock
nodes.page: A frozen water-clock drips no longer, smelling only of stale silt and ancient lime. You slide behind a carved basalt pillar just as iron boots echo from the gallery entrance, their cadence merciless. The shadows here are cool and deep, offering a brief reprieve from the blinding glare outside.

nodes.brief: Within a chamber of hollow mirrors, a nervous runner from an eastern post mistakes your shadow for a Salt Court spy and draws a jagged glass dagger.

exits.label: Retreat softly beneath the hanging brass wind-chimes.

exits.privWhy: the reader is bound by the Dune Sisters' well-oath, and is known for it
exits.label: Show your well-oath brand to prove your allegiance.

nodes.title: The Mirror Chamber
nodes.page:
Hollow mirrors multiply your reflection into a fractured crowd of strangers. A nervous runner from an eastern post mistakes your shadow for a Salt Court spy and draws a jagged glass dagger with a sharp scrape of metal on stone. The reflections shimmer and warp in the harsh light.

You must act quickly to defuse the tension before the blade strikes.

nodes.brief: Under the hum of vibrating quartz tuning-forks, you balance along a narrow masonry ledge high above a dry subterranean atrium where guard dogs pace.

exits.label: Ease along the ledge toward the dim antechamber ahead.

exits.privWhy: the reader is bound by the Dune Sisters' well-oath, and is known for it
exits.label: Display your well-oath brand to the sentry watching from below.

nodes.title: The Masonry Ledge
nodes.page:
Quartz tuning-forks vibrate with a low, tooth-aching hum that fills the high air. You balance along a narrow masonry ledge high above a dry subterranean atrium where guard dogs pace and snarl in the gloom. A single misstep would send you crashing onto the stone flags below.

You must maintain your precarious balance and choose where to drop.

nodes.brief: Beside an alcove filled with brass sand-glasses, a weary glass-maker named Skene offers a cup of bitter salt-tea in exchange for news from the western rim.

exits.label: Slip away toward the dim antechamber of the archives.

exits.privWhy: the reader is bound by the Dune Sisters' well-oath, and is known for it
exits.label: Flash your well-oath brand to secure safe passage through the gate.

nodes.title: The Bitter Tea
nodes.page: Brass sand-glasses trickle silently in their wooden frames, measuring out the slow collapse of the city. A weary glass-maker named Skene offers a cup of bitter salt-tea in exchange for news from the western rim, his eyes bright with curiosity. The earthenware cup rattles against his trembling fingers.

nodes.brief: Within a subterranean library of lead-bound folios, a Dune Sister refugee named Sula tends a flickering tallow dip, warning you of treacherous sinkholes ahead.

exits.label: Slide past the rusted mining gear in the hollow pier.
Scramble over the tumbled pile of masonry beneath the mosaic.

nodes.title: The Lead Folios
nodes.page: Lead-bound folios line the subterranean library shelves like heavy bricks of grey metal. A Dune Sister refugee named Sula tends a flickering tallow dip, her fingers stained with ink as she warns you of treacherous sinkholes lurking in the dark ahead. The smell of melted fat and old paper fills the confined space.

nodes.brief: Underneath a great bronze quadrant pointing at the empty sky, you slip past a sleeping bailiff whose snoring rattles the brass astrolabes on their stands.

exits.privWhy: the reader is bound by the Dune Sisters' well-oath, and is known for it
exits.label: Show your well-oath brand to the guard at the iron latch.
Duck behind the yellow quartz solar fountain to avoid notice.
Drop down toward the ventilation shaft smelling of damp earth.

nodes.title: The Sleeping Bailiff
nodes.page: A great bronze quadrant points an empty metal arm at the blank sky. You slip past a sleeping bailiff whose loud snoring rattles the brass astrolabes on their stands. Century dust and stale wine foul the air.

nodes.brief: Beside a shattered skylight choked with wind-blown salt, a flock of desert pigeons startles into noisy flight, drawing sharp queries from a guard below.

exits.label: Slide through the narrow pillar gap
Crawl toward the mirror shadow

nodes.title: The Shattered Skylight
nodes.page: Loose salt rattles against your boots as you lean too heavily against the rim of a collapsed dome, sending a sudden grey cloud of grit down into the hollow beneath. A frantic rustle of wings erupts from the chasm as a flock of pale desert pigeons scatter toward the blinding sky, their startled cooing echoing sharply off the quartz walls. Immediately, a harsh challenge rings up from the sentry post below, the sound of iron-shod boots scraping against stone warning you that the Glasswrights are alert. You can either slip sideways through a narrow gap between two leaning pillars to avoid the courtyard entirely, or drop flat onto the sun-baked tiles and crawl toward the shadow of an old mirror-mount.

nodes.brief: Within a cool stairwell carved from green-veined alabaster, you dodge a tumbling heap of discarded ledger rolls sent sliding down by unseen hands.

exits.label: Slip through the low service door
Follow the curving wall toward the singing chamber

nodes.title: The Alabaster Stairwell
nodes.page: Cool green-veined alabaster walls rise on either side as you scramble higher, dodging a tumbling heap of discarded ledger rolls sent sliding down from above by unseen hands. The parchment cylinders crash against your boots with dry, hollow rattles, smelling strongly of old ink and centuries of damp dust. You press your shoulder hard into a narrow alcove to let the cascading paper storm rush past before the steep steps clear ahead.

nodes.brief: Guided by Calder's intimate knowledge of the old drainage conduits, you bypass a heavy iron portcullis guarded by Salt Court mercenaries without raising an alarm.

exits.label: Scramble over tumbled masonry
Slip past the damp ventilation shaft
Turn back toward the upper halls

priv.why: Calder the glass-diver is with the reader and knows this place

nodes.title: The Silt Conduits
nodes.page:
Calder drops through a rusted grate into the subterranean dark, his grease-stained coat brushing the damp brickwork of the old drainage conduit. You follow the glass-diver through the narrow brick-vaulted pipe, splashing silently through inches of brackish condensation that taste faintly of old copper and lime. Ahead, muffled boot-thuds echo through the iron grating - the Salt Court patrol guarding the upper iron portcullis, completely unaware of your passage beneath their boots.

The air grows cooler as the conduit slopes steeply downward into shadow, offering three distinct openings where side-tunnels branch away from the main drainage line.

nodes.brief: Beneath a massive refracting dome that scatters pale twilight, a lone sentry polishes a brass spyglass, humming a melancholy tune about the lost sea-towns.

exits.label: Approach the circular mirror gallery
Press against the sun-carved timber lintel

nodes.title: The Refracting Dome
nodes.page: Pale twilight spills through the overhead facets of a massive glass dome, casting shifting geometric lattices across the flagstones. Beneath this luminous canopy, a lone sentry polishes a brass spyglass with a greasy rag and murmurs a melancholy local tune about the drowned sea-towns that vanished before the basin dried. Your boots remain perfectly still against the grit as you weigh the quiet space ahead, watching the slow rhythm of the guard's shoulders rise and fall with every note of his song.

nodes.brief: Within a storeroom stacked with spare lamp-wicks, you hide among crates of dried resin while a patrol searches the racks with hooked lanterns.

exits.label: Slip toward the heavy timber lintel
Take the reckless way through the gate

nodes.title: The Resin Storeroom
nodes.page: Crates of dried pine resin and spare lamp-wicks tower around you in the suffocating dimness of the supply alcove. Through a narrow gap between two stacked hampers, you watch the yellow glow of hooked lanterns sweep across the floorboards as a patrol searches the racks for intruders. Your fingers tighten instinctively around the cold ceramic seedkey in your satchel while the distant murmur of boots draws closer by the second.

nodes.brief: In a corridor paved with green basalt, a nervous Salt Court clerk named Vane drops his ink-horn, threatening to raise an alarm unless you bribe him.

exits.label: Present credentials at the lens archive

nodes.title: The Ink-Stained Clerk
nodes.page: Green basalt paving stones echo sharply beneath your boots in a narrow corridor where an agitated Salt Court clerk drops his brass ink-horn with a dull clatter. Vane scrambles on hands and knees to gather his scattered parchment slips, muttering nervously about missing quotas and severe penalties. He looks up at you with wide, desperate eyes, blocking your forward path and threatening to raise a clamour unless you pay him off.

nodes.brief: Beside a humming resonance pillar that vibrates through the soles of your boots, a Glasswright veteran named Kestel blocks the iron door with a heavy iron pike.

exits.label: Check in at the grand lens archive
Face the Salt Court sergeant on the stairs

nodes.title: The Resonance Pillar
nodes.page: Low vibrations hum through the soles of your boots, pulsing directly from a massive glass resonance pillar that dominates the narrow intersection. Kestel stands firmly beside the vibrating column, a Glasswright veteran whose weathered face is set like flint against trespassers. He rests the butt of a heavy iron pike squarely upon the flagstones, barring the iron door with unyielding authority.

nodes.brief: Within a round chamber of whispering whispers, you dodge a sweeping beam of concentrated sunlight that melts the mortar between the stone flags.

exits.label: Confront the sergeant on the bronze steps

nodes.title: The Whispering Gallery
nodes.page: A thin, blinding line of concentrated sunlight sweeps across the round chamber, hissing fiercely as it melts the mortar between the ancient stone flags. You drop low against the cool floor, listening to the high-pitched whispers that bounce endlessly around the curved limestone walls like trapped insects. The scorching beam reverses its arc, slicing back across the room and threatening to char anything in its path.

nodes.brief: Under a vaulted ceiling painted with fading constellations, an old water-seller named Lumen begs for a drop from your flask while blocking the downward ramp.

exits.label: Pass through the main lens archive gate
Slip past the sergeant guarding the stair
Barter fresh oil by the quartz lens

nodes.title: The Fading Constellations
nodes.page: Faint gold leaf traces ancient constellations across the high vaulted ceiling above a crowded junction of downward-sloping ramps. An old water-seller named Lumen clutches a bone-white cup, her rheumy eyes fixed on your canteen as she begs for a single drop from your dwindling store. Her frail body blocks the main descent, forcing you to choose between charity, speed, or finding another route downward into the darkness.

nodes.brief: Beside a massive copper astrolabe as large as a wagon wheel, you crouch behind a stack of lead weights as heavy patrol steps approach from the dark.

exits.label: Barter oil by the massive quartz lens
Present the seedkey to the Glasswright elder

nodes.title: The Astrolabe Shadow
nodes.page: A massive copper astrolabe, tall as a wagon wheel, creaks gently on its rusted axis in the draughty corridor. Crouched behind a pyramid of lead weights, you hold your breath while rhythmic footfalls near from the darkened cross-passage. The shadows stretch long and jagged across the floor before the patrol comes into view.

nodes.brief: Within a narrow slot-window overlooking the dead basin, a desperate rival runner named Gault lunges for your satchel, seeking the ceramic seedkey.

exits.label: Enter the lens archive gateway
Trade oil near the quartz lens

nodes.title: The Slot-Window Ambush
nodes.page: Dust motes dance in the harsh strip of light falling through a narrow slot-window that overlooks the dead, salt-caked basin far below. Gault lunges suddenly from the shadows, his fingers clawing desperately for your satchel in a bid to steal the cold ceramic seedkey. You twist hard to the side, narrowly avoiding his grasp as the glass walls ring with the sudden violence of the scuffle.

nodes.brief: Beneath a hanging array of brass wind-chimes, you step carefully across a floor of brittle salt-crust that threatens to crack under your travel-worn boots.

exits.label: Barter oil with the lens guard
Slip through the grinding gear hatch

nodes.title: The Chime-Stwn Corridor
nodes.page: Beneath a hanging array of brass wind-chimes, you step carefully across a floor of brittle salt-crust that threatens to crack under your travel-worn boots. Every shift of your weight sends tiny, bell-like fractures ringing through the vaulted silence, echoing up toward the high, smoke-stained ceiling where old mirrors catch the grey twilight. You hitch the pack strap and pin the banked coal-lantern against your hip while you eye the narrow passage ahead.

nodes.brief: In a dim antechamber smelling of hot copper and old wool, a wary Glasswright archivist named Neris bars the vault threshold with pointed questions.

exits.label: Trade fresh fuel for passage
Dodge past the heavy gears

nodes.title: The Archivist's Threshold
nodes.page: In a dim antechamber smelling of hot copper and old wool, a wary Glasswright archivist named Neris bars the vault threshold with pointed questions. Her eyes narrow on your travel-stained coat and the soot-smudged lantern in your hand; she is still sorting seeker from scavenger off the dry rim. You stand your ground against her suspicious gaze, feeling the cold weight of the seedkey pressing securely through the fabric of your inner pocket.

nodes.brief: Recognizing your Dune Sister well-oath brand on your forearm, a sympathetic sentry quietly lowers the iron latch of the inner service gate for you.

exits.label: Seek the elder in the fragrant gallery
Approach the rival at the stagnant cistern
Press onward to the heavy bronze vault doors

priv.why: the reader is bound by the Dune Sisters' well-oath, and is known for it

nodes.title: The Sister's Gate
nodes.page: Recognizing your Dune Sister well-oath brand on your forearm, a sympathetic sentry quietly lowers the iron latch of the inner service gate for you. The heavy metal bar lifts with a dull, grating clatter that seems startlingly loud in the hushed corridor, opening a narrow way deeper into the heart of Prism. You offer a silent nod of gratitude to the guard, whose skin is deeply creased by decades of desert wind, before stepping through into the shadowed recesses beyond.

nodes.brief: Within a hollow foundation pier filled with echoing drafts, you slide past a heap of rusted mining gear just as a distant brass gong sounds.

exits.label: Enter the juniper-scented gallery
Face the rival at the dry cistern

nodes.title: The Hollow Pier
nodes.page: Within a hollow foundation pier filled with echoing drafts, you slide past a heap of rusted mining gear just as a distant brass gong sounds. The deep, resonant note vibrates through the cold masonry under your boots, setting the loose metal fragments shivering in the gloom. You crouch low in the shadows, waiting for the reverberations to fade before deciding your next direction through the maze of old architecture.

nodes.brief: Beside a frozen solar fountain carved from yellow quartz, a Salt Court tax-collector named Olen demands an inventory of your pack contents.

exits.label: Slip through the maintenance hatch
Confront the runner at the water-cistern

nodes.title: The Tax-Collector's Demand
nodes.page: Beside a frozen solar fountain carved from yellow quartz, a Salt Court tax-collector named Olen demands an inventory of your pack contents. His rich velvet tunic is stiff with white salt crystals, and his ledger book rests open on the rim of the dry basin while his ink-fingers twitch with impatience. You keep your hand near your lantern's iron handle, measuring the distance between yourselves and the narrow escape routes flickering in the gloom.

nodes.brief: Under the gaze of a faded mosaic depicting the ancient sea-kings, you scramble over a tumbled pile of masonry blocks to avoid a patrolling squad.

exits.label: Find the elder in the gallery
Locate the rival by the cistern

nodes.title: The Masonry scramble
nodes.page: Under the gaze of a faded mosaic depicting the ancient sea-kings, you scramble over a tumbled pile of masonry blocks to avoid a patrolling squad. Loose chunks of carved limestone clatter down the slope behind you, threatening to betray your hurried ascent to the guards patrolling the upper tier. You haul yourself over the jagged ridge and drop silently into the dust of the corridor beyond.

nodes.brief: Within a narrow service gallery lined with soot-stained grease-lamps, a coughing watchman named Haze mistakes your lantern for an inspector's signal.

exits.label: Seek out the rival at the cistern
Duck into the stone-lined cutting
Head toward the central vault doors

nodes.title: The Sooty Passage
nodes.page: Within a narrow service gallery lined with soot-stained grease-lamps, a coughing watchman named Haze mistakes your lantern for an inspector's signal. He snaps to a ragged attention, clutching a bundle of damp rags and squinting through the greasy yellow smoke without asking for your name or credentials. You offer a crisp nod to satisfy his brief inspection before glancing down the diverging corridors that stretch into the dark.

nodes.brief: Beside an open ventilation shaft that smells of damp earth and coming rain, you pause to catch your breath while distant alarms ring above.

exits.label: Enter the juniper-scented hall
Take the downward stone cutting

nodes.title: The Ventilation Shaft
nodes.page: Beside an open ventilation shaft that smells of damp earth and coming rain, you pause to catch your breath while distant alarms ring above. Cool drafts sweep up from the dark depths of the Basin, carrying the sharp, metallic tang of approaching moisture that confirms the monsoon's relentless advance. You grip your lantern tightly, weighing the risks of the upper galleries against the dark descent below.

nodes.brief: Within a circular gallery of singing mirrors, a confused apprentice named Telli spins in circles, trying to answer flashing signals from the upper terrace.

exits.label: Reach the heavy bronze vault doors

nodes.title: The Singing Mirrors
nodes.page: Within a circular gallery of singing mirrors, a confused apprentice named Telli spins in circles, trying to answer flashing signals from the upper terrace. The polished glass surfaces shiver under a low vibration that sets your teeth on edge, and fragments of your tired face return a hundred times over in the shimmering light. You pick a path between the vibrating frames, eyes locked on the monumental archway ahead.

nodes.brief: Underneath a heavy timber lintel carved with sun-burst glyphs, you press your back against the cool stone as Salt Court guards march past.

exits.label: Advance to the central bronze doors

nodes.title: The Lintel Ambush
nodes.page: Under a timber lintel carved with sun-burst glyphs you press your back to cool stone while Salt Court guards march past. Their heavy boots strike rhythmically against the stone flags just yards away, their voices low and sharp as they discuss the price of water rights in the outer rim. You hold your breath until the sound of their passing fades into the vast echoing spaces of the citadel.

nodes.brief: In the gateway of the great lens-archive, a sentinel named Brann checks your credentials against a list of approved delegates from the western rim.

exits.label: Step past the checking sentinel
Retreat toward the outer shadow

nodes.title: The Lens-Archive Gate
nodes.page: Cold metal rattles against slate as a sentinel named Brann checks your credentials against a list of approved delegates from the western rim. His fingers trace the paper while the great glass roofs above groan in the rising wind. Your ember-lamp casts a dull red glow across his polished brass breastplate, revealing deep lines carved into his weathered face by decades of desert glare. Behind him, the high vaulted corridors of the archive stretch into shadow like the ribs of an ancient leviathan. You adjust the weight of your pack and wait for his verdict.

nodes.brief: Within the shadowed atrium of the astronomical clock, a Salt Court sergeant named Corvus blocks the bronze stair leading down to the vault doors.

exits.label: Push down the guarded stair
Slip sideways into the alcove

nodes.title: The Clock Atrium
nodes.page: Overhead, iron gears grind in a rhythmic deafening heartbeat while a Salt Court sergeant named Corvus blocks the bronze stair leading down to the vault doors. He rests a heavy hand upon the pommel of a broadsword notched from countless skirmishes in the dry basin. Dust motes dance in the amber light leaking through the high clerestory windows, catching the sweat on his forehead. Every movement of the massive clockwork above seems timed to your own racing pulse.

nodes.brief: Beside a massive quartz lens that catches the final rays of twilight, you barter a flask of fresh oil for passage past a stubborn watch-captain.

exits.label: Follow the downward stone path
Pause to watch the twilight fade

nodes.title: The Quartz Lens
nodes.page: Sunlight splinters through a massive quartz lens that catches the final rays of twilight, painting the dusty flagstones in brilliant strokes of violet and gold. You barter a flask of fresh oil for passage past a stubborn watch-captain who eyes your provisions with undisguised hunger. The sweet smell of refined cedar oil mingles with the dry, alkaline tang of the basin dust drifting through the high embrasures. He uncorks the flask with his teeth, sniffs the contents with an approving nod, and gestures toward the descending corridor.

nodes.brief: Under a vault of interlocking brass gears, you slip through a maintenance hatch just as the heavy mechanisms begin their evening rotation with a roar.

exits.label: Crawl deeper into the machinery
Climb the inspection ladder upward

nodes.title: The Brass Hatch
nodes.page: Air whistles through narrow conduits as you slip a maintenance hatch the moment the mechanisms roar into their evening rotation. Grease and metal shavings coat your palms as you squeeze past vibrating brass pistons that dwarf a grown person. Heat from the steam-channels cuts the damp chill of the lower tiers, and hot oil scent sticks to every breath. Blind turns loom in the gloom ahead, promising either safety or a dead end among the turning cogs.

nodes.brief: In a gallery fragrant with burning juniper resin, a Glasswright elder named Sargon examines your seedkey with a critical, rheumy eye.

exits.label: Ask for the elder's formal blessing
Snatch the cold key back now
Wait in silence for his word

nodes.title: The Juniper Gallery
nodes.page: Fragrant curls of burning juniper resin drift across a gallery where a Glasswright elder named Sargon examines your seedkey with a critical, rheumy eye. He turns the cold ceramic artifact over and over in his wrinkled palms, testing its weight against the murmur of distant machinery. Blue smoke coils toward the vaulted ceiling, blurring the elaborate star-charts painted upon the plaster overhead. His silence stretches out like a taut wire, unbroken except for the crackle of the resin brazier.

nodes.brief: Beside an ancient water-cistern that holds the last stagnant drops of the basin, a rival runner named Miri challenges your right to open the vault.

exits.label: Stand your ground against her
Offer a truce of shared water

nodes.title: The Stagnant Cistern
nodes.page: Green scum rings an ancient water-cistern that holds the last stagnant drops of the basin, reflecting the pale glow of your lantern. A rival runner named Miri challenges your right to open the vault, her hand resting casually on the hilt of a bone-handled dagger. Her boots are crusted with white salt from the deep flats, telling of a hard march that rivaled your own. The damp smell of stagnant moisture rises from the stone basin, a bitter reminder of what every living soul in Candlemere is dying for.

nodes.brief: Within a stone-lined cutting that descends into the dark earth, you dodge a volley of warning arrows fired by trigger-happy sentries from the parapet.

exits.label: Dash forward into the deeper shadow
Scramble back up the rising incline

nodes.title: The Stone Cutting
nodes.page: Whistling shafts graze the damp masonry within a stone-lined cutting that descends into the dark earth, forcing you to dodge a volley of warning arrows fired by trigger-happy sentries from the parapet. Feathers flutter down to the flagstones as you flatten yourself against the rough-hewn rock wall. Dust and grit sting your eyes while the echoes of the bow-shots die away into the vaulted gloom below. Every breath tastes of ancient lime and the sharp tang of ozone from the approaching storm.

nodes.brief: Under the shadow of the central observatory tower, you reach the heavy bronze doors of the Rain Vault where the final test awaits.

exits.label: Turn the heavy bronze handle
Inspect the glyphs on the lintel

nodes.title: The Central Tower
nodes.page: Looming pillars of dark basalt rise toward the heavens under the shadow of the central observatory tower, where you reach the heavy bronze doors of the Rain Vault where the final test awaits. Green verdigris streaks the massive metal panels like ancient weeping scars, smelling faintly of copper and rain. Your ember-lamp flickers in the draft whistling through the high colonnade, throwing long and jittery shadows across the glyph-carved threshold. The air grows noticeably cooler here, smelling of damp earth and distant, long-locked moisture.

nodes.brief: At the threshold of the deep subterranean vestibule, you insert the cold ceramic key into the ancient brass lock while distant thunder rumbles overhead.

exits.label: Press on
Turn back

nodes.title: The Subterranean Vestibule
nodes.page: Deep stone walls absorb the sound at the threshold of the deep subterranean vestibule, where you insert the cold ceramic key into the ancient brass lock while distant thunder rumbles overhead. The mechanism responds with a heavy, satisfying click that vibrates up through your forearms. Dust puffs from the keyhole after decades of absolute silence, carrying the dry scent of forgotten harvests. A sudden gust of wind sweeps up the stairwell behind you, howling like a lost spirit against the stone.

nodes.brief: Before the massive obsidian seal of the Rain Vault, you hold your flickering ember-lamp high to verify the glyphs before turning the mechanism.

exits.label: Press on

nodes.title: The Obsidian Seal
nodes.page: Gleaming facets catch the dull red glare of your lantern before the massive obsidian seal of the Rain Vault, where you hold your flickering ember-lamp high to verify the glyphs before turning the mechanism. The polished black stone reflects a distorted, thumb-sized version of your weary face. Somewhere deep within the sealed chamber, water drips with a hollow, resonant echo that promises an end to the long drought. Your fingers grow numb against the freezing metal lever as you prepare to throw your weight behind it.

nodes.brief: Within the echoing threshold chamber, you stand before the sealed bronze barrier as the first heavy drops of the monsoon strike the observatory dome.

exits.label: Press the heavy bronze boundary

nodes.title: Threshold of Bronze
nodes.page:
Within the echoing threshold chamber, you stand before the sealed bronze barrier as the first heavy drops of the monsoon strike the observatory dome. The metal feels damp beneath your fingertips, sweating with condensation from the subterranean air rushing up through the gaps in the stonework. Your banked coal-lantern sputters, casting frantic shadows against the oxidized green ribs of the vault door while distant thunder shakes the bedrock far above your head.

The cold ceramic seedkey rests heavily in your coat pocket, its surface completely immune to the rising warmth of the chamber. Outside, the great dried basin drinks the sudden downpour, but your single purpose lies locked behind this ancient barrier, waiting for the turn of your wrist and the breath of old promise.

nodes.brief: At the final landing of the descent, you press the seedkey home into the waiting socket, sealing your desperate quest against the rising tide.

exits.label: Turn the lock and press on

nodes.title: Final Descent Landing
nodes.page:
At the final landing of the descent, you press the seedkey home into the waiting socket, sealing your desperate quest against the rising tide. The ancient brass mechanism swallows the cold ceramic shaft with a heavy, satisfying click that reverberates deep into the foundation stones. Faint currents of clean, ozone-laden air rush past your shoulder, smelling of damp earth and unspent rain after months of blinding salt-glare and choking dust.

Your shoulder aches from the long miles across the basin, and the soot inside your glass lantern settles as the draft stabilizes around the turning lock. Nothing moves in the dim stairwell except the shifting reflections of your own exhausted face trapped in the polished obsidian panels surrounding the monumental gateway.

nodes.brief: You sprint blindly across the open mirror-terrace, drawing a coordinated volley of blinding light-beams that ignite your pack.
nodes.title: Caught in the Glare
nodes.page: You sprint desperately across the open mirror-terrace, abandoning cover as the heat bears down on your shoulders. Instantly, a coordinated volley of blinding light-beams converges on your position from every nearby tower. The focused solar energy strikes your pack with ferocious heat, instantly scorching the canvas and igniting your banked coal-lantern in a sudden puff of smoke and flame. Blinded and overwhelmed by the searing brilliance, you are forced to halt as the guardians of the basin close in.

nodes.brief: Attempting to smash through the Glasswright sentry gate with your heavy lantern, you shatter your only light-source and are trapped in the pitch-dark galleries as the basin floods.
nodes.title: Darkness in the Gallery
nodes.page:
Attempting to smash through the Glasswright sentry gate with your heavy lantern, you shatter your only light-source and are trapped in the pitch-dark galleries as the basin floods. The brass casing splits with a sharp, metallic shriek, spilling glowing coals across the salt-encrusted floor before a sudden gust of underground wind snuffs the last red embers into absolute blackness. Frantic fingers trace cold, smooth stone and alien brass bezels in the void, finding only locked panels and dead ends while the muffled, rushing roar of the incoming water grows louder from the upper levels.

You stand still in the damp dark, listening to the creeping murmur of the tide filling the hollow glass streets above, knowing the dry rim of Candlemere is a lifetime away across a sea that has finally reclaimed its bed.

nodes.brief: Arrival in The Rain Vault: beneath Prism: the seed halls, the lock, every old promise coming due, and the final choice about the seed. The reader enters with several ways forward.

exits.label: Follow the lamp-lit road
Cut across the common ground

exits.intent: Ask the way of a stranger
exits.label: Ask the way of a stranger
Take the old drovers' track

nodes.title: Beneath the Glass City
nodes.page:
Arrival in the Rain Vault beneath Prism brings the scent of ancient damp and the heavy weight of every old promise coming due as you enter the central hall with several ways forward. Towering pillars of fused quartz and dark basalt stretch upward into the gloom, holding up the observatory-city above while water begins to drip with a rhythmic chime from the ceiling. Your lantern flame steadies in the still, chilled air, throwing long, wavering fingers of light across the dust-covered stone pathways that branch out into the subterranean darkness.

Direction sits on your tongue like grit, for each tunnel leads deeper into the labyrinth where the forgotten harvests of the Old Lensfolk sleep beneath their locks. You adjust the strap of your pack and grip the warm handle of your lantern, ready to pick your path through the sleeping heart of the basin.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Seed Halls: the seed halls; what the reader finds depends on whether they came believing the vault was full or looted

exits.intent: Walk the full halls you believed in
exits.label: Walk the full halls you believed in

exits.intent: Search the looted halls for what was missed
exits.label: Search the looted halls for what was missed

nodes.title: The Heart of the Vaults
nodes.page: Vaulted ceilings stretch into darkness as the massive doors swing inward to reveal the legendary seed halls of Prism, silent and immense. What you find here hangs upon the long-buried truths of the basin, shifting between towering heaps of preserved grain and empty chambers stripped bare by forgotten looters. The cold ceramic key grows heavier in your hand as the silence of the deep earth presses down on your shoulders.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Lock Chamber: the vault lock: sworn Dune Sisters know a well-song the lock remembers; others must work it by hand

exits.intent: Sing the Sisters' well-song to the lock
exits.label: Let the old well-song unlock the heavy stone seal.
Turn the heavy iron levers by hand until the mechanism yields.

nodes.title: The Vault Lock Chamber
nodes.page: Heavy air settles in the Lock Chamber, tasting of deep stone and dry centuries. Before you looms the great circular seal of the Rain Vault, its cold face etched with the faded map of a flooded basin. If you carry the memory of the well-song given by the Dune Sisters, your voice can coax the ancient tumblers to turn without friction or fury. Without that fragile covenant, however, the lock demands muscle and patience, forcing you to crank the rusted iron levers by hand while the basalt walls groan around your shoulders. Every choice here carries the weight of the coming harvest, and the chamber watches with silent, expectant stillness.

nodes.brief: The final reckoning in the Rain Vault: the seed is within reach, the door open or sealed, and the reader must choose what becomes of it. Each exit is one stance.

exits.intent: Open the Rain Vault to everyone
exits.label: Turn the large wheel to open the Rain Vault to everyone

exits.intent: Seal the vault and guard its secret
exits.label: Drop the heavy locking bar and seal the vault against all comers

exits.intent: Take only the seed and run for Candlemere
exits.label: Pry free the primary canister and run for Candlemere alone

nodes.title: The Final Reckoning
nodes.page:
Cool ceramic rests against your palm as you stand before the towering bronze gates of the Rain Vault, listening to the deep drumbeat of the monsoon against the observatory dome. The choice of what to do with the ancient seed hall hangs heavier now than any pack or weapon, shaping the future of every parched town from the rim to the sunken basin. Water pools around your boots, shallow and persistent, signaling that the dry years are over and the time for half-measures has passed entirely.

Every road out of this vaulted chamber leads to a different destiny for the dried lands, whether shared among the thirsty millions, hidden forever behind sealed lead, or carried in secret toward the dying hearths of Candlemere.

nodes.brief: You step through the brass lintel of the Rain Vault, where the air smells of ozone and ancient stone, and the Seedkey warms in your palm.

exits.label: Proceed down the central corridor
Take the narrow arched hallway
Follow the collapsed masonry trail

nodes.title: The Brass Lintel
nodes.page:
You step through the brass lintel of the Rain Vault, where the air smells of ozone and ancient stone, and the Seedkey warms in your palm. The metal threshold is cold beneath your boots, etched with faded agricultural glyphs that trace the turning of forgotten planting seasons. Shadows stretch long and crooked across the paved floor as your lantern light catches the edges of abandoned stone storage bins stretching into the gloom on either side of the passage.

Far overhead, the muffled rumble of the storm echoes through the rock like the beating of a giant's heart, reminding you that the twenty days have run their course. You pause to catch your breath in the drafty corridor, weighing the narrow paths that branch out ahead into the silent heart of the vault.

nodes.brief: Downward stairs of ribbed slate descend into the dark, echoing with the rhythmic drip of condensation that mocks the thirsty towns above.

exits.label: Descend the ringing iron steps

exits.privWhy: the reader carries the glass-burn scar that marks them as one who crossed the Storm
exits.label: Follow the glass-burn passage
Take the cobalt mosaic route

nodes.title: Ribbed Slate Stairs
nodes.page:
Downward stairs of ribbed slate descend into the dark, echoing with the rhythmic drip of condensation that mocks the thirsty towns above. Each step is worn smooth in the center by generations of salt-tax auditors and seed-keepers who walked this way before the great drought settled over the basin. Your boots find a steady purchase on the ridged stone, though the dampness clings to your wool coat like a cold hand.

A faint, whistling draft rises from the lower depths, carrying the metallic tang of old iron and wet earth through the stairwell. You hold your lantern out before you, watching the yellow glow wash over the slick walls and the dark, yawning mouths of side-passages leading away from the descent.

nodes.brief: A rusted grating blocks the secondary tunnel, rattling under the pressure of subterranean draughts that carry the sharp scent of damp earth.

exits.label: Pry at the rusted grating
Check the cobalt mosaic route
Follow the copper tally trail

nodes.title: The Rusted Grating
nodes.page:
A rusted grating blocks the secondary tunnel, rattling under the pressure of subterranean draughts that carry the sharp scent of damp earth. Orange flakes of oxidized iron drift down onto the stone floor as the heavy metal mesh groans against its stone frame with every pulse of the rising underground air. Your lantern illuminates the dark cavity beyond the barrier, where narrow service tunnels vanish into the limestone ribs of the vault.

The bolt holding the frame in place is crusted with thick salt crystals that glitter like dull diamonds in the dim light. With a careful twist of your fingers, you test the give of the rusted iron, listening to the hollow ping of water droplets falling into unseen cisterns far below.

nodes.brief: You slide through a fractured lens-partition, emerging onto a narrow catwalk suspended above an abyss of jagged, silent quartz stalactites.

exits.label: Follow the copper tally trail
Cross the narrow bronze pipe
Inspect the crooked mirror-frame

nodes.title: Fractured Lens-Partition
nodes.page:
You slide through a fractured lens-partition, emerging onto a narrow catwalk suspended above an abyss of jagged, silent quartz stalactites. The shattered glass edges of the partition gleam with a faint, trapped iridescence, catching the yellow rays of your lantern and scattering them into pale prisms against the far wall. Below the metal walkway, the chasm drops away into absolute blackness, broken only by the pale, dagger-like points of crystal rising from the floor of the void.

The metal grating flexes slightly under your boots, ringing with a high, musical vibration that travels straight up through the soles. You keep your center of gravity low, gripping the rusted handrail as you trace the curving edge of the abyss toward the opposite ledge.

nodes.brief: Beside a pillar of fused glass, an abandoned cart of rotting wicker baskets holds only dust and the grey husks of forgotten gourds.

exits.label: Follow the stone drainage trench
Squeeze through the acoustic service vent
Pick across the broken ceramic shards

nodes.title: The Abandoned Cart
nodes.page:
Beside a pillar of fused glass, an abandoned cart of rotting wicker baskets holds only dust and the grey husks of forgotten gourds. The wooden spoking of the wheels has dried and warped away from the iron rims, leaving the vehicle canted at a sad, tired angle against the translucent green column. Fine layers of grey silt coat the bottom of the baskets, undisturbed since the last granary wardens locked these doors and walked out into the blinding glare of the dying sea.

Your lantern flame flickers as a sudden eddy of cool air swirls around the glass pillar, carrying the faint, dry scent of ancient chaff. You step around the splintered axle, keeping your eyes fixed on the branching corridors that cut deeper into the labyrinth of bins and storage vaults.

nodes.brief: A flickering blue gas-jet casts long, wavering shadows across an arched corridor where carved wheat sheaves line the vaulted ceiling.

exits.label: Crawl through the low acoustic vent
Enter the circular brass niche chamber

nodes.title: The Wheat Vault Corridor
nodes.page:
A flickering blue gas-jet casts long, wavering shadows across an arched corridor where carved wheat sheaves line the vaulted ceiling, their stone husks grey with ancient dust. Your banked coal-lantern sputters in the draught, throwing weak orange light against the masonry as you weigh your next step in the quiet dark.

You can press onward through a tight, acoustic service passage or investigate the circular chamber up ahead where brass niches stand empty and waiting.

nodes.brief: You squeeze past a collapsed masonry archway where fallen blocks of white sandstone trap a trickle of bitter, mineral-stained water.

exits.label: Squeeze into the low service vent
Pick your way across the ceramic shards
Push past the stiff leather curtain

nodes.title: The Mineral Seep
nodes.page: You squeeze past a collapsed masonry archway where fallen blocks of white sandstone trap a trickle of bitter, mineral-stained water that pools in the hollows of the floor. The air here tastes of wet lime and old iron, chilled by deep stone.

nodes.brief: An iron door hangs ajar on screaming hinges, revealing an empty alcove scored with deep, frantic claw marks from some desperate predecessor.

exits.label: Step toward the circular brass chamber

exits.privWhy: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over

nodes.title: The Scored Alcove
nodes.page:
An iron door hangs ajar on screaming hinges, revealing an empty alcove scored with deep, frantic claw marks from some desperate predecessor who found no way out before the drought took hold. The metallic tang of rust fills your nose as you shine your banked lantern into the shadowed recess.

You can advance toward the circular chamber or risk a hidden floor-drop if you are traveling entirely alone without a companion to distract your eye.
