priv.why: the reader carries the glass-burn scar that marks them as one who crossed the Storm

nodes.title: The Hidden Shortcut
nodes.page:
Your glass-burn scar tingles against the chill wall, responding to some latent heat in the dressed stones as a concealed latch swings a panel outward to a hidden shortcut. Dust cascades from the pivot as the dark gap widens, offering a route past the main corridors.

You can step through into the field of broken ceramic shards, risk the concealed floor-drop if you are traveling alone, or slip behind the heavy leather curtain of the side gallery.

nodes.brief: A subterranean cistern of black brine laps against a stone quay, reflecting the weak yellow glow of your banked coal-lantern.

exits.label: Walk among the frozen water-pipes
Approach the iron sconce and wax pillar

nodes.title: The Black Brine Quay
nodes.page:
A subterranean cistern of black brine laps against a stone quay, reflecting the weak yellow glow of your banked coal-lantern in oily ripples. The heavy scent of salt and stagnant depth rises from the dark water, untouched by the surface winds for centuries.

You can follow the frozen pipe gallery where ruptured bellies split wide like dry pods, or head toward an old iron sconce holding a grey pillar of ancient wax.

nodes.brief: Overhead, a mosaic of stained glass depicts the legendary First Monsoon, its cobalt panels casting a cool, ocean-deep hue over the flagstones.

exits.label: Inspect the crumbling turquoise mural
Navigate the low brick flood bulkheads

nodes.title: The Stained Glass Mosaic
nodes.page:
Overhead, a mosaic of stained glass depicts the legendary First Monsoon, its cobalt panels casting a cool, ocean-deep hue over the flagstones beneath your boots. The lead cames binding the colored panes hum faintly whenever a stray subterranean current brushes the ceiling vault.

Ahead lies a crumbling mural of turquoise ceramic flakes or a labyrinth of low brick bulkheads designed to hold back ancient floods.

nodes.brief: A pile of discarded copper tally sticks clatters under your boot, left behind by salt-tax auditors who never returned from the deep.

exits.label: Examine the old iron tallow sconce
Traverse the maze of brick bulkheads
Seek the shafts of filtered amber light

nodes.title: The Auditor's Tally
nodes.page:
A pile of discarded copper tally sticks clatters under your boot, left behind by salt-tax auditors who never returned from the deep when the wells failed. The dull clink echoes sharply through the high corridor, disturbing only the quiet accumulation of grey dust.

You can examine the iron sconce with its grey wax stub, thread your way through the low brick bulkheads, or follow narrow ventilation shafts where filtered amber light catches floating motes of quartz.

nodes.brief: You balance along a narrow bronze pipe spanning a chasm, listening to the hollow groan of subterranean metal shifting in the dark.

exits.label: Reach for the warped warden door
Follow the shafts of filtered amber light

nodes.title: The Bronze Pipe Crossing
nodes.page:
You balance along a narrow bronze pipe spanning a chasm, listening to the hollow groan of subterranean metal shifting in the dark below. Every footstep requires absolute care as your banked lantern swings, casting erratic arcs of light against the far abyss wall.

Across the span, you face a warped cedar door bearing an old warden plaque or the narrow ventilation shafts where amber light filters down.

nodes.brief: An old mirror-frame hangs crookedly on the damp wall, its silvered backing flaking away to reveal a cold, empty cavity behind the stone.

exits.label: Try the warped cedar door of the warden
Head toward the filtered amber shafts

nodes.title: The Flaking Mirror
nodes.page:
An old mirror-frame hangs crookedly on the damp wall, its silvered backing flaking away to reveal a cold, empty cavity behind the stone where no reflection lingers. Your own tired face appears only as a blurred shadow against the dark glass as you pause to catch your breath.

You can test the warped cedar door of the Pith warden or press toward the shafts of amber light piercing down from above.

nodes.brief: A stone-lined drainage trench cuts across the floor, carrying a sluggish stream of grey silt toward some unseen sump far below.

exits.label: Ascend the hollow copper spiral stair
Wade through the drift of salt crystals
Follow the ribbed lead tube gallery

nodes.title: The Silt Trench
nodes.page:
A stone-lined drainage trench cuts across the floor, carrying a sluggish stream of grey silt toward some unseen sump far below in the heart of Prism. The damp air smells of wet earth and old lime, thick with the silence of the sealed vault.

Three distinct routes open before you: a spiral stair of hollow copper treads, a threshold choked with crunching salt crystals, or an arched gallery humming with distant winds.

nodes.brief: You crawl through a low service vent lined with acoustic baffles, where every scrape of your pack echoes like distant thunder.

exits.label: Follow the humming metallic conduit
Crawl toward the draft of cold air

nodes.title: The Acoustic Vent
nodes.page:
Every scrape of your heavy canvas pack echoes like distant thunder against the curved metal plates as you crawl through the low service vent. Acoustic baffles of ribbed felt, stiffened with age and salt-dust, press close from above and below, muffling your breathing into a harsh, rhythmic rasp. Your banked lantern casts a amber pulse along the narrow conduit, catching fine filaments of grey lint that drift in the stagnant draft. Ahead the metal narrows into a pair of arteries: one breathes a faint current of cold damp air, and the other carries a deep note from below.

You pause to shift your weight off bruised knees, weighing which direction offers a safer passage through the heart of the sealed observatory.

nodes.brief: A circular chamber opens before you, its perimeter lined with empty brass niches that once held the archives of the old lens-keepers.

exits.label: Wade through the crunching salt drift
Squeeze into the glittering gypsum fissure

nodes.title: The Empty Archives
nodes.page: Empty brass niches line the perimeter of the circular chamber like open teeth in an ancient skull, once holding the delicate paper rolls and glass plates of the old lens-keepers. A thin skim of white powder coats the flagstones where historical records have long since turned to dust and drifted into the corners. Your lantern light sweeps across the vacant slots, revealing only faint rectangular shadows left by centuries of filtered light. Two narrow exits pierce the weathered limestone wall beyond the ring of shelves, offering a choice of routes deeper into the silent complex.

nodes.brief: Broken ceramic shards crunch beneath your soles, glinting in the lantern-light like shattered stars scattered across the basalt floor.

exits.label: Inspect the workbench of clouded beads
Cross the petrified timber bridge

nodes.title: The Shard-Littered Floor
nodes.page: Broken ceramic shards crunch beneath your soles with every stride, glinting in the warm lantern-light like shattered stars scattered across the dark basalt floor. The remnants of ancient vessels lie half-buried in grey silt, testimony to some long-forgotten upheaval that emptied the storage vaults of Prism long before the drought took hold. The air here tastes of baked clay and old lime, thick and motionless against your skin.

nodes.brief: Traveling alone lets you spot the hairline crack in the floor-seal, revealing a hollow drop that bypasses the unstable stairway ahead.

exits.label: Slip down through the hidden floor fracture
Bypass the drop for the timber bridge

priv.why: the reader travels alone and so notices what a guide would talk over

nodes.title: The Hidden Drop
nodes.page: Traveling entirely alone lets you notice the subtle flaws that a guided party would walk straight past, such as the hairline fracture running through the stone floor-seal. You kneel, pressing your fingertips into the cold grout, and feel the faint downward draft of air that reveals a hollow drop beneath the flags. This narrow void bypasses the groaning, unstable stairway ahead, offering an unmonitored descent into the lower tier of the vaults. Silence of the old observatory presses close, years stacked without measure.

nodes.brief: A heavy leather curtain blocks a side gallery, stiffened by age and salt until it feels like a sheet of hammered iron.

exits.label: Step across the petrified timber bridge
Follow the peeling fresco corridor

nodes.title: The Salt-Stiffened Curtain
nodes.page: A heavy leather curtain blocks the side gallery, stiffened by decades of creeping salt until it feels less like hide and more like a sheet of hammered iron. When you push against it with your shoulder, it resists with a dry, cracking groan, showering fine white flakes onto your boots. Beyond this rigid barrier lies a deeper alcove where the amber glow of your lamp catches the faint glint of damp masonry. Two possible routes beckon from the shadows past the curtain.

nodes.brief: You step into a gallery of frozen water-pipes, their ruptured bellies split wide like dry seed pods from ancient winter freezes.

exits.label: Walk toward the peeling barley fresco
Inspect the polished rope ringbolt
Turn back toward the rusted grating

nodes.title: The Ruptured Pipes
nodes.page: Rows of frozen water-pipes stretch down the long gallery, their ruptured bellies split wide like dry seed pods from ancient winter freezes that predated the great heat. Thick collars of grey oxidation crust the jagged metal lips, and the floor beneath them is warped into undulating ridges of hardened silt. Your lantern beam catches the dark mouths of branching corridors cutting away from the central pipe run. A stale draft breathes from behind you, recalling the rusted grating of the secondary tunnel you left not long ago.

nodes.brief: An iron sconce holds the stub of a tallow candle that went out centuries ago, leaving a grey wax pillar on the limestone block.

exits.label: Head toward the polished rope ringbolt

exits.privWhy: the reader owes nobody and can bargain freely
exits.label: Slip through the unmonitored maintenance gate

nodes.title: The Dead Sconce
nodes.page: An iron sconce holds the stub of a tallow candle that went out centuries ago, leaving a thick, grey pillar of hardened wax congealed upon the limestone block. The flame of your own banked coal-lantern flickers in the thin draft, casting dancing shadows across the pitted stone walls. You stand where the path divides between maintained passages and older, forgotten service ways. Depending on the debts you carry or have managed to avoid, certain doors remain open or barred to your passage.

nodes.brief: A mural of glazed ceramic tiles crumbles at your touch, showering the floor with turquoise flakes that tell of long-vanished harvests.

exits.label: Enter the alcove of stamped amphorae
Wade across the dark mineral pool
Brace for the heavy ceiling drop

nodes.title: The Turquoise Murals
nodes.page: Glazed ceramic tiles crumble at the mere brush of your sleeve, showering the floor with bright turquoise flakes that tell of long-vanished harvests and rain-swollen rivers. The mural depicts a green valley that has not existed within the memory of any living runner at Candlemere. Beneath your boots, the ground slopes gently toward a series of dark openings carved into the bedrock. You steady your pack and consider the three narrow ways diverging from the crumbling wall.

nodes.brief: You navigate a maze of low brick bulkheads, designed to stem floods that never reached this high before the great drought.

exits.label: Approach the double-lens stamped amphorae
Step into the dark mineral pool

nodes.title: The Brick Bulkheads
nodes.page: A labyrinth of low brick bulkheads confronts you, built stoutly across the floor to stem floodwaters that never reached this high before the great drought drained the Basin. You step carefully over each low barrier, your lamp swinging in hand and painting long arcs of amber light across the damp brickwork. The air is remarkably still here, smelling of baked clay and ancient lime mortar. Two passages open beyond the bulkhead maze, each promising a way forward through the subterranean labyrinth.

nodes.brief: A brass plaque on a cedar door reads THE WARDEN OF PITH, but the wood is warped and swollen shut against the jamb.

exits.label: Step beneath the dripping bronze grating
Hide behind the slate partition slabs

nodes.title: The Warden's Door
nodes.page: A heavy brass plaque fixed to a cedar door bears the inscription THE WARDEN OF PITH, but the wood is warped and swollen tightly shut against its stone jamb. Age and humidity have fused the grain, resisting even a determined shoulder shove. To either side, alternative routes wind away into the dim recesses of the observatory basement, bypassing the stubborn barrier altogether. You adjust your grip on your lantern and weigh your remaining options in the silence.

nodes.brief: Shafts of filtered amber light pierce down through narrow ventilation shafts, illuminating floating motes of quartz dust in the stillness.

exits.label: Hide behind the slate slabs

nodes.title: Shafts of Amber Light
nodes.page:
Shafts of filtered amber light pierce down through narrow ventilation shafts, illuminating floating motes of quartz dust in the stillness of the subterranean hall. Your banked coal-lantern casts a competing red glow against the ancient masonry, warming the damp air.

You slip behind a stack of slate partition slabs, hiding from the distant, rhythmic clank of automated machinery echoing through the masonry.

A grand double door of iron-studded oak stands slightly ajar ahead, leaking a smell of dry chaff and ancient preservation. A grand double door of iron-studded oak stands slightly ajar ahead, leaking a smell of dry chaff and ancient preservation. Alternatively, you can scramble down a chute of polished green glass, sliding past rows of empty bin markers cut into the basalt.

nodes.title: Arched Gallery of Lead

A grand double door of iron-studded oak stands slightly ajar ahead, leaking a smell of dry chaff and ancient preservation. You can also scramble down a chute of polished green glass, sliding past rows of empty bin markers cut into the basalt, or step through a shattered fanlight into a long gallery where rows of bronze seed-urns stretch into the dim.

nodes.title: Rusted Shears and Glass Beads
nodes.page: A wooden workbench holds a rusted set of jeweler's shears and a bowl of clouded glass beads left mid-polish by an unknown hand. A rusted winch mechanism spans the corridor nearby, its iron chain sagging into a heap of orange flakes upon the flagstones. You might also follow a narrow service catwalk that hugs the apex of the ceiling, or descend a stone staircase into a thick bank of subterranean mist.

nodes.brief: You cross a bridge of petrified timber over a dry irrigation canal, its wooden ribs groaning under your cautious weight.

You can scramble down a chute of polished green glass, sliding past rows of empty bin markers cut into the basalt, or step through a shattered fanlight into a long gallery where rows of bronze seed-urns stretch into the dim.

Turn back toward the pillar

nodes.title: Peeling Fresco of Green Barley
nodes.page: A fresco of green barley stalks peels from the plaster in long ribbons, revealing dark volcanic rock beneath the grand design. You can step through a shattered fanlight into a long gallery where rows of bronze seed-urns stretch into the dim, follow a narrow service catwalk that hugs the apex of the ceiling, or retrace your steps past a pillar of fused glass where an abandoned cart of rotting wicker baskets holds only dust and grey husks.

nodes.brief: An iron ringbolt is set into the floor beside a gaping drainage pit, its shank polished bright by ropes that pulled heavy loads.

exits.label: Ascend to the ceiling catwalk
Descend the misty stone stairs

nodes.title: Iron Ringbolt and Drainage Pit
nodes.page: An iron ringbolt is set into the floor beside a gaping drainage pit, its shank polished bright by heavy ropes that once hauled loads through the dark. You can follow a narrow service catwalk that hugs the apex of the ceiling, offering a bird's-eye view of the vast, silent storage, or descend a stone staircase into a thick bank of subterranean mist that clings to the floor like chilled breath.

nodes.brief: Owing no debts allows you to bypass the locked toll-gate entirely, slipping through an unmonitored maintenance hatch into the inner vaults.

Climb the narrow service catwalk

nodes.title: Unmonitored Maintenance Hatch
nodes.page: Owing no debts to the toll-lords allows you to bypass the locked toll-gate entirely, slipping through an unmonitored maintenance hatch into the inner vaults without a murmur of protest. You can step through a shattered fanlight into a long gallery where rows of bronze seed-urns stretch into the dim, or follow a narrow service catwalk that hugs the apex of the ceiling, offering a bird's-eye view of the vast, silent storage below.

nodes.brief: A stone alcove contains a row of empty amphorae, their clay sides stamped with the double-lens seal of the ancient Prism magistrates.

exits.label: Descend the steep service drop
Follow the lower conduit onward
Turn back toward the dry shaft

nodes.title: The Magistrate's Alcove
nodes.page:
A stone alcove contains a row of empty amphorae, their clay sides stamped with the double-lens seal of the ancient Prism magistrates. The unglazed pottery drinks the dry air of the vault, smelling faintly of ancient resin and long-evaporated wine. Beyond the alcove, the corridor forks around a pillar of fused basalt, leaving you to choose between the narrow service drop or the lower conduit.

You brush your fingers against the stamped clay, feeling the cold weight of your ember-lamp shift on its strap.

nodes.brief: You wade through a shallow pool of mineral water that mirrors the vaulted brickwork like a sheet of dark, liquid obsidian.

exits.label: Step down into the mist
Track the iron transport groove

nodes.title: The Obsidian Mirror Pool
nodes.page: You wade through a shallow pool of mineral water that mirrors the vaulted brickwork like a sheet of dark, liquid obsidian. Every step sends dull ripples outward to disturb the absolute stillness of the subterranean lakelet, echoing softly against the damp mortar. Ahead, the path divides into two distinct routes through the flooded foundations of the observatory.

nodes.brief: A bronze grating set into the ceiling drops a single, heavy drop of water directly onto the shoulder of your damp jacket.

exits.label: Slip through the salt-crusted drape
Step down into the mist
Track the iron transport groove

nodes.title: The Leaking Grating
nodes.page: A bronze grating set into the ceiling drops a single, heavy drop of water directly onto the shoulder of your damp jacket. The chill moisture startles your skin, a rare reminder of open skies above the dead sea of glass. The passage ahead splits into a pair of branching tunnels that wind deeper into the gloom.

nodes.brief: You slip behind a stack of slate partition slabs, hiding from the distant, rhythmic clank of automated machinery that refuses to stop.

exits.label: Track the iron transport groove
Turn back toward the broken arch

nodes.title: Behind the Slate Slabs
nodes.page: You slip behind a stack of slate partition slabs, hiding from the distant, rhythmic clank of automated machinery that refuses to stop. The heavy stone blocks smell of ancient dust and cool iron, offering a secure shadow away from the open thoroughfare. You can either push forward into the humming heart of the mechanism or retrace your steps.

nodes.brief: A grand double door of iron-studded oak stands slightly ajar, leaking a smell of dry chaff and ancient, preserved grain hulls.

exits.label: Approach the outer bronze gate
Inspect the central granary threshold

nodes.title: The Chaff-Scented Door
nodes.page: A grand double door of iron-studded oak stands slightly ajar, leaking a smell of dry chaff and ancient, preserved grain hulls. The wood is warped with age yet remarkably sturdy, held together by hand-forged braces that catch the yellow flicker of your lamp. Stepping through this gap promises entry into the vaulted granaries of the Old Lensfolk.

nodes.brief: You scramble down a chute of polished green glass, sliding past rows of empty bin markers cut into the basalt rock-face.

exits.label: Approach the outer bronze gate of the Great Seed Hall
Step toward the threshold of the primary vault

nodes.title: The Green Chute
nodes.page: Slipping through the vertical throat of the green glass chute, you descend in a rush of cool air and friction, your boots skimming past rows of empty bin markers deeply incised into the dark basalt rock-face. The chute deposits you upon a landing of ribbed lead where the smell of stale copper hangs heavy and your ember-lamp casts long, jittery shadows against the stone. Ahead, two distinct passages beckon from the gloom, each offering a different approach to the heart of the dormant vault.

nodes.brief: A rusted winch mechanism spans the corridor, its iron chain sagging into a heap of orange flakes upon the flagstone floor.

exits.label: Inspect the central granary threshold
Examine the primary vault threshold

nodes.title: The Rusted Winch
nodes.page: A rusted winch mechanism spans the corridor, its iron chain sagging into a heap of orange flakes upon the flagstone floor. The heavy drum is locked fast by thick crusts of oxide, bearing silent witness to the centuries that have passed since anyone hoisted a load here. The path ahead branches around the dead machinery.

nodes.brief: You step through a shattered fanlight into a long gallery where rows of bronze seed-urns stretch into the dim distance.

exits.label: Approach the heavy doors of the central granary

nodes.title: The Bronze Gallery
nodes.page:
Through the jagged frame of a shattered fanlight you step into a long subterranean gallery of bronze seed-urns stretching into the dim distance, surfaces oxidized to a pale sea-green. Your ember-lamp flickers against the vaulted ceiling, catching the faint glint of ancient condensation weeping down the metal flanks of the urns. Silence wraps around you like a wet wool blanket, broken only by the steady rhythm of your own breathing and the dull scrape of your boots on the flagged floor.

The doors of the central granary stand ahead, ready for the key you carry.

nodes.brief: A narrow service cat-walk hugs the apex of the ceiling, offering a bird's-eye view of the vast, silent storage vaults below.

exits.label: Examine the primary vault threshold
Approach the final rain seal

nodes.title: The Service Cat-Walk
nodes.page: A narrow service cat-walk hugs the apex of the ceiling, offering a bird's-eye view of the vast, silent storage vaults below. Iron mesh rattles under your boots, suspended high above the darkened floor where old bins wait in eternal twilight. You can follow the suspended walkway further into the storage complex or descend toward the massive sealing doors.

nodes.brief: You push past a heavy wool drape stiffened with salt- crust, entering a chamber where the air tastes startlingly sweet and cold.

exits.label: Step toward the threshold of the primary vault
Face the massive seal of the Rain Vault

nodes.title: The Salt-Draped Chamber
nodes.page:
Pushing past a wool drape stiffened with a thick crust of white salt, you enter a subterranean chamber where the air tastes startlingly sweet and cold beside the dry alkaline dust of the upper levels. Your lamp illuminates smooth limestone walls weeping pale droplets into a central stone basin that has stayed dry for generations. Every sound here feels muffled, soaked up by the hangings and the dense packed earth underfoot.

The massive seal of the Rain Vault fills the corridor ahead, presenting the final barrier between Candlemere and survival.

nodes.brief: A stone staircase descends into a thick bank of subterranean mist that clings to the floor like chilled breath in winter.

exits.label: Step carefully down into the thick mist
Reach out to feel along the cold damp wall

nodes.title: Mist Along the Stairs
nodes.page: Cool moisture dampens your brow as a stone staircase descends into a thick bank of subterranean mist that clings to the floor like chilled breath in winter. Every downward step muffles your boots against the flagstones, trading the dry alkaline grit of the upper levels for the dense, stagnant damp of the deep vaults. Faint shadows shift beyond the reaches of your ember-lamp, suggesting massive pillars or towering granary walls hidden just beneath the grey haze.

nodes.brief: You follow a groove in the floor where heavy iron transport trucks once ran, leading straight toward the heart of the seed halls.

exits.label: Follow the old iron tracks deeper inward
Step off the tracks to search the shadowy alcoves

nodes.title: The Iron Transport Groove
nodes.page: Where iron transport trucks once ran, deep channels score the floor in a straight cut toward the heart of the seed halls. Your boots follow the smooth iron tracks through an endless corridor of echoing silence, guided by the straight path carved by hands that vanished centuries ago. The air here tastes faintly of rusted metal and dry earth, promising that the central vaults are near at hand.

nodes.brief: You stand before the outer bronze gate of the Great Seed Hall, where the cold ceramic Seedkey hums in your trembling grip.

exits.label: Turn the ceramic key in the bronze lock

nodes.title: The Outer Bronze Gate
nodes.page: Massive metalwork blocks your path as you stand before the outer bronze gate of the Great Seed Hall, where the cold ceramic Seedkey hums in your trembling grip. Green verdigris streaks the panels around engravings of long-withered grain stalks and clouds that never brought rain. Your banked coal-lantern casts a warm, flickering amber glow over the keyway, inviting the final turn that will test every mile you walked across the basin.

nodes.brief: The heavy doors of the central granary loom before you, their surfaces carved with hollow depressions that await the true key.

exits.label: Press the ceramic key into the hollow panel

nodes.title: The Central Granary Doors
nodes.page: Before you loom wooden timbers bound in darkened iron, surfaces carved with hollow depressions that await the true key. The wood is bone-dry and cracked with age, yet it still smells of ancient harvests that outlasted empires. Your fingers brush the central depression while your ember-lamp sputters softly against the draft slipping from the gaps in the grain-house.

nodes.brief: You reach the threshold of the primary vault, wondering whether the ancient bins hold life-giving grain or only centuries of ash.

exits.label: Step across the threshold to test the ancient bins

nodes.title: The Primary Vault Threshold
nodes.page: Stone lintels frame the entrance as you reach the threshold of the primary vault, wondering whether the ancient bins hold life-giving grain or only centuries of ash. Faint drafts whistle through the doorframe, carrying the dry rattle of neglected husks and the hollow echoes of your own breathing. Your lantern light washes over towering mounds of shadow that might conceal either salvation or absolute ruin.

nodes.brief: The massive seal of the Rain Vault fills the corridor ahead, presenting the final barrier between Candlemere and total ruin.

exits.label: Slide the Seedkey into the glass seal

nodes.title: The Rain Vault Seal
nodes.page: Massive slabs of fused glass and grey stone form the final barrier between Candlemere and total ruin, filling the corridor ahead with an impenetrable wall. The seal bears no handle or latch, only a narrow slot shaped precisely to receive the cold ceramic key resting in your palm. Your ember-lamp flickers once as a sudden subterranean draft sweeps past the great barrier, whispering of secrets kept too long.

nodes.brief: Among towering alabaster jars filled with petrified rye, you discover a ledger detailing long-forgotten debts that could rewrite your village's survival.

exits.label: Examine the ledger entries by lantern light
Dodge tumbling ceramic tiles beneath a shattered skylight

exits.privWhy: the Seedkey is whole and answers the old locks
exits.label: Open the hidden floor panel revealed by your key

nodes.title: Alabaster Jars and Old Debts
nodes.page: Towering alabaster jars rise like pale monuments out of the gloom, filled with petrified rye that has turned to stone over the long centuries. Beside them, you discover a ledger detailing long-forgotten debts that could rewrite your village's survival, written in neat ink that has outlasted the hands that penned it. The faint scent of dried salt clings to the parchment pages as your lantern light flickers across columns of figures promising redemption or bitter reckonings.

nodes.brief: Beneath rows of copper pods smelling faintly of dry lavender, an intact seed vault holds thousands of shimmering wheat kernels awaiting your key.

exits.label: Navigate mounds of blackened barley husks
Listen to the abandoned copper hoe clatter against your boot
Step gingerly over drifts of crystal dust under peeling constellations

nodes.title: The Intact Seed Pods
nodes.page: Rows of copper pods stretching into the gloom smell faintly of dry lavender, guarding an intact seed vault that holds thousands of shimmering wheat kernels awaiting your key. The metal containers remain tightly sealed against the ravages of time, preserving life within their gleaming bellies while the outside world turns to salt and dust. Your ember-lamp catches on the polished surfaces, casting dancing amber reflections across the long-forgotten bounty.

nodes.brief: Beside a collapsed grain silo leaking gray dust, a discarded iron lantern flickers with a trapped ghost-moth guiding you deeper.

exits.label: Squeeze through the narrow ventilation slit choked with price
Enter the circular archive room where parchment scrolls drift
Follow the rhythmic water-clock dripping beside bitter brine

nodes.title: The Ghost-Moth's Lantern
nodes.page: A collapsed grain silo leaks gray dust across the flagstones, accompanied by a discarded iron lantern flickering with a trapped ghost-moth guiding you deeper. Its pale blue luminescence cuts through the heavy gloom, pointing toward a narrow fissure in the stone wall where ancient air circulates freely. You adjust your grip on your own coal-lantern, following the erratic flight of the glowing insect into the uncharted dark.

nodes.brief: Underneath a shattered skylight weeping fine white sand, you dodge tumbling ceramic tiles threatening to crush your ceramic key.

exits.label: Dash past the falling tiles ahead
Duck into a shadowy alcove to wait
Scramble toward a brass-fitted maintenance pipe

nodes.title: Shattered Skylight Vault
nodes.page: Fine white salt sifts through a jagged rent in the overhead vault, dusting your shoulders as you dance across the flagstones. Ceramic tiles break loose from the crumbling sill above and smash into white shards inches from your boots, close enough to crush the cold ceramic key clutched in your palm. You leap past the falling debris into the deeper gloom, your coal-lantern swinging wildly against your thigh while you weigh your next step toward the lower chambers.

nodes.brief: Because your Seedkey resonates with the ancient brass latches, a hidden floor panel pops open to reveal an unplundered grain gallery.

exits.label: Descend into the unplundered grain gallery
Follow the narrow corridor along the wall
Inspect the low basalt archway ahead

priv.why: the Seedkey is whole and answers the old locks

nodes.title: The Resonant Latch
nodes.page: The cold ceramic key in your hand kicks once against your palm, vibrating in time with the concealed machinery within the masonry. A heavy stone floor panel clicks and pivots open without a sound, revealing a cool, untouched subterranean gallery filled with untouched rows of dark grain bins. You peer down into the unexpected recess where the air tastes of ancient dust and promised life.

nodes.brief: Within a freezing chamber of basalt shelves, you navigate mounds of blackened barley husks while your banked coal-lantern sputters.

exits.label: Follow the sound of distant water running
Step beneath the low salt-crusted basalt arch

exits.label: Present your debt badge to the brass gate
Hide behind the empty terracotta seed-bin

nodes.title: Frost and Barley Husks
nodes.page: Bitter drafts bite through your coat as you wade through knee-deep drifts of blackened barley husks inside the freezing basalt chamber. Your banked coal-lantern sputters and dims against the damp cold, casting pale, wavering light over frost-rimed walls and twisted iron conduits. You brace the lantern and listen to the hollow crunch of husks beneath your boots while you hunt a way through the gloom.

nodes.brief: Beside a dry stone fountain carved with sleeping fish, an abandoned copper hoe clatters against your boot in the echoing silence.

exits.label: Descend the narrow spiral staircase downward
Skirt the slippery pool of green mineral scum
Pocket the heavy bronze gear from the desk

nodes.title: The Sleeping Stone Fish
nodes.page: A dry stone fountain carved with curling stone fish stands silent under the low vault, its basin choked with pale crystal dust. Your boot kicks against an abandoned copper hoe left in the dust, sending a sharp metallic clatter ringing off the damp walls. The sudden noise hangs heavy in the stillness as you grip your lantern and look down the branching dark tunnels.

nodes.brief: Under a vaulted ceiling painted with peeling constellations, you step gingerly over drifts of crystal dust that whisper when disturbed.

exits.label: Trace the faded blue stencil toward the granary
Hurry past the stacks of crumbling wicker hampers

nodes.title: Whispering Crystal Dust
nodes.page: Peeling constellations painted in faded lapis and gold arch above your head across the low vaulted ceiling. You step gingerly over undulating drifts of crystal dust that shift and sigh under your weight like sleeping insects. The faint scratching sound follows your heels as you scan the shadows for a clear passage deeper into the vault.

nodes.brief: Past a row of rusted iron gates locked by time, you squeeze through a narrow ventilation slit choked with prickly saltwort.

exits.label: Emerge into the damp round vestibule
Check your Seedkey near the bronze scales
Hack through the gray vines ahead

nodes.title: The Saltwort Vent
nodes.page: Rusted iron gates secured by long-dead mechanisms bar the main corridor, forcing you to squeeze sideways through a narrow ventilation slit choked with prickly saltwort. Sharp thorns tug at your sleeves and scratch your knuckles while you worm your way through the dry vegetation into the dark space beyond. You shake the stinging burrs from your coat and catch the scent of damp stone and old earth.

nodes.brief: Within a circular archive room, fluttering parchment scrolls drift like dying moths around your head while you seek the lock chamber.

exits.label: Cut through the subterranean greenhouse
Sidestep the rushing mineral drainage channel
Examine the deep dark shaft by the winch
Turn back toward the alabaster jars

nodes.title: Scrolls of the Archive
nodes.page: Fluttering parchment scrolls detach from the rotting shelves like dying moths, brushing against your face and hair in the drafty circular archive. You swat the brittle paper away while keeping your eyes fixed on the shadows for any sign of the lock chamber. The air smells intensely of dry glue and centuries of forgotten records.

nodes.brief: Beside a bubbling puddle of bitter brine, an old copper water-clock drips rhythmic warnings of the approaching monsoon flood.

exits.label: Hack through the tangled greenhouse vines
Sidestep the rushing mineral drainage channel
Peer down the deep dark shaft by the winch

nodes.title: The Dripping Water Clock
nodes.page: An ancient copper water-clock ticks beside a bubbling puddle of thick bitter brine, its slow rhythmic drips marking the monsoon flood's approach. The metal vessel echoes with every metallic plop, a stark reminder of the twenty days ticking away above the basin. You wipe moisture from your brow and eye the branching tunnels leading onward.

nodes.brief: Underneath hanging clusters of dried gourd-flasks, you find an open vault alcove smelling sharply of old vinegar and parched earth.

exits.label: Inspect the rusted winch system and hanging chains
Search the charred lockers for the master hatch
Wipe the stinging sweat near the dry lime trough

nodes.title: The Vinegar Alcove
nodes.page: Hanging clusters of dried gourd-flasks knock gently together in the stale draft, casting ribbed shadows across an open stone alcove that smells sharply of old vinegar and parched earth. You crouch by the low threshold, lifting your amber-lamp higher to inspect the pale crusts scaling the lower masonry. Every surface bears the fine, gray powder of a long-dead harvest, undisturbed except for the narrow tracks of your own boots in the dust. Ahead, the dry corridor splinters into three distinct routes deeper into the vault's labyrinth, each marked by its own peculiar scent and shadow.

nodes.brief: Through a corridor lined with fractured prisms, red light slices across your path to reveal a floor paved with fragile glass shards.

exits.label: Check your Seedkey by the ancient scales
Sidestep the rushing mineral drainage channel
Search the long gallery of charred oak lockers

nodes.title: The Prism Corridor
nodes.page: Fractured prisms lining the walls catch the weak glow of your lantern, slicing sharp ribbons of red light across the floor. Each step must be placed with absolute care upon the pavement of fragile glass shards that crunch delicately beneath your soles. You hold your breath to keep your balance as the corridor bends toward a fresh expanse of shadow.

nodes.brief: Beside a monumental stone pillar carved with sprouting ferns, you clear away heavy cobwebs hiding a brass maintenance hatch.

exits.label: Descend the iron ladder
Follow the lateral service tunnel

nodes.title: The Maintenance Hatch
nodes.page: Beside a monumental stone pillar carved with sprouting ferns, you clear away heavy cobwebs hiding a brass maintenance hatch. The metal is cold under your fingers, coated in a fine layer of white crystalline dust that flakes off at your lightest touch. Inside the narrow cavity, a draft of stale underground air stirs the flame of your banked coal-lantern, casting restless shadows against the damp masonry. You press your ear against the cold casing, listening for the faint, rhythmic pulse of hidden machinery vibrating through the bedrock.

nodes.brief: Within a dim alcove filled with discarded sieves, you listen to the distant rumble of subterranean water probing the lower foundations.

exits.label: Proceed toward the low rumble
Climb the fracture stairs
Investigate the shadowed corner

nodes.title: The Distant Rumble
nodes.page: Within a dim alcove filled with discarded sieves, you listen to the distant rumble of subterranean water probing the lower foundations. Fine particles of grit sift down from the vaulted ceiling above, settling on the shoulders of your travel-worn coat as the tremor deepens. Your ember-lamp flickers in the draft, throwing long, trembling silhouettes against stacked heaps of rusted ironwork and broken pottery. The air tastes thick with copper and damp earth, warning you that the deep cisterns are shifting beneath the weight of the coming monsoon.

nodes.brief: Under a low basalt archway encrusted with salt crystals, your lamp catches the glint of a silver measuring rod left behind.

exits.label: Venture down the salt-lined gallery

nodes.title: The Silver Measuring Rod
nodes.page: Under a low basalt archway encrusted with salt crystals, your lamp catches the glint of a silver measuring rod left behind by generations past. The delicate instrument is welded into the stone by centuries of saline growth, its markings dulled by a pale crust of grey residue. Beyond this point, the corridor slopes downward into absolute darkness, broken only by the rhythmic dripping of condensation from overhead pipes. You adjust your grip on the Seedkey, feeling its cold ceramic surface steadying your nerves against the gathering chill.

nodes.brief: Because the Salt Court recognizes your registered debt badge, an automated brass gate swings open to spare you a treacherous climb.

exits.label: Follow the paved ledger path

nodes.title: The Automated Gate
nodes.page: Because the Salt Court recognizes your registered debt badge, an automated brass gate swings open to spare you a treacherous climb. Counterweights groan inside the stone wall as the metal barrier sinks into the floor with a dull, echoing thud. The sudden passage opens into a wide, dry gallery smelling faintly of old parchment and dried resin, untouched by the drafts of the outer halls. You step across the threshold and the mechanism locks behind you with a final click.

nodes.brief: Beside an empty terracotta seed-bin large enough to hide inside, you pause to catch your breath against the rising humidity.

exits.label: Advance toward the vaulted junction
Squeeze through the narrow fissure
Turn back to the upper galleries

nodes.title: The Empty Seed-Bin
nodes.page: Beside an empty terracotta seed-bin large enough to hide inside, you pause to catch your breath against the rising humidity. The vast ceramic container stands half-cracked, its interior stained with the purple residue of ancient grain preservation vats. Wisps of warm air curl up from the floor grates, carrying the unmistakable scent of wet stone and brewing fermentation from deep within the basin's roots. You check your coal-lantern to ensure the banked embers remain glowing brightly in the thickening fog.

nodes.brief: Within a gallery of silent terracotta statues, you spot a narrow spiral stair winding downward toward the dark core of the basin.

exits.label: Descend the spiral steps
Inspect the heavy lead boxes
Squeeze through the narrow fissure

nodes.title: The Spiral Stair
nodes.page: Within a gallery of silent terracotta statues, you spot a narrow spiral stair winding downward toward the dark core of the basin. Each stone step is worn smooth in the center by the countless footsteps of ancient tenders who once maintained these deep agricultural vaults. Your lantern light catches the pale glint of mica embedded in the handrail, guiding your descent into the cool, silent depths below Prism. A faint draft hums through the stairwell like a distant chorus sung in an empty cathedral.

nodes.brief: Under a web of rusted iron pipes dripping stagnant moisture, you skirt a slippery pool of green mineral scum blocking the doorway.

exits.label: Proceed past the stagnant pool
Squeeze through the narrow fissure

nodes.title: The Mineral Scum
nodes.page: Under a web of rusted iron pipes dripping stagnant moisture, you skirt a slippery pool of green mineral scum blocking the doorway. The viscous liquid bubbles sluggishly, releasing a sharp tang of sulfur and aged brine that stings the back of your throat. You press close to the damp stone wall, planting your boots carefully on dry patches of granite to keep your footing secure. The faint glow of your lantern glints off the slick surface, revealing tiny, pale insects scattering into the dark recesses beneath the doorframe.

nodes.brief: Beside a shattered observation desk covered in gritty salt, you pocket a heavy bronze gear that might serve as a makeshift lever.

exits.label: Inspect the lead storage stacks
Examine the scored iron hatch
Enter the ceramic-lined vestibule

nodes.title: The Observation Desk
nodes.page: Beside a shattered observation desk covered in gritty salt, you pocket a heavy bronze gear that might serve as a makeshift lever. The wooden furniture has long since warped and split under the harsh desert climate, leaving only metal brackets and brittle splinters behind. Through the grimy fragments of a high reinforced window, pale shafts of light pierce the gloom, illuminating floating motes of white dust. You test the weight of the metal piece in your palm, appreciating its solid reassurance against the unknown chambers ahead.

nodes.brief: Within a vaulted granary echoing with your solitary footsteps, you trace the faded blue stencil of the Old Lensfolk grain mark.

exits.label: Squeeze past the iron pipe
Investigate the sunken drain

Take the reckless way

nodes.title: The Granary Wall
nodes.page: Within a vaulted granary echoing with your solitary footsteps, you trace the faded blue stencil of the Old Lensfolk grain mark. The painted emblem - a stylized rain cloud pierced by a needle of light - remains remarkably sharp despite centuries of neglect. Rows of empty storage bays stretch away into the gloom on either side, their earthen floors covered in a fine drift of powdery mineral dust. You pause to listen, hearing only the steady, rhythmic drip of water somewhere in the darkness ahead.

nodes.brief: Under a ceiling pierced by pale sunbeams from above, you hurry past stacks of crumbling wicker hampers that threaten to collapse.

exits.label: Approach the scored iron hatch
Enter the tiled vestibule

nodes.title: The Sunbeam Ceiling
nodes.page: Under a ceiling pierced by pale sunbeams from above, you hurry past stacks of crumbling wicker hampers that threaten to collapse. The fragile baskets shed dry fibers that crunch under your boots, filling the air with the dry, papery scent of antiquity. High above, narrow light-shafts cut through the gloom like golden spears, illuminating the dust motes dancing in the quiet vault. You keep your head down, watching your footing as the stone path narrows sharply between two massive pillars of fused glass.

nodes.brief: Through a narrow gap between massive stone slabs, you emerge into a round vestibule smelling strongly of damp iron and cold earth.

exits.label: Advance toward the green hall
Hurry past the flood marker pillar

nodes.title: The Iron Vestibule
nodes.page:
Through a narrow gap between massive stone slabs, you emerge into a round vestibule smelling strongly of damp iron and cold earth. Your coal-lantern flickers, casting long, distorted shadows against the flaking mortar of the walls. Every breath tastes faintly of the ancient dust settling over the basin's forgotten heart. Ahead, the route fractures into deeper shadows, demanding a swift decision before the stale air saps your remaining strength.

You adjust the ceramic Seedkey tucked securely inside your coat, feeling its familiar, steady chill against your ribs.

nodes.brief: Beside an ancient bronze weighing scale tilted at a reckless angle, you check your Seedkey to ensure it remains free of grit.

exits.label: Proceed through the green archway

nodes.title: The Bronze Scale
nodes.page: Beside an ancient bronze weighing scale tilted at a reckless angle, you check your Seedkey to ensure it remains free of grit. The rusty pans scrape against the flagstones with a thin, metallic sigh whenever a subterranean draft sweeps through the chamber. Your banked coal-lantern glows warmly against the gloom, illuminating the fine layer of salt crusting the floor like hoarfrost. There is only one clear way forward from this cramped alcove, deeper into the bowels of the silent observatory.

nodes.brief: Within a subterranean greenhouse filled with gray vines, you hack through brittle stems blocking the approach to the inner vault.

exits.label: Follow the path toward the granite pillar

nodes.title: The Gray Vines
nodes.page: Within a subterranean greenhouse filled with gray vines, you hack through brittle stems blocking the approach to the inner vault. The severed stalks release a sharp, herbal tang that cuts right through the heavy smell of old moisture and dry earth. Shadows dance across the tangled trellises as you push your way toward the far side of the enclosure. Several murky routes branch out from the tangled foliage, each promising a different path through the tangled ruins.

nodes.brief: Under a low ceiling studded with glowing mineral veins, you sidestep a deep drainage channel rushing with bitter subterranean meltwater.

nodes.title: The Mineral Meltwater
nodes.page: Under a low ceiling studded with glowing mineral veins, you sidestep a deep drainage channel rushing with bitter subterranean meltwater. The constant gushing echoes hollowly off the basalt walls, masking any other sounds that might creep up from the dark tunnels. You grip your coal-lantern tighter to keep the damp draft from snuffing out the precious flame. Behind you, the way back remains open, while two other passages beckon into the gloom.

nodes.brief: Beside a rusted winch system dangling heavy iron chains, you examine a deep shaft plunging into absolute darkness below.

exits.label: Raise your lantern against the gathering dark
Step into the narrowing basalt corridor

nodes.title: The Rusted Winch
nodes.page: Beside a rusted winch system dangling heavy iron chains, you examine a deep shaft plunging into absolute darkness below. Links clink softly as rising air currents set the rusted tackle swinging in slow rhythmic arcs. Your lantern light barely reaches the slimy brickwork lining the abyss.

nodes.brief: Within a long gallery of charred oak lockers, you search for the master hatch while your coal-lantern dims in the stale air.

exits.label: Hurry past the towering granite pillar

nodes.title: The Charred Lockers
nodes.page: Within a long gallery of charred oak lockers, you search for the master hatch while your coal-lantern dims in the stale air. Splintered doors hang loosely from rusted hinges, revealing only empty shelves and accumulated drifts of gray soot. The floor creaks beneath your boots with an unsettling hollowness that suggests deep voids beneath the masonry.

nodes.brief: Underneath a massive stone lintel bearing an eroded warning glyph, you steady your trembling hands against the damp masonry.

exits.label: Approach the glittering salt gate

nodes.title: The Eroded Warning
nodes.page: Underneath a massive stone lintel bearing an eroded warning glyph, you steady your trembling hands against the damp masonry. The carved script has been worn down by centuries of humid air, leaving only mysterious curves that hint at forgotten perils. Beyond the threshold the floor drops into still air broken only by the soft hissing of your coal-lantern. Two distinct routes invite your next cautious steps into the vault's core.

nodes.brief: Beside a dry stone trough filled with powdery white lime, you wipe stinging sweat from your eyes as the air grows heavier.

exits.label: Walk toward the green glass arch

nodes.title: The Lime Trough
nodes.page: Beside a dry stone trough filled with powdery white lime, you wipe stinging sweat from your eyes as the air grows heavier. The fine dust clings to your fingers and coats the hem of your coat like flour. Faint drafts whistle through hairline fractures in the stone above, carrying the scent of ancient stone and deep earth. The chamber splits into several shadowy avenues, each offering a different way forward through the subterranean labyrinth.

nodes.title: The Sunlit Bypass
nodes.page: Because you read the Glasswrights' high-wall mirror flashes, you bypass a collapsed tunnel by taking a sun-lit ventilation bypass. Shafts of pale, refracted daylight cut through the gloom like golden wires, guiding your boots safely over the rubble. The air here is surprisingly dry and crisp, smelling faintly of heated glass and clean desert wind. Two clear exits lie ahead, leading deeper into the heart of the sealed observatory.

nodes.brief: Within a circular junction chamber paved with green slag-glass, three competing archways beckon with different drafts of stale air.

nodes.title: The Slag-Glass Junction
nodes.page: Within a circular junction chamber paved with green slag-glass, three competing archways beckon with different drafts of stale air. The smooth floor reflects your coal-lantern's amber glow in shimmering, distorted pools of green light. Faint whispers seem to ride the air currents, though they dissolve into silence the moment you stop to listen. Multiple passages branch out into the darkness, alongside the route by which you arrived.

nodes.brief: Under a vaulted roof etched with map lines of the dry basin, you calculate your exact bearings against the approaching flood rumble.

exits.label: Take the left path toward the basin slope
Follow the right passage beneath the mineral veins

nodes.title: The Map Etchings
nodes.page:
Cartographic lines of the desiccated inland sea stretch across the vaulted ceiling above your head, traced in fine mineral dust by long-dead surveyors. A deep, subterranean rumble vibrates through the stone floor beneath your boots, carrying the unmistakable threat of the approaching monsoon flood. You trace your current bearing against the ancient diagrams, weighing the remaining distance against the gathering roar.

Two paths diverge ahead into the gloom, each offering a distinct route deeper toward the vault's core.

nodes.brief: Beside a stack of heavy lead storage boxes, you pause to mend a frayed strap on your lamp harness before continuing onward.

exits.label: Proceed forward down the unlit hall
Turn toward the sloping chamber ahead

nodes.title: The Frayed Harness
nodes.page:
Heavy lead storage boxes line the damp corridor, casting long, blocky shadows in the dim light of your coal-lantern. You pause beside them to secure a fraying leather strap on your lamp harness, pulling the buckle tight to keep the weight steady against your chest. Heat from the banked coals soaks the metal while you ready yourself for the final push into the subterranean depths.

Ahead, the tunnel splits into two distinct directions, leading deeper into the cool masonry.

nodes.brief: Within a narrow crevice between basalt foundations, you squeeze past a jutting iron pipe that groans under the weight of the ruin.

exits.label: Step down toward the broad antechamber
Walk past the dark sentry alcoves

nodes.title: The Groaning Pipe
nodes.page:
Basalt foundations press close around your shoulders as you squeeze sideways through a narrow, jagged crevice. A rusted iron pipe runs along the wall, groaning under the immense shifting weight of the ancient ruin with every breath of damp air. You slide past the metal barrier carefully, your boots finding firm purchase on the grit-strewn floor just as the pressure eases.

Two distinct routes open up before you out of the tight passage.

nodes.brief: Under a flickering amber glow from your lantern, you inspect a heavy iron hatch scored by old claw marks and salt rot.

exits.label: Head down toward the main basin threshold
Walk past the silent stone alcoves
Step toward the booming bronze doors

nodes.title: The Scored Hatch
nodes.page:
Amber light flickers across a heavy iron hatch, revealing deep, erratic claw marks and thick crusts of white salt rot baked into the hinges. You hold your coal-lantern closer to inspect the seal, wondering what desperate hands once tried to tear the metal open from the other side. The air here tastes dry and old, yet a faint, cool draught stirs the soot around your boots.

Three separate tunnels beckon from this junction point into the dark.

nodes.brief: Beside a sunken drain grate choked with fossilized roots, you listen closely for the mechanical click of the distant vault tumblers.

exits.label: Approach the massive swinging bronze doors

nodes.title: The Fossilised Grate
nodes.page:
Fossilised roots choke a sunken drain grate beside your boots, forming a tangled web of stone and dark sediment. You kneel close to the iron bars, holding your breath to listen past the hum of your lantern for the precise mechanical click of distant vault tumblers. A heavy draft sweeps up from the depths, carrying the scent of damp earth and ancient iron.

A single towering doorway stands ready for your approach.

nodes.brief: Within a vestibule lined with dusty ceramic tiles, you spot the carved stone insignia of the Rain Vault pointing down the final passage.

exits.label: Pass by the empty sentry alcoves
Approach the heavy bronze doors ahead

nodes.title: The Ceramic Insignia
nodes.page: Dusty ceramic tiles cover the walls of this quiet vestibule, framing the distinct, weathered stone insignia of the Rain Vault. The carved emblem points downward with a worn finger of clay, marking the correct descent through the final passage. You adjust your grip on the ceramic key tucked inside your coat and step forward.

nodes.brief: Through a towering archway of fused green glass, you enter the grand approach hall leading straight to the great lock chamber.

exits.label: Approach the massive iron lock cylinder
Walk toward the monumental vault portal

nodes.title: The Glass Archway
nodes.page:
Towering arches of fused green glass soar overhead, catching the amber beams of your lantern and refracting them into shifting emerald shards. You step across the grand threshold, entering the sweeping approach hall that leads straight toward the central lock chamber of the vault. The sound of your footsteps echoes against the translucent walls, bright and sharp in the silence.

Two distinct routes present themselves ahead in the vast chamber.

nodes.brief: Beside a colossal granite pillar inscribed with centuries of flood heights, you quicken your pace as distant water echoes grow louder.

exits.label: Move quickly toward the waiting lock cylinder

nodes.title: The Flood Pillar
nodes.page:
Centuries of recorded flood heights score the surface of a colossal granite pillar rising beside your path like a rugged stone tree. You quicken your pace as distant water echoes bounce through the hall, growing noticeably louder with each passing second. The air turns cool and humid, whispering of the rising tide waiting beyond the gates.

The corridor ahead leads directly toward the great lock.

nodes.brief: Within a narrowing corridor of polished basalt, your boots ring sharply against the floor as the air turns damp and cold.

exits.label: Step before the towering brass central seal
Advance toward the shadow of the vault portal

nodes.title: The Basalt Corridor
nodes.page:
Polished basalt walls narrow sharply around you, pressing the shadows inward until your lantern's glow is the only warm thing left in the world. Your boots ring with a sharp, metallic rhythm against the stone floor as the air grows steadily colder and damper. Every shadow seems to stretch and reach toward you from the dark crevices of the stone.

Two options lie ahead in the narrowing corridor.

nodes.brief: Under a ceiling of glittering salt stalactites, you spot the massive iron framework of the inner security gate looming ahead.

exits.label: Approach the iron lock cylinder
Step before the towering brass seal

nodes.title: The Salt Stalactites
nodes.page:
Glittering salt stalactites hang like jagged teeth from the low ceiling above, sparkling whenever your lantern light sweeps across them. Ahead, the massive iron framework of the inner security gate looms out of the haze, its heavy bars rusted into place over the centuries. You steady your breathing and step closer to examine the barrier.

Two paths open up beyond the security frame.

nodes.brief: Beside a row of unlit wall sconces shaped like open palms, you hold your coal-lantern high to pierce the gathering gloom.

exits.label: Step toward the lower passage
Follow the curving eastern gallery

nodes.title: The Open Palms
nodes.page: Beside a row of unlit wall sconces shaped like open palms, you hold your coal-lantern high to pierce the gathering gloom. The yellow light casts long, trembling shadows across carved sandstone reliefs that depict ancient water rites long forgotten by the valley folk. Every surface is caked in a fine, glittering layer of ancient salt crystals, making the very walls look as though they are frosted with rime. You pause to catch your breath, listening for the faint rumble of the distant monsoon waters echoing through the deep basalt strata.

nodes.brief: Within a vast hemispherical antechamber, the ground slopes gently toward the heavy brass threshold of the vault lock.

exits.label: Approach the central iron cylinder
Turn toward the lower passage
Follow the curving eastern gallery

nodes.title: The Brass Threshold
nodes.page: Within a vast hemispherical antechamber, the ground slopes gently toward the heavy brass threshold of the vault lock. Above your head, intricate geometric traceries carved into the vaulted ceiling gleam with faint phosphorescence as your lantern approaches. The air here is thin, dry, and bitterly cold, carrying the sharp tang of aged metal and dry desert dust. You steady the strap of your lantern across your shoulder and survey the imposing approaches that fan out into the deep recesses of the underground hall.

nodes.brief: Under a dome of dark stone streaked with white mineral veins, you stride past silent sentry alcoves empty of any living guard.

exits.label: Follow the curving eastern gallery

nodes.title: The Silent Alcoves
nodes.page: Under a dome of dark stone streaked with white mineral veins, you stride past silent sentry alcoves empty of any living guard. The floor beneath your boots is perfectly smooth, polished by centuries of dry desert winds that once whistled through these subterranean avenues before the great seals were dropped. Only the sputtering of your coal-lantern breaks the silence, casting a warm amber halo on the cold unyielding masonry on either side.

nodes.brief: Beside a pair of monumental bronze doors standing slightly ajar, you feel the suction of heavy air rushing into the vault core.

exits.label: Step toward the lower passage
Follow the curving eastern gallery

nodes.title: The Monumental Doors
nodes.page: Beside a pair of monumental bronze doors standing slightly ajar, dense air sucks past you into the vault core. The massive metal panels are etched with swirling patterns of rain clouds and lightning bolts, now sea-green with tarnish around the hinges. A thin draft whistles through the narrow gap, carrying the unmistakable scent of deep earth and moisture that heralds the approaching storm.

nodes.brief: Across the threshold of the great antechamber, you face the massive iron lock cylinder waiting for your next definitive action.

exits.label: Proceed to the lock chamber

nodes.title: The Iron Cylinder
nodes.page: Across the threshold of the great antechamber, you face the massive iron lock cylinder waiting for your next definitive action. The cold ceramic key in your pouch feels unnaturally heavy against your ribs, a silent reminder of the dried canals and desperate villages waiting far above in the blinding salt light. You raise your lamp over the stacked tumblers that hold the chance for Candlemere's fields to drink again.

nodes.brief: Before the towering brass face of the central seal, you steady your breathing as the heavy mechanism clicks in response.

exits.label: Proceed to the lock chamber
Retrace your steps back

nodes.title: The Central Seal
nodes.page: Before the towering brass face of the central seal, you slow your breath as the mechanism clicks at your approach. The air grows heavier still, vibrating with the latent power stored beneath the silent observatory city. You grip your lantern tighter, feeling the stark contrast between the warmth of your banked coals and the absolute chill radiating from the ancient lock.

nodes.brief: Within the shadow of the monumental vault portal, you raise your cold ceramic key toward the intricate locking tumbler slots.

exits.label: Proceed to the lock chamber

nodes.title: The Vault Portal
nodes.page: Within the shadow of the monumental vault portal, you raise your cold ceramic key toward the intricate locking tumbler slots. The smooth stone around the mechanism is worn down by generations of hands that sought the very same deliverance from the unending drought. Every second counts now as the distant rumble of the approaching monsoon grows louder through the rock.

nodes.brief: At the edge of the sunken lock platform, you prepare your hands to work the ancient levers before the rising waters arrive.

exits.label: Proceed to the lock chamber

nodes.title: The Sunken Platform
nodes.page: At the edge of the sunken lock platform, you prepare your hands to work the ancient levers before the rising waters arrive. The polished floor slopes down toward a dark trench where the subterranean runoff channels converge into a single, thirsty drain. You take one last look back at the winding corridors you have traversed, then square your shoulders against the biting draft.

nodes.title: The Obsidian Antechamber
nodes.page: Within the echoing obsidian antechamber, cold ceramic tiles hum against your boots as you weigh the final sacrifice of the seed. The air smells intensely of dry minerals and ancient stone, carrying a faint vibration through the floorboards from deep beneath the vault. Your fingers tighten around the cold ceramic key, feeling its weight and stillness against the rising tension in the chamber. Shadows stretch long and sharp across the polished walls as your banked lantern throws a dim circle of warmth over the floor.

nodes.brief: Beside the grinding basalt gears of the inner vault, a forgotten ledger lies open, detailing the bitter cost of past harvests.

nodes.title: The Basalt Gears
nodes.page: Beside the grinding basalt gears of the inner vault, a forgotten ledger lies open, detailing the bitter cost of past harvests in faded ink. The heavy machinery groans with a low, rhythmic vibration that rattles the dust motes suspended in the dim air. You trace the dry pages with a thumb, noting the columns of numbers and names of forgotten towns that perished when the rains failed generations ago. The smell of old paper and machine oil thickens around you, pressing close against your skin like a physical weight. Every gear turn brings the imminent arrival of the monsoon closer to the surface.

nodes.brief: Beneath a chandelier of fractured prisms, rusted iron levers groan under your grip while the heavy air tastes of ozone and dry salt.

nodes.title: Fractured Prisms
nodes.page: Beneath a chandelier of fractured prisms, rusted iron levers groan under your grip while the heavy air tastes of ozone and dry salt. Sharp slivers of amber light scatter across your shoulders as the overhead fixture sways slightly from subterranean drafts. Your muscles strain against the stubborn metal, locked in place by decades of neglect and mineral buildup. Every breath burns your throat with the fine dust of the dried sea basin. You have to force the mechanism to move or find another way forward before the corridor seals itself.

nodes.brief: Slipping past the sentry's blind spot with your darkened lantern, you discover an unsealed maintenance hatch bypassing the grinding bronze seals.

nodes.title: The Maintenance Hatch
nodes.page: Slipping past the sentry's blind spot with your darkened lantern, you discover an unsealed maintenance hatch bypassing the grinding bronze seals. The narrow metal corridor beyond smells of cool grease and stagnant subterranean damp, offering a quiet route away from the guarded main gates. Your fingers brush against the cold rivet heads as you slide sideways into the gloom, keeping your footsteps light and silent. The distant hum of the vault's inner machinery vibrates faintly through the floor beneath your boots. Ahead lies a choice of paths into the heart of the structure.

nodes.brief: In the alcove of weeping crystals, a saline condensation drips onto your bare shoulders as you inspect the cracked pneumatic seals.

exits.label: Insert your cold ceramic key into the vault door

Wedge a rigid copper tube against the jammed pneumatic seal
Leave an offering in the dry basin of the rain-seers

nodes.title: Weeping Crystals
nodes.page: In the alcove of weeping crystals, a saline condensation drips onto your bare shoulders as you inspect the cracked pneumatic seals. Each droplet hits the stone floor with a sharp, echoing ping that sounds unnaturally loud in the narrow corridor. The air here is heavy with moisture and the sharp tang of mineral salts. You run a finger along the fractured casing, feeling the faint hiss of escaping pressure from deep within the wall. A decision must be made before the seal gives way entirely.

nodes.brief: Across a chasm of singing glass plates, a spectral reflection mimics your every hesitation while the abyss hums a low, warning note.

exits.label: Leave a tribute in the dry rain-seer basin
Cross the trembling glass bridge above the deep shaft
Drop your ember-lamp into the singing abyss below

nodes.title: Singing Glass
nodes.page: Across a chasm of singing glass plates, a spectral reflection mimics your every hesitation while the abyss hums a low, warning note. The transparent floor beneath your boots vibrates in tune with the resonant tones rising from the dark depths. Every movement sends a shimmering wave of musical sound bouncing off the distant walls. You grip your lantern tightly, watching your own distorted image shift and fracture across the glass expanse. The path ahead requires an absolute commitment of balance and nerve.

nodes.brief: Beside a mural of fused silica depicting the ancient drought, you pry open a maintenance box to expose the sputtering control circuits.

exits.label: Cut the glowing red wire in the box
Reset the sputtering control circuit with a firm push
Close the metal maintenance box and walk away

nodes.title: Fused Silica Mural
nodes.page: Beside a mural of fused silica depicting the ancient drought, you pry open a maintenance box to expose the sputtering control circuits. Sparks of white light snap against your knuckles, casting brief, erratic shadows across the carved glass figures of starving citizens. The smell of scorched copper and ozone fills the cramped alcove as the wires buzz with unstable current. Your fingers hover over the exposed toggles, each one connected to a vital sector of the subterranean complex. You must act quickly before the circuitry fries completely.

nodes.brief: Within the narrow ventilation flue choked with white salt dust, your cramped fingers search for the hidden latch that releases the pressure valve.

exits.label: Press hard against the hidden iron latch
Kick outward with your boot against the ventilation wall

nodes.title: White Salt Flue
nodes.page: Within the narrow ventilation flue choked with white salt dust, your cramped fingers search for the hidden latch that releases the pressure valve. The abrasive powder coats your skin and throat, making every breath a dry, ragged cough. Above you the ceiling's metal plates groan beneath the city resting overhead. You slide your palm along the cold interior wall, feeling for the tiny notch carved into the ironwork. The space is claustrophobic, leaving no room for error or hesitation.

nodes.brief: In the vaulted gallery of hollow resonators, your heavy footsteps trigger a cascade of melodic echoes that threaten to wake the lower guardians.

exits.label: Move forward into the lower residential tier
Enter the blind panopticon of dead indicator lights
Investigate the mournful chime near the shattered quartz

nodes.title: Hollow Resonators
nodes.page: In the vaulted gallery of hollow vessels, each footfall sets off a cascade of melodic echoes that could wake the lower guardians. Ceramic vessels built into the stone walls catch and multiply every sound, turning a simple shuffle into a rolling chord of alarm. The air is cool and still, carrying the scent of ancient clay and dust. You freeze in place, waiting to see if the reverberations fade into the masonry or draw unwanted attention from the depths. A choice of directions opens before you in the dim light.

nodes.brief: Under the flickering amber glow of emergency beacons, a corroded brass valve resists your straining muscles as boiling steam hisses overhead.

exits.label: Descend into the freezing deep refrigeration tier
Enter the sunken gallery where sulfur fills the air

nodes.title: Emergency Beacons
nodes.page: Under the flickering amber glow of emergency beacons, a corroded brass valve resists your straining muscles as boiling steam hisses overhead. The harsh light turns the shadows into violent, jagged shapes that dance across the riveted iron walls. Scalding mist burns your forearms, and the metallic taste of hot condensation coats your tongue. You lean your entire body weight against the turning wheel, desperate to shut off the hazardous leak. The heat in the corridor is becoming unbearable.

nodes.brief: Because no debt binds your name to the basin, a wary archivist hands you the master schematic of the lower seed vaults without demanding a toll.

exits.label: Follow the path past the quartz chime
Descend into the sulfur-scented gallery
Trace the copper veins beneath the green glass

nodes.title: The Unbound Archivist
nodes.page:
Free of any toll-lord's ledger or well-keeper's oath, you stand before a hooded archivist whose fingers are stained with permanent indigo. Seeing your ledger clean of debt and your name unspooled from the Salt Court's demands, she wordlessly slides a master schematic of the lower seed vaults across the pitted zinc table. The vellum crackles with dry age, mapping every sealed conduit and forgotten bulkhead beneath Prism.

Outside the alcove, the air tastes of ancient dust and the low, resonant thrum of the approaching monsoon begins to vibrate through the floorboards beneath your boots, urging you to choose your route before the tunnels flood.

nodes.brief: Within the subterranean cistern of bitter brine, floating fragments of old maps swirl around your shins as you search for the emergency drainage plug.

exits.label: Head toward the quartz chime gallery
Search the sulfur-scented lower chamber
Seek the vaulted hall of green glass

nodes.title: The Brine Cistern
nodes.page:
Bitter brine laps against your shins, sending ripples through a floating mosaic of waterlogged paper maps that swirl in the dark water. You wade deeper into the subterranean cistern, holding your ember-lamp high to ward off the chill rising from the flooded floor. Somewhere beneath the surface turbulence, the emergency drainage plug waits to be found and hauled free, though the rusted iron ring might snap under too much strain.

The dark liquid stirs with every step, and you must decide whether to pry at the stuck drain, wade toward the echoing archway, or turn back before the rising water cuts off your retreat.

nodes.brief: Before the towering vault doors etched with the history of the lensfolk, your cold ceramic key fits into the intricate frost-patterned keyway.

exits.label: Enter the green glass vaulted hall
Approach the condensing tower's shadow

nodes.title: The Frost-Patterned Lock
nodes.page:
Towering slabs of dark basalt etched with the sprawling history of the lensfolk loom before you, dwarfing the narrow stone ledge. Your cold ceramic Seedkey fits snugly into the intricate, frost-patterned keyway, sliding into the ancient tumbler with a satisfying click that echoes down the corridor. A faint blue luminescence creeps along the carved grooves, signaling that the inner mechanism is ready to turn.

The weight of Candlemere's failed harvests rests entirely on your wrists, and the impending monsoon rattles the distant ventilation grates like a gathering storm.

nodes.brief: In the chamber of whispering lenses, hundreds of curved mirrors catch your lantern light and scatter blinding beams across the damp stone floor.

exits.label: Venture into the sulfur-scented gallery
